But it's the pizza-snacking super-powered tag team of Shaggy and Scooby-Doo who tap into their inner super hero to prevent the entire event from being smothered in ghoulish green goo! Like right on Dog Wonder!
tagline: Scooby-Doo Foils A Comic Cook Baddie!
title: Scooby-Doo! Mask of the Blue Falcon
plot:
Scooby-Doo! Mask of the Blue Falcon is an animated mystery film that revolves around the iconic characters from the classic series, with a unique twist on their personalities and relationships. The movie delves into the theme of identity and how it can be both a source of strength and weakness.

The main character, Fred Jones, struggles to come to terms with his role as the leader of the group, feeling overshadowed by the attention given to the Blue Falcon, a legendary superhero who is also a childhood idol. This internal conflict serves as a catalyst for the mystery that unfolds, as the gang must work together to uncover the truth behind the Blue Falcon's mask and the sinister forces driving it.

Throughout the film, the characters' relationships with each other are put to the test as they navigate their individual strengths and weaknesses. Shaggy and Scooby's insecurities about being part of a team lead to comedic moments, while Velma's analytical mind helps unravel the mystery. Daphne's confidence in her abilities is shaken when she realizes that her skills may not be as valuable as she thought.

The movie also explores the theme of nostalgia and how it can both unite and divide people. The gang's encounters with their past selves, who are trapped in a time loop, serve as a reminder of the importance of friendship and teamwork. Ultimately, the film suggests that true strength lies not in individual accomplishments but in the bonds between friends.

Overall, Scooby-Doo! Mask of the Blue Falcon is a heartwarming mystery that celebrates the power of friendship, teamwork, and embracing one's unique strengths and weaknesses.

overview: Walking with Dinosaurs 3D is a film depicting life-like 3D dinosaur characters set in photo-real landscapes that transports audiences to the prehistoric world as it existed 70 million years ago. The film is based on the 1999 documentary television miniseries Walking with Dinosaurs, produced by the BBC. Walking with Dinosaurs 3D is being produced by Evergreen Studios, the company that produced Happy Feet, and it is was released on October 11, 2013.
tagline: The Greatest Adventure in 70 Million Years
title: Walking with Dinosaurs
plot:
Walking with Dinosaurs is a 2013 documentary film that follows the life story of a young Pachyrhinosaurus named Patchi, from his birth to adulthood. The film is narrated by Fionn Whitehead and features stunning computer-generated imagery (CGI) animation.

The movie begins with the birth of Patchi, who emerges from his egg in the Late Jurassic period, around 75 million years ago. The scene is set in a lush, prehistoric forest filled with towering trees and teeming with life. Patchi's mother, a Pachyrhinosaurus matriarch, takes care of him, teaching him essential survival skills such as hunting and social behavior.

As Patchi grows, he faces numerous challenges, including fierce rivalries with other young dinosaurs, treacherous terrain, and the threat of predators like Tyrannosaurs. Despite these obstacles, Patchi perseveres, learning valuable lessons from his mother and other experienced dinosaurs.

One of the most significant plot points in the film is Patchi's encounter with a group of intelligent and social Troodons. The Troodons are depicted as being highly intelligent and resourceful, using tools to hunt and gather food. Patchi forms a close bond with one of the Troodons, who becomes his ally and friend.

As Patchi approaches adulthood, he faces a critical decision: whether to stay in his family group or venture out on his own. After much contemplation, Patchi decides to leave his family and explore the world beyond his forest home. This marks a significant turning point in his life, as he must rely solely on himself to survive.

The film's climax features an epic battle between Patchi and a Tyrannosaurus Rex. The two dinosaurs engage in a fierce fight, with Patchi using all his skills and cunning to outwit the predator. In the end, Patchi emerges victorious, having proven himself as a formidable hunter.

The movie concludes with Patchi, now a mature adult, standing proudly on a hill overlooking his forest home. He has come full circle, from a vulnerable hatchling to a confident and powerful dinosaur. The film ends with a sense of closure and new beginnings, as Patchi looks out towards the horizon, ready to face whatever challenges the future may hold.

Overall, Walking with Dinosaurs is an engaging and visually stunning documentary that explores the life cycle of a Pachyrhinosaurus. Through Patchi's journey, we gain insight into the social behavior, intelligence, and adaptability of these fascinating creatures.

belongs_to_collection.name: The Other Side of Heaven Collection

original_title: The Other Side of Heaven 2: Fire of Faith
overview: Missionary John H. Groberg returns to Tonga in the 1960s with his wife and their five young daughters. When their sixth child is born with a serious illness, the Grobergs face their ultimate test of faith, only to find themselves surrounded by the love and prayers of thousands of Tongans. Barriers of inter religious strife are soon broken down as all unite in hopes of a miracle that will save the baby's life, as well as the life of a Tongan minister's son.
title: The Other Side of Heaven 2: Fire of Faith
plot:
The Other Side of Heaven 2: Fire of Faith is a 2019 biographical adventure drama written and directed by Mitch Davis, a sequel to The Other Side of Heaven (2001). It is based on The Fire of Faith, the second memoir of John H. Groberg. Christopher Gorham returns as Groberg, with Natalie Medlock replacing Anne Hathaway as his wife Jean, Ben Baker as the minister Sione Paletu'a, Alex Tarrant as his son Toutai and Russell Dixon as Thomas S. Monson.

In the 1960s, ten years after his service as a young missionary in Tonga, Groberg is called to lead the Tonga–Fiji mission of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. He returns with Jean and their five daughters. Sione, a Tongan minister, is enraged to learn that his son Toutai plans to join the Church and become a missionary, and he sets out to thwart the missionaries. He punishes Toutai by burying him up to his neck in the sand on a beach as a storm approaches from the sea. When Toutai's brother tries to dig him out, he is struck by lightning, but Toutai survives against the odds.

Jean gives birth to the family's sixth child, a son who is born gravely ill. The baby is too sick to be taken off the island for the medical care he needs, and while she stays in the hospital, local people bring her gifts and fruit. In the same hospital, Sione's son lies in a coma. As both sons fight for their lives, the two fathers set aside their differences and comfort each other.

Davis had long refused to make a sequel, fearing a cheap imitation of the first film. He changed his mind after Groberg told him that the late Church president Thomas S. Monson had wanted both of his memoirs filmed, and after learning that Fiji offered a 47 percent film incentive. Cyclones Josie and Keni struck during filming. Hathaway was replaced for budget reasons. The film opened in U.S. theaters on June 28, 2019, deliberately released against Toy Story 4 and Spider-Man: Far From Home. It was the top faith-based film at the box office and grossed about $1.8 million. Critics were divided. The Deseret News called it a more thoughtful examination of its subject than the original, and The Salt Lake Tribune found it quietly powerful. Variety dismissed it as tedious and bland, and RogerEbert.com was largely negative despite praising its production values. It won the 2019 AML Award for narrative feature film.

overview: A man involved in a horrific car crash is pronounced dead, only to come back to life an hour and a half later, claiming to have seen Heaven.
tagline: Hope lives
title: 90 Minutes in Heaven
plot:
"90 Minutes in Heaven" is a 2015 American drama film directed by Michael Polish, based on the 2006 memoir of the same name by Don Piper. The movie stars Hayden Christensen as Don Piper and Kate Bosworth as Donna Piper.

The main themes of "90 Minutes in Heaven" include:

1. **Faith and Redemption**: The film explores Don's journey from a near-death experience to his return to life, and how it changes him spiritually. He struggles with the concept of faith and redemption, questioning why he was given a second chance.
2. **Love and Sacrifice**: The movie highlights the unconditional love and sacrifice of Donna Piper for her husband, Don. Her unwavering devotion inspires Don to re-evaluate his life and priorities.
3. **Personal Growth and Transformation**: As Don navigates his new reality, he undergoes significant personal growth, learning to appreciate the value of every moment and finding a deeper sense of purpose in life.
4. **The Power of Prayer**: The film emphasizes the importance of prayer and faith in overcoming adversity. Don's experiences demonstrate that prayer can be a powerful tool for healing, guidance, and transformation.

Throughout the movie, these themes are woven together to create a narrative that is both inspiring and thought-provoking.

overview: A punk rock band becomes trapped in a secluded venue after finding a scene of violence. For what they saw, the band themselves become targets of violence from a gang of white power skinheads, who want to eliminate all evidence of the crime.
tagline: One way in. No way out.
title: Green Room
plot:
Green Room is a 2015 American horror-thriller film directed by Jeremy Saulnier. The movie follows a young punk rock band that must fight for survival after witnessing a racist murder at a neo-Nazi skinhead bar.

The main themes of Green Room include:

1. **Racism and Xenophobia**: The film explores the dark underbelly of racism and xenophobia, highlighting the violent and intolerant attitudes of some groups towards others. The neo-Nazis in the movie embody these ideologies, leading to a tense and violent confrontation with the band.
2. **Punk Rock Culture**: Green Room celebrates punk rock culture, showcasing its energy, rebellion, and DIY ethos. The film's protagonist, Pat (Anton Yelchin), is a passionate and dedicated musician who finds solace in his music and the sense of community it provides.
3. **Violence and Escalation**: As the story unfolds, violence becomes increasingly intense and brutal, mirroring the escalating tensions between the band and the neo-Nazis. This theme serves as a commentary on how small incidents can escalate into larger conflicts.
4. **Moral Ambiguity**: The film's characters are often morally complex, with no clear heroes or villains. Pat, in particular, is forced to confront his own moral code when faced with the harsh realities of the situation.
5. **Survival and Resilience**: Despite being outnumbered and outgunned, the band members must use their wits, resourcefulness, and determination to survive. This theme highlights the human capacity for resilience in the face of adversity.

Overall, Green Room is a tense, thought-provoking thriller that explores themes of racism, violence, and survival through the lens of punk rock culture.

overview: Six deadly stories that explore the extremities of human behaviour involving distressed people seeking revenge.
tagline: We can all lose control
title: Wild Tales
plot:
Wild Tales (2014) is a Spanish anthology film directed by Pablo Larraín, produced by El Deseo, and written by Pedro Almodóvar. The film consists of six interconnected stories that explore various themes.

One of the main themes of Wild Tales is the exploration of human nature, particularly in relation to violence, morality, and the consequences of our actions. Each story presents a different character who commits a violent act, but as the narrative unfolds, it becomes clear that these acts are not just random outbursts, but rather a reflection of deeper psychological issues.

Another significant theme is the concept of social hierarchy and class divisions in Argentina. The film critiques the country's complex history of military dictatorships, economic inequality, and social stratification. Many characters in the stories embody different aspects of Argentine society, from wealthy elites to working-class individuals struggling to make ends meet.

The film also explores the idea of guilt, shame, and redemption. As the characters confront their past actions, they are forced to confront their own moral failings and seek forgiveness or redemption. This theme is particularly evident in the story of "The Old Man," who seeks revenge against a group of wealthy tourists who have wronged him.

Furthermore, Wild Tales touches on the theme of storytelling itself. The film's narrative structure, which consists of six interconnected stories, blurs the lines between reality and fiction, highlighting the subjective nature of truth and the power of storytelling to shape our perceptions of the world.

Overall, Wild Tales is a thought-provoking exploration of human nature, social hierarchy, guilt, shame, and redemption, all woven together by a complex narrative structure that challenges the audience to piece together the stories and their connections.

overview: Between personal obligations and training for his next big fight against an opponent with ties to his family's past, Adonis Creed is up against the challenge of his life.
tagline: There's More to Lose than a Title
title: Creed II
plot:
Creed II is a 2018 American sports drama film directed by Steven Caple Jr. and written by Ryan Coogler and Zach Baylin. The movie serves as a sequel to the 2015 film Creed, which was a spin-off of the Rocky franchise.

The story takes place four years after the events of the first film. Adonis Creed (Michael B. Jordan), now a successful boxer, is facing pressure from his father's legacy and the expectations of those around him. He is also struggling to find his own identity outside of his famous lineage.

Meanwhile, Ivan Drago (Dmitriy Badyakin), the formidable Soviet boxer who defeated Apollo Creed in the infamous 1985 fight, has retired from boxing. However, he is approached by a mysterious figure who convinces him to come out of retirement and face Adonis in the ring.

As Adonis prepares for the big match, he also begins to explore his family's past and the truth about his father's death. He discovers that Apollo was killed by Ivan Drago, not just from a boxing accident as previously thought. This revelation sets Adonis on a path of revenge against Ivan Drago.

The film takes us through Adonis' training with Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone), who becomes a mentor to him in both the ring and out of it. As Adonis trains, he also delves deeper into his family's history and the circumstances surrounding Apollo's death.

As the big match approaches, tensions rise between Adonis and Ivan Drago. The two boxers engage in a series of intense training sessions, each trying to gain an edge over the other. Meanwhile, Adonis' personal life becomes increasingly complicated as he struggles to balance his relationships with those around him.

The film's climax features an epic boxing match between Adonis and Ivan Drago. The fight is intense and brutal, with both boxers giving it their all. In the end, Adonis emerges victorious, but not without scars both physically and emotionally.

Throughout the film, there are also themes of identity, legacy, and redemption explored. Adonis must come to terms with his own identity and find a way to forge his own path in life, separate from his famous father's shadow. The film ultimately concludes on a hopeful note, with Adonis having found a sense of purpose and belonging.

Overall, Creed II is a powerful and emotional film that explores the complexities of family, legacy, and identity. With outstanding performances from Michael B. Jordan and Sylvester Stallone, the film delivers an unforgettable cinematic experience.

overview: 16-year old Rhiannon falls in love with a mysterious spirit named “A” that inhabits a different body every day. Feeling an unmatched connection, Rhiannon and “A” work each day to find each other, not knowing what the next day will bring.
tagline: Every day a different body. Every day a different life. Every day in love with the same girl.
title: Every Day
plot:
Every Day is a 2018 American romantic fantasy drama directed by Michael Sucsy and written by Jesse Andrews, based on David Levithan's 2012 novel. Angourie Rice stars as Rhiannon, a 16-year-old who falls in love with a wandering soul that wakes up each morning in a different body. Justice Smith plays her boyfriend Justin, Debby Ryan plays Jolene, Maria Bello plays Rhiannon's mother Lindsey and Owen Teague plays Alexander.

"A" is a spirit who lives each day in the body of a different teenager. One morning A wakes up as Justin, Rhiannon's neglectful boyfriend, skips school with her and falls in love as she confides about her troubled family. She tells A, whom she believes to be Justin, that their day should end on "a nice note". The next day, the real Justin is careless again and remembers nothing. A keeps finding her, at one point as Nathan at a party, telling her she deserves better than Justin. Later, as Megan, A explains the truth. As James, A reveals that the body-switching has gone on since infancy and shows Rhiannon a private Instagram account documenting every life. As Vic, a transgender teen, A persuades her that the soul matters more than the body, and she agrees to keep meeting.

One day A wakes up as Rhiannon herself and respectfully spends the day bonding with her family. Rhiannon leaves Justin and spends a weekend with A at her uncle's cabin, but A later fails to appear, having woken in a patient undergoing a lung transplant. A refuses to leave lasting marks on the lives of others, though in Kelsea's body A stays alive until the suicidal girl's father can be alerted. When A becomes Rhiannon's classmate Alexander, she asks A to stay in his body indefinitely. It works briefly, but A cannot bear to take over someone else's life. Knowing they cannot have a future together, the couple spend one last night dancing and talking, and A tells her that "this is the nice note". The next morning, A wakes up as a girl named Katie and drives off to New York, while Rhiannon meets the real Alexander at school.

It was shot in Toronto in 2017. Orion Pictures released it on February 23, 2018, after several date changes. It opened ninth and grossed $12.8 million worldwide. In the United Kingdom, four seconds showing suicide methods were cut to earn a 12A certificate. Reviews were mixed. Rotten Tomatoes reported 64% approval, with a consensus that the film wastes its metaphysical premise on shallow storytelling but is enlivened by its diverse young cast.

overview: After discovering her boyfriend is married, Carly soon meets the wife he's been cheating on. And when yet another affair is discovered, all three women team up to plot mutual revenge on the three-timing SOB.
tagline: The oddest friends are about to get even
title: The Other Woman
plot:
The Other Woman is a 2014 American romantic comedy film directed by Adam Brooks and starring Cameron Diaz, Leslie Mann, and Kate Upton.

The movie follows the story of three women - Kate King (Cameron Diaz), Elizabeth (Leslie Mann), and Robin (Kate Upton) - who discover that they are all being cheated on by the same man, Dylan Harper (Nikolaj Coster-Waldau). As they navigate their relationships with each other and with Dylan, they learn to support and empower each other.

The main themes of The Other Woman include:

1. Female empowerment: The movie showcases the strength and resilience of women who are often marginalized or overlooked in society. Through their shared experiences, the characters learn to stand up for themselves and support one another.
2. Friendship and sisterhood: The film highlights the importance of female friendships and the bonds that form between women. As the characters navigate their relationships with each other, they develop a strong sense of camaraderie and trust.
3. Self-discovery and growth: Throughout the movie, the characters undergo significant personal growth and self-discovery. They learn to let go of their insecurities and focus on their own happiness and well-being.
4. Revenge and empowerment: The movie features a comedic take on revenge, as the women use their newfound knowledge to exact their own brand of justice on Dylan. However, this theme is ultimately subverted as the characters realize that seeking revenge is not the key to true happiness.

Overall, The Other Woman is a fun and engaging romantic comedy that explores themes of female empowerment, friendship, self-discovery, and growth.

overview: Derek and Hansel are modelling again when an opposing company attempts to take them out from the business.
tagline: Long time no Z
title: Zoolander 2
plot:
Zoolander 2 (promoted as Zoolander No. 2) is an American action comedy of 2016 directed and co-produced by Ben Stiller, who wrote it with Justin Theroux, John Hamburg and Nicholas Stoller. The sequel to Zoolander (2001), it reunites Stiller as Derek Zoolander, Owen Wilson as Hansel and Will Ferrell as Mugatu, with Penélope Cruz as the Interpol agent Valentina Valencia, Kristen Wiig as the designer Alexanya Atoz, Kyle Mooney as Don Atari, Cyrus Arnold as Derek Zoolander Jr. and cameos from Benedict Cumberbatch, Sting and many celebrities.

Valentina, a former swimsuit model in Interpol's fashion division, notices that murdered pop stars died making Derek's trademark "Blue Steel" look. Years earlier, Derek's Center for Kids Who Can't Read Good collapsed, killing his wife Matilda and injuring Hansel, while Mugatu was jailed for life. Having lost custody of his son, Derek became a hermit in the far north of New Jersey. Billy Zane persuades him and Hansel to attend a show by the couture queen Alexanya, where the out-of-date pair are humiliated by a new generation of hipster designers. Valentina recruits them to help find the killer, and through her Derek finds his son at an orphanage but is dismayed that the boy is overweight; urged by Matilda's ghost, he tries to bond with him.

At St. Peter's Basilica, Sting reveals that the stars died protecting a secret: the bloodline of Steve, a forgotten third human after Adam and Eve and ancestor of all models, whose closest descendant, Derek Jr., holds the key to the Fountain of Youth. Derek Jr. is abducted, Mugatu escapes from fashion prison and Alexanya is unmasked as his henchwoman Katinka. At a lavish ball, Mugatu plans to sacrifice the boy, revealing that he gathered the world's designers to kill them and that he sabotaged Derek's centre. Derek holds back a bomb with his "Magnum" look until Sting, revealed as Hansel's father, joins him, Hansel and Derek Jr. in hurling it back at Mugatu. Derek reconciles with his son and finds love with Valentina, and a reformed Mugatu joins the celebrations.

Shot in Rome in 2015 and released by Paramount, the film premiered in London in February 2016, where Stiller set a world record for the longest selfie stick. It grossed $56.7 million worldwide on a $50 million budget and was panned, scoring 21% on Rotten Tomatoes.

overview: Samantha Kingston has everything. Then, everything changes. After one fateful night, she wakes up with no future at all. Trapped into reliving the same day over and over, she begins to question just how perfect her life really was.
tagline: What if today was the only day of the rest of your life?
title: Before I Fall
plot:
"Before I Fall" is a 2017 American teen drama film directed by Richard Tanne and written by Lauren Oliver. The movie is based on the novel of the same name by Lauren Oliver.

The main theme of "Before I Fall" revolves around the concept of time loops, fate, and personal growth. The story follows Samantha (Zoey Deutch), a high school student who dies in a car accident on her 18th birthday. However, she finds herself reliving the same day over and over again, with slight variations each time.

As Samantha tries to make sense of her situation, she begins to re-evaluate her relationships, priorities, and choices. She starts to focus on making amends with those around her, particularly her friends and family members who are struggling with their own issues.

Throughout the film, the themes of mortality, regret, and self-discovery are woven throughout the narrative. Samantha's time loops allow her to learn from her mistakes and try again, but she also comes to realize that some things in life cannot be changed or controlled.

The movie explores the idea that our lives are shaped by the choices we make, and that sometimes, it takes a second chance (or multiple chances) to appreciate the people and experiences that truly matter. The film's message is one of hope, resilience, and the importance of living in the present moment.

Overall, "Before I Fall" is a thought-provoking and emotional drama that encourages viewers to reflect on their own values, priorities, and relationships.

overview: Drifting aimlessly through life, Kaisi has racked up debts of several million having borrowed money from his friends. Lured with the promise of writing it all off, Kaisi leaves his ailing mother and childhood sweetheart Qing to board the ship Destiny and attend a gambling party controlled by the mysterious Anderson. All players join the game with stars. For each game they lose, their opponent captures a star. Everyone is holding daggers behind their backs plotting dirty means by which to overcome their opponents. The game quickly deteriorates into a slaughter and Kaisi must battle save his own skin.
title: Animal World
plot:
Animal World (Chinese: 动物世界), also known as Animal World: Mr. Nobody, is a 2018 Chinese action-adventure film written and directed by Han Yan and based on Nobuyuki Fukumoto's manga Kaiji. Li Yifeng stars as Zheng Kaisi, with Michael Douglas as Anderson, Zhou Dongyu as Liu Qing, Cao Bingkun as Li Jun, Wang Ge as Meng Xiaopang ("Fatty Meng") and Su Ke as Zhang Jingkun.

Kaisi works a poorly paid job and struggles to cover his mother's medical bills, relying on help from his girlfriend Liu Qing, a nurse. On the advice of his friend Li Jun, he mortgages his mother's apartment to invest in a property scheme, which collapses and leaves him even deeper in debt. Anderson, the man who holds his debt, invites him aboard the ship Destiny, where players from around the world gamble on games of rock paper scissors. Each player receives cards representing rock, paper or scissors and three stars, which are won or lost with each match. To leave the ship, a player must use up all of their cards while keeping at least three stars.

Another player, Zhang Jingkun, proposes they tie all their matches but betrays Kaisi, leaving him one star. Kaisi teams up with Li Jun, also aboard, and Fatty Meng, another one-star player. Kaisi's talent for mathematics and probability lets him choose winning matches and guide his teammates. When Jingkun tries to lure him away, Kaisi refuses and exposes the fact that Jingkun has marked the cards. Left with one card and no one willing to play him, Jingkun is offered a final match by Kaisi, who wants revenge by forcing him to slap himself. Kaisi loses all his stars and is taken to the "black room", where he waits for his teammates to rescue him. Li Jun and Fatty Meng win the stars they need with his strategy, but Fatty Meng persuades Li Jun to sell them instead to clear their own debts. Kaisi tricks his way out of the black room and uses the money his former teammates earned to buy freedom for another betrayed player. He returns to Liu Qing a changed man. In an epilogue, he realizes that Anderson is the man who killed his father.

It was filmed in 2017. The film premiered at the 21st Shanghai International Film Festival and opened in China on June 29, 2018. It topped the Chinese box office, displacing Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom, and grossed about CN¥510 million in China, for a worldwide total of roughly $77.4 million. Netflix acquired its global digital rights. Reviews were mainly positive.

overview: When Rex finds himself left behind in the bathroom, he puts his limbs to use by getting a bath going for a bunch of new toy friends.
tagline: An Electro Sudsy Good Time!
title: Partysaurus Rex
plot:
Partysaurus Rex is an animated science fiction comedy film that revolves around the adventures of a young dinosaur named Rex, who dreams of becoming a party animal. The movie explores the theme of self-discovery and embracing one's individuality.

The story delves into Rex's desire to fit in with his peers and be accepted by the other dinosaurs on the planet Dinosauria. However, as he navigates through various social situations, Rex learns that being true to oneself is more important than trying to conform to societal expectations.

Throughout the film, there are also undertones of friendship and loyalty, particularly between Rex and a young triceratops named Spike. The movie showcases the importance of having supportive friends who accept you for who you are, and not judging others based on their differences.

The film's lighthearted tone and comedic elements add to its playful and carefree atmosphere, making it an entertaining ride for audiences of all ages. Overall, Partysaurus Rex is a heartwarming tale about embracing one's uniqueness and finding happiness in being oneself.

overview: Summer, New York City. A college girl falls hard for a guy she just met. After a night of partying goes wrong, she goes to wild extremes to get him back.
title: White Girl
plot:
White Girl is a 2016 American crime thriller film directed by Elizabeth Woods and written by Amy Holden Jones. The movie follows the story of Alexis, a young woman who becomes embroiled in a complex web of deceit and violence after she accidentally kills a man while driving under the influence.

At its core, White Girl explores themes of privilege, entitlement, and the destructive nature of toxic masculinity. The film critiques the societal norms that allow men to behave with impunity, particularly those from wealthy and influential backgrounds who feel entitled to power and respect. Through Alexis's character, the movie highlights the ways in which a sense of entitlement can lead individuals to engage in reckless and destructive behavior.

The film also delves into the complexities of female relationships and the ways in which women can both enable and be enabled by toxic masculinity. As Alexis navigates her complicated web of relationships with men, she must confront the ways in which she has been socialized to prioritize their needs and desires over her own.

Furthermore, White Girl touches on themes of class and privilege, highlighting the disparities between those who are born into wealth and privilege and those who are not. The film suggests that these disparities can lead to a sense of disconnection and isolation, as individuals from different backgrounds struggle to understand and relate to one another.

Ultimately, White Girl is a thought-provoking exploration of the darker aspects of human nature, revealing the ways in which societal norms and expectations can both enable and destroy us.

overview: A look at how climate change affects our environment and what society can do to prevent the demise of endangered species, ecosystems, and native communities across the planet.
tagline: The science is clear, the future is not.
title: Before the Flood
plot:
Before the Flood is a 2016 American documentary film about climate change directed by Fisher Stevens, a producer of the Oscar-winning The Cove, and written by Mark Monroe. Created by Stevens with Leonardo DiCaprio, who presents and narrates it, the film was produced by Appian Way, RatPac Documentary Films and National Geographic, with Martin Scorsese among the executive producers. It premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival in September 2016, opened in a limited number of American cinemas on 21 October and was broadcast by the National Geographic Channel on 30 October in 171 countries. Its score features music by Trent Reznor and Atticus Ross, Gustavo Santaolalla and Mogwai.

The film follows DiCaprio, appointed a United Nations Messenger of Peace on climate change in 2014, on a three-year journey around the world to document the impact of global warming. He travels by snowmobile along the coast of Greenland, where melting ice is turning the region from a reflector of sunlight into an absorber of heat, flies over the Canadian oil sands, visits Miami Beach as it raises its streets against rising seas, and sees the burning rainforests of Sumatra cleared for palm oil plantations. In India he visits flood-ravaged farmland, in Kiribati he sees communities already displaced by flooding, and at NASA he studies ocean models with astronaut and scientist Piers Sellers, who was then living with terminal cancer. He meets Barack Obama, Pope Francis, Ban Ki-moon, John Kerry and Elon Musk, whom he joins at the Tesla Gigafactory, as well as Sunita Narain and scientists including Johan Rockström and Michael E. Mann.

DiCaprio uses Hieronymus Bosch's triptych The Garden of Earthly Delights, a reproduction of which hung above his crib as a child, as an analogy for humanity's path toward ruin, and the film also draws on the production of his film The Revenant. It devotes particular attention to climate change denial among American politicians and lobbyists, and argues for a carbon tax to shift investment to renewable energy; the production offset its own emissions through a voluntary carbon tax.

Streamed free in the week before the 2016 US election, the film was viewed by more than 60 million people within weeks. Reviews were generally positive: Rotten Tomatoes gave it a 75 percent approval rating, and The Guardian called it a heartfelt, educational documentary about the most important issue of the time. It won a Hollywood Film Award for best documentary.

overview: Elastigirl springs into action to save the day, while Mr. Incredible faces his greatest challenge yet – taking care of the problems of his three children.
tagline: Back to work.
title: Incredibles 2
plot:
Incredibles 2 is a 2018 animated superhero film produced by Pixar Animation Studios and released by Walt Disney Pictures. The movie serves as a sequel to the 2004 film The Incredibles.

The story begins with Mr. Incredible (Bob Parr), Elastigirl (Helen Parr), Violet, Dash, and Jack-Jack living in a seemingly ordinary suburban life. However, their peaceful existence is disrupted when a mysterious villain known as Screenslaver starts using technology to control people's minds, forcing them to do his bidding.

The Screenslaver, later revealed to be Winston Deavor (a wealthy businessman), uses his advanced technology to manipulate the public's perception of superheroes, making it seem like they are villains. This creates an opportunity for Mr. Incredible and Elastigirl to take on a high-profile mission to stop the villain and restore their reputation.

As the story unfolds, we see the Parr family struggling to balance their superhero lives with their everyday responsibilities. The children, Violet and Dash, are dealing with their own personal issues - Violet is trying to navigate her teenage years while hiding her superpowers from her peers, and Dash is struggling to control his speed.

Meanwhile, Elastigirl takes on a high-profile mission to stop the Screenslaver, while Mr. Incredible stays behind to take care of the children. However, as Elastigirl delves deeper into the mystery, she discovers that Winston Deavor's true intentions are far more sinister than initially thought.

As the story progresses, we see the Parr family facing various challenges and obstacles, including a confrontation with the villainous Underminer (a character from the first film). The family also receives help from Frozone (Lucius Best), who becomes an ally in their quest to stop the Screenslaver.

In the climactic final act, Elastigirl faces off against Winston Deavor, who reveals his true identity as a former superhero turned villain. The battle is intense, with both characters using their powers and technology to try and gain the upper hand.

Ultimately, Elastigirl emerges victorious, but not before realizing that her family's happiness and well-being are more important than her superhero reputation. The movie ends on a heartwarming note, with the Parr family reunited and ready to face whatever challenges come their way.

Throughout the film, Pixar explores themes of identity, family, and the importance of finding balance between personal and professional lives. The animation is stunning, with vibrant colors and intricate details that bring the characters and world to life.

Overall, Incredibles 2 is a fun, action-packed animated film that is sure to delight both children and adults alike. With its engaging storyline, lovable characters, and stunning animation, it's a must-see for fans of superhero movies and Pixar films.

original_title: Whitney Houston: I Wanna Dance with Somebody
overview: The joyous, emotional, heartbreaking celebration of the life and music of Whitney Houston, the greatest female R&B pop vocalist of all time. Tracking her journey from obscurity to musical superstardom.
tagline: This Christmas celebrate the untold story of an icon.
title: Whitney Houston: I Wanna Dance with Somebody
plot:
Whitney Houston: I Wanna Dance with Somebody is an American biographical musical drama of 2022 directed by Kasi Lemmons from a screenplay by Anthony McCarten, tracing the life and career of the pop star Whitney Houston. Naomi Ackie plays Houston, with Stanley Tucci as the record executive Clive Davis, Ashton Sanders as Bobby Brown, Tamara Tunie as her mother Cissy, Nafessa Williams as her friend Robyn Crawford and Clarke Peters as her father John.

In 1983, nineteen-year-old Whitney sings in a church choir under the exacting eye of her mother, a professional singer, and her friendship with Robyn becomes a romance that upsets Cissy. At the Sweetwaters nightclub, Cissy feigns illness so that Whitney must sing "The Greatest Love of All" in front of Clive Davis, who signs her to Arista Records on the spot. Her television debut leads to the massive success of her first album, but her controlling father, acting as her manager, pushes her to date men, and she ends the romance with Robyn while keeping her close as a friend and assistant. "I Wanna Dance with Somebody" makes her a crossover star, though some accuse her of not sounding black enough, and she meets Bobby Brown at the 1988 Soul Train Music Awards.

At her peak in the early 1990s she sings the national anthem at the Super Bowl, makes her acting debut in The Bodyguard, marries Bobby and gives birth to their daughter, Bobbi Kristina, and performs for Nelson Mandela in South Africa. But her marriage is turbulent, she turns to cocaine, and she discovers that her father has squandered much of her fortune, forcing her into a $100 million contract with an exhausting world tour. Robyn leaves after Whitney refuses to cut the tour short, and Whitney cuts off her father, skipping his funeral. Cissy has her arrested to force her into rehab; sober, she reconnects with her daughter and divorces Bobby in 2007. A 2009 comeback falters when her voice fails her on tour. On 11 February 2012, at the Beverly Hilton before Davis's pre-Grammy party, she sings "Home" softly to herself while preparing drugs in her bath, and dies. The film closes with her acclaimed medley at the 1994 American Music Awards.

Shot in Massachusetts and New Jersey in late 2021 on a $45 million budget, the film was released by Sony on 23 December 2022 and grossed $59.8 million worldwide. Reviews were mixed, with 43% on Rotten Tomatoes, and Ackie earned a BAFTA Rising Star nomination.

overview: On Halloween, Mickey tells a tale of two witches-in-training, Minnie and Daisy, who must pass four tests to graduate from the With Academy in Happy Haunt Hills.
title: Mickey's Tale of Two Witches
plot:
Mickey's Tale of Two Witches is a 2021 American animated Halloween television special produced by Disney Television Animation for Disney Junior. Directed by Jeff Gordon and written by Thomas Hart, it runs about 46 minutes and was the first special spun off from the series Mickey Mouse Mixed-Up Adventures, followed later in 2021 by Mickey and Minnie Wish Upon a Christmas. It premiered on Disney Junior on 7 October 2021, was made available on DisneyNow, and began streaming on Disney+ the following day.

On Halloween, Mickey tells Pluto a story about two witches-in-training, Minnie the Wonderful and Daisy Doozy, who must pass four magical tests set by Witch Master Clarabelle in order to graduate from the Witch Academy in Happy Haunt Hills. Daisy doubts herself at every test. Their studies are disrupted when a mischievous ghost gets hold of the powerful Moo Wand, and the two apprentices join forces with Count Mickula and the rest of the gang, who appear in Halloween guises such as Franken-Goof, Mummy Donald and Werewolfy Pluto, to defeat him. Along the way Minnie and Daisy learn that working together makes both their magic and their friendship stronger.

The voice cast is led by Bret Iwan as Mickey and Count Mickula, Kaitlyn Robrock as Minnie, Tress MacNeille as Daisy and April Winchell as Clarabelle, with Bill Farmer as Goofy and Pluto, Daniel Ross as Donald, Jim Cummings as Pete the Ghost, Nika Futterman as Cuckoo-Loca and Frank Welker as Figaro and Butch the Bulldog. The special features four songs: "How to Witch", sung by the two witches and their teacher; "The Fright Stuff", performed by Pete the Ghost; "Spooky Side"; and the finale "Spooky Spirit".

Its first airing on Disney Junior drew about 350,000 viewers, and a Disney Channel rebroadcast the next morning about 300,000. Critics recommended it as Halloween viewing for young children: Kristy Ambrose of TheGamer named it one of the best Disney Halloween films, praising its sweetness and its message that magic works best when friendship is the main ingredient, Real Simple called it a "super sweet" choice for families, and Good Housekeeping and Romper highlighted its emphasis on teamwork and its songs and spells. It was nominated at the 2023 Kidscreen Awards, and in July 2023 Disney Publishing Worldwide released a tie-in book.

overview: A drama about explorer John Smith and the clash between Native Americans and English settlers in the 17th century.
tagline: Once discovered, it was changed forever.
title: The New World
plot:
The New World is a 2005 historical romantic drama written and directed by Terrence Malick, his fourth feature. It depicts the founding of Jamestown, Virginia. Colin Farrell plays Smith and newcomer Q'orianka Kilcher plays Pocahontas, with Christian Bale as John Rolfe, Christopher Plummer as Captain Newport, August Schellenberg as Powhatan and Wes Studi as Opechancanough.

In 1607, Pocahontas, the adventurous daughter of Chief Powhatan, watches three English ships arrive to found a colony. Aboard is Smith, condemned for mutinous talk but pardoned on landing by the expedition's leader, Newport. Disease, shortages and tensions with the Native people soon threaten the colony. Trading upriver, Smith is captured and brought before Powhatan. He is about to be executed when Pocahontas intervenes. Living among the tribe, Smith admires their way of life and falls in love with Pocahontas. Powhatan sends him back on the understanding that the English will leave in the spring. Smith finds Jamestown in chaos, is made its leader and comes to see his time with the tribe as "a dream". During a brutal winter, the starving settlers are saved by Pocahontas, who brings food and supplies.

Realizing the English will not leave, Powhatan attacks Jamestown and banishes his daughter. Smith is imprisoned for opposing a plan to abduct her as a bargaining chip, but they reunite when she is brought to the fort. Offered his own expedition to find a passage to the East Indies, Smith chooses his career and leaves, arranging for Pocahontas to be told he has died. Grief-stricken, she is comforted by Rolfe. She is baptized, marries him and has a son, Thomas. Learning that Smith is alive, she is shaken, but on a voyage to England she meets him privately. He admits he may have chosen wrongly and calls their time together "the only truth", and they part forever. She finally embraces Rolfe as her husband but falls ill and dies at Gravesend before they can sail home.

Malick was still editing when the planned release arrived. A 150-minute cut played briefly in December 2005 to qualify for awards, and he cut it to 135 minutes for its wide release in January 2006. It failed at the box office. Rotten Tomatoes reported 63% approval, noting its arresting visuals but unfocused narrative. Roger Ebert gave it four stars and called Malick a visionary. Emmanuel Lubezki's cinematography earned an Academy Award nomination, and several critics later ranked it among the decade's best films.

overview: When a law-abiding woman gets indicted for murdering her husband, her lawyer soon realizes that a larger conspiracy may be at work.
tagline: Every Woman Has A Breaking Point
title: A Fall from Grace
plot:
A Fall from Grace is a 2020 American thriller film produced, written and directed by Tyler Perry, the first of his films to be released by Netflix. It follows a novice attorney who defends a woman accused of killing the charming new husband who turned out to be a dangerous man. Crystal Fox, Phylicia Rashād, Bresha Webb and Mehcad Brooks star, and the cast includes Cicely Tyson in her final film role before her death in January 2021. Principal photography took place at Tyler Perry Studios in the fall of 2018 over just five days.

Jasmine Bryant is a public defender in a small Virginia town who routinely settles her cases with plea deals, while her husband Jordan, a police officer, is shaken after failing to save an elderly woman. Her boss Rory assigns her the case of Grace Waters, a woman charged with murdering her husband, Shannon DeLong. Grace insists she is guilty and wants only a plea deal that keeps her near her son Malcolm, but Jasmine is troubled by the case, not least because Shannon's body has never been found, and she decides to take it to trial despite Rory's objections about the cost and the media attention. Grace explains that after her divorce, her best friend Sarah Miller encouraged her to meet someone new, and she married Shannon, an artist, three months after meeting him at a gallery. He soon became cruel and secretive, stole from her accounts and forged documents to mortgage her house, she eventually lost her job at the bank, and on the final night she caught him in bed with another woman, beat him with a baseball bat and pushed him down the basement stairs. At trial Jasmine's defense collapses when Sarah admits on the stand that Grace confessed the killing to her, and Grace is convicted. As she is led away, however, Grace notices that Sarah is wearing a pendant identical to a supposedly one-of-a-kind piece of Shannon's, and she begins to see Sarah's hand in every stage of her relationship. Jasmine, now fired, visits Sarah's home, where she uncovers a sinister secret involving elderly women held captive, putting her own life in danger as Jordan races to find her.

Netflix released the film on January 17, 2020, and it was watched by 26 million viewers in its first week. Critics panned it, particularly its screenplay, giving it a 15% rating on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 34, and viewers noted visible production errors such as boom microphones; the improvised line "Ashtray, bitch!" became an internet meme.

overview: Four couples, all friends, descend on a tropical island resort. Though one husband and wife are there to work on their marriage, the others just want to enjoy some fun in the sun. They soon find, however, that paradise comes at a price: Participation in couples therapy sessions is mandatory. What started out as a cut-rate vacation turns into an examination of the common problems many face.
tagline: It may be paradise... but it's no vacation.
title: Couples Retreat
plot:
Couples Retreat is a 2009 American romantic comedy film directed by Peter Billingsley and written by Mark Perez. The movie stars Jason Bateman, Vince Vaughn, Malin Åkerman, Faizon Love, Kristin Bell, and Jon Favreau.

The story revolves around four couples who embark on a couples' retreat in Costa Rica, led by Dr. Harrison Copeland (Jon Favreau), a therapist specializing in relationship issues. The couples are all struggling with their relationships, and they hope that the retreat will help them work through their problems and strengthen their bonds.

The four couples are:

* Jason (Jason Bateman) and Cynthia (Malin Åkerman), who are on the verge of breaking up due to their differences.
* Dave (Vince Vaughn) and Ronnie (Faizon Love), a couple with a troubled past, including infidelity and addiction issues.
* Blake (Kristin Bell) and Jason's friend, Jimmy (Jon Favreau), who is in a relationship that feels unfulfilling.

Upon arrival at the retreat center, the couples are initially resistant to the idea of working through their problems. However, as they participate in various exercises and activities designed by Dr. Copeland, they begin to open up and share their feelings with each other.

Through a series of challenges and group therapy sessions, the couples start to confront their issues and work towards healing and growth. Jason and Cynthia have a breakthrough when they realize that their differences are not insurmountable, while Dave and Ronnie face their demons and make amends.

As the retreat progresses, Jimmy and Blake begin to re-evaluate their relationship and discover new feelings for each other. The couples also learn valuable lessons about communication, trust, and intimacy.

In the end, the couples depart from the retreat center with a newfound appreciation for each other and a renewed commitment to their relationships. Jason and Cynthia share a romantic kiss, while Dave and Ronnie make amends and work towards rebuilding their relationship. Jimmy and Blake confess their feelings for each other, and the movie ends on a hopeful note.

Throughout the film, the cast delivers witty banter and comedic performances, making Couples Retreat an entertaining and lighthearted watch. The movie's themes of relationships, communication, and personal growth are timely and relatable, making it a enjoyable and engaging romantic comedy.

overview: In an effort to repair their relationship, a couple books a vacation in the countryside for themselves and their daughter. What starts as a perfect retreat begins to fall apart as one loses their grip on reality, and a sinister force tries to tear them apart.
tagline: The house finds you
title: You Should Have Left
plot:
You Should Have Left is a 2020 American horror film directed by Christopher Landon and written by Christopher Landon and Jeff Buhler. The movie stars Paul Rudd, Amelia Eve, and Lauren Lapkus.

The main themes of You Should Have Left revolve around the idea of isolation, the supernatural, and the psychological effects of being trapped in a remote location with no escape. The story follows Stephen Merchant's character, David Harp, who takes his family on a vacation to a remote cabin in the woods, hoping to reconnect with them after a difficult period.

However, things take a dark turn when they discover that the cabin has a mind of its own and seems to be exerting a malevolent influence over them. As the family tries to survive and escape, they realize that their isolation is not just physical but also emotional, as they are forced to confront their deepest fears and secrets.

The movie explores themes of:

1. Isolation: The film takes place in a remote cabin with no phone signal or way to communicate with the outside world, highlighting the vulnerability of its characters.
2. Supernatural horror: The supernatural elements of the cabin add an eerie atmosphere to the story, blurring the lines between reality and the unknown.
3. Family dynamics: As the family tries to survive, they are forced to confront their relationships with each other, revealing underlying tensions and conflicts that threaten to tear them apart.
4. Trauma and grief: The movie touches on themes of trauma, grief, and loss, as David struggles to cope with his past mistakes and find a way to move forward.

Overall, You Should Have Left is a tense, atmospheric horror film that explores the darker aspects of human nature and the power of isolation to reveal our deepest fears.

overview: When Sarah Marshall dumps aspiring musician Peter Bretter for rock star Aldous Snow, Peter's world comes crashing down. His best friend suggests that Peter should get away from everything and to fly off to Hawaii to escape all his problems. After arriving in Hawaii and meeting the beautiful Rachel Jansen, Peter is shocked to see not only Aldous Snow in Hawaii, but also Sarah Marshall.
tagline: You lose some, you get some.
title: Forgetting Sarah Marshall
plot:
Forgetting Sarah Marshall is a 2008 American romantic comedy film directed by Nicholas Stoller and written by Jason Segel and Andrew Cohen.

The movie begins with Peter Bretter (played by Jason Segel), a struggling musician who has been dating the famous actress Sarah Marshall (played by Kristen Bell) for three years. However, their relationship ends abruptly when Sarah breaks up with him on live television during her concert in Hawaii. Heartbroken, Peter travels to Hawaii to attend Sarah's wedding, where he hopes to find closure and move on from his heartbreak.

Upon arrival, Peter discovers that Sarah is marrying the famous rock star Aldous Snow (played by Russell Brand), who is also a close friend of hers. As Peter tries to come to terms with his breakup, he meets Rachel Jansen (played by Mila Kunis), a hotel receptionist who becomes his unlikely companion and confidante.

As Peter navigates his way through the wedding and its aftermath, he begins to realize that he has been using Sarah as an excuse to avoid dealing with his own emotional baggage. Through his interactions with Rachel, Peter starts to confront his feelings and learn to move on from his heartbreak.

Meanwhile, Aldous Snow's character is revealed to be a self-centered, egotistical rock star who is struggling with his own personal demons. As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Sarah has been using Aldous as a rebound partner after her breakup with Peter, and that she is not ready to move on from their relationship.

Throughout the movie, Peter's character undergoes significant development as he learns to let go of his emotional attachment to Sarah and find happiness again. The film features a range of comedic moments, including Peter's disastrous attempts at playing music with Rachel and his awkward interactions with Aldous.

In the end, Peter comes to terms with his breakup and finds closure by realizing that he deserves better than someone who has hurt him so deeply. He also learns to appreciate the beauty of moving on and finding happiness again, as embodied by his growing connection with Rachel.

Overall, Forgetting Sarah Marshall is a heartwarming and hilarious romantic comedy that explores themes of love, loss, and self-discovery. The film features outstanding performances from its cast, particularly Jason Segel and Mila Kunis, who bring depth and nuance to their characters.

overview: When three college students move into an old house off campus, they unwittingly unleash a supernatural entity known as The Bye Bye Man, who comes to prey upon them once they discover his name. The friends must try to save each other, all the while keeping The Bye Bye Man's existence a secret to save others from the same deadly fate.
tagline: Don't think it. Don't say it.
title: The Bye Bye Man
plot:
The Bye Bye Man is a 2017 American supernatural horror film directed by John R. Leonetti and written by Jonathan Goldstein and John Francis Daley.

The movie follows the story of Elliot (played by Douglas Smith), a teenager who moves to a new town with his family, only to discover that it's haunted by a supernatural entity known as "The Bye Bye Man" (played by Michael Trucco). The entity is an ancient being that feeds on people's fears and can manipulate reality.

As the story unfolds, Elliot discovers that he has a personal connection to The Bye Bye Man, which makes him its next target. He must find a way to defeat the entity before it's too late.

The main themes of The Bye Bye Man include:

1. **Fear and Anxiety**: The movie explores the theme of fear and anxiety, particularly in the context of adolescence. Elliot's experiences with The Bye Bye Man serve as a metaphor for the fears and anxieties that many teenagers face.
2. **Isolation and Loneliness**: The film highlights the importance of human connection and relationships. Elliot's struggles to fit in and form connections with others make him more vulnerable to The Bye Bye Man's manipulation.
3. **Trauma and PTSD**: The movie touches on the theme of trauma and post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD). Elliot's past experiences are slowly revealed, showing how they have affected his present and future.
4. **The Power of Belief**: The Bye Bye Man is a manifestation of the characters' collective fears and beliefs. The entity grows stronger as more people believe in its existence, highlighting the power of fear and superstition.

Overall, The Bye Bye Man is a tense, suspenseful horror film that explores themes of fear, anxiety, isolation, trauma, and the power of belief.

overview: Housewife and mother Penny Chenery agrees to take over her ailing father's Virginia-based Meadow Stables, despite her lack of horse-racing knowledge. Against all odds, Chenery - with the help of veteran trainer Lucien Laurin - manages to navigate the male-dominated business, ultimately fostering the first Triple Crown winner in 25 years.
tagline: The Impossible True Story
title: Secretariat
plot:
Secretariat is a heartwarming and inspiring film that delves into the world of horse racing, exploring themes of perseverance, determination, and the unbreakable bond between a horse and its rider. The movie follows the journey of Big Red, a talented but troubled thoroughbred, as he rises to become one of the greatest horses in history under the guidance of his trainer, Lucien Laurin.

At its core, Secretariat is a story about overcoming adversity and pushing beyond perceived limitations. The film showcases the incredible resilience of both Big Red and his rider, Penny Chenery, as they face numerous challenges and setbacks on their path to success. Through their struggles, the movie highlights the importance of perseverance, hard work, and believing in oneself.

One of the most striking aspects of Secretariat is its portrayal of the deep emotional connection between horses and humans. The film beautifully captures the trust, loyalty, and affection that can develop between a horse and its rider, as seen in the remarkable bond between Big Red and Penny. This bond serves as a powerful reminder of the transformative power of relationships and the impact they can have on our lives.

The movie also explores themes of family, legacy, and the pursuit of greatness. As Penny navigates her journey to train Big Red for the Kentucky Derby, she must balance her personal ambitions with the demands of her family's expectations. The film ultimately reveals that true success is not just about achieving a goal but also about staying true to oneself and one's values.

Overall, Secretariat is a cinematic masterpiece that celebrates the human spirit, the power of relationships, and the unyielding pursuit of excellence.

overview: A group of young boys on the cusp of becoming teenagers embark on an epic quest to fix their broken drone before their parents get home.
tagline: You Must Be This Tall to See This Movie
title: Good Boys
plot:
Good Boys is a coming-of-age comedy film released in 2019, directed by Gene Stupnitsky and written by Seth Kearsley. The movie follows three sixth-grade friends, Max, Lucas, and Thor, who have been inseparable since kindergarten.

The story begins with the boys preparing to attend their first kissing party, a rite of passage for pre-teens in their neighborhood. They are excited but also nervous about what to expect. However, things take an unexpected turn when they accidentally get invited to a grown-up's party instead of the kids' party.

At the adult gathering, the boys are initially overwhelmed by the sophisticated atmosphere and the adults' behavior. They try to blend in with the other guests, but their innocence and naivety lead them into various awkward situations. Max (Jacob Tremblay), Lucas (Brady Noon), and Thor (Keith L. Williams) must navigate through a series of misadventures, including trying to impress girls, drinking juice from a flask, and getting caught up in a wild party.

As the night progresses, the boys' behavior becomes more reckless, and they start to lose control. They also begin to realize that their friendship is being tested by their newfound exposure to adulthood. The movie takes a turn when Max's parents announce that they are getting divorced, adding an extra layer of complexity to the story.

Throughout the film, the characters face various challenges, including peer pressure, family drama, and self-discovery. As the night comes to a close, the boys must confront their own maturity and figure out what it means to be growing up.

The ending is both heartwarming and humorous, as the boys reflect on their experiences and learn valuable lessons about friendship, loyalty, and growing up. The movie concludes with Max, Lucas, and Thor returning home, where they share a heartfelt moment of brotherhood, solidifying their bond despite the challenges they faced that night.

Overall, Good Boys is a relatable and entertaining coming-of-age story that explores the ups and downs of adolescence. With its talented young cast, witty dialogue, and hilarious situations, the movie has become a favorite among audiences of all ages.

overview: A koala named Buster recruits his best friend to help him drum up business for his theater by hosting a singing competition.
tagline: Auditions begin 2016.
title: Sing
plot:
Sing is a 3D computer-animated musical comedy film released in 2016 by Illumination Entertainment and Universal Pictures. The movie follows the story of Buster Moon, a koala who owns a struggling theater in the city.

The story begins with Buster Moon announcing that he will hold a singing competition to save his theater from being shut down. He promises the winner a recording contract and $1 million prize money. However, things take a turn when Buster realizes that he doesn't have enough money to pay the bills for the next month.

Buster approaches his friends, including Johnny, an elderly gorilla who is also a singer; Ash, a young porcupine with a big voice; Meena, a shy elephant who wants to sing but is afraid of being laughed at; and Rosita, a pregnant pig who sings in a sassy, Latin-inspired style. Buster convinces them to participate in the competition.

As the competition heats up, Buster faces several challenges, including a rival theater owner named Jimmy Crystal, who tries to sabotage his event. Meanwhile, Buster also has to deal with his own personal struggles, including his failing business and his relationship with his girlfriend, Rosita.

The movie takes a dramatic turn when Meena's past is revealed, showing that she was once a star singer but was abandoned by her mother. This revelation makes Meena even more anxious about singing in front of an audience.

In the end, Buster decides to let all the contestants sing together on stage, and they perform a powerful rendition of "The Greatest Day." The performance is a huge success, and the movie ends with Buster's theater being saved and his friends finding their own unique voices.

Throughout the movie, the characters learn valuable lessons about perseverance, friendship, and believing in oneself. The movie features a talented voice cast, including Matthew McConaughey as Buster Moon, Reese Witherspoon as Rosita, Seth MacFarlane as Jimmy Crystal, and Scarlett Johansson as Meena.

Overall, Sing is a heartwarming and entertaining movie that celebrates the power of music and friendship.

overview: Tragedy strikes when a woman named Joyce's son falls through the ice on a frozen lake and is trapped underwater for over 15 minutes. After being rushed to the hospital, the 14-year-old boy continues to fight for his life as Joyce, her husband and their pastor stay by his bedside and pray for a miracle.
tagline: Based On The Impossible True Story
title: Breakthrough
plot:
Breakthrough is a 2019 American Christian drama film directed by Kyle Killen and written by Killen and Jon Gunn. The movie stars Chrissy Metz, Josh Lucas, and Marlee Matlin.

The story revolves around Joyce Smith (Chrissy Metz), a devoted mother of three who lives in Kansas with her husband Eric (Josh Lucas) and their children, Melody (Mila Brener), James (Isaiah Russell Morris), and Faith (Auggie Maturo). The family is loving and supportive, but they face challenges as they navigate everyday life.

Tragedy strikes when Joyce's youngest daughter, Faith, falls into a frozen lake on Christmas Eve. Despite the efforts of the rescue team, Faith slips beneath the surface and drowns. The incident leaves the family devastated, and Joyce becomes consumed by grief and guilt.

In her desperation to save her daughter, Joyce turns to prayer, seeking divine intervention. She believes that God can perform miracles, and she prays fervently for Faith's return. As Joyce continues to pray, a miraculous event occurs - Faith is miraculously revived after being clinically dead for 15 minutes.

The family is overjoyed at the news of Faith's recovery, but they soon realize that her experience has changed her. Faith begins to exhibit unusual behavior, including speaking in tongues and experiencing vivid visions. The family struggles to understand what is happening to their daughter, and they seek help from a faith healer named Sean (Josh Lucas), who claims to have the power to heal.

As the story unfolds, Joyce becomes increasingly obsessed with understanding the nature of Faith's experience. She believes that God has chosen her daughter for a greater purpose, but she also fears that Faith is being manipulated by evil forces. The family's relationships are put to the test as they navigate their faith and their love for one another.

Throughout the movie, there are moments of tension and conflict, particularly between Joyce and Sean. While Joyce believes that God has sent Sean to help her daughter, Sean seems more interested in using Faith's experience to further his own ministry. The film raises questions about the nature of faith, healing, and the role of divine intervention in our lives.

Ultimately, Breakthrough is a story about the power of love, forgiveness, and redemption. Despite the challenges they face, the Smith family remains committed to one another and to their faith. In the end, Joyce comes to understand that her daughter's experience has been a gift, but also a test of her own faith and devotion.

The movie ends on a hopeful note, with Faith having found a new sense of purpose in life. The film concludes with a message of hope and redemption, encouraging viewers to hold onto their faith even in the face of adversity.

overview: It's Halloween night and video store clerk Stan Helsing just got stuck with a last minute request to deliver some videos. With his best friend, his best friend's date, and a smoking hot ex-girlfriend waiting to go to a party, Stan convinces them to take a side trip to Stormy Night Estates for the drop. But the group gets locked inside and Stan discovers he's actually Stan Van Helsing, descendan
tagline: The most feared monsters in cinematic history have met their match...
title: Stan Helsing
plot:
Stan Helsing is a 2009 American horror-comedy film directed by Dean Barker and written by Dean Barker and Michael J. Martin. The movie stars Steve Howey, Dana Delany, and Christopher Lloyd.

The story begins with Stan Helsing (Steve Howey), a descendant of the famous vampire hunter Abraham Van Helsing, who has lost his way in life after being kicked out of his family's business. Stan is now working as a used car salesman in suburban Los Angeles, where he spends most of his time drinking and womanizing.

However, when Stan's mother (Dana Delany) dies under mysterious circumstances, he inherits her vast fortune and the family's old mansion. As he moves into the mansion, he discovers that it is infested with vampires, werewolves, and other supernatural creatures.

Stan soon learns that his ancestors were famous vampire hunters, and he decides to take up the mantle of his great-grandfather Abraham Van Helsing. With the help of his mother's old friend, Dr. Alan Fenwick (Christopher Lloyd), a scientist who has been studying the supernatural, Stan sets out to rid the mansion of its monstrous inhabitants.

As Stan delves deeper into the world of vampire hunting, he discovers that his family's business was not just about killing monsters, but also about protecting humans from supernatural threats. He also learns that his mother's death was no accident and that she had been working on a way to defeat the vampires once and for all.

Throughout the movie, Stan faces various challenges as he battles his way through hordes of vampires, werewolves, and other creatures. Along the way, he meets a beautiful woman named Gwen (Meredith Hagner), who becomes his love interest and helps him on his quest to rid the mansion of its monsters.

As the story unfolds, Stan discovers that the source of the supernatural problem is a powerful vampire lord named Count Dracula (Christopher Lloyd), who has been awakened by a mysterious artifact. In a thrilling finale, Stan faces off against Count Dracula in an epic battle of good vs. evil.

In the end, Stan emerges victorious, having defeated the vampires and saved humanity from their clutches. With his newfound confidence and skills as a vampire hunter, Stan sets out to continue his family's legacy and protect the world from supernatural threats.

Overall, Stan Helsing is a hilarious and action-packed horror-comedy that pays homage to the classic Universal monster movies of the 1930s and 1940s. The movie features plenty of humor, gore, and excitement, making it a fun watch for fans of the genre.

original_title: 進撃の巨人 ATTACK ON TITAN エンド オブ ザ ワールド
overview: Eren leaves to restore a break in the wall destroyed by a Titan. He comes under attack by the Titans and is cornered. Shikishima comes to his aid. The titans never stops attacking.  Eren is now injured and tries to protect Armin, but is swallowed by a titan. A Titan with black hair appears and begins to expel the other titans.
tagline: The world is merciless.
title: Attack on Titan II: End of the World
plot:
Attack on Titan: End of the World is a 2015 Japanese post-apocalyptic action film directed by Shinji Higuchi and the second of two live-action features adapted from Hajime Isayama's manga Attack on Titan. Written by Yusuke Watanabe and Tomohiro Machiyama, with music by Shiro Sagisu and cinematography by Shoji Ehara, it was distributed by Toho and opened in Japan on 19 September 2015, seven weeks after the first part. Funimation released both films in North America, screening this one in a limited engagement in October 2015.

The story continues from the first film, in which Eren and his friends Mikasa and Armin joined the Survey Corps to fight the man-eating giants called Titans after their town was destroyed. A flashback shows the young Eren being forcibly injected with an experimental serum by his father before military police seize his parents and burn their home. In the present, Eren, who can now transform into a Titan, is captured by the commander Kubal, who regards him as a threat to humanity; Mikasa does nothing to defend him, and his ally Souda is killed. Before Eren can be executed, a Titan bursts in and carries him off.

Eren wakes in a mysterious bunker with Shikishima, who reveals that the Titans originated in a failed military experiment and plans a coup against a corrupt government that uses the walls and fear of the giants to oppress its people. Meanwhile Hans, Mikasa and the others recover an unexploded bomb from Eren's home town, hoping to seal the breach in the outer wall. When Shikishima reveals that he intends to blow up the capital instead and let the Titans liberate humanity, Eren turns against him, transforms and defeats him. In the final battle Kubal turns into the Colossal Titan, Jean is killed, and Shikishima sacrifices himself by placing the bomb in the giant's mouth; the blast seals the wall, and Eren and Mikasa stand on top of it looking out at the ocean.

Haruma Miura stars as Eren, with Kiko Mizuhara as Mikasa, Kanata Hongo as Armin, Hiroki Hasegawa as Shikishima, Satomi Ishihara as Hans and Jun Kunimura as Kubal. The film underperformed relative to the first part, taking about 2.7 million dollars in its opening week in Japan against 4.8 million for its predecessor. Critics were divided: half of the reviews collected by Rotten Tomatoes were positive, and the Lexikon des internationalen Films noted its graphic CGI and its focus on a totalitarian government alongside the threat of the giants.

original_title: ゴジラ×モスラ×メカゴジラ／東京SOS
overview: Mothra and her fairies return to Japan to warn mankind that they must return Kiryu to the sea, for the dead must not be disturbed. However Godzilla has survived to menace Japan leaving Kiryu as the nation's only defense.
tagline: Three giant monsters, one violent final battle!!
title: Godzilla: Tokyo S.O.S.
plot:
Godzilla: Tokyo S.O.S. is a 2003 Japanese kaiju film directed by Takao Okawara and produced by Toho Pictures, Inc. The movie explores several thought-provoking themes that are deeply rooted in the human condition.

At its core, Godzilla: Tokyo S.O.S. is a cautionary tale about the dangers of unchecked technological advancement and the consequences of playing with forces beyond human control. The film's protagonist, Mothra, is a powerful creature who serves as a symbol of nature's wrath against humanity's arrogance. Through Mothra's character, the movie highlights the importance of respecting and preserving the natural balance.

The film also delves into themes of sacrifice and redemption. The main character, Yumi, is driven by a desire to save her sister, which ultimately leads her to make a heroic sacrifice. This selfless act serves as a powerful metaphor for the human capacity for love, compassion, and selflessness in the face of adversity.

Furthermore, Godzilla: Tokyo S.O.S. touches on the theme of environmental degradation and the consequences of humanity's destructive tendencies. The movie depicts a world ravaged by pollution, destruction, and chaos, serving as a stark warning about the devastating impact of human actions on the planet.

Ultimately, Godzilla: Tokyo S.O.S. is a powerful exploration of the human condition, one that challenges viewers to confront their own relationship with nature and the consequences of their actions. Through its thought-provoking themes and iconic characters, the movie offers a compelling commentary on the world we live in today.

overview: A former intelligence agent gets involved with the first human clone, Seobok, who others seek, causing trouble.
tagline: Live the Moment.
title: Seobok: Project Clone
plot:
Seobok, also known as Seo Bok: Project Clone, is a 2021 South Korean science fiction action thriller written and directed by Lee Yong-ju. Gong Yoo stars as Min Gi-heon, a former intelligence agent, and Park Bo-gum plays the title character, the first human clone, with Jo Woo-jin as Chief Ahn of the Korea Intelligence Agency, Jang Young-nam as Dr. Im Se-eun, director of the institute that created him, and Park Byung-eun as Shin Hak-seon.

Gi-heon has been living in isolation, haunted by a traumatic event from his past and dying of a terminal brain tumor, when the intelligence agency makes him an offer he cannot refuse: safely escort an experimental subject named Seo Bok. Produced through stem cell cloning and genetic engineering, Seo Bok has cells that could cure disease and grant humans something close to eternal life, and he has also developed telekinetic powers. Almost as soon as the transfer begins, the convoy is attacked, and Gi-heon and Seo Bok barely escape together. On the run, the young clone, seeing the outside world for the first time, is fascinated by everything around him, while Gi-heon simply wants to finish what he believes will be his last mission. Their opposing outlooks cause constant friction, but along the way the two confront questions of mortality, fear of death and what it means to be human. Meanwhile, rival groups, including the institute's backers and hired mercenaries, close in, each seeking either to exploit Seo Bok, who could be humanity's salvation or its ruin, or to destroy him. The pursuit builds to a violent confrontation in which Seo Bok's powers are unleashed and both men are forced into an unavoidable choice.

Lee began developing the project in 2017, when Park was announced in the lead; Gong joined in 2018. Filming ran from May to October 2019, mainly at a studio in Jeonju with location work in Tongyeong. Postponed from December 2020 by the COVID-19 pandemic, the film opened on April 15, 2021, in South Korea and several Asian markets and simultaneously on the streaming service TVING, the first Korean film released that way. It topped the domestic box office in its opening weekend. Critical reaction was mixed to positive, with 80% approval on Rotten Tomatoes; The New York Times found it slow-burning and increasingly poignant, while the South China Morning Post called it a ponderous quasi-philosophical melodrama. Park's performance was widely praised and won him Best New Actor at the Golden Cinematography Awards.

overview: Clavius, a powerful Roman military tribune, and his aide, Lucius, are tasked with solving the mystery of what happened to Jesus in the weeks following the crucifixion, in order to disprove the rumors of a risen Messiah and prevent an uprising in Jerusalem.
tagline: Witness the manhunt that changed the course of human history
title: Risen
plot:
Risen is a 2016 biblical drama film directed by Kevin Reynolds and written by Reynolds and Paul Aiello. An American-Spanish co-production starring Joseph Fiennes, Tom Felton, Peter Firth and Cliff Curtis, it tells the story of the resurrection of Jesus through the eyes of a Roman soldier who is ordered to find his missing body. The project began in 2013 as The Resurrection of Jesus Christ, conceived as a mystery thriller and an unofficial sequel to The Passion of the Christ, and was filmed in Malta and Spain between August and November 2015.

Clavius, a Roman tribune of the Legio X Fretensis, crushes a rebellion of zealots led by Barabbas and then oversees the crucifixion of Yeshua, posting guards at the tomb. When the body vanishes, rumors spread that Yeshua's followers stole it to make it appear he had risen from the dead.
