Pontius Pilate, eager to prevent unrest in Jerusalem before the Emperor's visit, orders Clavius to find the corpse. With his aide Lucius, Clavius interrogates people who claim to have seen Yeshua alive, but their accounts grow ever more miraculous, and followers such as Mary Magdalene and Bartholomew answer only in riddles. As his investigation unsettles Romans and Jews alike, Pilate grows distant. Clavius forces one of the tomb's disgraced guards to abandon his cover story, and the drunken soldier describes a blinding flash, the tomb's seals disintegrating and a figure emerging. Clavius refuses to believe it until, during a raid, he comes face to face with Yeshua, alive among his apostles, the same man he watched die on the cross. Shaken, he calls off the search and soon abandons his old life and gods to follow the group, befriending the apostle Peter and talking with Yeshua as they travel, while Pilate sends Lucius and a contingent of soldiers after him. Clavius helps the disciples evade the pursuing Romans and witnesses Yeshua heal a leper and ascend to heaven, before the apostles part to spread their message and Clavius reflects on how his life has been transformed.

Columbia Pictures released Risen in the United States on February 19, 2016. It grossed $46.8 million worldwide against a $20 million budget and received mixed reviews; Rotten Tomatoes gave it 53%, with a consensus praising its lighter tone and a terrific turn from Fiennes, and audiences gave it an A− CinemaScore.

overview: A group of teenagers fear for their lives in the swamps of Louisiana, chased by Mr. Jangles, a man possessed by 13 evil souls, and now relentless in his pursuit of new victims.
tagline: He never hurt a soul until the day he died.
title: Venom
plot:
Venom is a 2005 American supernatural slasher film directed by Jim Gillespie, who reunited with screenwriter Kevin Williamson after their collaboration on I Know What You Did Last Summer. The ensemble cast features Agnes Bruckner as Eden Sinclair, Jonathan Jackson as Eric, Laura Ramsey as Rachel, Meagan Good as CeCe, D. J. Cotrona as Sean, Rick Cramer as tow truck driver Ray Sawyer and Method Man as Deputy Turner. The film was based on Backwater, an unproduced survival horror video game designed by John Zuur Platten and Flint Dille, and was shot in Louisiana, in Amite, Choctaw, Hammond and New Orleans.

In a small town, high school senior Eden and her friends spend their time at the local burger joint, where Sean's father Ray, a gruff tow truck driver, picks up an order. That night a Creole woman, CeCe's grandmother, who has just dug up a mysterious briefcase, swerves to avoid Ray's truck on a bridge and nearly plunges over the edge. Ray rescues her, but at her desperate urging he reaches back for the case as the car sinks into the water, and snakes burst out of it and bite him repeatedly. Both Ray and the old woman die. In the morgue, Ray rises again, kills the coroner and a police officer, and sets out on a murderous rampage through the teenagers' circle with the tools of his trade, including chains and a crowbar. CeCe, who took a charm from her grandmother's body, explains that the snakes contained evil that her grandmother had drawn out of wicked men to purify their souls, and that this evil has now possessed Ray. As their friends are picked off one by one, the survivors take refuge in the grandmother's house, which is protected by voodoo spells, and search for a way to destroy the seemingly unstoppable killer.

Venom was released by Miramax Films' Dimension Films label on September 16, 2005, the last Dimension release before the Walt Disney Company sold the label to The Weinstein Company. Its timing, days after Hurricane Katrina devastated southeast Louisiana, made the film seem unfortunately topical, and it was a box-office failure. Critics gave it negative reviews; it holds a 13% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus calls it a voodoo horror film without the mojo whose unimaginative rampage quickly lulls viewers to sleep.

overview: Erik, Ryan, and Cooze start college and pledge the Beta House fraternity, presided over by none other than legendary Dwight Stifler. But chaos ensues when a fraternity of geeks threatens to stop the debauchery and the Betas have to make a stand for their right to party.
tagline: The most outrageous slice of pie!
title: American Pie Presents: Beta House
plot:
American Pie Presents: Beta House is a 2007 American comedy film directed by Jesse Dylan and written by Adam Herz. The movie is part of the American Pie franchise, which follows the lives of a group of high school friends as they navigate love, relationships, and growing up.

The plot takes place after the events of American Wedding (2003) and follows Jim Levenstein (Eddie Kaye Thomas), who has just been accepted into a prestigious college called Beta House. The movie begins with Jim arriving at Beta House, where he meets his new roommate, Matt (John White), and becomes fast friends with him.

However, things take a turn when the house is taken over by a group of misfits, led by a charismatic but troubled student named Steve Stills (Adam Pally). As Jim tries to navigate this new environment, he finds himself caught up in a series of wacky misadventures and pranks with his new friends.

Meanwhile, Jim's on-again, off-again girlfriend, Michelle Flaherty (Amanda Crew), is dealing with her own issues as she navigates college life. The movie also features appearances from several familiar faces from the American Pie franchise, including Stifler (Seann William Scott) and Oz (Erik Stolhanske).

As the story unfolds, Jim becomes increasingly frustrated with Steve's antics and tries to assert his authority in the house. However, things escalate when Steve starts a series of pranks that put the entire house at risk.

In the end, Jim must confront Steve and find a way to restore order to Beta House. Along the way, he learns valuable lessons about friendship, loyalty, and growing up.

Throughout the movie, there are plenty of humorous moments, including several memorable scenes featuring Stifler's antics and Oz's deadpan reactions. The film also explores themes of identity, belonging, and finding one's place in the world.

Overall, American Pie Presents: Beta House is a lighthearted, entertaining comedy that provides plenty of laughs and nostalgic value for fans of the franchise.

original_title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
overview: Doctor Strange, with the help of mystical allies both old and new, traverses the mind-bending and dangerous alternate realities of the Multiverse to confront a mysterious new adversary.
tagline: Enter a new dimension of Strange.
title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
plot:
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness is a 2022 American superhero film directed by Sam Raimi and produced by Marvel Studios. The movie follows the story of Dr. Stephen Strange, a brilliant neurosurgeon who becomes the Sorcerer Supreme after mastering the mystic arts.

The film begins with Doctor Strange (Benedict Cumberbatch) trying to balance his life as a sorcerer with his relationships with his friends and loved ones. However, he soon discovers that there are multiple versions of himself across different dimensions, each living alternate lives. These alternate versions, known as the "Multiverse," begin to invade our world, threatening the fabric of reality.

Strange teams up with Wanda Maximoff (Elizabeth Olsen), also known as the Scarlet Witch, who is struggling to cope with her own grief and guilt over the death of her children in a previous Marvel film. Together, they embark on a journey across multiple dimensions to find a way to stop the invasion and restore balance to the Multiverse.

Along the way, Strange encounters various alternate versions of himself, each with their own unique abilities and personalities. He also meets America Chavez (Xochitl Gomez), a young Latina superhero who becomes his ally in the quest to save the Multiverse.

As they navigate through different dimensions, Strange and Wanda face numerous challenges and obstacles, including powerful villains and alternate versions of familiar characters from other Marvel films. The movie features stunning visual effects, action sequences, and emotional drama, as the characters grapple with the consequences of their actions and the nature of reality itself.

Throughout the film, Strange's character undergoes significant development, as he confronts his own limitations and the weight of responsibility that comes with being the Sorcerer Supreme. The movie also explores themes of grief, trauma, and the complexities of power, raising questions about the morality of using magic to manipulate and control others.

Ultimately, Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness is a thrilling adventure that delves into the mysteries of the multiverse and the human condition. With its talented cast, impressive visuals, and thought-provoking themes, it's a must-see for fans of the Marvel Cinematic Universe.

overview: Victoria is a young mother trying to put her dark past as a Russian drug courier behind her, but retired cop Damon forces Victoria to do his bidding by holding her daughter hostage. Now, Victoria must use guns, guts and a motorcycle to take out a series of violent gangsters—or she may never see her child again.
tagline: She's got one night to save her life.
title: Vanquish
plot:
Vanquish is a 2021 American action thriller directed by George Gallo, who wrote it with Samuel Bartlett. Ruby Rose stars as Victoria, a former drug courier forced back into her old life, and Morgan Freeman plays Damon, a retired, wheelchair-using police officer, with Patrick Muldoon, Julie Lott and Ekaterina Baker.

Victoria works as the evening caregiver for Damon at his palatial home, bringing along her young daughter, Lily, who is ill. When Victoria admits she cannot afford Lily's treatment, Damon offers to pay for it in exchange for a favor. A corrupt cop who ran illicit operations around the city, he wants to pull his money from five associates after a recent double cross, and he asks Victoria, who once worked as a courier for the Russian mob alongside her late brother, to collect it in a single night. She refuses until Lily disappears, and Damon makes clear that her daughter will be returned only when the job is done.

Wearing a body camera so that Damon can watch from his computer, Victoria sets out. At the first stop she recognizes the criminal she is collecting from as the man who killed her brother and kills him and his men. Each subsequent pickup brings her face to face with enemies from her past and ends in a fight, a shootout or a chase, and her trail of violence draws the attention of crooked police officers, federal agents and government operatives. Meanwhile a police officer breaks into Damon's house, and Damon kills him. At her final stop, Victoria is captured and brought to the corrupt Governor, who asks for her help in bringing down Damon; Victoria refuses and kills the Governor. When she returns to Damon's home and is reunited with Lily, he reveals that he never needed the money: the night was a plan to wipe out Victoria's enemies and the corrupt Governor, ridding the city of its criminals. At dawn, Damon lures the crooked officers who worked for the Governor into his house and blows himself up along with them, while Victoria and Lily escape.

Lionsgate released Vanquish in select theaters on April 16, 2021, followed by digital and home video releases later that month. Critics savaged it, giving it 5% approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 22; RogerEbert.com called it a dull, threadbare rehash of genre clichés.

overview: A bright young yeti finds something he thought didn't exist—a human. News of this “smallfoot” throws the simple yeti community into an uproar over what else might be out there in the big world beyond their snowy village.
tagline: There's been a big myth-understanding
title: Smallfoot
plot:
Smallfoot is a 2018 American computer-animated comedy-adventure film produced by Warner Bros. Animation and New Line Cinema. The movie follows the story of Migo, a Yeti who lives in the frozen wilderness of North Pole.

The film begins with Migo (voiced by Channing Tatum) living a peaceful life among his fellow Yetis, who believe that humans are mythical creatures that exist only in stories. However, Migo is fascinated by human artifacts and has discovered a human foot in the ice. He decides to embark on a journey to find out if humans really do exist.

Migo's search leads him to a group of humans living in the city of New York, where he meets a kind-hearted explorer named Meechee (voiced by Gina Rodriguez). Meechee is an anthropologist who has been studying Yetis and their culture. She helps Migo understand human behavior and language.

As Migo spends more time with Meechee, he begins to question his own identity and the stories told by his fellow Yetis. He starts to see humans as real individuals rather than just mythical creatures. However, not everyone is happy about Migo's newfound friendship with a human. A rival Yeti named King Waternoose (voiced by James Corden) seeks to exploit Migo's discovery for his own gain.

King Waternoose and his followers believe that the existence of humans will lead to the downfall of the Yetis' way of life. They plan to capture Meechee and use her as a pawn in their game. Migo must now protect Meechee and find a way to convince his fellow Yetis that humans are real.

As the story unfolds, Migo learns more about human culture and values. He also discovers that humans have been watching him and his fellow Yetis from afar. The film features stunning animation and humor, with plenty of comedic moments.

In the end, Migo's friendship with Meechee helps to change the way the Yetis perceive humans. They begin to see humans as individuals rather than just mythical creatures. King Waternoose is defeated, and Migo returns home a hero. The film ends on a hopeful note, with Migo and his fellow Yetis embracing their newfound understanding of humans.

Overall, Smallfoot is a heartwarming and entertaining film that explores themes of identity, friendship, and acceptance. With its stunning animation and lovable characters, it's a must-see for families and fans of animated movies.

overview: Documentary examining what happens to some of the biggest names in the history of the adult entertainment industry after they leave the business and try and live "normal" lives.
tagline: Can they really live a normal life after porn?
title: After Porn Ends
plot:
After Porn Ends is a 2013 documentary film directed by Scott Marshall Breitenbach, not released in 2012, but I'll provide you with the information about the movie.

The film follows the lives of four former adult film performers - Rick, Tera, Jayden, and Georgette - as they navigate their post-porn careers. The movie explores the harsh realities of life after leaving the adult entertainment industry, including financial struggles, relationship issues, and personal crises.

At the beginning of the film, we see each performer struggling to cope with the transition from a lucrative career in adult films to an uncertain future. Rick, who was one of the most popular performers before retiring, is now working as a janitor and dealing with depression. Tera, on the other hand, has started her own business but struggles to make ends meet.

As the film progresses, we see each performer facing unique challenges. Jayden, who had been struggling with addiction, begins to rebuild his life and find new purpose. Georgette, who had become a successful entrepreneur, faces financial difficulties due to the instability of her business.

Throughout the film, Breitenbach raises questions about the exploitation of adult performers and the lack of support systems in place for those leaving the industry. He also highlights the importance of mental health awareness and the need for resources to help former performers transition to new careers.

The film's title, After Porn Ends, is a poignant commentary on the fleeting nature of fame and fortune in the adult entertainment industry. The movie serves as a warning to young performers about the potential consequences of entering this field without proper support or planning.

Ultimately, the film offers a nuanced portrayal of life after porn, highlighting both the difficulties and the resilience of former performers. By sharing their stories, the performers hope to raise awareness about the need for better support systems and resources for those leaving the industry.

The ending of the film is bittersweet, with each performer reflecting on their experiences and the lessons they've learned. While some have found success in new careers, others continue to struggle, serving as a reminder that life after porn can be complex and challenging.

overview: Barbie plays Lumina, a mermaid girl with the power to change the color of pearls. Cheerful and creative, Lumina finds herself working in a mermaid salon customizing fabulous hairstyles. And when Lumina has the chance to attend the royal ball, her friends adorn her with a gown fit for a princess. At the ball, villains try to seize power over the kingdom, and Lumina finds within herself an unexpected power that proves she is much more than a hair stylist.
title: Barbie: The Pearl Princess
plot:
Barbie: The Pearl Princess is a 2014 American-Canadian computer-animated fantasy film and the 27th entry in the Barbie film series. Directed by Zeke Norton from a screenplay by Cydne Clark and Steve Granat, it was produced by Barbie Entertainment with animation by Rainmaker Entertainment, featured music by Jim Dooley, and was released direct to home video by Universal, appearing in France in February 2014 and in the United States on 11 March 2014. It runs 73 minutes and includes the songs "Mermaid Party" and "Light Up the World".

Kelly Sheridan voices Lumina, a cheerful seventeen-year-old mermaid who can make pearls glow and move at her command. She lives on a remote reef with her seahorse friend Kuda (Katie Crown) and her stern aunt Scylla (Trish Pattendon), who forbids her to show her power. In the royal capital, King Nereus and Queen Lorelei still mourn a daughter lost years earlier, and the king's brother-in-law Caligo (John Novak) arranges a royal ball at which his son Fergis, heir in the absence of the princess, is to find a wife. Caligo secretly sends his eel henchman Murray to force Scylla, a potion-maker, to poison the king at the ball.

Finding the invitation Scylla left behind, Lumina sets off for the city with Kuda, befriending a lonely spiny fish named Spike along the way. There she becomes a celebrated hairstylist at the salon of the octopus Madame Ruckus, using her pearls to create dazzling styles, meets the visiting Prince Delphin, and watches the gentle Fergis, who would rather be a botanist, fall for her co-worker Cora. Caligo, meanwhile, realises from a hidden royal bracelet that Lumina is the missing princess and has her imprisoned, but she escapes using her powers.

At the ball Lumina knocks the poisoned cup from the king's hand. When Scylla tries to reveal the plot, Caligo pushes her onto one of Spike's venomous spines, and she confesses that she took Lumina away as a baby on Caligo's orders but chose to raise her instead of harming her. Fergis supplies a rare lily that cures her, and Lumina uses her pearls to stop Caligo. The queen reveals that she shares the same pearl magic, a royal gift, confirming Lumina's identity; the princess is reunited with her parents and asks that Scylla and Kuda join her at the palace.

The voice cast also includes Mark Oliver as Nereus, Rebecca Shoichet as Lorelei, Simon Hill as Fergis, Peter New as Murray and Kathleen Barr as Madame Ruckus.

overview: Nory and her best friend Reina enter the Sage Academy for Magical Studies, where Nory’s unconventional powers land her in a class for those with wonky, or “upside-down,” magic. Undaunted, Nory sets out to prove that that upside-down magic can be just as powerful as right-side-up.
tagline: Find your magic
title: Upside-Down Magic
plot:
Upside-Down Magic is a 2020 American fantasy film made as a Disney Channel Original Movie and adapted from the book series of the same name by Sarah Mlynowski, Lauren Myracle and Emily Jenkins. Joe Nussbaum directed and executive produced it. Izabela Rose and Siena Agudong star, with Vicki Lewis as the headmistress and Kyle Howard, Elie Samouhi, Alison Fernandez and Max Torina in supporting roles.

Best friends Elinor "Nory" Boxwood-Horace and Reina Carvajal discover that they have magic: Nory can turn into animals and Reina can conjure fire. They enroll at Sage Academy, an elite school that sorts students into Flares, Fluxers, Flyers, Fuzzies and Flickers, and where everyone must follow a code called "the Sage way". At her placement test Reina impresses, while Nory, trying to become a cat, turns into a cat-dragon hybrid. Reina enters the honors Flare class, but Nory is sent to the Upside-Down Magic program for students with irregular powers, whom Headmistress Linda Knightslinger regards as easy prey for Shadow Magic, an evil force that possesses people and turns their magic against others.

Belittled by a more experienced Flare student, Reina finds a book about Shadow Magic and reads a passage on strengthening her powers. Her abilities grow dangerously strong. Her odd new friend Chandra turns out to be Shadow Magic in human form, invisible to everyone else, and she manipulates and possesses Reina. Meanwhile the groundskeeper Budd Skriff, who teaches the program, reveals that he is an upside-down Fuzzy who can communicate with animals only by singing, and encourages his students to control their unusual gifts rather than force them into normal ones. At the Founders' Day competition Reina becomes a shadowy being that threatens the whole school, and Nory and her classmates rescue her so that she can defeat the Shadow Magic. Afterward the program's students join their magic classes, Budd becomes an official teacher and the Sage way is abolished, though a closing scene hints that Shadow Magic has not been fully vanquished.

Principal photography took place on Vancouver Island, with Shawnigan Lake School standing in for Sage Academy. The film premiered on Disney Channel on July 31, 2020, came out on DVD that November and later streamed on Disney+. LaughingPlace.com gave it four out of five, calling it predictable and derivative but enjoyable for young viewers.

overview: In the Antarctic, after an expedition with Dr. Davis McClaren, the sled dog trainer Jerry Shepherd has to leave the polar base with his colleagues due to the proximity of a heavy snow storm. He ties his dogs to be rescued after, but the mission is called-off and the dogs are left alone at their own fortune. For six months, Jerry tries to find a sponsor for a rescue mission.
tagline: The Most Amazing Story Of Survival, Friendship, And Adventure Ever Told.
title: Eight Below
plot:
Eight Below is a heartwarming drama film released in 2006, directed by Frank Marshall and produced by Walt Disney Pictures. The movie is based on a true story and tells the tale of a team of sled dogs that were left behind by their owner, Dr. Davis (Paul Walker), during a research expedition in Antarctica.

The film begins with Dr. Davis, a renowned scientist, leading an expedition to Antarctica to study the effects of climate change on the continent's wildlife. He is accompanied by his loyal team of sled dogs, including eight Alaskan Malamutes, which are trained to pull a specially designed sled. The dogs are an integral part of the research team and play a crucial role in collecting data and conducting experiments.

As the expedition progresses, Dr. Davis becomes increasingly obsessed with his work, leaving his team behind for extended periods. His loyal companion, Jerry (played by Luke Wilson), is left to care for the dogs while Dr. Davis is away. However, when Dr. Davis returns from a particularly long absence, he discovers that Jerry has abandoned the dogs in an attempt to save them from starvation.

The eight sled dogs are now left alone and struggling to survive in the harsh Antarctic environment. The team's morale is low, and it seems unlikely that they will be able to make it through the winter without human intervention. However, as the days turn into weeks, the dogs begin to adapt to their new circumstances, using their natural instincts to hunt for food and stay warm.

As the months pass, the dogs face numerous challenges, including treacherous terrain, blizzards, and the constant threat of starvation. Despite these obstacles, they remain loyal to each other and work together to survive. The film's climax features an incredible rescue mission, where a team of scientists and sled dog handlers from New Zealand arrive in Antarctica to retrieve the dogs.

The movie ends on a heartwarming note, as Dr. Davis is reunited with his beloved sled dogs, who have been through unimaginable hardships but remain loyal and faithful companions. The film's conclusion serves as a testament to the incredible bond between humans and animals, highlighting the importance of compassion, loyalty, and perseverance in the face of adversity.

Throughout the film, the cinematography is breathtaking, capturing the stunning beauty of Antarctica's landscapes and the resilience of its inhabitants. The performances by the human cast are also noteworthy, particularly Paul Walker's portrayal of Dr. Davis, which conveys a sense of vulnerability and dedication to his work.

Overall, Eight Below is a powerful and emotional film that celebrates the human-animal bond and the incredible adaptability of sled dogs in extreme environments.

overview: Eliza and Debbie are two sisters who don't always get along. But their relationship is put to the test when Debbie's life is in danger, and Eliza might have to give up her power to talk to animals....
tagline: You don't need extraordinary powers to do extraordinary things.
title: The Wild Thornberrys Movie
plot:
The Wild Thornberrys Movie is a 2002 animated film produced by Nickelodeon Movies and Paramount Pictures.

The movie follows the adventures of Eliza Thornberry, a young girl who has the ability to communicate with animals. The story begins with the Thornberry family, including parents Marianne and Donnie, and their children Eliza, Debbie, and Darwin, embarking on a journey to Africa for a documentary film project.

As they travel through the African wilderness, the family faces various challenges and dangers, including poachers and treacherous terrain. However, Eliza's unique gift allows her to help the animals in need and ultimately save the day.

The main themes of The Wild Thornberrys Movie include:

1. Environmentalism: The film highlights the importance of conservation and protecting wildlife habitats.
2. Family values: The movie showcases the love and support within the Thornberry family, as they work together to overcome challenges and learn valuable lessons.
3. Empowerment: Eliza's ability to communicate with animals gives her a sense of purpose and confidence, allowing her to make a positive impact on the world around her.
4. Friendship: The film features various animal characters who become Eliza's friends and allies, teaching her about teamwork and cooperation.

The movie also explores themes of identity, self-discovery, and growing up, as Eliza navigates her unique gift and learns to balance her individuality with her family responsibilities.

Overall, The Wild Thornberrys Movie is a heartwarming and entertaining film that promotes positive values and messages for both children and adults.

overview: Lovable and friendly, the trolls love to play around. But one day, a mysterious giant shows up to end the party. Poppy, the optimistic leader of the Trolls, and her polar opposite, Branch, must embark on an adventure that takes them far beyond the only world they’ve ever known.
tagline: Find your happy place.
title: Trolls
plot:
Trolls is a 2016 American computer-animated musical comedy film produced by DreamWorks Animation. The movie follows the story of two trolls, Poppy and Branch, who live in the colorful world of Troll Village.

The film begins with an introduction to Poppy (voiced by Anna Kendrick), the optimistic and cheerful princess of Troll Village. She loves music, dance, and parties, and is known for her bright pink hair and infectious smile. Meanwhile, Branch (voiced by Justin Timberlake) is a grumpy and pessimistic troll who lives on the outskirts of the village. He's always gloomy and believes that the world outside Troll Village is full of danger.

One day, Poppy discovers that the Bergens, a group of gray creatures who live in the forest, are coming to Troll Village to eat trolls for their "troll-hunting" tradition. The Bergens believe that eating a troll will give them happiness and energy. Desperate to save her friends, Poppy sets out on a journey to find the Bergens' leader, Queen Barb (voiced by Christine Baranski), with Branch reluctantly joining her.

As they journey through the forest, Poppy and Branch encounter various obstacles, including treacherous terrain, wild animals, and even a group of Bergens who are trying to capture them. Along the way, Poppy teaches Branch about the importance of happiness and friendship, while Branch tries to protect Poppy from harm.

When they finally reach Queen Barb's castle, Poppy and Branch discover that she's been brainwashed by her advisor, Prince Gristle (voiced by Christopher Mintz-Plasse), who has convinced her that eating trolls is the key to happiness. However, Poppy's optimism and kindness eventually break through to Queen Barb, and she begins to see the error of her ways.

In a thrilling finale, Poppy and Branch lead an army of trolls in a musical battle against the Bergens, with the help of Guy Diamond (voiced by Ken Jeong) and Biggie (voiced by James Corden). The movie ends with Queen Barb and Prince Gristle being defeated, and Troll Village celebrating their newfound happiness and unity.

Throughout the film, the animation is vibrant and colorful, with a range of fun and quirky characters. The music is catchy and upbeat, featuring songs like "Can't Stop the Feeling!" and "Get Back Up Again." Overall, Trolls is a heartwarming and entertaining movie that celebrates the power of friendship, happiness, and individuality.

The film received generally positive reviews from critics, with many praising its colorful animation, catchy music, and strong voice cast. However, some critics noted that the plot was somewhat predictable and that the characters could have been more developed. Despite this, Trolls has become a beloved animated classic, and its success spawned a sequel, Trolls World Tour (2020).

original_title: LEGO Marvel Super Heroes: Avengers Reassembled!
overview: The Avengers are forced to “party” with Ultron when he seeks to disassemble the team by taking control of Iron Man’s armor and enact a nefarious scheme to take over the world.
title: LEGO Marvel Super Heroes: Avengers Reassembled!
plot:
LEGO Marvel Super Heroes: Avengers Reassembled! is a 2015 American computer-animated television special based on Lego's Marvel Super Heroes toy line and featuring Marvel Comics' Avengers. Directed by Rob Silvestri and written by Mark Hoffmeier, it was produced by Arc Productions, with Jill Wilfert and Jason Cosler as executive producers alongside Marvel's Alan Fine, Dan Buckley, Jeph Loeb and Joe Quesada. Running about 22 minutes, it serves as a comedic spin-off of Avengers: Age of Ultron. The voice cast includes Mick Wingert as Iron Man, Roger Craig Smith as Captain America, Travis Willingham as Thor and Yellowjacket, Fred Tatasciore as the Hulk, Laura Bailey as Black Widow, Troy Baker as Hawkeye, JP Karliak as Vision and Baron Strucker, Jim Meskimen as Ultron, Grant George as Ant-Man, Ben Diskin as Spider-Man, Eric Bauza as Iron Spider and Bumper Robinson as Falcon.

As the Avengers prepare for a party at Avengers Tower, the team notices that Iron Man is behaving strangely. They soon discover that the villain Ultron has taken control of Tony Stark and his armor, turning him into a puppet as part of a scheme to take over the world. After causing chaos in the tower, the possessed Iron Man flies off, and the heroes give chase, learning that Ultron has joined forces with Yellowjacket and Hydra, led by Baron Strucker, to destroy them. Captain America, the Hulk, Thor, Vision, Black Widow and Hawkeye set out to free their teammate, with help from Spider-Man, Iron Spider and Ant-Man. Thor enters Stark's mind and learns that he must shock him to break Ultron's hold, and with a jolt of thunder he restores Iron Man to the team. Meanwhile, Spider-Man and Iron Spider capture Yellowjacket and extract information about the villains' plans. Returning to the tower, the reunited Avengers find Ultron wreaking havoc; he assembles his robot minions into a giant version of himself to finish them off, but Ant-Man shrinks down, gets inside Ultron's head and forces him to fall apart. The special ends with the team welcoming its newest member, Falcon.

The special premiered on Disney XD on 16 November 2015. Bubbleblabber gave it 5.5 out of 10, finding it less funny and gag-heavy than Lego's Star Wars parodies such as Droid Tales and its film-inspired dialogue grating, but noting that fans of cameos would enjoy the appearances of Spider-Man's allies, Falcon, Ant-Man and his nemesis Yellowjacket.

original_title: Game of Thrones: The Last Watch
overview: For a year, acclaimed British filmmaker Jeanie Finlay was embedded on the set of the hit HBO series “Game of Thrones,” chronicling the creation of the show’s most ambitious and complicated season.  Debuting one week after the series 8 finale, GAME OF THRONES: THE LAST WATCH delves deep into the mud and blood to reveal the tears and triumphs involved in the challenge of bringing the fantasy world of Westeros to life in the very real studios, fields and car-parks of Northern Ireland.  Made with unprecedented access, GAME OF THRONES: THE LAST WATCH is an up-close and personal portrait from the trenches of production, following the crew and the cast as they contend with extreme weather, punishing deadlines and an ever-excited fandom hungry for spoilers.  Much more than a “making of” documentary, this is a funny, heartbreaking story, told with wit and intimacy, about the bittersweet pleasures of what it means to create a world – and then have to say goodbye to it.
tagline: A farewell to Westeros with the people who built the realm
title: Game of Thrones: The Last Watch
plot:
Game of Thrones: The Last Watch is a 2019 documentary film directed by Jeanie Finlay that chronicles the making of the eighth and final season of HBO's fantasy series Game of Thrones. Embedded on the production for a year, Finlay followed the work from the first table read to the filming of the last scene, and the film features cast members such as Kit Harington and Emilia Clarke and David Nutter alongside many of the crew members whose work is rarely seen.

Described by HBO as revealing "the tears and triumphs involved in the challenge of bringing the fantasy world of Westeros to life" in the studios, fields and car parks of Northern Ireland, the documentary mixes behind-the-scenes footage with interviews. Rather than concentrating only on the stars and writers, it gives equal attention to production assistants, costume designers, set decorators, caterers and carpenters, revealing the scale of the effort behind the production. It opens with the cast's first reading of the final scripts and closes with the wrap of filming.

HBO approached Finlay, a casual fan of the series, after being impressed by her earlier documentaries such as The Great Hip Hop Hoax (2013) and Orion (2015). After meeting with producers David Benioff, D. B. Weiss, Bernadette Caulfield and Carolyn Strauss, she was given full autonomy and unrestricted access to the set, alternating weeks on the production with work on her documentary Seahorse. The project was kept secret from all but those directly involved, and Finlay received the season's scripts before some of the cast had read them so that she could decide whose reactions to film at the table read. Composer Hannah Peel was commissioned to write the score in late 2017. Filming wrapped alongside the season in July 2018, with more than 950 hours of footage shot over 14 months, and Finlay delivered her final cut two weeks before the season premiered.

Announced in March 2019, the documentary aired on HBO on 26 May 2019, a week after the series finale, and drew 1.63 million viewers on its first broadcast. It received mostly positive reviews, holding 100% on Rotten Tomatoes; Mashable called it "a better ending than the Game of Thrones finale", while IGN praised it as a satisfying coda but wished it had explored the writing process further. Peel received a Primetime Emmy nomination for its music.

overview: In an isolated family mansion, a group of rich 20-somethings decides to play Bodies Bodies Bodies, a game where one of them is secretly a "killer" while the rest tries to "escape". Things take a turn for the worse when real bodies start turning up, setting off a paranoid and dangerous chain of events.
tagline: This is not a safe space.
title: Bodies Bodies Bodies
plot:
Bodies Bodies Bodies is a 2022 American horror-comedy film written and directed by Halina Reijn. The movie follows three friends, Emily (Amandla Stenberg), Claire (Maria Bakalova), and Whitney (Myanmar-born actress Pimberley), who reunite for a weekend at a remote vacation home in rural Texas.

The story begins with the trio engaging in a game of "Truth or Dare," which they played as teenagers. The game, however, takes a dark turn when Claire is forced to perform a gruesome task, resulting in her death. The remaining two friends are shocked and traumatized by the event, but they soon realize that they have been invited to Claire's funeral.

As the weekend progresses, Emily and Whitney begin to experience strange and terrifying events at the house. They start to suspect that someone is impersonating Claire, who had a troubled past with her friends. The tension builds as the two women try to uncover the identity of the imposter and the motives behind it.

Throughout the film, the lines between reality and fantasy become increasingly blurred. Emily and Whitney's perceptions of each other and themselves are challenged, leading to a descent into paranoia and violence. As the body count rises, the friends' relationships with each other begin to deteriorate.

The movie takes a darkly comedic turn as the characters engage in a series of gruesome and satirical murders, which serve as a commentary on toxic masculinity, privilege, and social status. The film's tone is reminiscent of classic horror movies from the 1970s and 1980s, with a dash of modern irreverence.

As the story unfolds, Emily and Whitney are forced to confront their own dark pasts and the true nature of their friendship. In the end, only one person remains, and the film's climax is both shocking and thought-provoking.

Bodies Bodies Bodies received widespread critical acclaim for its originality, wit, and performances. The movie has been praised for its subversion of traditional horror tropes and its commentary on toxic masculinity and social status.

overview: Charlie Cullen was an experienced registered nurse, trusted and beloved by his colleagues at Somerset Medical Center in New Jersey. He was also one of history’s most prolific serial killers, with a body count potentially numbering in the hundreds across multiple medical facilities in the Northeast.
title: Capturing the Killer Nurse
plot:
American Factory is a documentary film that explores the transformation of a factory in Ohio from manufacturing auto parts to producing goods for Chinese tech giant Foxconn. The movie delves into the lives of the workers who are struggling to adapt to this change, as well as the owners and managers who are trying to navigate the complexities of globalization.

At its core, American Factory is a film about the human cost of economic transformation and the struggle for dignity in the workplace. It highlights the tensions between tradition and innovation, as well as the clash between old-fashioned values and modern capitalist principles. The documentary also explores themes of identity, community, and the search for meaning in a rapidly changing world.

Through the stories of its characters, American Factory reveals the emotional toll that this transformation has taken on the workers, many of whom have dedicated their lives to the factory and are now facing an uncertain future. The film raises important questions about the nature of work, the role of corporations in society, and the impact of globalization on local communities.

Ultimately, American Factory is a powerful exploration of the human side of economic change, one that challenges viewers to think critically about the consequences of our globalized economy and the importance of preserving traditional ways of life.

overview: An uptight MBA student falls for the charismatic new neighbor who charms her troubled family – but he has a secret that forces him to push her away.
tagline: A story of a lifetime… in a heartbeat.
title: Kal Ho Naa Ho
plot:
Kal Ho Naa Ho is a thought-provoking film that explores the complexities of life, love, and mortality. The movie delves into the theme of living in the present moment, letting go of past regrets, and embracing the uncertainty of the future.

The story revolves around Aman (played by Shah Rukh Khan), a young man who is diagnosed with a heart condition that gives him only 24 hours to live. As he navigates his final days, Aman encourages those around him to seize the day, chase their dreams, and find meaning in life.

Through Aman's character, the film highlights the importance of human connection, love, and relationships in giving life its purpose. The movie also explores the theme of finding one's identity and purpose, as embodied by the characters of Naina (played by Preity Zinta) and Aman himself.

The film's narrative is woven around the idea that every moment counts, and that life is a precious gift that should be cherished and lived to the fullest. The movie's title, "Kal Ho Naa Ho," which translates to "Tomorrow May Never Come," serves as a poignant reminder of the importance of making the most of each day.

Ultimately, Kal Ho Naa Ho is a heartwarming and thought-provoking film that encourages viewers to reevaluate their priorities, let go of fear and anxiety, and live life with intention, purpose, and passion.

overview: Determined to get engaged before her youngest sister's wedding, flight attendant Montana Moore finds herself with only 30 days to make a connection. Fortunately, her friends have cooked up a high-flying scheme to help Montana land...the perfect guy!
tagline: She's done flying solo.
title: Baggage Claim
plot:
Baggage Claim is a romantic comedy-drama film that explores the theme of self-discovery and growth through the lens of love and relationships. The movie follows the story of Montana, a successful event planner in her late 20s who has given up on love after a string of failed relationships.

As Montana navigates her way through a series of dates with various men, she begins to realize that she's been focusing on finding the perfect partner rather than becoming the best version of herself. The film takes her on a journey of self-discovery, where she learns to let go of her past and focus on building meaningful connections with others.

Throughout the movie, Montana faces various challenges and setbacks, including a painful breakup and a series of awkward dates. However, with each failure, she gains valuable insight into what she truly wants in life and love. The film ultimately becomes a heartwarming exploration of how love can be found in unexpected places and that true happiness comes from within.

The movie also touches on the theme of female empowerment, as Montana learns to take control of her life and make decisions that align with her values and goals. Through her journey, she discovers that she's capable of more than she ever thought possible and that love can be a powerful catalyst for personal growth and transformation.

overview: A troubled psychologist is sent to investigate the crew of an isolated research station orbiting a bizarre planet.
tagline: How far will you go for a second chance?
title: Solaris
plot:
Solaris is a 2002 science fiction film directed by Steven Soderbergh, produced by 20th Century Fox, and based on the novel of the same name by Stanislaw Lem.

The main themes of Solaris include:

1. **Identity and Humanity**: The film explores the nature of humanity and what it means to be alive. The protagonist, Chris Kelvin (played by George Clooney), is a psychologist sent to investigate strange occurrences on the space station Solaris. As he delves deeper into the mystery, he begins to question his own identity and sense of self.
2. **Isolation and Loneliness**: The film takes place in a remote space station, where the crew is isolated from the rest of humanity. This isolation serves as a catalyst for exploring themes of loneliness, disconnection, and the human need for connection.
3. **The Nature of Reality**: Solaris raises questions about the nature of reality and how it can be perceived by humans. The film's use of hallucinatory projections and alternate realities blurs the lines between what is real and what is imagined.
4. **Grief and Loss**: Chris Kelvin's wife, Rheya (played by Natascha McElhone), dies in a car accident, leaving him with emotional scars. Her presence on Solaris serves as a reminder of his loss and forces him to confront his grief.
5. **The Dangers of Unchecked Emotions**: The film highlights the dangers of allowing emotions to consume us without control. Chris Kelvin's growing attachment to Rheya's projection on Solaris threatens to destroy his own sense of identity and relationships with others.

Throughout the film, Soderbergh masterfully weaves these themes together, creating a thought-provoking and visually stunning exploration of the human condition.

overview: Bruce Wayne faces a deadly menace from his past, with the help of three former classmates: world-renowned martial artists Richard Dragon, Ben Turner and Lady Shiva.
tagline: Get ready for the ultimate showdown.
title: Batman: Soul of the Dragon
plot:
Batman: Soul of the Dragon is a 2021 American animated superhero film produced by Warner Bros. Animation and DC Entertainment, the 43rd entry in the DC Universe Animated Original Movies line. Directed by Sam Liu and executive produced by Bruce Timm, it tells an original story set in the 1970s and inspired by the martial arts films of that era. David Giuntoli voices Bruce Wayne/Batman, with Mark Dacascos as Richard Dragon, Kelly Hu as Lady Shiva, Michael Jai White as Ben Turner/Bronze Tiger and James Hong as O-Sensei; White reprised his role from the television series Arrow and Hu hers from the video game Batman: Arkham Origins. The film is dedicated to comic book writer Dennis O'Neil, who died in 2020.

Years earlier, while training to become a crime-fighter, the young Bruce Wayne studies at Nanda Parbat, a hidden monastery in the Hindu Kush run by the martial arts master O-Sensei, alongside fellow students Shiva, Richard Dragon, Jade, Ben Turner and Rip Jagger. O-Sensei entrusts Shiva with Soul Breaker, a Muramasa sword, while forbidding his students to pass through a certain door. One night Rip breaks through it and kills Jade with the sword, which proves to be the key to a mystical gate leading to the realm of the serpent god Nāga. Demons pour through, and to close the gate O-Sensei sacrifices himself by stepping into Nāga's dimension. Years later, Richard learns that millionaire Jeffrey Burr, leader of the Kobra cult, has obtained the gate, and he travels to Gotham City to warn Bruce, only for both men to be attacked by the Axe Gang, hired by Burr's enforcer Schlangenfaust, who is hunting for Soul Breaker. Richard discovers Bruce's secret identity, and the two seek out Shiva, now a crime lord in Gotham's Chinatown, before the sword is stolen. Reuniting with Ben, now a martial arts teacher, the former classmates track the cult to a fortified island where Burr plans to open the gate by sacrificing kidnapped children, intending to become Nāga's earthly avatar, and they must stop the ritual before the god is unleashed.

The film was released on digital platforms on January 12, 2021, followed by Blu-ray and DVD on January 26. It was well received, with 93% of 15 critics' reviews positive on Rotten Tomatoes, and DVD Talk rated it "Recommended".

original_title: 劇場版総集編 オーバーロード 漆黒の英雄【後編】
overview: The second recap film of season 1 of the anime TV series Overlord, covering episodes 8 to 13.
title: Overlord: The Dark Hero
plot:
Overlord: The Dark Hero (Japanese: Gekijō-ban Sōshūhen Ōbārōdo: Shikkoku no Eiyū) is a 2017 Japanese animated fantasy compilation film produced by Madhouse and released by Kadokawa, the second of two theatrical recap films condensing the first season of the anime Overlord, itself based on Kugane Maruyama's light novel series. Covering episodes eight to thirteen, it follows the first film, The Undead King, released in February 2017; English-language sources also list it as The Dark Warrior. Satoshi Hino voices Ainz Ooal Gown, with Yumi Hara as Albedo, Sumire Uesaka as Shalltear Bloodfallen, Emiri Katō as Aura, Aoi Yūki as Clementine and Asami Seto as CZ2128 Delta.

When the virtual reality game Yggdrasil shut down, the guild master Momonga found himself transported with his guild's stronghold, the Great Tomb of Nazarick, and its loyal servants into a real fantasy world, where he took the name Ainz Ooal Gown. Seeking to learn about this world, he poses as the adventurer Momon, accompanied by the battle maid Narberal disguised as Nabe, and joins the adventurers' guild of E-Rantel. Escorting the young Nfirea with the adventurer party Swords of Darkness, Momon tames the legendary Wise King of the Forest, a giant hamster he names Hamsuke. Back in the city, the assassin Clementine and the necromancer Khajiit kidnap Nfirea, slaughter the Swords of Darkness and raise an undead army in the cemetery. Hired by Nfirea's grandmother, Momon tracks them down; Nabe destroys Khajiit and his skeletal dragons, while Momon toys with Clementine before revealing his undead form and crushing her. Meanwhile Shalltear, hunting for martial arts users, falls under the control of a powerful World Class Item wielded by unknown attackers. Realizing that no ordinary means can free her, Ainz decides to face one of Nazarick's strongest guardians himself, defeating her with a meticulously prepared plan built on knowledge from her creator before resurrecting her at great cost. Momon and Nabe are then promoted directly to adamantite rank, becoming the kingdom's third adamantite party.

The Dark Hero opened in Japanese theaters on 11 March 2017, two weeks after The Undead King. The theme song of the two films, "Crazy Scary Holy Fantasy," was performed by Myth & Roid. A second television season was announced during screenings of the second compilation film and premiered in January 2018.

overview: After starting at an upmarket boarding school, a teenage girl forms close friendships with her two older roommates. However, when she discovers that her new friends are lovers she finds herself caught in a complicated situation.
tagline: Friends. Roommates. Lovers.
title: Lost and Delirious
plot:
Lost and Delirious is a 2001 Canadian drama film directed by Léa Pool. The movie revolves around the lives of three teenage girls, Annie, Marcia, and Louise, who embark on a summer road trip to Quebec City with their friends' fathers. 

The main theme of Lost and Delirious explores the complexities of female adolescence, identity, and the struggles of growing up. It delves into the characters' desires for freedom, autonomy, and self-discovery as they navigate through the challenges of adolescence.

Throughout the film, Annie, Marcia, and Louise grapple with their own insecurities, fears, and dreams, often finding themselves at odds with each other. The movie also touches on themes of class differences, social status, and the constraints placed on women by societal expectations.

The title "Lost and Delirious" captures the essence of the characters' emotional states, as they become increasingly disoriented and disconnected from their surroundings. This sense of disorientation is mirrored in the film's use of vibrant colors, dreamlike sequences, and a non-linear narrative structure, which adds to the overall sense of confusion and uncertainty.

Ultimately, Lost and Delirious presents a poignant portrayal of female adolescence, one that is both raw and unflinching, yet ultimately hopeful and redemptive.

overview: When a virus threatens to turn the now earth-dwelling friendly alien hybrids against humans, Captain Rose Corley must lead a team of elite mercenaries on a mission to the alien world in order to save what's left of humanity.
tagline: To save our world she must invade theirs.
title: Skylines
plot:
Skylines, also known as Skyline 3, is a 2020 American science fiction action film directed and co-produced by Liam O'Donnell, from a story he developed with Matthew E. Chausse. The third installment in the Skyline series and a sequel to Beyond Skyline (2017), it stars Lindsey Morgan as Rose Corley, with Jonathan Howard as Leon, Daniel Bernhardt as Owens, Rhona Mitra as Dr. Mal, Alexander Siddig as General Radford and James Cosmo as Grant.

Ten years after the first invasion, Rose, a super-powered hybrid, leads Earth's fleet against the Harvesters' mothership, the Armada, orbiting the Moon. Sacrificing a ship and thousands of lives, she destroys it. Guilt-stricken, she disappears as humanity rebuilds alongside billions of Pilots, alien-human hybrids. Five years later, Rose lives in a tent city near the ruins of London, staving off accelerated aging with transfusions from her friend Dr. Mal. A virus begins killing the Pilots while returning them to their brainwashed state. The resistance brings Rose to General Radford, who says only the Armada's core drive, which warped to the Harvester homeworld Cobalt One, can save them.

Rose reluctantly joins the mission. The ship crash-lands on Cobalt One, where the team, including Rose's adoptive brother Trent, finds dead Harvesters and mutations. The Harvester Matriarch briefly controls Rose, whose wartime hesitation was caused by that influence, until Trent frees her. Rose seizes the core drive, but Owens betrays the team, infects Trent and flees with it. Rose and Leon discover that Radford had already bombed the planet with a biological weapon, the same virus ravaging the Pilots, which was meant to euthanize them and wipe out the Harvesters. Radford uses the drive to destroy Cobalt One, but the Matriarch, who has stowed away aboard, kills him. In a wormhole, Owens disintegrates, and Trent knocks the Matriarch to the same fate, losing most of his body. On Earth, Mal and the other residents fight off infected Pilots, losing Grant, until Rose arrives and uses her ship to spread Mal's cure worldwide. Mal transplants Trent's brain into a new body, and Rose sets course for a secret prison where Radford held their father, Mark Corley.

The film premiered at London's FrightFest on October 25, 2020. Vertical Entertainment released it in U.S. theaters and on Apple TV on December 18, 2020, during the COVID-19 pandemic. Rotten Tomatoes reported 56% approval from 27 reviews, and Metacritic gave it 46 out of 100.

overview: Jai and Ali return, this time on the trail of an international thief who steals priceless artifacts and has chosen Mumbai as his next target.
tagline: Back in Action
title: Dhoom 2
plot:
Dhoom 2 is an action-packed heist film that delves into the world of high-stakes crime and deception. At its core, the movie explores the theme of greed and its corrupting influence on individuals. The main character, Jai (played by Abhishek Bachchan), is a man driven by his desire to bring down the villainous Aamir (played by Hrithik Roshan) and his accomplices.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that greed is not just about material wealth but also about power and control. The characters in the movie are willing to go to great lengths to achieve their goals, often sacrificing their morals and values in the process. This theme is expertly woven throughout the narrative, adding depth and complexity to the film.

The movie also touches on the idea of identity and how it can be manipulated for personal gain. Aamir's character, in particular, is a master of disguise and deception, using his charm and wit to manipulate those around him. This theme serves as a commentary on the superficiality of modern society, where people are often more concerned with appearances than substance.

Furthermore, Dhoom 2 explores the concept of loyalty and betrayal, highlighting the blurred lines between right and wrong in the world of crime. The film's climax is particularly noteworthy for its thought-provoking portrayal of these themes, leaving the audience to ponder the true nature of morality and the consequences of one's actions.

Overall, Dhoom 2 is a gripping thriller that delves into the darker aspects of human nature, making it a compelling watch for fans of action-packed heist films.

overview: On the run with a bag full of cash after a robbing his former crime boss—and a potentially fatal wound—Freddy slips onto a bus headed into the unrelenting California desert. With his life slipping through his fingers, Freddy is left with very few choices to survive.
tagline: No wrong turn goes unpunished.
title: One Way
plot:
One Way is a 2022 American action crime thriller directed by Andrew Baird from a screenplay by Ben Conway. Colson Baker, the musician also known as Machine Gun Kelly, stars as Freddy Sullivan, a small-time criminal on the run, with Storm Reid as Rachel, Kevin Bacon as Freddy's father, Travis Fimmel as a fellow passenger named Will, and Drea de Matteo, Meagan Holder, Rhys Coiro and Luis Da Silva in supporting roles.

Freddy, a low-level Los Angeles hoodlum, has stolen a bag of cash and cocaine from his criminal associates, a gang run by the sociopathic Vic, played by de Matteo. Shot in the gut while escaping, he boards a long-distance bus bound for a small town in Georgia, and most of the film unfolds on board. Badly wounded and growing weaker, Freddy works the phone throughout the journey, in tense calls with Vic, with his ex-girlfriend Christine, a nurse, with a nervous associate, and with his deadbeat father, whose contact in Freddy's phone is saved under an insult. Along the way, he is betrayed by his own father.

In the seat in front of him sits Rachel, a precocious young woman who is probably underage but claims to be 21. Out of minutes on her own phone, she persuades Freddy to lend her his so that she can make arrangements to meet a mysterious stranger named Smokie, who is clearly grooming her. The cramped bus fills with fellow passengers who are by turns kind, rude and sinister, among them the unsettling Will. As the miles pass, Freddy must contend with his worsening injury while deciding whether to put himself at further risk to protect Rachel from the danger she is heading toward.

Baker and Fimmel were cast in September 2020, Bacon joined that November, and Reid in February 2021. Principal photography began on February 2, 2021, in Thomasville, Georgia. Saban Films released the film in theaters and on video on demand in the United States on September 2, 2022. Reviews were mixed, with 53% approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 46. The Guardian's Leslie Felperin felt the director overused woozy handheld camerawork and fluttery editing but found the script better than expected at exploiting its confined setting and the odd community of a long bus journey; she judged that Baker could act but was consistently upstaged by Reid, whose character had the more interesting story.

original_title: Beneath the Planet of the Apes
overview: The sole survivor of an interplanetary rescue mission discovers a planet ruled by apes, and an underground city run by telepathic humans.
tagline: The bizarre world of "Planet of the Apes" was only the beginning...
title: Beneath the Planet of the Apes
plot:
Beneath the Planet of the Apes is a 1970 science fiction film directed by Ted Post, produced by Arthur P. Jacobs, and written by Michael Wilson. The movie is the third installment in the Planet of the Apes series.

The story begins with a spaceship carrying a group of astronauts on a mission to explore the planet A-274, which has been discovered to be rich in minerals. However, upon arrival, they discover that the planet's surface is covered in a thick layer of radioactive waste and toxic gases. The crew soon realizes that their ship is damaged beyond repair, and they are forced to make an emergency landing on the planet's surface.

The astronauts soon discover that the planet has been devastated by nuclear war, which has caused widespread destruction and mutated many of its inhabitants into violent, ape-like creatures. The crew members begin to experience strange visions and hallucinations, which they attribute to the radiation poisoning they have suffered during their crash landing.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that the astronauts are not alone on the planet. A group of humans, led by a mysterious figure known as Dr. Milo, have been living in secret beneath the surface of the planet. These humans have developed advanced technology and have been working to rebuild society after the nuclear war.

The leader of the human survivors is a woman named Dr. Zaius's daughter, who has become increasingly unstable due to her exposure to radiation. She becomes convinced that the astronauts are a threat to humanity's survival and orders her men to capture them.

As tensions rise between the humans and the astronauts, it becomes clear that the true enemy is not the apes, but rather the nuclear war that devastated the planet. The movie takes a dark and satirical tone as it explores the consequences of nuclear war and the dangers of playing with forces beyond human control.

In the end, the humans are forced to make a difficult decision: either sacrifice themselves or allow the astronauts to escape with their lives. In a shocking twist, Dr. Zaius's daughter is revealed to be the one who has been manipulating events from behind the scenes, and she ultimately decides to sacrifice herself to save humanity.

The movie ends with the astronauts escaping the planet, but not before they witness the destruction of the human settlement beneath the surface. The final shot is of a nuclear missile heading towards the Earth, leaving the audience with a sense of foreboding and unease.

Overall, Beneath the Planet of the Apes is a thought-provoking and unsettling film that explores themes of nuclear war, survival, and the dangers of playing with forces beyond human control. The movie's dark tone and satirical commentary on the consequences of nuclear war make it a classic of science fiction cinema.

overview: Tess enlists her biological father - a lovable slacker from the wrong side of the tracks - and the charming juvenile delinquent next door to help her come to grips with the death of her little sister.
title: Dear Zoe
plot:
Dear Zoe is an American drama of 2022 directed by Gren Wells from a screenplay by Marc Lhormer and Melissa Martin, adapted from Philip Beard's novel of 2005. Sadie Sink stars as Tess DeNunzio, a grieving teenager in Pittsburgh, with Theo Rossi as her father Nick, Kweku Collins as her neighbour Jimmy Freeze, Jessica Capshaw as her mother Elly, Justin Bartha as her stepfather David and Vivien Lyra Blair as her younger half-sister Em.

Sixteen-year-old Tess lives with her mother, stepfather and Em. Her three-year-old half-sister Zoe was killed by a hit-and-run driver on the day of the September 11 attacks, while Tess was meant to be watching her. Since then she has helped David look after Em while Elly battles depression, and in family therapy she feels shut out of her parents' grief. When she learns that her mother has been carrying on an emotional affair with a much younger grocery clerk, Tess breaks down and moves in with her biological father, a German Shepherd breeder living in poorer Braddock, though she feels guilty about leaving Em behind.

Tess cares for one of Nick's puppies and he drives Em home from school so the sisters can still meet, but a hymn at church brings back 9/11 and sends her fleeing in tears. She is drawn to Jimmy, a neighbour Nick warns her to avoid, and realises that her father sells drugs from his truck. Jimmy starts climbing through her window at night; he talks of his mother's death and his time in a correctional facility, and they fall in love while working summer jobs at the Kennywood amusement park. Weekly calls with Elly help mother and daughter heal. On Tess's seventeenth birthday, Nick and Jimmy are both arrested, revealing that Jimmy deals with her father. That night Tess finally tells Jimmy the truth: she missed the bus, ran indoors to watch the news of the attacks, and came back to see Zoe step off the curb into the path of a car. Jimmy still loves her. Tess returns home, weeps on the spot where Zoe fell and reconciles with her mother, David and Em.

Shot in Pittsburgh with a mostly local crew in late 2019, after the novel had been optioned since 2010, the film was released in select cinemas and on demand on 4 November 2022. It holds 71% on Rotten Tomatoes.

overview: The tale of an extraordinary family, the Madrigals, who live hidden in the mountains of Colombia, in a magical house, in a vibrant town, in a wondrous, charmed place called an Encanto. The magic of the Encanto has blessed every child in the family—every child except one, Mirabel. But when she discovers that the magic surrounding the Encanto is in danger, Mirabel decides that she, the only ordinary Madrigal, might just be her exceptional family's last hope.
tagline: There's a little magic in all of us ...almost all of us.
title: Encanto
plot:
Encanto is a 2021 animated musical fantasy film produced by Walt Disney Pictures. The movie takes place in Colombia and follows the story of the Madrigal family, who live in a magical house in the mountains.

The story centers around Mirabel Madrigal (voiced by Stephanie Beatriz), the only member of the family who does not possess any special gifts or magical powers. According to Colombian folklore, each member of the family has been blessed with a unique gift that allows them to contribute to the household and its magic.

Mirabel's family is led by her mother, Julieta (voiced by Jennifer Lopez), who can heal physical wounds through cooking; her father, Agustín (voiced by Juan de Dios Botero), who can make anyone fall in love with him through music; and her older sister, Luisa (voiced by Diane Guerrero), who has superhuman strength.

As Mirabel navigates her way through adolescence, she struggles to find her place within the family. She feels like an outcast because of her lack of magical powers and is often overlooked by her family members. However, when a mysterious curse begins to affect the family's gifts, Mirabel must embark on a journey to save her family and their magical house.

Along the way, Mirabel discovers that the curse was caused by a past tragedy in the family's history and that she has a crucial role to play in breaking it. With the help of her family members, Mirabel learns to appreciate her own unique qualities and finds a way to contribute to the household in her own special way.

The movie features stunning animation, catchy music, and a heartwarming story that celebrates Colombian culture and the importance of family. The characters are well-developed and relatable, making it easy for audiences to become invested in their stories.

Overall, Encanto is a beautifully crafted film that explores themes of identity, belonging, and the power of love and acceptance. With its vibrant animation, memorable music, and inspiring story, it's no wonder why Encanto has become a modern Disney classic.

overview: Sarah Huttinger's return home with her fiance convinces her that the sedate, proper, country-club lifestyle of her family isn't for her – and that maybe the Huttinger family isn't even hers – as she uncovers secrets that suggest the Huttingers are neither sedate nor proper.
tagline: Based on a true rumor
title: Rumor Has It...
plot:
Rumor Has It... is a 2005 American romantic comedy film directed by Kevin Williamson and starring Jennifer Aniston, Kevin Costner, and Shirley MacLaine. The movie follows the story of Elizabeth "Liz" Taylor (played by Jennifer Aniston), who recounts her life story to her daughter, revealing her experiences with love, loss, and fame.

The main themes of Rumor Has It... include:

1. **Love and Relationships**: The film explores Liz's tumultuous relationships with men, including her iconic marriages to Richard Burton and Eddie Fisher. Through her stories, the movie highlights the complexities of love, desire, and heartbreak.
2. **Identity and Self-Discovery**: As Liz navigates her life, she struggles to define herself beyond her celebrity status. The film shows how she grapples with finding her own identity, values, and sense of purpose.
3. **Fame and Celebrity Culture**: Rumor Has It... satirizes the excesses and superficiality of Hollywood's Golden Age, particularly in the 1950s and '60s. The movie pokes fun at the glamour and pretensions of celebrity culture, while also exploring its darker side.
4. **Mother-Daughter Relationships**: The film focuses on the complex bond between Liz and her daughter, as they share stories and secrets. This theme highlights the challenges and rewards of intergenerational relationships and the power of storytelling to bridge gaps between generations.

Overall, Rumor Has It... is a lighthearted, entertaining film that balances humor with poignant insights into the human experience.

overview: At “Prom,” every couple has a story and no two are exactly alike. As the big dance approaches for Nova Prescott, it’s a battle of wills as she finds herself drawn to the guy who gets in the way of her perfect prom. Fellow seniors Mei and Tyler harbor secrets, while others face all the insecurity and anticipation that surrounds one of high school’s most seminal events.
tagline: There are hundreds of nights in high school, but there’s only one prom.
title: Prom
plot:
Prom is a 2011 American teen romantic comedy directed by Joe Nussbaum, written by Katie Wech and produced by Ted Griffin and Justin Springer for Walt Disney Pictures. Aimee Teegarden stars as Nova Prescott and Thomas McDonell as Jesse Richter, with Danielle Campbell as Simone, Nolan Sotillo as Lucas, DeVaughn Nixon as Tyler, Kylie Bunbury as Jordan and Nicholas Braun as Lloyd. It follows students at a Michigan high school before their prom.

Nova, on the prom committee, hopes her crush Brandon will ask her to the dance. Mei fears telling her boyfriend Justin she got into a different university. Shy Lucas wants to ask his lab partner Simone, and Lloyd cannot find a date at all. When the popular Tyler takes his girlfriend Jordan on a candlelit date in the shed where the prom decorations are stored, a candle left burning sets it on fire. Nova must rebuild everything, and the principal tells Jesse, a disrespectful student indifferent to prom, to help her or not graduate. The two reluctantly begin working together, and as Brandon fails to ask her out, Nova grows closer to Jesse. A spying mission at a rival school ends with police catching them.

As Lucas courts Simone, Tyler, who has been cheating on Jordan, begins pursuing her too. Simone surprises Lucas with concert tickets, and he drops his friend Corey to take her, but after Jordan dumps Tyler, Tyler asks Simone to prom that night, and she accepts. Mei finally tells Justin the truth, and he is proud of her. Nova admits to her friends that she has feelings for Jesse, but her father, who overhears, tells Jesse he is dragging her down and must not ask her to prom. On prom night, Lucas begs Simone not to go, then makes amends by taking Corey to the concert. Nova learns what her father did and storms out, while Jesse's mother persuades him to go after her. At the dance, Tyler abandons Simone, who leaves to dance with Lucas outside. As a heartbroken Nova is about to leave, the broken fountain springs back to life; Jesse has fixed it, and he asks her to prom.

Disney developed the film after the success of High School Musical 3, in the vein of John Hughes, with a modest budget and newcomers. Shot in Los Angeles, it was the first major release filmed on Arri Alexa cameras. Released on April 29, 2011, it opened fifth and grossed $10.1 million domestically. Reviews were mixed to negative. Rotten Tomatoes reported 36% approval, calling it more nuanced and less cynical than expected but just as corny and clichéd.

overview: The journey of a woman scientist who, at the end of times, discovers that true Faith can bring Miracles.
tagline: For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ shall all be made alive.
title: The Second Coming of Christ
plot:
The Woman in the Window is a 2021 psychological thriller film directed by Joe Wright, based on the novel of the same name by A.J. Finn.

The movie follows Anna Fox, a recluse who spends her days spying on her neighbors and watching old movies. However, when she witnesses what appears to be a crime, her life becomes entangled in a mystery that puts her own life at risk.

Some of the main themes present in The Woman in the Window include:

1. **Isolation and loneliness**: Anna's reclusive lifestyle serves as a backdrop for exploring the consequences of social isolation and loneliness. Her inability to connect with others leads to feelings of disconnection and despair.
2. **Guilt and regret**: Anna's past mistakes and regrets are slowly revealed throughout the film, highlighting the weight of guilt and its impact on one's mental health.
3. **Perception vs. reality**: The movie blurs the lines between what is real and what is perceived, leaving the audience questioning what actually happened. This theme speaks to the fragility of human perception and the ease with which our perceptions can be manipulated.
4. **Trauma and PTSD**: Anna's experiences are rooted in a traumatic event from her past, which has left her with PTSD-like symptoms. The film explores the long-term effects of trauma on individuals and their relationships.
5. **The power dynamics between men and women**: The movie critiques the societal expectations placed on women, particularly those related to domesticity and caregiving. Anna's character is a prime example of this, as she struggles to assert her own identity and autonomy.

Overall, The Woman in the Window is a thought-provoking thriller that delves into complex themes and explores the human condition through its protagonist's journey.

overview: In post-industrial Ohio, a Chinese billionaire opens a new factory in the husk of an abandoned General Motors plant, hiring two thousand blue-collar Americans. Early days of hope and optimism give way to setbacks as high-tech China clashes with working-class America.
tagline: Cultures collide. Hope survives.
title: American Factory
plot:
American Factory is a documentary film that explores the transformation of a factory in Ohio from manufacturing auto parts to producing goods for Chinese tech giant Foxconn. The movie delves into the lives of the workers who are struggling to adapt to this change, as well as the owners and managers who are trying to navigate the complexities of globalization.

At its core, American Factory is a film about the human cost of economic transformation and the struggle for dignity in the workplace. It highlights the tensions between tradition and innovation, as well as the clash between old-fashioned values and modern capitalist principles. The documentary also explores themes of identity, community, and the search for meaning in a rapidly changing world.

Through the stories of its characters, American Factory reveals the emotional toll that this transformation has taken on the workers, many of whom have dedicated their lives to the factory and are now facing an uncertain future. The film raises important questions about the nature of work, the role of corporations in society, and the impact of globalization on local communities.

Ultimately, American Factory is a powerful exploration of the human side of economic change, one that challenges viewers to think critically about the consequences of our globalized economy and the importance of preserving traditional ways of life.

overview: In 1971, Carole and Delphine meet and fall in love in Paris. When Carole follows Delphine back to her family farm in Limousin, the two find lesbianism and feminism are not as easy in the countryside.
title: Summertime
plot:
Summertime (French: La Belle Saison, "The Beautiful Season") is a romantic drama of 2015 directed by Catherine Corsini, who wrote it with Laurette Polmanss. Set in 1971, it stars Izïa Higelin as Delphine, a young farmer's daughter, and Cécile de France as Carole, a Parisian feminist, with Noémie Lvovsky as Delphine's mother Monique, Kévin Azaïs as Antoine and Laetitia Dosch as Adeline.

Delphine, the only child of a farming couple, loves working the land, while her father hopes to see her married. When the local girl she has been secretly seeing announces her own engagement and dismisses their affair as nothing serious, Delphine leaves for Paris. There she steps in to defend a woman attacked by a man during a feminist street action and meets Carole, a member of the group, which welcomes Delphine into its protests. Delphine persuades the women to help rescue a gay friend of one member who has been locked in a psychiatric hospital and subjected to electroshock therapy. Soon after, she kisses Carole, who at first insists she is not a lesbian but quickly falls for her, straining her relationship with her boyfriend.

When Delphine's father suffers a stroke, she returns home to run the farm, drawing on the collective's lessons to defend her parents' interests among the other farmers. Carole leaves her boyfriend and joins her, only to find they must hide their relationship because Delphine's mother knows nothing. Carole delights in country life and farm work but chafes at the locals' mockery of her politics and at living in secret, and grows jealous when Monique hints that Antoine, Delphine's devoted childhood friend, means to marry her. Their quarrels expose the secret to a neighbour who glimpses them kissing in the woods and to Monique, who finally finds them in bed. Feigning normality with her daughter, Monique turns on Carole, accuses her of corrupting Delphine and strikes her. Carole leaves and Delphine goes with her, but on the journey she cannot bring herself to abandon her home and misses the connecting train to Paris. Five years later, Carole, now working at a women's health clinic and in a new relationship, receives a letter from Delphine, who has her own farm in the south and regrets not having gone with her.
