Columbia Airlines Flight 409, a Boeing 747, flies overnight from Washington to Los Angeles, while businessman Scott Freeman pilots his Beechcraft to Boise. Bad weather diverts both to Salt Lake City. As Flight 409 is cleared to land ahead of him, Freeman suffers a heart attack, and his plane climbs out of control and slams into the jet's cockpit. First Officer Urias is sucked out, the flight engineer is killed and Captain Stacy is blinded. Stacy engages the autopilot before passing out, and Nancy radios that no one can fly the plane. Patroni, a Columbia executive whose family is aboard, turns to Murdock, the chief flight instructor and Nancy's estranged boyfriend.

The autopilot keeps the jet level but cannot turn it, and the plane is heading toward the Wasatch Range. Murdock talks Nancy through manual turns until radio contact fails, and with Stacy's help she climbs over the peaks. A military helicopter then attempts a midair pilot transfer. Major Alexander is lowered toward the hole in the cockpit, but his harness snags on the torn metal, he comes loose and falls to his death. Murdock, the only other person aboard qualified to land a 747, is lowered successfully. He lands at Salt Lake City, using high-speed taxiing to stop as brake pressure fails. The passengers escape down the evacuation slides, and Nancy and Murdock reconcile. Reddy, as a nun, sings "Best Friend" to an ailing girl played by Blair.

The production rented a 747 from American Airlines and filmed at Salt Lake City and Dulles. Universal released it on October 18, 1974. Made for $3 million, it grossed $47.3 million in the United States and Canada, the seventh-highest total of the year, and about $103 million worldwide. Reviews were largely negative. Pauline Kael dismissed it as "cut-rate swill" and Roger Ebert called it "corny escapism", while both Kael and Ebert criticized the condescending treatment of Black's character. Reddy received a Golden Globe nomination.

overview: The adventures of a group of explorers who make use of a newly discovered wormhole to surpass the limitations on human space travel and conquer the vast distances involved in an interstellar voyage.
tagline: Mankind was born on Earth. It was never meant to die here.
title: Interstellar
plot:
Interstellar is a thought-provoking science fiction film directed by Christopher Nolan, produced by Lynda Obst and Caleya Smith, and distributed by Warner Bros. Pictures.

In a dystopian future where Earth is facing an impending environmental disaster, humanity's last hope for survival lies in colonizing other planets. The story follows Cooper (Matthew McConaughey), a former NASA pilot who is forced to leave his daughter Murph (Jessica Chastain) behind when he is selected for a top-secret mission.

Cooper joins a team of scientists and engineers on a spaceship called the Endurance, led by Professor Brand (Michael Caine). Their mission is to travel through a wormhole in search of a new habitable planet for humanity. The crew must navigate treacherous asteroid fields, black holes, and time dilation effects caused by the intense gravitational forces they encounter.

As Cooper journeys deeper into space, he experiences strange occurrences that challenge his perception of time and space. He begins to communicate with an alien entity through a tesseract, a four-dimensional construct that allows for communication across vast distances. The entity, known as "Murph," is revealed to be the future version of his daughter.

Throughout the film, Nolan explores complex themes such as the power of love, the consequences of time dilation, and the search for a new home for humanity. Cooper's journey takes him through stunning visual effects, including wormholes, black holes, and gravitational waves.

Ultimately, Cooper finds himself in a tesseract where he can communicate with Murph at different points in her life. He realizes that his actions in the past have a profound impact on her future, and that their love is the key to humanity's survival. The film concludes with an emotional reunion between Cooper and Murph, as they find a way to transcend time and space.

Interstellar is a visually stunning and intellectually stimulating film that explores the boundaries of human knowledge and understanding. With its complex themes and thought-provoking ideas, it has become a modern classic in the science fiction genre.

overview: It's the 1940s, and the notorious Axe Gang terrorizes Shanghai. Small-time criminals Sing and Bone hope to join, but they only manage to make lots of very dangerous enemies. Fortunately for them, kung fu masters and hidden strength can be found in unlikely places. Now they just have to take on the entire Axe Gang.
tagline: So many gangsters… so little time.
title: Kung Fu Hustle
plot:
Kung Fu Hustle is a 2004 martial arts comedy film directed by Stephen Chow, produced by China Film Co-Production Corporation, and written by Stephen Chow. The film stars Stephen Chow, Zhang Manzi, and Yuen Biao.

The story takes place in the 1940s in the fictional city of Gong Tong, which is modeled after 1930s Shanghai. The film begins with a prologue that sets the tone for the rest of the movie: a flashback to the life of Sing (played by Stephen Chow), a young boy who dreams of becoming a kung fu master.

Sing's life takes a dramatic turn when he meets Master Pain (played by Yuen Biao), a renowned kung fu expert, and his sidekick, Thunderleg (played by Zhang Manzi). The two men are on the run from the notorious Triad leader, Boss Wolf (played by Danny Lee).

The story then shifts to the present day, where Sing is now an adult and working as a taxi driver. He lives in a small apartment with his mother, who runs a noodle shop. One day, a group of thugs, led by Boss Wolf, arrive at the noodle shop, seeking revenge against Sing's family.

To protect his mother, Sing teams up with Master Pain and Thunderleg to form an unlikely alliance. Together, they concoct a plan to defeat Boss Wolf and his gang. The trio uses their unique kung fu skills to outsmart and outmaneuver their opponents.

As the story unfolds, Sing becomes more confident in his abilities and begins to develop his own fighting style. He also starts to fall for a local woman named Princess Jasmine (played by Charlene Choi), who is being pursued by Boss Wolf's henchmen.

The film's climax features an epic battle between Sing, Master Pain, Thunderleg, and Boss Wolf's gang. The fight takes place in the streets of Gong Tong, with the trio using their kung fu skills to take down the thugs one by one.

In the end, Sing emerges victorious, having defeated Boss Wolf and saved his mother's noodle shop. He also wins Princess Jasmine's heart, and the two share a romantic moment.

Throughout the film, Stephen Chow showcases his impressive comedic timing and acting skills, as well as his mastery of kung fu. The film's blend of action, comedy, and music makes it a unique and entertaining ride.

Overall, Kung Fu Hustle is a hilarious and action-packed film that pays homage to classic Hong Kong cinema while also introducing new elements to the genre. With its colorful characters, witty dialogue, and impressive fight choreography, this film is sure to delight audiences of all ages.

overview: As Garibaldi's troops begin the unification of Italy in the 1860s, an aristocratic Sicilian family grudgingly adapts to the sweeping social changes undermining their way of life. Proud but pragmatic Prince Don Fabrizio Salina allows his war hero nephew, Tancredi, to marry Angelica, the beautiful daughter of gauche, bourgeois Don Calogero, in order to maintain the family's accustomed level of comfort and political clout.
tagline: Luchino Visconti's enduring romantic adventure
title: The Leopard
plot:
The Leopard (Italian: Il Gattopardo) is a 1963 epic historical drama directed by Luchino Visconti and adapted from Giuseppe Tomasi di Lampedusa's 1958 novel. Burt Lancaster stars as Don Fabrizio Corbera, Prince of Salina, with Alain Delon as his ambitious nephew Tancredi and Claudia Cardinale as Angelica. Paolo Stoppa plays Don Calogero Sedara. It was an Italian-French co-production between Titanus and Pathé.

In Sicily in 1860, as Garibaldi's redshirts fight the Bourbon king Francis II, the Prince tolerates his rebel nephew Tancredi with wry affection. After Garibaldi's forces take Palermo, the Prince reflects that change is inevitable: the middle class will replace the old ruling class, even if on the surface everything stays the same. He retreats to his summer palace at Donnafugata, where a plebiscite on unification passes unanimously, helped by the corruption of the town's leading citizen, Calogero. Calogero's beautiful daughter Angelica captivates both the Prince and Tancredi. Knowing Tancredi needs Calogero's money, the Prince blesses their engagement. When Tancredi switches from Garibaldi's army to the new royal army of Victor Emmanuel, the Prince recognizes him as the kind of opportunist who will thrive in the new Italy.

An envoy, Chevalley, invites the Prince to sit in the senate of the new Kingdom of Italy. He declines, saying Sicilians are too proud of their ancient heritage to want modernity, and predicts that the leopards and lions of his class will be replaced by jackals and hyenas. He suggests Calogero instead. At a lavish ball that marks Angelica's entry into high society, the melancholy Prince wanders through the rooms, disillusioned with the nouveau riche, until Angelica invites him to dance. For a moment he regains the grace of his youth, but his disenchantment soon returns. At dawn he walks home alone, pausing as a priest hurries by to give last rites, and disappears into a dark alley, a symbol of the fading past to which he belongs.

The Leopard won the Palme d'Or at the 1963 Cannes Film Festival and opened in Italy on March 28, 1963. It succeeded in Europe, but the shortened, English-dubbed version Fox released in the United States was panned by most American critics. The restored 185-minute version reached American theaters in 1983 to warm reviews, with Pauline Kael calling it intelligent and rapturous. It is now widely regarded as one of the greatest films ever made,.

overview: Three friends from California are filming an audition tape for an extreme reality game show. They document their journey to Australia where they will be doing their most dangerous activity.... Shark Cage Diving. A catastrophic turn of events leaves them in baited water full of Great White Sharks, turning their recording into a blood chilling diary of survival... and death.
production_companies: Just One More Productions Pty. Ltd
tagline: First you find the sharks. Then they find you.
title: Cage Dive
plot:
Open Water 3: Cage Dive is a 2017 Australian found-footage survival horror film written and directed by Gerald Rascionato. Presented as a mockumentary about supposedly true events, it follows three American tourists recording an audition tape for an extreme reality show when their shark cage diving boat capsizes. The cast includes Joel Hogan, Megan Peta Hill and Pete Valley. Although billed as the third Open Water film, it is a standalone story linked to the earlier entries only by theme.

A news report from October 2015 describes a capsized shark diving boat off Australia and a search for three missing passengers from Laguna Beach, California. A week later a diver finds an underwater camera lodged in a reef, its memory card intact, and posts the footage online. The recordings show brothers Josh and Jeff and Jeff's girlfriend, Megan, arriving in Sydney to stay with the brothers' cousin Greg before flying to Adelaide for their dive, and reveal that Megan is secretly having an affair with Josh. During the excursion, as the three enter the cage, a rogue wave overturns the boat. They escape to the surface amid wounded passengers, and sharks soon kill several people nearby.

Drifting for hours, the trio clings to tangled life preservers while Jeff, who has a heart condition and needs regular medication, weakens. That night they find an inflatable emergency raft with supplies, and Josh rescues an unconscious, hypothermic woman from floating debris. During an argument Megan and Josh accidentally fire a flare inside the raft, which burns, killing the woman. The quarrel exposes the affair, and soon afterward a shark drags Megan under. The next morning Jeff taunts Josh about Megan's death until he loses consciousness from his heart condition, and Josh eventually lets his brother's body sink. With the camera battery nearly exhausted, Josh films a rescue helicopter in the distance, but as he waves and shouts, the camera captures a great white rising beneath him, and the footage ends as he is pulled under.

Lionsgate acquired the independent production in early 2017 and rebranded it as part of the Open Water series after the success of Open Water 2: Adrift, releasing it across multiple platforms on August 11, 2017. It bears similarities to 47 Meters Down, another 2017 film about a cage dive gone wrong. It received a 25% score on Rotten Tomatoes from eight critics, although Starburst Magazine reviewed it positively.

overview: Jack Harper is one of the last few drone repairmen stationed on Earth. Part of a massive operation to extract vital resources after decades of war with a terrifying threat known as the Scavs, Jack’s mission is nearly complete. His existence is brought crashing down when he rescues a beautiful  stranger from a downed spacecraft. Her arrival triggers a chain of events that  forces him to question everything he knows and puts the fate of humanity in his hands.
tagline: Earth is a memory worth fighting for
title: Oblivion
plot:
Oblivion is a 2013 science fiction film directed by Joseph Kosinski and written by Josie McClelland, Karl Gajdusek, and Michael DeLuise. The movie stars Tom Cruise as Jack Harper, a repairman who lives on a post-apocalyptic Earth.

The story begins in the year 2177, where humanity has retreated to a generation ship called the Ark, fleeing a catastrophic event known as "The Great War" that devastated the planet. The war was caused by an alien invasion, which wiped out most of human civilization and left behind only a few scattered settlements.

Jack Harper is one of these survivors, living on a floating city called New York, where he works as a repairman for the company that maintains the city's defenses against the alien threat. Jack's life is mundane and lonely, with his only companion being his AI assistant, Sara (Andrea Riseborough).

However, Jack's life takes a dramatic turn when he encounters a mysterious woman named Julia (Olga Kurylenko), who claims to be from the Ark. She reveals that she has been sent to Earth to investigate the alien threat and that she needs Jack's help to complete his mission.

As they journey across the planet, Jack and Julia discover that the aliens have created a massive machine known as "The Oblivion," which is destroying entire cities on Earth in order to harvest their resources. The machine is also creating a rift in space-time, causing time dilation effects that are accelerating the aging process of those who live on Earth.

Jack and Julia soon realize that they are not alone in their quest. A group of rogue soldiers, led by Colonel Spear (Morgan Freeman), are also searching for the Oblivion, but with sinister intentions. The soldiers plan to use the machine's power to gain control over the Ark and rule humanity.

As Jack and Julia navigate through the treacherous landscape, they encounter various obstacles and challenges, including hostile alien creatures and treacherous terrain. Along the way, Jack begins to question his own identity and purpose, as he grapples with the consequences of his actions in the past.

The climax of the movie takes place at the Oblivion's core, where Jack and Julia must confront Colonel Spear and his team. In a thrilling showdown, Jack uses his knowledge of the machine's mechanics to disable it, saving humanity from destruction.

In the end, Jack and Julia succeed in their mission, but not without sacrifices. The movie concludes with Jack returning to New York, where he is welcomed as a hero. However, as he looks out at the city, he realizes that he has been given a new purpose: to protect humanity from the alien threat and ensure its survival.

Overall, Oblivion is a visually stunning film with impressive special effects, but it also explores themes of identity, sacrifice, and redemption in a thought-provoking way.

overview: With the impending ice age almost upon them, a mismatched trio of prehistoric critters – Manny the woolly mammoth, Diego the saber-toothed tiger and Sid the giant sloth – find an orphaned infant and decide to return it to its human parents. Along the way, the unlikely allies become friends but, when enemies attack, their quest takes on far nobler aims.
tagline: They came. They thawed. They conquered.
title: Ice Age
plot:
Ice Age is an American computer-animated adventure comedy of 2002 directed by Chris Wedge from a script by Michael Berg, Michael J. Wilson and Peter Ackerman, and the debut feature of Blue Sky Studios, produced with 20th Century Fox Animation. Set in the Pleistocene, it stars Ray Romano as the woolly mammoth Manny, John Leguizamo as the ground sloth Sid and Denis Leary as the sabre-toothed cat Diego, with Goran Višnjić as the pack leader Soto, Jack Black as Zeke and Wedge himself as the acorn-obsessed squirrel Scrat.

As the animals migrate south to escape the coming ice age, the clumsy Sid is left behind by his family. Rescued from a pair of angry brontotheres by Manny, a gruff mammoth heading north alone, Sid insists on tagging along despite Manny's wish for solitude. Meanwhile, Soto's sabre-toothed pack, half of which was killed by human hunters for their pelts, raids a human camp to seize the chief's infant son, Roshan, in revenge. The baby's mother escapes by leaping down a waterfall, and Soto orders Diego to bring the child back alive or face death. At the bottom of the falls, Manny and Sid find the exhausted mother, who entrusts them with her son before she is swept away.

Finding the human camp deserted, the pair decide to return the baby to his tribe, and Diego offers to guide them, secretly planning to deliver both the child and the mammoth to his pack at Half Peak. Through adventures and shared dangers the three grow close. In an ice cave, cave paintings stir Manny's painful memory of his family being killed by humans, yet he has come to love the baby. After Manny saves Diego from a lava flow, Diego confesses the ambush and persuades his friends to trust him. Their trick works until Soto corners Manny on a ledge; Diego leaps to his defence and is badly wounded, and Soto is killed by falling icicles. Manny and Sid return Roshan to his father, who gives Manny the necklace he had made for his son, and a recovered Diego arrives in time to say goodbye before the new herd heads south together.

Released on 15 March 2002, Ice Age opened with a record $46.3 million for March and grossed about $383 million worldwide. It received positive reviews, with 76% on Rotten Tomatoes, and was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Animated Feature.

overview: A young boy finds a powerful otherworldly weapon, which he uses to save his older adoptive brother from a crew of thugs. Before long, the two of them are also pursued by federal agents and mysterious mercenaries aiming to reclaim their asset.
tagline: All he needed was a way out.
title: Kin
plot:
Kin is a 2018 American action thriller film directed by Jonathan Hensleigh and written by Chris Sparling. The movie stars Gerard Butler, Zoë Saldana, Daniel Radcliffe, and Michael Angarano.

The main themes of Kin include:

1. **Redemption**: The protagonist, Ian McKenna (played by Gerard Butler), is a former Army Ranger who seeks redemption for his past mistakes. Throughout the film, he tries to make amends with his family and find a new purpose in life.
2. **Trauma and PTSD**: The movie explores the psychological effects of war on soldiers, particularly those who have experienced traumatic events. Ian's struggles with PTSD are a significant aspect of the story.
3. **Family dynamics**: The film highlights the complexities of family relationships, particularly between fathers and sons. Ian's relationship with his son is central to the plot, and he must confront his own shortcomings as a father in order to make things right.
4. **Guilt and responsibility**: As Ian delves deeper into the mystery surrounding his son's death, he is forced to confront his own guilt and sense of responsibility for the events that led to the tragedy.

The movie follows Ian as he embarks on a perilous journey to uncover the truth about his son's death and to find redemption. Along the way, he must confront his own demons and make difficult choices that will determine the course of his life.

Overall, Kin is a gripping thriller that explores themes of redemption, trauma, family dynamics, and guilt, making for a thought-provoking and emotionally charged viewing experience.

overview: Alan Clay, a struggling American businessman, travels to Saudi Arabia to sell a new technology to the King, only to be challenged by endless Middle Eastern bureaucracy, a perpetually absent monarch, and a suspicious growth on his back.
tagline: How far will you go? To find yourself.
title: A Hologram for the King
plot:
A Hologram for the King is a thought-provoking film that delves into the complexities of cultural exchange, identity, and the human condition. The movie follows Alan Clay, an American businessman who travels to Saudi Arabia to sell a holographic teleconferencing system to the Saudi government.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that this trip is not just about business, but also about self-discovery and understanding of one's place in the world. Through his interactions with the Saudi royal family and the local population, Alan is forced to confront his own biases and assumptions, as well as the cultural differences between East and West.

One of the main themes of the film is the clash of cultures, which serves as a backdrop for exploring issues of identity, power dynamics, and communication. The movie highlights the challenges of navigating unfamiliar environments and the importance of empathy in building relationships across cultural boundaries.

The film also touches on the theme of disillusionment, particularly in the context of American foreign policy and the notion of "winning" in international relations. Alan's experiences in Saudi Arabia serve as a commentary on the complexities of modern-day geopolitics and the difficulties of achieving success through diplomacy alone.

Ultimately, A Hologram for the King is a nuanced exploration of human connection and understanding, encouraging viewers to question their own assumptions and biases about the world around them.

keywords.name: beauty is in the eye of the beholder

overview: After taking his dying father's advice, Hal dates only the embodiments of female physical perfection. But that all changes after Hal has an unexpected run-in with self-help guru Tony Robbins. Intrigued by Hal's shallowness, Robbins hypnotizes him into seeing the beauty that exists even in the least physically appealing women. Hal soon falls for Rosemary, but he doesn't realize that his gorgeous girlfriend is actually a 300-pound-not-so-hottie.
tagline: True love is worth the weight.
title: Shallow Hal
plot:
Shallow Hal is a 2001 American romantic comedy film directed by Peter Farrelly and Bobby Farrelly, starring Jack Black and Gwyneth Paltrow. The movie follows the story of Hal Larson, a shallow and obese man who undergoes a transformation after meeting a group of angels.

The film begins with Hal (Jack Black), a 35-year-old man who is struggling to find love due to his weight and lack of self-confidence. He is obsessed with celebrity culture and spends most of his time watching TV and eating junk food. One day, while on a date at a restaurant, Hal meets Rosemary (Gwyneth Paltrow), a beautiful woman who is engaged to be married.

However, during their date, Hal becomes infatuated with Rosemary's appearance, but not her inner qualities. He decides to take a different approach and starts dating women based solely on their physical appearance. This leads him to meet a group of angels, led by Tony Robbins (Joe Viterelli), who claim that they can help people change their lives.

The angels convince Hal to undergo a transformation, where he is hypnotized and told to see only the inner beauty in people. At first, Hal resists this idea, but eventually, he starts to notice the positive qualities of those around him, including Rosemary's kindness and generosity.

As Hal continues to date women based on their inner beauty, he starts to develop feelings for Rosemary, who is not initially aware of his transformation. However, things become complicated when Rosemary discovers that Hal has been seeing other women, including a beautiful woman named Marianna (Jenna Elfman), who is actually an angel in disguise.

Marianna is sent by the angels to test Hal's commitment to changing his ways and to see if he can truly find love based on inner beauty. As Hal navigates this challenge, he must confront his own flaws and weaknesses, including his weight and lack of self-confidence.

In the end, Hal realizes that true love requires more than just physical appearance and that he has fallen in love with Rosemary's kindness and generosity. The movie ends with Hal and Rosemary getting married, surrounded by their friends and family.

Throughout the film, Jack Black delivers a memorable performance as the lovable but shallow Hal Larson. His comedic timing and charisma bring humor to the film, while also highlighting the importance of inner beauty and self-acceptance. Gwyneth Paltrow shines as Rosemary, bringing depth and nuance to her character.

Overall, Shallow Hal is a heartwarming and hilarious romantic comedy that explores themes of love, self-acceptance, and transformation. With its talented cast and witty dialogue, the film is sure to delight audiences and leave them feeling uplifted and inspired.

overview: When the King Gareth dies, his potential heirs, twin grandchildren who possess the dragon’s unique strengths, use their inherited powers against each other to vie for the throne. When Drago’s source of power – known as the Heartfire – is stolen, more than the throne is at stake; the siblings must end their rivalry with swords and sorcery or the kingdom may fall.
title: Dragonheart: Battle for the Heartfire
plot:
Dragonheart: Battle for the Heartfire is a 2017 fantasy adventure film directed by Patrik Syversen. The second prequel to Dragonheart (1996), it is set about 50 years after Dragonheart 3: The Sorcerer's Curse. Patrick Stewart voices the dragon Drago, with Tom Rhys Harries as Edric, Jessamine-Bliss Bell as his twin sister Mehgan, André Eriksen as the Viking Thorgrim and Marte Germaine Christensen as Sable.

King Gareth and Queen Rhonu have a son, Walter, who grows disillusioned with dragons and runs away. Years later, Walter's wife dies giving birth to twins who bear strange patches of scales, and Walter raises them alone. Twenty years on, Gareth dies, and Drago, whose heart he shared, survives because the bond has passed to someone new: Edric, a strong young sheriff serving Earl Robert Cole. Learning that Edric is Gareth's grandson, Drago persuades him to claim the throne at Lundenwic, but Edric proves arrogant and unprepared, and their bond is only partial. Edric then reveals a twin sister, Mehgan, outcast for her visible scales and power over fire. After their home burned down with Walter inside, Edric sent her away by boat to save her from the villagers.

When Vikings invade, Edric ignores Drago's advice and challenges their leader to a duel, only to discover that it is Mehgan. Drago explains the Heartfire, source of his fire. Mehgan claims the throne as the elder twin, and when Edric refuses, she drains the Heartfire from the sleeping Drago and seizes power. Banished and betrayed by Robert, Edric is rescued by Drago, who will die without the Heartfire, and a theatre troupe helps them into the castle. Mehgan, who has been improving women's rights, is attacked by Thorgrim's lieutenant Sable, and Thorgrim takes the Heartfire. Forced to fight, the twins confront the truth: Edric accidentally killed their father, and Mehgan took the blame. Reconciled, they retake the castle with the help of its women. Edric kills Thorgrim, who has been overwhelmed by the Heartfire's power, and when Mehgan is mortally wounded, Drago has the Heartfire used to heal her. The twins share the bond, losing their scales and powers, and Drago dies peacefully, becoming a star and urging them to rule together.

The film was released on Netflix, DVD and Blu-ray on June 13, 2017. Brian Costello of Common Sense Media gave it three stars out of five, calling it an entertaining medieval fantasy whose humor and brisk action make up for its weaker computer-generated dragon effects.

overview: The remarkable story of Brazilian racing driver Ayrton Senna, charting his physical and spiritual achievements on the track and off, his quest for perfection, and the mythical status he has since attained, is the subject of Senna, a documentary feature that spans the racing legend's years as an F1 driver, from his opening season in 1984 to his untimely death a decade later.
tagline: No Fear. No Limits. No Equal.
title: Senna
plot:
Senna is a 2010 documentary directed by Asif Kapadia about the life and death of the Brazilian Formula One champion Ayrton Senna. It follows his career from his debut at the 1984 Brazilian Grand Prix to his fatal crash at the 1994 San Marino Grand Prix, with particular emphasis on his rivalry with Alain Prost. It avoids narration and "talking head" interviews, using archival footage, voiceovers and Senna family home movies.

The film opens with footage of a young Senna racing go-karts, as he later recalls that in those days there was "no money, no politics – it was real racing." After brief early spells with Toleman and Lotus, Senna joins McLaren and becomes world champion. He clashes with his teammate Prost and with the sport's powerful regulator, Jean-Marie Balestre, and wins three titles in four years. The rivalry peaks in 1989 and 1990, when controversial collisions between the two decide the championship, and Senna blames Balestre's rulings for costing him the 1989 title. In 1991 he finally wins his home Grand Prix despite gearbox failure. A national icon, he champions driver safety and helps poor children in Brazil.

In 1992 and 1993, the computer-controlled cars of the rival Williams team dominate, and Senna watches Nigel Mansell and then Prost win the title. Prost, still resentful, blocks Senna from joining Williams. Senna takes Prost's seat for 1994 just as new rules ban the team's electronic aids. Williams struggles, and Senna suspects Benetton, whose Michael Schumacher wins the opening races, of cheating. The San Marino Grand Prix weekend brings crash after crash: Rubens Barrichello is badly hurt on Friday, Roland Ratzenberger is killed on Saturday, and two cars collide on race day. Shortly afterward, Senna crashes fatally after a mechanical failure. The film ends with his funeral and notes that no Formula One driver had died since, and that his family founded the Instituto Ayrton Senna to continue his charitable work.

After a screening at the 2010 Japanese Grand Prix, it premiered in São Paulo. It opened in Brazil in November 2010 and in the United Kingdom in June 2011. Rotten Tomatoes reported 93% approval, promising thrills and heartbreak even for non-fans. Empire called it deeply compelling, and The New York Times praised its editing while noting that viewers unfamiliar with the sport might find some episodes confusing. At the BAFTA Awards it won Best Documentary and Best Editing and was nominated for Outstanding British Film.

overview: The story of the life of Domino Harvey, who abandoned her career as a Ford model to become a bounty hunter.
tagline: Heads You Live... Tails You Die.
title: Domino
plot:
Domino is a 2005 action crime film directed by Tony Scott from a screenplay by Richard Kelly, based on a story by Kelly and Steve Barancik. A co-production of France, the United States and the United Kingdom, it is inspired by Domino Harvey, the English daughter of actor Laurence Harvey, who became a bounty hunter in Los Angeles. Keira Knightley plays Domino, with Mickey Rourke, Édgar Ramírez, Delroy Lindo, Lucy Liu and Christopher Walken in supporting roles.

Arrested by the FBI over the theft of $10 million from an armored truck, Domino is questioned by criminal psychologist Taryn Mills. She explains that after being expelled from college, the former model answered an advertisement for a bounty hunter seminar and joined Ed Moseby, Choco and their Afghan driver, Alf. They work for bail bondsman Claremont Williams III, who also runs an armored car company. His mistress, Lateesha Rodriguez, who runs a fake license racket at the DMV, needs $300,000 for her granddaughter Mica's operation. Claremont plans to steal $10 million belonging to his client Drake Bishop, owner of the Stratosphere casino in Las Vegas, and have his bounty hunters recover it for a $300,000 finder's fee.

When the FBI pressures Lateesha, she claims that a teenager named Frances, his brother and two friends will commit the robbery, then carries it out herself with co-workers. Claremont learns that Frances and his brother are sons of mafia boss Anthony Cigliutti and orders the money left with getaway driver Locus Fender. He sends the bounty hunters to hand the four young men to Bishop's men and to recover the cash, which they do after a shootout with Fender's mother. Bishop's men release the boys, but Cigliutti is led to believe Bishop had them killed and heads for Las Vegas. Domino gives Lateesha $300,000 for Mica's surgery. At the Stratosphere, Alf reveals that he has shipped the money to Afghanistan and filled the bags with explosives, with the detonator taped to his hand. Cigliutti arrives and shoots Bishop, and in the gunfight Ed and Choco are badly wounded. The mortally wounded Alf blows up the top of the tower, and Domino emerges as the only survivor. The FBI releases her, and Mills advises her to quit bounty hunting.

Domino Harvey died of a fentanyl overdose in June 2005, months before the film's October 14 release, and the film is dedicated to her. Reviews were largely negative, faulting an overly complicated plot; it holds 18% on Rotten Tomatoes and 37 on Metacritic.

overview: When Bússi, Iceland's toughest cop, is forced to work with a new partner to solve a series of bank robberies, the pressure to close the case as soon as possible proves too much for him.
tagline: To solve this crime, they'll need to break all the rules
title: Cop Secret
plot:
Cop Secret, released in Iceland as Leynilögga, is a 2021 Icelandic action comedy directed by Hannes Þór Halldórsson, who wrote it with Nína Pedersen and Sverrir Þór Sverrisson. Expanded from a mock trailer that Auðunn Blöndal, Halldórsson and Sverrisson made for television in 2011, it stars Blöndal as Bússi and Egill Einarsson as Hörður, with Björn Hlynur Haraldsson as Rikki and Steinunn Ólína Þorsteinsdóttir as police chief Þorgerður.

Böðvar "Bússi" Böðvarsson, Reykjavík's toughest rule-breaking cop, is investigating a string of bank robberies in which nothing seems to be stolen. Chasing a motorcyclist from the latest heist through the city and a shopping mall, to the dismay of his by-the-book partner, Klemenz, he crosses paths with his rival Hörður Bess of neighboring Garðabær, a pansexual millionaire and former male model who speaks fifteen languages. Bússi, who is in denial about his sexuality and drifting from his girlfriend, Lilja, is drawn to Hörður as the two foil a robbery together and capture the motorcyclist, Stefanía, whose only clue is a vague warning about an upcoming women's football match between Iceland and England. After a drunken kiss, Þorgerður assigns them as partners when Klemenz asks to be reassigned.

They trace the gang to Rikki Ferrari, a former model who vanished after an explosion and who addresses his henchmen only in dubbed English, and a burned USB drive leads them to a virus designed to crash Iceland's security systems. Bússi breaks up with Lilja, accepts that he is gay and spends the night with Hörður, but Rikki blackmails him with photographs into handing in his badge. While the entire police force guards the stadium, where Rikki has planted a bomb, his gang uses the virus to rob the national gold reserves. Bússi stows away on their getaway truck, reunites with Hörður, whose brother is being held hostage, and discovers that Klemenz was the inside man. After escaping a German torturer, Bússi declares his love for Hörður; Klemenz dives in front of a bullet fired by Rikki, Bússi blows up Rikki's speedboat, and the bomb is defused seconds before Iceland wins the match. The two departments are merged, and the couple later raise a child together.

The film premiered in competition at the Locarno Film Festival in August 2021 and opened in Iceland that October, finishing second at the local box office for the year behind No Time to Die. It earned 84% approval on Rotten Tomatoes.

overview: After a doctor kills his mistress and himself while researching the mysterious previous owner of his Boston home, his colleague, Dr. Norman Boyle, takes over his research and moves his family from New York City to the Boston mansion. Soon after, Boyle's young son Bob becomes plagued by visions of a young girl, who warns him of the danger within the house.
tagline: Read the fine print. You may have just mortgaged your life.
title: The House by the Cemetery
plot:
The House by the Cemetery is a 1981 Italian horror film directed by Lucio Fulci. The movie tells the story of John Harker, an American architect who travels to Rome with his wife Lisa and their young son Tommy to visit his father-in-law, but instead finds himself in the middle of a dark and sinister mystery.

The main theme of The House by the Cemetery is the struggle between good and evil, as embodied by the two main characters: John Harker, a rational and logical man who tries to uncover the truth behind the mysterious house, and Carl Fredricksen, a seemingly harmless old man with a dark secret. As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Carl's intentions are far from pure, and that he is driven by a malevolent force that threatens to destroy John and his family.

The film also explores the theme of the supernatural and the power of the human psyche. The house itself seems to have a life of its own, exerting a strange influence over those who enter it, and Carl's connection to it is deeply unsettling. As the story progresses, it becomes clear that the house has a dark history, and that Carl's past is inextricably linked to its malevolent energy.

Furthermore, The House by the Cemetery can be seen as a commentary on the dangers of curiosity and the importance of respecting the unknown. John Harker's determination to uncover the truth behind the mysterious house ultimately leads him down a path of terror and despair, highlighting the risks of meddling with forces beyond human control.

Overall, The House by the Cemetery is a classic horror film that masterfully weaves together themes of good vs. evil, the supernatural, and the dangers of curiosity, creating a tense and unsettling viewing experience.

overview: Emily arrives in Miami with aspirations to become a professional dancer. She sparks with Sean, the leader of a dance crew whose neighborhood is threatened by Emily's father's development plans.
tagline: One Step Can Change Your World
title: Step Up Revolution
plot:
Step Up Revolution is a 2012 American dance film directed by Jon M. Chu and starring Kathryn Morris, Adam G. Sevani, and Stephen "tWitch" Boss.

The movie follows Emily (Kathryn Morris), an FBI agent who goes undercover to investigate a string of high-profile robberies in Los Angeles. She teams up with Sean (Adam G. Sevani), the leader of an underground dance crew called "Rebel Crew," who are being targeted by the robbers. As Emily and Sean work together, they develop feelings for each other while also navigating their respective worlds.

The main themes of Step Up Revolution include:

1. **Self-discovery**: The movie explores Emily's journey as she leaves her comfortable life behind to take risks and find herself. She discovers a new passion for dance and learns to let go of her inhibitions.
2. **Love and relationships**: The film highlights the blossoming romance between Emily and Sean, as well as their friendships with other characters in the Rebel Crew. The movie shows how love and support can help people overcome challenges and grow as individuals.
3. **Identity and community**: Step Up Revolution celebrates the power of dance as a form of self-expression and community building. The Rebel Crew's passion for dance brings them together, providing a sense of belonging and purpose.
4. **Overcoming adversity**: Emily faces numerous obstacles as she navigates her undercover mission, including danger from the robbers and internal conflicts within herself. Sean and his crew also face challenges as they try to protect their art form from exploitation.

The movie features high-energy dance sequences, stunning choreography, and a captivating storyline that explores themes of identity, love, and self-discovery.

overview: Amid the dust storms and economic depression of Dust Bowl Era Oklahoma, Eugene Evans finds his family farm on the brink of foreclosure. Discovering fugitive bank robber Allison Wells hiding in his small town, he is torn between claiming the bounty on her head and his growing attraction to the seductive criminal.
title: Dreamland
plot:
Dreamland is a 2019 American period thriller film directed by Miles Joris-Peyrafitte from a screenplay by Nicolaas Zwart. Set in drought-stricken 1930s Texas, it stars Finn Cole as Eugene Evans, a restless teenager, and Margot Robbie as Allison Wells, a wounded fugitive bank robber, with Travis Fimmel as Eugene's stepfather George, Kerry Condon as his mother Olivia, Darby Camp as his younger sister Phoebe, Garrett Hedlund as Allison's partner Perry, and Lola Kirke as the adult Phoebe, who narrates the story. Robbie also produced the film through her company LuckyChap Entertainment, and principal photography took place in New Mexico beginning in October 2017.

In a drought-stricken Texas town plagued by dust storms, Eugene, whose father abandoned the family when he was five, spends his days stealing dime novels with his friend Joe and dreaming of another life. His stepfather George, a lawman, tries to be a father to him and urges him to find work. When the sheriff announces a $10,000 reward for Allison Wells, wanted for bank robbery and murder, Eugene fantasizes about catching her, only to find her hiding, injured, in the family's barn. Allison strikes a deal with him: he tends her wounds, and she offers him a large sum if he helps her get a car to Mexico. She tells him that the girl she is accused of killing died when police fired into a crowd during a robbery. Drawn to the outlaw, Eugene hides her, takes her swimming at a local watering hole and grows infatuated. When he breaks into the police evidence room using his stepfather's keys, he discovers that she concealed the existence of her murderous accomplice, Perry, who was killed during their escape. His theft costs George his job and threatens the family's home, yet Eugene still flees with Allison in the family truck, hoping also to find his real father in Mexico. As the pair head for the border, their romance deepens, and a desperate bank robbery sends them on the run with the law closing in.

Dreamland premiered at the Tribeca Film Festival on April 28, 2019, and was released in a limited release by Vertical Entertainment on November 13, 2020, followed by video on demand from Paramount Home Entertainment. It holds a 60% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus says that Robbie's strong work offsets the film's diffuse narrative, and a Metacritic score of 57.

overview: Navy SEALS mount an attack on Colombian special forces to clear their names and rescue a hostage.
tagline: Framed, abandoned, but never defeated.
title: Behind Enemy Lines III: Colombia
plot:
Behind Enemy Lines III: Colombia is an action-thriller film that delves into the complexities of war and its effects on individuals and society. The movie follows a group of American soldiers who are captured by Colombian rebels, leading to a cat-and-mouse game between the captors and the rescuers.

At its core, the film explores the theme of survival in the face of overwhelming odds. The characters must use their wits, resourcefulness, and determination to stay alive and ultimately escape from their captors. This theme is woven throughout the narrative, as the soldiers confront the harsh realities of war and the moral dilemmas that come with it.

The movie also touches on the theme of loyalty and camaraderie among soldiers. The bonds between the characters are tested as they face extreme situations, and the film highlights the importance of trust, sacrifice, and teamwork in overcoming adversity.

Furthermore, Behind Enemy Lines III: Colombia critiques the darker aspects of human nature, particularly in the context of war. The film portrays a world where civilians are caught in the crossfire, and the lines between good and evil become increasingly blurred. This theme is reflected in the character development, as the soldiers grapple with their own morality and the true nature of their enemies.

Overall, Behind Enemy Lines III: Colombia is a tense, action-packed thriller that explores the complexities of war, survival, loyalty, and human nature.

overview: To save the universe, and their friendship, Mordecai and Rigby must defeat an evil volleyball coach.
tagline: Save the Universe from Yourselves... or You're FIRED.
title: Regular Show: The Movie
plot:
Regular Show: The Movie is a 2015 animated film based on the Cartoon Network series of the same name. The movie follows Mordecai, Rigby, Benson, Skips, and Muscle Man as they embark on a road trip to a music festival.

The main themes of Regular Show: The Movie revolve around friendship, adventure, and self-discovery. Throughout the film, the characters face various challenges and obstacles that test their relationships with each other. Mordecai and Rigby's friendship is put to the ultimate test as they navigate their differences and learn to rely on each other.

The movie also explores themes of growing up and letting go. As the characters approach adulthood, they must confront the reality of leaving their carefree childhood days behind. The film features a mix of humor, action, and heartwarming moments that showcase the growth and development of the main characters.

Additionally, the movie touches on the idea of finding one's true purpose in life. Mordecai and Rigby's road trip is initially driven by a desire to attend a music festival, but as they journey through various landscapes and encounter different people, they begin to discover their own passions and interests. The film suggests that it's never too late to explore new things and find one's true calling.

Overall, Regular Show: The Movie offers a fun and entertaining ride filled with humor, adventure, and heartwarming moments that celebrate the power of friendship and self-discovery.

overview: A widowed farmer and his son warily take in a mysterious, injured man with a satchel of cash. When a posse of men claiming to be the law come for the money, the farmer must decide who to trust. Defending a siege of his homestead, the farmer reveals a talent for gun-slinging that surprises everyone calling his true identity into question.
tagline: You can't bury the past.
title: Old Henry
plot:
Old Henry is a 2021 American Western thriller film directed by Paddy Breathnach. The movie follows an aging outlaw, Henry, who has been living in isolation for years, and his confrontation with a group of ruthless men who are after him.

The main theme of Old Henry revolves around the struggle between solitude and community. Henry's isolated life is disrupted when he encounters a group of strangers who challenge his way of living and force him to confront his past. This confrontation raises questions about the importance of human connection, belonging, and redemption in a world that often values individualism over community.

The film also explores themes of identity, particularly for older characters like Henry, who are struggling to find their place in a rapidly changing world. As Henry navigates this new reality, he must confront his own demons and re-evaluate his sense of self-worth.

Furthermore, Old Henry touches on the idea of violence as a means of survival and the cyclical nature of revenge. The film's tense atmosphere is fueled by the characters' violent pasts and their desperate attempts to protect themselves from harm.

Overall, Old Henry is a gripping thriller that delves into complex themes of isolation, community, identity, and redemption, set against the backdrop of the American West.

overview: Hutch Mansell, a suburban dad, overlooked husband, nothing neighbor — a "nobody." When two thieves break into his home one night, Hutch's unknown long-simmering rage is ignited and propels him on a brutal path that will uncover dark secrets he fought to leave behind.
tagline: Never underestimate a nobody.
title: Nobody
plot:
Nobody is a 2021 action comedy film directed by Ilya Naishuller, not Odenkirk Provissiero Entertainment. The movie stars Bob Odenkirk as Hutch Mansell, a suburban dad who leads a double life as a hitman.

The story begins with Hutch's seemingly ordinary life: he works as an insurance investigator and is married to his wife Becca (Connie Nielsen) and has two kids. However, when his family is threatened by a group of Russian gangsters, Hutch must use his "nobody" persona to protect them.

As the plot unfolds, we see Hutch's past as a hitman come back to haunt him. He was once a skilled assassin known as "The Conductor," but he retired and tried to leave his old life behind. However, when his family is targeted, Hutch must use his skills to take down the gangsters and save those he loves.

Throughout the movie, Odenkirk's performance brings humor and heart to the story. He plays both the suburban dad and the hitman with ease, making it difficult to distinguish between the two personas. The action scenes are also well-choreographed and intense, showcasing Hutch's skills as a fighter.

One of the standout aspects of Nobody is its commentary on societal expectations and the pressure to conform. Hutch's "nobody" persona is a metaphor for the idea that we're all hiding behind masks, whether it's our work lives or our personal relationships. The movie suggests that true strength lies in embracing our vulnerabilities and being willing to take risks.

Overall, Nobody is an entertaining and action-packed film with a strong performance from Bob Odenkirk. It's a fun twist on the traditional action movie genre, with plenty of humor and heart to go around.

overview: Seventeen-year-old Jesse has been hearing terrifying sounds coming from his neighbor’s apartment, but when he turns on his camera and sets out to uncover their source, he encounters an ancient evil that won’t rest until it’s claimed his very soul.
tagline: Once Marked It Is Already Too Late.
title: Paranormal Activity: The Marked Ones
plot:
Paranormal Activity: The Marked Ones is a 2014 American supernatural horror film directed by Fede Alvarez and written by Christopher Landon. The movie is the fourth installment in the Paranormal Activity franchise, which began with the 2007 film Paranormal Activity.

The story follows Jesse (Jorge Lendeborg Jr.), a high school student who moves to Los Angeles from El Paso, Texas, with his family. Jesse's cousin, Alex (Javier Botet), is struggling to adjust to life in LA after being bullied at school. The two cousins bond over their shared experiences as outsiders.

One night, while exploring the neighborhood, Jesse and Alex stumble upon a mysterious figure lurking around an abandoned house. They soon discover that the house has been marked with strange symbols, which seem to be connected to an ancient ritual. As they delve deeper into the mystery, they begin to experience terrifying supernatural events, including unexplained noises, movements, and visions.

As the events escalate, Jesse becomes increasingly obsessed with uncovering the truth behind the markings and the mysterious figure. He enlists the help of his friends, including Marisol (Claudia Geilfuss), a local artist who is familiar with the history of the house. Together, they research the symbols and try to understand their significance.

The group soon discovers that the markings are connected to an ancient cult that was active in the area. The cult believed that certain individuals were "marked" by the supernatural forces, and these individuals would be chosen for a dark purpose. As Jesse becomes more deeply embroiled in the mystery, he realizes that he is one of the marked ones.

As the events reach a climax, Jesse's friends are picked off one by one, and he is left to face the mysterious figure alone. In a desperate bid to survive, Jesse uses his knowledge of the ancient ritual to try and defeat the supernatural forces.

The movie culminates in a shocking twist: Jesse discovers that Alex is not just an innocent bystander but is actually the chosen one, destined for a dark purpose. The film ends with Jesse's fate uncertain, leaving the audience wondering if he will survive or succumb to the supernatural forces.

Throughout the movie, Fede Alvarez masterfully builds tension and suspense, using clever camera work and sound design to create an atmosphere of unease. The cast delivers strong performances, particularly Jorge Lendeborg Jr., who brings a sense of vulnerability and determination to his character.

Overall, Paranormal Activity: The Marked Ones is a tense and unsettling horror film that explores themes of identity, community, and the supernatural. While it may not be as well-known as some of its predecessors in the franchise, it offers a unique take on the paranormal activity genre and is sure to leave viewers on the edge of their seats.

overview: Capitol Policeman John Cale has just been denied his dream job with the Secret Service of protecting President James Sawyer. Not wanting to let down his little girl with the news, he takes her on a tour of the White House, when the complex is overtaken by a heavily armed paramilitary group. Now, with the nation's government falling into chaos and time running out, it's up to Cale to save the president, his daughter, and the country.
tagline: It will start like any other day
title: White House Down
plot:
White House Down is a 2013 American action thriller film directed by Roland Emmerich and written by James Vanderbilt. The movie stars Channing Tatum as Capitol Police Officer John Cale, a young officer who has been training to join the Secret Service, and Jamie Foxx as President James Sawyer, the newly elected President of the United States.

The movie begins with John Cale (Channing Tatum) trying to get into the White House for his daughter's birthday party. However, he is denied entry due to a security breach. Despite this, Cale manages to sneak in and meets President Sawyer (Jamie Foxx), who is struggling to connect with his 12-year-old daughter Emily.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Cale has a personal connection to the White House - his father was a Secret Service agent who died on duty when he was a child. Cale's desire to join the Secret Service is motivated by a sense of duty and loyalty to his father's memory.

Meanwhile, a group of heavily armed terrorists, led by Emil Stenz (Richard Jenkins), take over the White House and hold its occupants hostage. The terrorists are seeking revenge against President Sawyer for his role in the death of their leader, who was killed during a previous operation.

As the situation escalates, Cale finds himself trapped inside the White House with Emily, who is being held captive by the terrorists. Despite the danger, Cale uses his knowledge of the building and his training to try and rescue Emily and take down the terrorists.

President Sawyer, meanwhile, is trying to negotiate with Stenz and his team, but they are unwilling to listen. As the standoff continues, it becomes clear that Stenz has a personal vendetta against the President and will stop at nothing to carry out his plan.

In the end, Cale comes up with a plan to take down the terrorists from within the White House. He uses his knowledge of the building's ventilation system to sneak into the control room where Stenz is holding the hostages. In a tense showdown, Cale manages to defeat Stenz and his team, saving Emily and President Sawyer.

The movie ends with Cale being offered a job as a Secret Service agent, and he accepts, finally fulfilling his dream of joining the agency. The film concludes on a hopeful note, with Cale and his daughter starting a new life together, free from the trauma of their past.

Overall, White House Down is an action-packed thriller that explores themes of loyalty, duty, and redemption. While it received mixed reviews from critics, the movie has its fans, who appreciate its over-the-top action sequences and Channing Tatum's performance as the lead character.

overview: A young man receives an emergency phone call on his cell phone from an older woman. She claims to have been kidnapped – and the kidnappers have targeted her husband and child next.
tagline: If the signal dies so does she.
title: Cellular
plot:
Cellular is a 2004 American thriller film directed by David R. Ellis and starring Chris Evans, Kim Basinger, and Jason Statham.

The main themes of Cellular include:

1. **Revenge and Retribution**: The movie revolves around the character of Stuart St. Clair (played by Chris Evans), who seeks revenge against the people responsible for his wife's death. Throughout the film, Stuart's actions become increasingly violent and vengeful, highlighting the destructive nature of unchecked anger.
2. **Trauma and Grief**: Stuart's wife is killed in a car accident, leaving him with severe emotional trauma. The movie explores how this event affects Stuart's life and relationships, leading to his downward spiral into violence.
3. **Obsession and Fixation**: Stuart becomes fixated on finding the people responsible for his wife's death, which ultimately leads to his downfall. This theme highlights the dangers of becoming overly obsessed with a single goal or desire.
4. **Redemption and Self-Discovery**: As the story unfolds, Stuart is forced to confront his own demons and the consequences of his actions. The movie suggests that redemption may be possible, but it requires Stuart to let go of his anger and find a new path.

The film's plot is driven by these themes, which are expertly woven together to create a tense and suspenseful narrative.

overview: A woman learns about the death of her Orthodox Jewish father, a rabbi. She returns home and has romantic feelings rekindled for her best childhood friend, who is now married to her cousin.
tagline: Love is an act of defiance
title: Disobedience
plot:
Disobedience is a 2017 British drama film directed by Sebastian Lelio, written by Rebecca Miller, and starring Rachel Weisz, Rachel McAdams, and Alessandro Nivola.

The story takes place in the Orthodox Jewish community of London's East End. The film revolves around Esti Kuperman (Rachel Weisz), a woman who has been forbidden from having sex since her teenage years due to a promise she made to her father, Rabbi Cohen (Alessandro Nivola). This promise was made after Esti had an affair with a man named Avigdor (Aaron Eckhart) when she was 16.

The film begins with Esti's life as a successful lawyer and single woman. She is engaged to be married to a man named Max (Oscar Isaac), but their relationship feels empty and unfulfilling. One day, while attending a family gathering, Esti meets her childhood friend and former lover Avigdor again, who has returned to London after years abroad.

As Esti reconnects with Avigdor, she begins to re-examine the choices she made in the past and the promise she made to her father. She starts to question whether she should have sex with Avigdor, despite knowing it would be a betrayal of her father's trust. Meanwhile, Max becomes increasingly suspicious of Esti's behavior and their relationship begins to unravel.

As the story unfolds, Esti's relationships with both men become more complicated. Her friendship with Avigdor deepens, but she is also drawn back into her engagement with Max. The film builds towards a dramatic confrontation between Esti and her father, who will stop at nothing to prevent her from breaking her promise.

Throughout the film, Lelio explores themes of identity, faith, and desire. Esti's journey is one of self-discovery, as she grapples with the choices she made in the past and the expectations placed upon her by those around her. The film also raises questions about the nature of love and relationships within a strict religious community.

The title "Disobedience" refers to Esti's decision to break her promise to her father, but it also serves as a metaphor for the ways in which we all struggle with obedience and disobedience throughout our lives. Ultimately, the film is a powerful exploration of the human condition, one that challenges its characters (and the audience) to confront their own desires and limitations.

The ending of the film is both poignant and thought-provoking, as Esti makes a choice that will have far-reaching consequences for herself and those around her. The final shot of the film shows Esti walking away from her father's house, symbolizing her newfound independence and self-awareness.

overview: Joanna’s plans for a quiet, cozy holiday season are shattered when her sisters call with the news that their dad has been dumped by his fiancée and has disappeared to Nevis, a tiny Caribbean island, and is not responding to any calls. The sisters decide to go to the island to save their father and bring him home for Christmas. Can the newly reconnected Christmas family survive a crazy Christmas?
title: Christmas in Paradise
plot:
Spider-Man: Far From Home is a 2019 superhero film directed by Jon Watts and produced by Marvel Studios and Sony Pictures Releasing. The movie takes place after the events of Avengers: Endgame and follows Peter Parker, aka Spider-Man (played by Tom Holland), as he tries to balance his personal life with his responsibilities as a superhero.

The story begins with Peter Parker attending a school trip to Europe, accompanied by his friends Ned Leeds (Jacob Batalon) and MJ (Zendaya). However, the trip is disrupted when Mysterio (Jake Gyllenhaal), a mysterious and charismatic figure, appears on social media, claiming to be a superhero who has been fighting alongside Spider-Man in the Avengers. Mysterio's presence sparks Peter's interest, and he begins to investigate his claims.

As Peter delves deeper into Mysterio's identity, he discovers that the man is actually Quentin Beck (Jake Gyllenhaal), a former special effects artist who created an elaborate illusion to gain fame and recognition as a superhero. Beck uses advanced technology to create fake battles and heroic feats, which he broadcasts on social media to gain sympathy and admiration from the public.

Meanwhile, Nick Fury (Samuel L. Jackson) reappears, revealing that Mysterio is actually a threat to global security. He has been using his technology to manipulate people's perceptions of reality, creating chaos and destruction in various parts of the world. Peter, along with Ned and MJ, joins forces with Beck's allies, including Maria (Rita Moreno), to stop Mysterio.

As the story unfolds, Peter begins to question his own identity as Spider-Man and whether he is truly making a difference as a superhero. He also starts to develop feelings for MJ, who becomes increasingly concerned about Peter's well-being.

The climax of the movie features an epic battle between Spider-Man and Mysterio, with Peter using his wits and agility to outsmart Beck's illusions. In the end, Peter manages to defeat Mysterio, but not before realizing that he has been living in a world of fantasy created by Beck.

In the aftermath, Peter comes to terms with the fact that being a superhero is not just about having powers or gadgets, but also about taking responsibility and making sacrifices for the greater good. He also begins to rebuild his relationships with his friends and loved ones, including MJ, who becomes more than just a friend to him.

The movie concludes with Peter reflecting on the lessons he has learned from Mysterio's illusions, realizing that the line between reality and fantasy is often blurred, and that true heroism requires courage, empathy, and selflessness.

overview: A working class family move into a new condo purchased after 11 years of hard work. They throw a housewarming party to show his co-workers when overnight a heavy downpour creates an extremely deep sinkhole that engulfs the entire building.
tagline: A house earned after 11 years of effort falls deep into the ground in a minute.
title: Sinkhole
plot:
Sinkhole is a 2021 South Korean disaster comedy film directed by Kim Ji-hoon and starring Cha Seung-won, Kim Sung-kyun, Lee Kwang-soo and Kim Hye-jun, with Nam Da-reum and Kwon So-hyun in supporting roles. Its premise centers on an ordinary office worker whose home, bought after eleven years of saving, plunges 500 meters underground into a sinkhole in the space of a single minute.

Park Dong-won, a mid-level manager at a company, has worked hard for eleven years to afford his first home, and he moves with his wife, Young-yi, and their family into a new condominium. Proud of his purchase, he throws a housewarming party and invites coworkers, including the junior employees Kim Seung-hyun and Hong Eun-joo. In the same building lives Jeong Man-soo, a resident who works day and night to raise his son, Seung-tae, on his own and who is not on good terms with him. After a heavy overnight downpour, an enormous sinkhole opens beneath the building, and in barely a minute the whole condominium is swallowed, with residents and guests still inside.

Trapped deep in the pit, Dong-won, Man-soo and the survivors must put aside their differences and work together to survive amid the wreckage and find a way back to the surface. Their situation grows more desperate when the rain starts again and water begins pouring into the sinkhole, and the group must find a solution before time runs out. The film blends the spectacle and peril of a disaster movie with ensemble comedy drawn from the clashing personalities of its characters.

Made on a budget of about ₩15 billion, the film began shooting in August 2019 at Bomnae Film Studio and a school in Chuncheon. It was planned for the 2020 Chuseok holidays but was postponed by the COVID-19 pandemic. It premiered in the Piazza Grande section of the Locarno Film Festival on August 6, 2021, and opened in South Korea on August 11, posting the year's best opening, crossing one million admissions in six days and ending 2021 as the country's second highest-grossing domestic film, with about 2.2 million admissions and nearly US$18 million. It also closed the New York Asian Film Festival and screened at Sarajevo, Vancouver and Busan. Korean critics praised the ensemble, the light humor and the elaborate sets used to convey the shaking of the sinking building, though Sports Korea found the second half's setting somewhat unrealistic while still calling it fun enough as a disaster blockbuster.

overview: The ambitious friends come together during the holidays after a mystery assailant targets one of their own. A comedic thrill-ride follows, as the wild and unpredictable Psych team pursues the bad guys, justice … and, of course, food!
title: Psych: The Movie
plot:
Psych: The Movie is a 2017 television film that serves as a continuation of the USA Network series Psych. The movie delves into the complexities of Shawn Spencer's (James Roday Rodriguez) life, exploring his struggles with identity and purpose.

At its core, the film grapples with the theme of finding one's true calling in life. Shawn, a fake psychic detective, has spent years pretending to be someone he's not, all while navigating his relationships with those around him. As he embarks on a new adventure, he begins to question whether his skills are truly being utilized for the greater good.

The movie also touches upon the idea of loyalty and friendship. Shawn's bond with Burton "Gus" Guster (Dulé Hill) is put to the test as they face various challenges together. The film highlights the importance of having a supportive network in life, particularly when navigating the complexities of adulthood.

Furthermore, Psych: The Movie explores the theme of identity and self-discovery. Shawn's journey is marked by moments of introspection, as he confronts his own strengths and weaknesses. This introspection allows him to grow as a character, ultimately leading to a deeper understanding of himself and his place in the world.

Overall, Psych: The Movie offers a thought-provoking exploration of identity, purpose, and the power of human connection.

overview: A corporate risk-management consultant must determine whether or not to terminate an artificial being's life that was made in a laboratory environment.
tagline: Don't let it out
title: Morgan
plot:
Morgan (2016) is a thought-provoking sci-fi horror film that delves into the darker aspects of human nature and the consequences of playing God. The movie follows a young woman, Kate, who becomes pregnant with a genetically engineered being, Morgan, created by her wealthy and reclusive boss, Lee.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Morgan is not just a simple creation, but a complex and evolving entity that challenges the boundaries of humanity. Through Morgan's character, the film explores themes of identity, free will, and the blurred lines between creator and creation.

The movie also touches on the idea of corporate greed and the exploitation of scientific advancements for personal gain. Lee's obsession with creating life is driven by his desire to control and manipulate, highlighting the dangers of unchecked ambition and the consequences of tampering with nature.

Furthermore, Morgan raises questions about what it means to be human and whether we are truly capable of understanding and empathizing with beings that are fundamentally different from ourselves. The film's portrayal of Morgan as a being who is both fascinating and terrifying serves as a commentary on our own fears and anxieties about the unknown.

Ultimately, Morgan is a cautionary tale about the dangers of scientific hubris and the importance of considering the ethics of playing God. The movie's thought-provoking themes and unsettling atmosphere make it a compelling watch for fans of sci-fi horror and those interested in exploring the darker aspects of human nature.

overview: When Andrew Briggman—a young soldier in the US invasion of Afghanistan—witnesses other recruits killing innocent civilians under the direction of a sadistic Sergeant, he considers reporting them to higher-ups. However, the heavily-armed and increasingly-violent platoon becomes suspicious that someone in their ranks has turned on them, and Andrew begins to fear that he'll be the next target.
tagline: Soldiers. Brothers. Enemies.
title: The Kill Team
plot:
The Kill Team is an American war drama of 2019 written and directed by Dan Krauss, a fictionalised version of the Maywand District murders in Afghanistan that Krauss had examined in his 2013 documentary of the same name. Nat Wolff stars as Andrew Briggman, a young soldier torn by conscience, with Alexander Skarsgård as Staff Sergeant Deeks, Adam Long as Rayburn, Jonathan Whitesell as Coombs, Brian Marc as Marquez, and Rob Morrow and Anna Francolini as Briggman's parents.

In Afghanistan in 2009, Briggman's platoon loses its leader, Staff Sergeant Wallace, to a roadside bomb, and Deeks takes command, promising his men that they will find those responsible for the deaths of American soldiers. When a wounded suspect is captured, Briggman refuses Deeks's order to hurt him. The platoon begins raiding civilian villages. On the first raid Briggman hears a shot and finds a boy dead; the others claim the child attacked them with a grenade. Doubting the story, Briggman messages his father, who calls the Army's Criminal Investigation Division. Deeks savagely beats Marquez, wrongly accusing him of informing, and a frightened Briggman begs his father to stop calling.

On a second raid Briggman watches Rayburn execute an unarmed man and plant a rifle on the body. Deeks catches him searching his office for evidence, insists that the villagers are collaborating with the insurgents, and makes clear that he knows Briggman is working against him. Briggman breaks down in tears on the phone to his father, aware that he is in danger. On a third raid, Deeks orders Rayburn and Briggman to kill a silent elderly captive and tosses a grenade beside him to fake an attack, and Briggman, firing for the first time in combat, takes part in the killing. The platoon celebrates while he is shattered by guilt, contemplating suicide before investigators question the unit, and, with his parents beside him, he agrees to tell everything. Closing titles explain that five soldiers were charged in 2010; Specialist Adam Winfield, the model for Briggman, pleaded guilty to involuntary manslaughter and was sentenced to three years, and testified against Staff Sergeant Gibbs, the model for Deeks, who received life imprisonment.

Distributed by A24, the film premiered at the Tribeca Film Festival on 27 April 2019 and opened on 25 October. Critics found it flawed but viscerally effective, praising its cast, and it holds 69% on Rotten Tomatoes.

overview: Music superstars Kat Valdez and Bastian are getting married before a global audience of fans. But when Kat learns, seconds before her vows, that Bastian has been unfaithful, she decides to marry Charlie, a stranger in the crowd, instead.
tagline: Say yes.
title: Marry Me
plot:
Marry Me is a 2022 American romantic comedy film directed by John M. Chu and written by Cassandra Peterson. The movie stars Jennifer Lopez, Owen Wilson, and Michael Caine.

The story begins with Alice (Jennifer Lopez), a successful music journalist who has lost touch with her passion for music after the death of her fiancé in a tragic accident. On the eve of her 40th birthday, she meets Charlie (Owen Wilson), a charming and charismatic musician who is about to get married to his girlfriend, Kate (played by Vanessa Hudgens).

During their conversation, Alice accidentally drinks a glass of champagne that Charlie had been saving for his wedding night, which contains a surprise twist - it's laced with a sedative that will make the drinker fall in love with the person they're with. Unbeknownst to Alice, this is a prank by Charlie, who wants to test whether he still has feelings for Kate.

As the night progresses, Alice finds herself falling deeply in love with Charlie, and she starts to question her own feelings about marriage and relationships. Meanwhile, Charlie's relationship with Kate begins to unravel as he realizes that his true feelings are for Alice.

The plot takes a turn when Alice discovers the truth behind the sedative and confronts Charlie about it. However, instead of being angry, she's touched by his vulnerability and willingness to take risks in love. The two start to develop real feelings for each other, but their relationship is put to the test as they navigate their past heartaches and fears.

As Alice and Charlie spend more time together, they realize that they have a deep connection and share similar values. They also discover that they both have unfinished business with Kate, who has been struggling to move on from her failed engagement.

In the end, Alice and Charlie must decide whether to follow their hearts or play it safe. In a heartwarming climax, they confess their love for each other and choose to take a chance on a new beginning together.

Throughout the movie, Jennifer Lopez shines as the lead character, bringing depth and nuance to Alice's emotional journey. Owen Wilson provides comedic relief and charm as Charlie, while Michael Caine adds a touch of sophistication and wit as Kate's father.

Overall, Marry Me is a delightful romantic comedy that explores themes of love, vulnerability, and taking risks. With its witty dialogue, engaging characters, and heartfelt performances, it's a must-watch for fans of the genre.

overview: Walter Meyer is a retired mechanic who lost the love of his life one year earlier. Now that the holiday season is here, he invites daughters Rachel and Cheryl and sons Christian and Evan to his house for a traditional celebration. Poor Walter soon realizes that if his bickering children and the rest of the family can spend five days together under the same roof, it will truly be a Christmas miracle.
tagline: Five days together? Oh joy.
title: Almost Christmas
plot:
Almost Christmas is a heartwarming drama film that explores the complexities of family relationships and the importance of forgiveness during the holiday season.

The movie delves into the struggles of the Johnson family, who are forced to confront their past mistakes and resentments when they gather together for Thanksgiving. As the family navigates their differences, they must also contend with personal crises, including infidelity, addiction, and health issues.

At its core, Almost Christmas is a story about the power of love and forgiveness to heal old wounds and bring people together. The film highlights the importance of communication, empathy, and understanding in relationships, particularly during times of stress and conflict.

Through the characters' experiences, the movie shows that even in the midst of chaos and dysfunction, there is always hope for redemption and renewal. Ultimately, Almost Christmas is a uplifting tale about the resilience of family bonds and the transformative power of love and forgiveness.

overview: An urban legend says that lighting fireworks at an abandoned airfield will beckon the “summer ghost,” a spirit that can answer any question. Three teenagers, Tomoya, Aoi, and Ryo, each have their own reason to show up one day. When a ghost named Ayane appears, she reveals she is only visible to those “who are about to touch their death.” Compelled by the ghost and her message, Tomoya begins regularly visiting the airfield to uncover the true purpose of her visits.
title: Summer Ghost
plot:
Summer Ghost (Japanese: Samā Gōsuto) is a 2021 Japanese animated fantasy drama short film, about 40 minutes long. It was directed by the animator and illustrator Loundraw in his directorial debut and produced by his company Flat Studio, with a script by Hirotaka Adachi. In Japanese, Chiaki Kobayashi voices Tomoya Sugisaki, Miyuri Shimabukuro voices Aoi Harukawa, Nobunaga Shimazaki voices Ryō Kobayashi and Rina Kawaei voices Ayane Satō.

Tomoya, Aoi and Ryō are high school students who have met through social media.
