When a disconnected phone on the wall begins to ring, Finney discovers that he can hear the voices of the killer’s previous victims. And they are dead set on making sure that what happened to them doesn’t happen to Finney.
tagline: Never talk to strangers.
title: The Black Phone
plot:
The Black Phone is a psychological horror film directed by Scott Derrickson, released in 2022 under Universal Pictures.

The movie takes place in the 1970s and follows the story of Finney Shaw (played by Mason Thames), an 11-year-old boy who lives with his abusive father. One day, while exploring the woods near his home, Finney stumbles upon a mysterious phone booth that seems to be calling him. The voice on the other end is that of a young girl named Abigail (voiced by Madeleine McGraw), who claims to have been kidnapped and murdered.

As Finney continues to communicate with Abigail through the phone booth, he becomes increasingly entangled in her story. He learns that she was taken from her home by a serial killer known as "The Grabber" (played by Bill Skarsgård). The Grabber is a monstrous figure who uses his hook-like hand to grab and kill his victims.

Finney soon realizes that Abigail's spirit is trapped in the phone booth, and he becomes determined to help her find peace. As Finney delves deeper into the mystery of Abigail's disappearance, he also uncovers dark secrets about his own family and their connection to The Grabber.

Throughout the film, Derrickson masterfully weaves together elements of horror, mystery, and coming-of-age drama. The Black Phone features a standout performance from Mason Thames, who brings a sense of vulnerability and determination to Finney's character.

The film's use of the phone booth as a narrative device is also noteworthy. The booth serves as a symbol of communication between Finney and Abigail, but it also represents a kind of liminal space where time and reality are distorted.

Overall, The Black Phone is a tense and unsettling horror film that explores themes of trauma, identity, and the power of human connection. With its atmospheric tension and standout performances, it's a must-see for fans of psychological horror.

overview: The year 2050 the planet has become overpopulated, to help control population the government develops a race. The Death Race. Annually competitors race across the country scoring points for killing people with their vehicles.
title: Death Race 2050
plot:
Death Race 2050 is a dystopian science fiction film that explores the darker aspects of human nature and the consequences of unchecked technological advancement. The movie takes place in a future where corporations have replaced governments, and people are forced to participate in a deadly game show called "Death Race" as a form of entertainment.

The main theme of Death Race 2050 is the exploitation of humanity for the sake of corporate profit and entertainment. The film critiques the voyeuristic tendencies of modern society, where people are willing to watch others suffer and die for the sake of entertainment. This theme is reflected in the character of Senator Armstrong, who sees the Death Race as a way to distract the population from the true issues facing the country.

The movie also explores the consequences of playing with fire when it comes to advanced technology. The Death Race itself is a twisted combination of reality TV and military training, where contestants are forced to fight for their lives in a televised event. This blurs the lines between what is real and what is staged, raising questions about the nature of truth and reality.

Furthermore, the film touches on the theme of rebellion and resistance against oppressive systems. The main character, Frankenstein, is a former soldier who seeks revenge against those responsible for his past traumas. His actions serve as a catalyst for the events that unfold, highlighting the importance of individual agency and the need for people to stand up against injustice.

Overall, Death Race 2050 is a thought-provoking film that explores the darker aspects of human nature and the consequences of unchecked technological advancement. It serves as a warning about the dangers of exploiting humanity for the sake of entertainment and corporate profit.

overview: Love never hurt so good for two co-workers who enter a contractual relationship as partners in consensual play, pleasure and pain.
tagline: Will you dominate me?
title: Love and Leashes
plot:
Love and Leashes is a South Korean romantic comedy of 2022 directed by Park Hyun-jin and adapted from the webtoon Moral Sense by Gyeoul, about an office romance built on a dominant-submissive arrangement. Seohyun stars as public relations manager Jung Ji-woo and Lee Jun-young as her new colleague Jung Ji-hoo, with Lee El as Ji-woo's best friend Hye-mi, Seo Hyun-woo as team leader Hwang, Ahn Seung-gyun as the youngest employee Lee Han and Kim Bo-ra as Ji-hoo's former girlfriend Hana.

Ji-hoo joins a public relations firm and notices that Ji-woo, a capable manager, is constantly undermined by her male colleagues. Because their names are so alike, a parcel addressed to him lands on her desk, and she opens it to find a leather collar and leash. He insists they are for his dog until a sex shop coupon falls out. Grateful that she keeps his secret, he misreads her apology for her bossy manner as an admission that she is a dominant and asks her to become his mistress; she is stunned, having assumed the gear was meant for a partner. At a company event he tearfully confesses that a past girlfriend left him over his desires, leaving him ashamed, and Ji-woo assures him she does not think him a pervert. Testing him with a blindfold, she asks why he chose her, and he says he admires her confidence, maturity and integrity. She agrees, researches BDSM all night, and the two sign a three-month contract with her as the dominant partner.

As gossip spreads and Ji-woo turns her commanding streak on co-workers such as Han, Ji-hoo grows jealous, and an after-hours session nearly gets them caught by a guard. Ji-woo realises she has feelings for him, but he refuses to date. They rescue Hye-mi from a violent man at a themed love hotel. On the contract's last day Hana visits Ji-hoo and blames his selfishness for his loneliness; in their final session he kisses Ji-woo and admits he has avoided love for fear of being hurt, and she walks out. When Han accidentally emails a recording of one of their sessions to the whole office and the managers' warning turns into harassment, Ji-hoo takes the blame and declares his love despite her safeword. Ji-woo has Han expose the managers' own affairs, and the couple begin dating openly while keeping their dynamic.

Netflix released the film in February 2022, timed for Valentine's Day. It scored 80% on Rotten Tomatoes from a handful of reviews, though OhmyNews noted its niche subject limited its appeal.

original_title: 劇場版ポケットモンスター ダイヤモンド&パール ギラティナと氷空（そら）の花束 シェイミ
overview: When Giratina is discovered to be able to create parallel dimensions, it's up to Ash and his friends to stop a mysterious stranger from using its powers for evil.
tagline: In a Reverse World, a Legendary battle rages on...
title: Pokémon: Giratina and the Sky Warrior
plot:
Pokémon: Giratina and the Sky Warrior is a 2008 Japanese animated adventure film produced by OLM and distributed by Toho. Kunihiko Yuyama directed from a screenplay by Hideki Sonoda. It is the eleventh Pokémon film, the second of the Diamond and Pearl era, and a direct sequel to Pokémon: The Rise of Darkrai (2007).

Years earlier, the researcher Newton Graceland designed a machine that could take the powers of Giratina, the Legendary Pokémon ruling the Reverse World, a mirror dimension of the real world, to cross between worlds. He abandoned the project when he learned it would kill Giratina, but his assistant Zero remembered the plans. After the battle of Dialga and Palkia polluted the Reverse World, an angry Giratina drags Dialga into it. The flower-bearing Pokémon Shaymin, caught on Dialga's back, escapes to the real world, and Dialga traps Giratina in a time loop that keeps it from following.

Shaymin meets the trainers Ash Ketchum, Dawn and Brock, who agree to take it to a Flower Garden in the mountains where its kind gather to migrate. Giratina, hoping to use Shaymin's power to break free, repeatedly pulls the group into the Reverse World, where Newton helps them, while Zero chases them. Touching a Gracidea flower turns Shaymin into its flying Sky Forme. Zero eventually captures Shaymin, forces it to release Giratina into the real world, and then uses Newton's device to drain Giratina's powers so he can rule the Reverse World. Newton shuts the machine down and Shaymin heals the exhausted Giratina. Zero's damage to the Reverse World sends a glacier sliding toward the Flower Garden until Regigigas and a herd of Mamoswine slow it. Shaymin drags Zero back to the real world, where his ship crashes and freezes, wiping his stolen data. Giratina repairs the damage and leaves to find Dialga, and the Shaymin perform their flower bearing before migrating.

In the Japanese version Rica Matsumoto voices Ash and Megumi Toyoguchi voices Dawn, with Shidō Nakamura as Zero and Kōichi Yamadera as Newton. Released in Japan on July 19, 2008, the film opened in second place behind Ponyo, drawing about 982,000 viewers and more than ¥1 billion on its first weekend, and its total ended about 10% below that of the previous film. Reviews were generally positive, and Kidzworld called it worth watching for fans and non-fans of Pokémon alike. A sequel, Arceus and the Jewel of Life, followed in 2009.

overview: Kenny Wells, a modern-day prospector, hustler, and dreamer, is desperate for a lucky break. Left with few options, Wells teams up with an equally luckless geologist to execute a grandiose, last-ditch effort: to find gold deep in the uncharted jungle of Indonesia.
tagline: Prove 'em all wrong
title: Gold
plot:
Gold is a 2016 Indian crime drama film directed by Saket Chaudhary and produced by Reliance Entertainment. The movie revolves around the life of Sudhir, a young man who becomes obsessed with gold mining in the Kolar Gold Fields.

The main theme of Gold is the struggle for survival and the pursuit of wealth in the face of adversity. The film explores how Sudhir's obsession with gold leads him to take risks that put his life and relationships at stake. Through Sudhir's story, the movie highlights the harsh realities of poverty and the desperation that drives people to make difficult choices.

The film also delves into the theme of redemption and the consequences of one's actions. As Sudhir navigates the complexities of gold mining, he must confront the darker aspects of his own nature and the true cost of his ambitions. The movie raises questions about the morality of exploiting natural resources for personal gain and the impact it has on individuals and communities.

Furthermore, Gold touches upon the theme of identity and the search for one's place in the world. Sudhir's journey is a metaphor for the struggles faced by many young Indians who feel lost and uncertain about their future. The film offers a poignant commentary on the societal pressures that drive people to seek wealth and status at any cost.

Overall, Gold is a gripping drama that explores the complexities of human nature, the consequences of our actions, and the struggle for survival in a world where resources are scarce.

overview: In RoboCop, the year is 2028 and multinational conglomerate OmniCorp is at the center of robot technology.  Overseas, their drones have been used by the military for years, but have been forbidden for law enforcement in America.  Now OmniCorp wants to bring their controversial technology to the home front, and they see a golden opportunity to do it.  When Alex Murphy – a loving husband, father and good cop doing his best to stem the tide of crime and corruption in Detroit – is critically injured, OmniCorp sees their chance to build a part-man, part-robot police officer.  OmniCorp envisions a RoboCop in every city and even more billions for their shareholders, but they never counted on one thing: there is still a man inside the machine.
tagline: We've got the future under control.
title: RoboCop
plot:
RoboCop is a 2014 science fiction action film directed by José Padilha and written by Justin Rhodes. The movie is a remake of the 1987 classic of the same name, directed by Paul Verhoeven.

In a dystopian Detroit, Officer Alex Murphy (Joel Kinnaman) is a dedicated and honest cop who is part of an elite police unit known as the GCPD's Special Response Team. On Christmas Eve, while responding to a call, Murphy is ambushed and brutally murdered by a group of armed robbers led by Norman (Gary Oldman), a former cop turned crime lord.

Murphy's body is then taken to the OmniCorp-owned corporation, where he is subjected to an experimental procedure that transforms him into a cyborg law enforcement officer. The process involves merging Murphy's consciousness with a robotic body, granting him enhanced strength, agility, and durability.

The new RoboCop (Kinnaman) is activated by his creator, Dr. Dennett Norton (Michael Keaton), who explains the purpose of the program: to create an unstoppable police force that can maintain order in Detroit without human oversight. However, as RoboCop begins to explore his newfound abilities and question his existence, he starts to develop a sense of self-awareness and morality.

As RoboCop delves deeper into the city's corruption and crime, he becomes determined to uncover the truth behind his own murder and the sinister motives of OmniCorp. He also forms an unlikely alliance with Anne Lewis (Abbie Cornish), a rookie cop who is initially hesitant to trust him.

Throughout the film, RoboCop faces off against Norman and his henchmen in a series of intense battles, while also navigating the complexities of his own identity and humanity. As he struggles to reconcile his robotic body with his human emotions, RoboCop becomes a symbol of resistance against corporate greed and corruption.

The movie culminates in an action-packed showdown between RoboCop and Norman, with the fate of Detroit hanging in the balance. In the end, RoboCop emerges victorious, but not without confronting the darker aspects of his own existence and the true nature of his programming.

Overall, the 2014 version of RoboCop offers a thought-provoking commentary on corporate power, free will, and what it means to be human. While it deviates from the original's satirical tone, the film retains the essence of the classic's themes and action-packed sequences, making it a compelling addition to the franchise.

overview: Philosophical twenty-something Ross Ulbricht creates Silk Road, a dark net website that sells drugs, while DEA agent Rick Bowden goes undercover to bring him down.
tagline: A mastermind is a terrible thing to waste.
title: Silk Road
plot:
Silk Road is a 2021 American biographical crime drama film directed by Tiller Russell. The movie revolves around Ross Ulbricht, a charismatic and intelligent individual who creates an anonymous online marketplace called the Silk Road.

The main theme of Silk Road is the allure and dangers of anonymity in the digital age. The film explores how Ulbricht's creation of the Silk Road allowed him to build a vast and secretive network of users, all while maintaining his own anonymity. This theme raises questions about the nature of identity, accountability, and the consequences of one's actions when they are hidden behind a veil of secrecy.

The movie also delves into the world of cryptocurrency and the dark web, highlighting the ease with which illicit activities can be conducted online. However, it also touches on the human cost of these activities, particularly for those who become entangled in Ulbricht's empire, including his own followers and users.

Furthermore, Silk Road examines the tension between individual freedom and societal responsibility. Ulbricht's character is portrayed as a complex figure, driven by both altruistic and self-serving motivations. His actions spark a moral debate about whether one should prioritize personal liberty or adhere to the law, even if it means sacrificing anonymity.

Ultimately, the film presents a thought-provoking exploration of the intersection of technology, morality, and human nature, leaving viewers to ponder the implications of Ulbricht's creation and its lasting impact on our digital landscape.

overview: An American pilot is sent to a Chinese province to teach a crew of would-be pilots how to fly war planes against the Japanese during World War II.
tagline: They fought World War II's greatest battle.
title: Air Strike
plot:
Air Strike is a 2018 Chinese war drama film directed by Chen Kaige, based on the novel "The Battle of Red Cliff" by Luo Guanzhong. The movie tells the story of a young pilot named Li Shang, who joins the air force to fight against the Japanese invasion during World War II.

One of the main themes of Air Strike is the psychological toll of war on soldiers and civilians alike. The film explores the emotional struggles of its characters as they face the harsh realities of conflict, including loss, grief, and trauma. Through Li Shang's character, the movie delves into the complexities of patriotism, duty, and the human cost of war.

Another significant theme in Air Strike is the struggle for identity and belonging. As a young pilot, Li Shang must navigate his place within the military hierarchy and reconcile his personal values with the demands of war. The film also touches on the theme of sacrifice, as characters are forced to make difficult choices between their own desires and the needs of others.

The movie also explores the theme of loyalty and camaraderie among soldiers, highlighting the bonds that form between comrades in the face of adversity. Through these relationships, the film conveys a sense of hope and resilience in the midst of chaos and destruction.

Overall, Air Strike is a powerful exploration of the human experience during times of war, shedding light on the complexities and nuances of conflict and its impact on individuals and society.

overview: Enjoy high-sea thrills as Barbie, Chelsea and the rest of the Roberts family set sail on an adventure cruise.  "Barbie & Chelsea The Lost Birthday" tells the story of Chelsea, Barbie’s precocious youngest sister, and the rest of the Roberts family as they set sail on an adventure cruise for her seventh birthday. When they cross the International Date Line, Chelsea discovers her actual birthday has been lost and she embarks on a fantastical journey through an enchanted jungle island in order to save it.
title: Barbie & Chelsea: The Lost Birthday
plot:
Barbie & Chelsea: The Lost Birthday is a 2021 computer-animated adventure comedy television film directed by Cassi Simonds and written by Ann Austen and Nate Federman from a story by Charlotte Fullerton. The 38th entry in the Barbie film series, it centers on her youngest sister, Chelsea Roberts.

The Roberts family takes an adventure cruise to celebrate Chelsea's seventh birthday. While their mother Margaret is busy, Chelsea and her sisters Barbie, Skipper and Stacie look around the ship for the right place to hold the party, but the Activities Director keeps turning them away until the friendly Arlene shows them a pool area with a special birthday spot. When Chelsea's plush elephant Kelsie is found jammed in the pool's wave controls, the Activities Director blames Chelsea, though her father George defends her. That night the ship crosses the International Date Line, and in the morning Chelsea learns that it is already the 11th, a day past her birthday.

Heartbroken, Chelsea hides in a tent, where a talking parrot tells her about a wish-granting gem on a nearby jungle island. She ziplines there and meets living versions of her plush toys, among them Kelsie, a lost baby elephant missing her family, Darbie the giraffe, whom Chelsea frees from a spider web, and Snipper, a tiger shy about her music. Her sisters search the island, braving itchy flowers and quicksand. Chelsea's group gets past a tiki statue, an erupting volcano and a river of crocodiles to reach the gem. They give the single wish to Kelsie, but her parents arrive, so Chelsea wishes to return to the ship. Her sisters find her asleep in the tent with her toys, and the island adventure turns out to have been a dream. Chelsea then catches the Activities Director sabotaging the ship to avoid his work. The captain names Arlene the new Activities Director, and Chelsea gets her party anyway.

The voice cast features Cassidy Naber as Chelsea and Kelsie, America Young as Barbie and Darbie, Kirsten Day as Skipper and Snipper, and Cassandra Morris as Stacie, with Greg Chun as George, Lisa Fuson as Margaret and Laila Berzins as Arlene. The film premiered on Netflix worldwide in April 2021, alongside a soundtrack album on streaming services. It later aired on children's channels such as Pop in the United Kingdom and Ireland, 9Go! in Australia, Super RTL in Germany and Cartoonito in Italy.

overview: When young Buddy falls into Santa's gift sack on Christmas Eve, he's transported back to the North Pole and raised as a toy-making elf by Santa's helpers. But as he grows into adulthood, he can't shake the nagging feeling that he doesn't belong. Buddy vows to visit Manhattan and find his real dad, a workaholic publisher.
production_companies: Guy Walks into a Bar Productions
tagline: This holiday, discover your inner elf.
title: Elf
plot:
Elf is a Christmas comedy film released in 2003, directed by Jon Favreau and produced by New Line Cinema.

The story begins with Buddy Hobbs (played by Will Ferrell), a human who was accidentally taken to the North Pole as a baby and raised by Santa's elves. Unaware that he is actually a human, Buddy grows up thinking he is one of the elves, and his childlike innocence and enthusiasm are unmatched among the elf population.

As Buddy discovers the truth about his identity on Christmas Eve, he sets out to find his biological father, Walter Hobbs (played by James Caan), a children's book publisher in New York City. However, upon arrival, Buddy is met with skepticism and disdain from his father, who is on Santa's naughty list.

Despite initial disagreements, Buddy's innocence and good-hearted nature eventually win over his father, and he begins to form a bond with him. Meanwhile, Walter's wife, Emily (played by Mary Steenburgen), takes Buddy under her wing and helps him adjust to life in the city.

As Christmas approaches, Buddy becomes determined to spread Christmas cheer to those around him, including his father and stepmother. However, his efforts are met with resistance from his father, who is struggling to connect with his son due to their past differences.

The plot thickens when Walter's company is threatened by a rival publisher, Michael (played by Daniel Tay), who seeks to sabotage Christmas spirit in the city. Buddy, determined to save Christmas, teams up with his father and Emily to outsmart Michael and bring joy back to the city.

Throughout the film, Ferrell's comedic genius shines as he brings Buddy's childlike wonder and enthusiasm to life. The supporting cast, including Caan, Steenburgen, and Zooey Deschanel (as Jovie), add depth and humor to the story.

As Christmas Eve approaches, Buddy's efforts pay off, and he helps his father rediscover the true meaning of Christmas. In a heartwarming finale, Walter comes to accept Buddy as his son, and the two share a heartfelt moment together.

The film ends with Buddy returning to the North Pole, where he is welcomed back by Santa and the elf community. As he says goodbye to his new family in New York City, Buddy reflects on the lessons he learned about family, love, and acceptance. The final shot of the film features Buddy's iconic "I'm a cotton-headed ninnymuggins!" line, leaving audiences with a lasting impression of this Christmas classic.

Overall, Elf is a delightful holiday film that celebrates the power of kindness, generosity, and the importance of finding one's place in the world.

overview: Rodney Copperbottom is a young robot inventor who dreams of making the world a better place, until the evil Ratchet takes over Big Weld Industries. Now, Rodney's dreams – and those of his friends – are in danger of becoming obsolete.
tagline: The Biggest Comedy Ever Assembled!
title: Robots
plot:
Robots is a 2005 computer-animated science fiction comedy film produced by Blue Sky Studios and distributed by 20th Century Fox.

In a world where robots live and work together, the story follows the journey of Rodney Copperbottom (voiced by Ewan McGregor), an idealistic young inventor who dreams of making a name for himself in the city of New Metal City. Rodney is fascinated by the works of his idol, Bigweld (voiced by Mel Brooks), a renowned robot inventor and entrepreneur.

Upon completing his apprenticeship under the guidance of Professor Ward (voiced by Richard Kind), Rodney sets out to find Bigweld's factory, where he hopes to meet his hero and learn from him. However, upon arrival, he discovers that Bigweld has abandoned his factory and is now a recluse, having lost his sense of purpose after being forced to retire.

Rodney soon learns that the evil Ratchet (voiced by Greg Kinnear), a ruthless robot who serves as the CEO of Bigweld Industries, has taken over the company and is exploiting its workers. Ratchet's plan is to replace all robots with new, cheaper models, which would lead to widespread unemployment and poverty among the robot population.

Determined to stop Ratchet and save his city, Rodney teams up with a street-smart robot named Fender (voiced by Halle Berry), who becomes his ally and love interest. Together, they embark on a mission to find Bigweld and convince him to return to his factory and lead the robots in a rebellion against Ratchet.

As Rodney and Fender navigate through the city, they encounter various obstacles and challenges, including Ratchet's henchmen and the treacherous terrain of New Metal City. Along the way, Rodney learns valuable lessons about perseverance, friendship, and believing in oneself.

In the end, Rodney and Fender successfully convince Bigweld to return to his factory and lead the robots in a rebellion against Ratchet. The film culminates in an action-packed showdown between the robots and Ratchet's forces, with Rodney and Fender playing key roles in the battle.

Ultimately, the robots emerge victorious, and Ratchet is defeated. Bigweld returns to his factory, and the city of New Metal City is saved. Rodney and Fender share a romantic moment, and the film ends on a hopeful note, with the robots looking forward to a brighter future under Bigweld's leadership.

Overall, Robots is a heartwarming and entertaining film that explores themes of friendship, perseverance, and believing in oneself. With its colorful animation, engaging characters, and exciting plot twists, it has become a beloved classic among both children and adults.

overview: A taxi driver gets more than he bargained for when he picks up two teen runaways. Not only does the pair possess supernatural powers, but they're also trying desperately to escape people who have made them their targets.
tagline: The race is on.
title: Race to Witch Mountain
plot:
Race to Witch Mountain is a 2009 science fiction adventure film that explores several thought-provoking themes. At its core, the movie delves into the idea of identity and self-discovery, as the protagonist, Chase Sanders, navigates his way through a world where he's forced to confront his true nature.

The film also touches on the theme of prejudice and stereotypes, as Chase faces skepticism and mistrust from those who don't understand him. This is particularly evident in the way the authorities and the general public react to Chase's alleged "alien" status, highlighting the dangers of jumping to conclusions based on limited information or assumptions.

Furthermore, Race to Witch Mountain examines the complexities of family relationships and the bonds that tie people together. The movie showcases the strong connection between Chase and his sister, Sara, as they work together to uncover the truth about their past and their place in the world.

The film also explores the theme of power and control, particularly in the context of government agencies and institutions that seek to exploit individuals with unique abilities for their own purposes. This serves as a commentary on the dangers of unchecked authority and the importance of individual freedom and autonomy.

Overall, Race to Witch Mountain is a thrilling adventure that weaves together these themes to create a captivating narrative that's both entertaining and thought-provoking.

overview: Shrek The Musical is a musical with music by Jeanine Tesori and book and lyrics by David Lindsay-Abaire. It is based on the 2001 DreamWorks Animation's film Shrek and William Steig's 1990 book Shrek! It was nominated for 8 Tony Awards including Best Musical.
title: Shrek the Musical
plot:
Shrek the Musical is a musical comedy that explores themes of identity, acceptance, and the power of self-discovery. At its core, the story revolves around the journey of an ogre named Shrek, who is struggling to find his place in a world where he doesn't quite fit in.

The musical delves into the idea of what it means to be different and how societal expectations can shape our perceptions of ourselves and others. Shrek's journey is a metaphor for the struggles many people face when trying to navigate their own identities and find acceptance from those around them.

Through the character of Donkey, who serves as Shrek's confidant and friend, the musical highlights the importance of friendship and the value of embracing one's uniqueness. The relationship between Shrek and Donkey is a heartwarming portrayal of an unlikely friendship that blossoms into something more profound.

The musical also explores themes of love and acceptance, particularly in the context of Shrek's romance with Princess Fiona. Their story serves as a commentary on the societal norms surrounding marriage and relationships, highlighting the importance of finding true love and acceptance for who one is, rather than trying to conform to external expectations.

Ultimately, Shrek the Musical is a celebration of individuality and self-acceptance, encouraging audiences to embrace their own quirks and imperfections. The musical's themes are timeless and universal, making it a relatable and entertaining experience for all ages.

overview: When Hayley accepts an invitation to spend Christmas with her sister’s new in-laws, her seemingly perfect holiday takes a turn when Paul, Hayley's brother-in-law's brother, unexpectedly shows up. Still harboring a grudge against Paul for ending her last relationship, Hayley reluctantly spends time with Paul and slowly realizes she may have been too quick a judge on Paul
title: Too Close for Christmas
plot:
Too Close for Christmas is a 2020 Canadian-American romantic holiday television film directed by Ernie Barbarash and written by Nicole Baxter, made for Lifetime by the Motion Picture Corporation of America, Brad Krevoy Television and Hideaway Pictures. It stars Jessica Lowndes as Hayley Parker and Chad Michael Murray as Paul, with Vanessa Sears as Hayley's sister Amy and Steve Byers, Rob Stewart, Deanna Jarvis, Chris Farquhar and Seana McKenna in supporting roles. It runs 88 minutes and premiered on Lifetime on Friday, 4 December 2020.

Hayley is a perfectionist Manhattan event planner who works hard but is still waiting for a long-overdue promotion and keeps fretting about a co-promotion that is on the cards. For the first time in many years she accepts an invitation to spend Christmas with her sister Amy and Amy's new in-laws at the family's holiday home, on one condition: that Paul, the brother of Amy's husband, will not be there. Hayley has a bad history with him from Amy's wedding, holding a grudge against him for ending her last relationship. To everyone's surprise, Paul unexpectedly shows up, though only for one night, or so Hayley thinks until his flight to a ski trip in Switzerland is cancelled the next morning. Forced to spend the days before Christmas together, the two clash, but Paul draws her into a series of holiday activities and recruits her to help the committee planning the town gala, where she takes charge of ticket sales. Hayley, who usually eats only greens and protein, is surprised by how much she enjoys the ribs at the local diner, and she gradually gets the emotionally guarded Paul to open up and embrace the family's Christmas food traditions. As Paul encourages her to stop selling herself short at work, she realizes she may have judged him too quickly, and after a late setback in their relationship he apologizes, showing her that she deserves better in both her career and her love life.

Reviews were mixed. Alakananda Bandyopadhyay of MEAWW found the romance a gush of warmth, praising the leads' ease in their roles and Barbarash's festive direction while finding the score too cartoonish. Rissi JC of RissiWrites enjoyed it as a fun enemies-to-lovers comedy with good banter between Lowndes and Murray, while noting the spark was weaker at the turning point. Jesse Burleson of Views on Film gave it one and a half stars, calling it a predictable slog and finding Murray mostly annoying.

overview: After his precocious behavior has gotten him bounced out of one more in a string of exclusive private schools, 16-year old Sebastian Valmont has arrived in New York City to live with his father and stepmother. The cunning and handsome Sebastian may have met his match, however in his equally manipulative and beautiful stepsister Kathryn Merteuil.
tagline: Seduce and destroy.
title: Cruel Intentions 2
plot:
Cruel Intentions 2, also known as Cruel Intentions 2: Manchester Prep, is a 2000 American direct-to-video teen drama film written and directed by Roger Kumble. A prequel to Cruel Intentions (1999) and the second installment in the franchise, it stars Robin Dunne, Sarah Thompson, Keri Lynn Pratt and Amy Adams. The film began life as Manchester Prep, a television series for which Fox ordered 13 episodes for the 1999–2000 season with Kumble writing and executive producing. After conflicts between Columbia TriStar Television and the network, and executives' discomfort with its themes of teen sexuality, the series was canceled with only two episodes filmed. The studio's home video division then edited those episodes into a film, shooting additional scenes to turn the story into a prequel, give it an ending and add sexual content, while cutting some subplots and characters.

Sebastian Valmont, a troublemaking student, moves to New York City after his father marries a wealthy divorcée. Before leaving, he takes revenge on his old principal, who insists on forwarding his permanent record, by publishing a nude photo of the principal's wife in the yearbook, and he secretly swaps the record for a glowing one so that he can start fresh at the exclusive Manchester Prep. In his new home he meets his scheming and ambitious stepsister, Kathryn Merteuil, who quickly warns him not to interfere with her privileged life,, and the two become bickering step-siblings. At school Sebastian meets and falls for Danielle Sherman, the headmaster's daughter. Kathryn presides over a secret society of elite students that judges the newcomers, and she embarks on a vendetta against Cherie, a new girl whose family turns out to be richer than hers and who accidentally humiliated her at an assembly. As Sebastian's romance with Danielle develops, Kathryn tries to lure him away, tempting him with a pair of identical twins who tell him that Danielle is the only virgin at the school. Meanwhile Sebastian discovers his father cheating on Kathryn's mother, and Kathryn's mother orders her to befriend Cherie in the hope of securing a large donation to the school. When Sebastian finally declares his love for Danielle, he learns that the manipulation around him runs deeper than he suspected, and he must decide whether to fight the game or join it.

Released on home video in 2001, Cruel Intentions 2 received generally negative reviews, with an 18% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes based on 11 critics.

overview: When a systems engineer blows the whistle on a dangerous technology, Charlie's Angels from across the globe are called into action, putting their lives on the line to protect society.
tagline: Unseen. Undivided. Unstoppable.
title: Charlie's Angels
plot:
Charlie's Angels is a 2019 action-comedy film directed by Elizabeth Banks, starring Kristen Stewart, Naomi Scott, and Ella Balinska as the main characters. The movie is a reboot of the classic 1970s television series of the same name.

The story begins with Charlie Townsend (Dustin Hoffman), a wealthy businessman who runs a private investigation agency called Townsend & Associates. However, Charlie has passed away, leaving his agency in disarray. His three daughters, Alex (Kristen Stewart), Sabrina (Naomi Scott), and Eleanor (Ella Balinska), are recruited by their father's business partner, Bosley (Patrick Wilson), to take over the agency.

The sisters, who were once part of a secret organization called Charlie's Angels, must now work together to solve cases and bring down villains. They soon discover that they have been replaced by a new team of agents, led by a ruthless and cunning adversary known as Madison Lee (Lily James).

As the story unfolds, Alex, Sabrina, and Eleanor embark on a series of missions, including infiltrating a high-stakes poker game and stopping a plot to steal a valuable artifact. Along the way, they must navigate their complicated relationships with each other and with Bosley, who is struggling to keep up with the modern world.

Throughout the film, the sisters showcase their unique skills and personalities, from Alex's tough-as-nails exterior to Sabrina's bubbly and charming demeanor. Eleanor, the youngest sister, brings a fresh perspective and a talent for hacking.

As the stakes grow higher, the Angels must confront Madison Lee and her team of henchmen in an epic showdown. The film culminates in a thrilling action sequence, with the sisters using their combined skills to take down the villains and save the day.

One of the standout aspects of Charlie's Angels is its strong female lead characters. The movie celebrates women's empowerment and sisterhood, showcasing the strength and camaraderie between Alex, Sabrina, and Eleanor as they work together to achieve their goals.

Overall, Charlie's Angels is a fun and action-packed film that pays homage to the original series while introducing new characters and themes. With its talented cast, witty dialogue, and exciting plot twists, this movie is sure to delight fans of the franchise and newcomers alike.

overview: A teenage fugitive with an incredible secret races to stay one step ahead of the mysterious forces seeking destroy him in this sci-fi action thriller. With three dead and one on the run, the race to find the elusive Number Four begins. Outwardly normal teen John Smith never gets too comfortable in the same identity, and along with his guardian, Henri, he is constantly moving from town to town. With each passing day, John gains a stronger grasp on his extraordinary new powers, and his bond to the beings that share his fantastic fate grows stronger.
tagline: Three like him have already been killed…he is Number Four.
title: I Am Number Four
plot:
I Am Number Four is a science fiction film directed by D.J. Caruso, released in 2011 by DreamWorks Pictures.

The movie begins with an alien invasion on Earth, where nine extraterrestrial beings known as the Lorien are sent to destroy human colonies. The ninth and final Lorien, John Smith (played by Alex Pettyfer), escapes the destruction of his home planet and is left with a rare genetic marker that makes him immune to the invasion.

John is taken in by a foster family, the Keys (played by Dianna Agron, Jake Abel, and Callum Keith Rennie), who are unaware of John's true identity. As he grows up on Earth, John struggles to control his powers, which include superhuman strength, speed, and agility.

However, an alien hunter named Henry Hartrick (played by Timothy Olyphant) is sent to find the remaining Lorien and eliminate them. Henry believes that John is one of the nine Lorien and will stop at nothing to kill him.

As John navigates his new life on Earth, he meets a girl named Daniel's friend, Claire Bennet (played by Alexandra Daddario), who becomes his love interest. Meanwhile, Henry begins to close in on John, leading to a series of intense confrontations between the two.

Throughout the movie, John struggles with his identity and his connection to his fellow Lorien. He also grapples with the moral implications of his powers and the danger he poses to humanity.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Henry is not what he seems. His true intentions are revealed, and John must use all his skills and resources to protect himself and those he cares about.

The movie culminates in an action-packed showdown between John and Henry, with the fate of humanity hanging in the balance. In the end, John emerges victorious, but not without sacrifices. The film concludes on a hopeful note, as John finds a new sense of belonging among his human friends and begins to forge a new identity for himself.

Overall, I Am Number Four is a thrilling sci-fi adventure that explores themes of identity, loyalty, and self-discovery. With its engaging storyline, memorable characters, and impressive action sequences, the movie has become a cult classic among fans of the genre.

overview: Chev Chelios, a hit man wanting to go straight, lets his latest target slip away. Then he awakes the next morning to a phone call that informs him he has been poisoned and has only an hour to live unless he keeps adrenaline coursing through his body while he searches for an antidote.
tagline: There are a thousand ways to raise your adrenaline. Today, Chev Chelios will need every single one.
title: Crank
plot:
Crank (2006) is a dark action-comedy film directed by Neveldine/Taylor, starring Jason Statham as Chev Chelios. The movie follows Chev's quest to survive after being poisoned with a deadly toxin that slowly kills him.

The main themes of Crank include:

1. **Existentialism and the Will to Live**: The film explores the human desire to live and the lengths people will go to in order to survive. Chev's actions are driven by his need to stay alive, even if it means putting himself and others at risk.
2. **Redemption and Personal Growth**: Throughout the movie, Chev undergoes a transformation from a self-centered, violent individual to someone who begins to care for others and find redemption. This theme is reflected in his relationships with his daughter and his interactions with other characters.
3. **Addiction and Self-Destruction**: The toxin that kills Chev serves as a metaphor for addiction and the destructive nature of self-destructive behaviors. As the movie progresses, it becomes clear that Chev's actions are not only driven by his physical need to survive but also by his emotional and psychological dependence on the rush of adrenaline.
4. **Violence and its Consequences**: Crank critiques the glorification of violence in popular culture, highlighting the devastating consequences of Chev's actions. The film suggests that violence can lead to a cycle of revenge and retaliation, rather than resolving conflicts or finding peaceful solutions.

Overall, Crank is a thought-provoking film that explores complex themes through its dark humor, over-the-top action sequences, and Jason Statham's charismatic performance.

overview: A newly-developed microchip designed by Zorin Industries for the British Government that can survive the electromagnetic radiation caused by a nuclear explosion has landed in the hands of the KGB. James Bond must find out how and why. His suspicions soon lead him to big industry leader Max Zorin who forms a plan to destroy his only competition in Silicon Valley by triggering a massive earthquake in the San Francisco Bay.
tagline: Has James Bond finally met his match?
title: A View to a Kill
plot:
A View to a Kill is a 1985 spy film directed by John Glen and the fourth installment in the James Bond series, produced by United Artists. The film stars Roger Moore as the iconic secret agent James Bond.

The story begins with Bond (Roger Moore) living in Switzerland, where he has retired from his spy life. However, his peaceful existence is disrupted when a wealthy businessman named Max Zorin (Christopher Walken) threatens to destroy San Francisco unless his demands are met. Zorin's plan involves using a deadly laser beam to destroy the Golden Gate Bridge.

Bond is drawn back into the world of espionage and teams up with Stacey Sutton (Tanya Roberts), a beautiful and resourceful American woman who works for Zorin's company, Zorin Industries. As Bond delves deeper into the mystery, he discovers that Zorin's plan is not just about destruction, but also about revenge against the world that wronged him.

Bond's investigation takes him to San Francisco, where he encounters a range of characters, including Stacey, who becomes his ally and love interest. Along the way, Bond must navigate a complex web of intrigue and deception, all while staying one step ahead of Zorin's henchmen.

As the story unfolds, Bond discovers that Zorin's true intention is to use the laser beam to destroy the Golden Gate Bridge and hold the city for ransom. However, he also learns that Stacey is not what she seems, and that her connection to Zorin is more sinister than initially thought.

The film's climax features an action-packed sequence as Bond confronts Zorin on the Golden Gate Bridge. In a thrilling finale, Bond uses his wits and skills to outsmart Zorin and destroy the laser beam, saving San Francisco from destruction.

Throughout the film, Moore brings his signature charm and wit to the role of Bond, while Walken provides a menacing presence as the villainous Zorin. The chemistry between Moore and Roberts is undeniable, making their romance a highlight of the film.

A View to a Kill received mixed reviews at the time of its release but has since become a cult classic among Bond fans. While it may not be considered one of the best Bond films by some, it remains an entertaining and action-packed addition to the series.

overview: A young man, Kazuya Mishima, wakes up alone in an unfamiliar hotel room without any recollection of who he is or how he got there. He is tormented by flashes of his past and by the face of an ominous stranger. The next thing he knows, Kazuya is ambushed and kidnapped by an underground crime organization and, soon after, turned into a ruthless assassin.  During a mission to assassinate a man named Brian Fury, Kazuya finds that his target harbors clues to his true identity. With the help of Fury and a female assassin, Kazuya follows the clues, leading him to the lab of his reoccurring flashbacks. Here, he will finally confront his past and the ominous man of his nightmares - Heihachi Mishima, face the ultimate betrayal, and Ieam the truth about who, and what, he really is.  TEKKEN 2: KAZUYA’S REVENGE is non-stop action from the first scene to the last.
tagline: Survival Is No Game
title: TEKKEN: A Man Called X
plot:
Tekken 2: Kazuya's Revenge, also released as Tekken: A Man Called X, is a 2014 American martial arts film directed by Wych Kaos and written by Nicole Jones and Steven Paul. It is based on Bandai Namco's Tekken fighting game series and serves as a prequel to the first live-action Tekken film. SP Distribution released it direct to video in the United States on August 12, 2014.

A young Japanese man with no memory of his past wakes in an apartment outside Tekken City, is chased by armed men and captured by the assassin Rhona Anders. She brings him to a guerrilla leader called the Minister, who gives him the code name "K" and has an explosive implanted in his chest to punish failure or desertion. Despite his amnesia, K is an expert fighter and marksman. He befriends a crippled janitor whose son attacked him and disappeared years earlier, and he refuses the Minister's order to kill either the janitor or a defeated sparring partner, whom a henchman then kills. While carrying out assassinations, K also befriends Laura, a nurse in his building, after saving her from muggers, and she later removes the bomb from his chest. Back at the apartment where he woke up, he learns he had signed in only as "K. M."

One of K's targets, Bryan Fury, beats him and warns him to quit. Fury, a former associate of the Minister, later tells K and Rhona that they are all pawns and that the Minister now wants K dead. Rhona turns on the Minister and stabs him, but Laura is kidnapped and taken to the Gentek factory. Inside, K meets Heihachi Mishima, who reveals that K is his son, Kazuya, brainwashed and set loose to test his ability to survive, much like the Spartan custom of leaving boys in the wild. Heihachi has also brainwashed Laura, changing her personality, and he kills her just after she and Kazuya share a kiss. Kazuya defeats the fighters Rip and Thorn, accepts his heritage and sets off with Rhona to find Heihachi.

Kane Kosugi plays Kazuya, with Kelly Wenham as Rhona, Rade Šerbedžija as the Minister and Paige Lindquist as Laura. Cary-Hiroyuki Tagawa and Gary Daniels return from the earlier film as Heihachi and Bryan Fury, and Sahajak Boonthanakit plays the janitor. Manly Movie scored it 3 out of 10, arguing that the filmmakers had little understanding of or interest in the game's characters and had simply cast whichever actors were available for cameos.

overview: Upstart payment firm Wirecard wowed the financial industry with its runaway success — until a tenacious team of journalists exposed massive fraud.
title: Skandal! Bringing Down Wirecard
plot:
Batman Beyond: Return of the Joker is a 2000 animated science fiction film produced by Warner Bros. Animation, based on the DC Comics series Batman Beyond.

The story takes place four years after the events of Batman Beyond: The Movie (1999). Bruce Wayne, now an older man, has retired from being Batman and is living a quiet life in Gotham City. However, his peaceful existence is disrupted when he receives a message from an unknown sender claiming to be the Joker, who was thought to have been defeated by Bruce's predecessor, Terry McGinnis.

The Joker, played by Mark Hamill, has managed to escape from Arkham Asylum and is now seeking revenge against Bruce for abandoning him. The Joker's plan involves using a device that can control people's minds, allowing him to take over the city of Gotham.

Meanwhile, Terry McGinnis, now an adult, is struggling with his own identity as he tries to balance his life as Batman with his personal relationships and responsibilities. He is haunted by the memory of his predecessor, Bruce Wayne, who has become a distant figure in his life.

As the Joker's plan unfolds, Bruce is forced to confront his past and face the villain he thought he had defeated years ago. The film features a mix of action, suspense, and emotional drama as Bruce and Terry work together to stop the Joker and save Gotham City.

Throughout the film, there are several flashbacks that reveal the events leading up to the Joker's escape from Arkham Asylum. These scenes show how the Joker was able to manipulate his way out of prison and set in motion his plan for revenge against Bruce.

The climax of the film features an epic battle between Batman and the Joker, with Terry playing a key role in helping his predecessor defeat the villain. In the end, the Joker is defeated, but not before he reveals that he has been manipulating events from behind the scenes to drive a wedge between Bruce and Terry.

The film ends on a bittersweet note, as Bruce reflects on the lessons he has learned about the importance of legacy and the need to pass on his knowledge and experience to the next generation. The final scene shows Bruce passing on the mantle of Batman to Terry, marking a new era in the history of the character.

Overall, Batman Beyond: Return of the Joker is a gripping and emotional film that explores themes of identity, legacy, and the complexities of the human psyche. With its engaging storyline, memorable characters, and stunning animation, it is a must-see for fans of the Batman franchise.

overview: Professor James Murray begins work compiling words for the first edition of the Oxford English Dictionary in the mid 19th century, and receives over 10,000 entries from a patient at Broadmoor Criminal Lunatic Asylum, Dr. William Minor.
tagline: The incredible true story that defined our world.
title: The Professor and the Madman
plot:
The Professor and the Madman is a 2019 biographical drama film directed by James Dearden, produced by Fastnet Films, and based on the book "The Curse of the Hope Diamond" by Richard Rhodes. 

The main themes of The Professor and the Madman revolve around obsession, madness, and the blurred lines between genius and insanity. The story follows William Stewart (played by Jeremy Irons), a lexicographer who creates the Oxford English Dictionary, and Samuel Wagstaff (played by Eddie Redmayne), a poet with mental health issues.

The plot begins with Wagstaff's arrest for murdering his wife, and he is subsequently institutionalized. While in prison, Wagstaff meets William Stewart, who becomes fascinated by Wagstaff's poetry and begins to correspond with him. As their relationship deepens, Stewart becomes increasingly obsessed with Wagstaff's work, which leads to a complex exploration of the nature of madness and genius.

Throughout the film, the themes of obsession and fixation are expertly woven together, raising questions about the boundaries between creativity and insanity. The character of William Stewart is portrayed as a brilliant but troubled individual who becomes consumed by his own demons, while Wagstaff's mental health issues serve as a catalyst for exploring the complexities of human psychology.

The film ultimately raises more questions than it answers, leaving the audience to ponder the nature of madness and genius, and whether they are mutually exclusive or intertwined. The ending is intentionally ambiguous, leaving viewers to draw their own conclusions about the characters' fates and the true extent of Wagstaff's mental health issues.

Overall, The Professor and the Madman is a thought-provoking drama that delves into the darker aspects of human nature, exploring the complexities of obsession, madness, and the blurred lines between genius and insanity.

overview: A tale of an inner city drug dealer who turns away from crime to pursue his passion, rap music.
tagline: If You Think You Know the Story...You Don't Know the Man.
title: Get Rich or Die Tryin'
plot:
Get Rich or Die Tryin' is a biographical crime drama film directed by Jim Sheridan, released in 2005 by Paramount Pictures. The movie is based on the life of Christopher "Chris" Gardner, played by Will Smith.

The film begins with Chris Gardner (Will Smith), a struggling single father who loses his job as an intern at a prestigious stock brokerage firm due to company restructuring. With no steady income and a young son, Christopher Jr., Chris is forced to navigate the harsh realities of poverty in San Francisco's Tenderloin district.

Despite facing numerous challenges, including homelessness and eviction from their apartment, Chris remains determined to provide for his son. He begins working as an intern at Dean Witter Reynolds, but struggles to make ends meet due to a lack of connections and resources.

As Chris navigates the cutthroat world of finance, he also faces personal demons, including a troubled relationship with his ex-wife, Linda (Thandie Newton), who is now dating another man. The tension between Chris and Linda comes to a head when she refuses to let him see their son, leading to a heart-wrenching confrontation.

Meanwhile, Chris meets a fellow struggling artist, Darnell Lewis (Snoop Dogg), who becomes his friend and confidant. Darnell introduces Chris to the world of street hustling, where he learns to rely on his wits and resourcefulness to survive.

As Chris's fortunes begin to change, he lands a job at Dean Witter Reynolds and starts to build a new life for himself and his son. However, just as things are starting to look up, Chris is diagnosed with testicular cancer, which forces him to confront the harsh realities of mortality.

With the support of Darnell and his colleagues, Chris undergoes treatment and begins to rebuild his life. He eventually lands a permanent job at Dean Witter Reynolds and becomes a successful stockbroker, providing a better life for himself and his son.

The film ends with Chris reflecting on the lessons he has learned along the way, including the importance of perseverance, hard work, and the value of human connection. Despite facing numerous challenges and setbacks, Chris emerges as a triumphant figure, determined to provide a brighter future for himself and those around him.

Throughout the film, Will Smith delivers a powerful performance that captures the complexity and nuance of Chris Gardner's story. The supporting cast, including Thandie Newton and Snoop Dogg, adds depth and authenticity to the narrative, bringing the harsh realities of poverty and struggle to life in a way that is both poignant and uplifting.

Overall, Get Rich or Die Tryin' is a powerful and moving film that explores themes of perseverance, redemption, and the human spirit. With its strong performances, gripping storyline, and thought-provoking themes, it is a must-see for anyone interested in biographical dramas or stories of overcoming adversity.

original_title: ノーゲーム・ノーライフ ゼロ
overview: In ancient Disboard, Riku is an angry, young warrior intent on saving humanity from the warring Exceed, the sixteen sentient species, fighting to establish the "One True God" amongst the Old Deus. In a lawless land, humanity's lack of magic and weak bodies have made them easy targets, leaving them on the brink of extinction. One day, hope returns to humanity when Riku finds a powerful female Ex-machina, whom he names Schwi. Exiled from her Cluster because of her research into human emotions, Schwi is convinced that humanity has only survived due to the power of these feelings. Forming an unlikely partnership in the midst of the overwhelming chaos, Riku and Schwi must now find the answers to their individual shortcomings in each other, and discover for themselves what it truly means to be human as they fight for their lives against all odds. Each with a powerful new ally in tow, it is now up to them to prevent the extinction of the human race and establish peace throughout Disboard!
title: No Game No Life: Zero
plot:
No Game No Life: Zero is a Japanese anime film directed by Takuya Igarashi and produced by Madhouse. The story takes place in a world where games are a central part of society, and the concept of "game" is not limited to video games or board games.

The plot follows Sora and Shiro, two siblings who are child prodigies in the world of games. They have been raised by their father, who has taught them everything he knows about strategy and game theory. The siblings are known as the "Zero Family," and they live a life of luxury and isolation.

One day, the Zero Family is challenged to a game by a group of powerful players from a neighboring country. The stakes are high, with the winner gaining control over the entire region. Sora and Shiro accept the challenge, but things take a turn when they discover that their opponent is not what it seems.

As the game progresses, Sora and Shiro realize that their opponent is actually a group of powerful players from a different world, known as the "Zero Family" from a parallel universe. The two families engage in an epic battle of wits, with the outcome hanging in the balance.

Throughout the film, the director explores themes of strategy, game theory, and the nature of reality. Sora and Shiro's relationship is also a central focus, as they work together to outmaneuver their opponents and uncover the secrets behind the mysterious Zero Family.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that the Zero Family from the parallel universe has been searching for a way to escape their world and enter our own. Sora and Shiro must navigate this complex web of games and reality to prevent a catastrophic outcome.

The film's climax features an intense showdown between the two families, with the fate of both worlds hanging in the balance. In the end, Sora and Shiro emerge victorious, but not without sacrifices. The film concludes on a bittersweet note, leaving the audience wondering about the implications of their actions and the future of the Zero Family.

Overall, No Game No Life: Zero is a thought-provoking and action-packed anime film that explores the complexities of strategy, game theory, and the nature of reality. With its engaging characters and intricate plot, it is sure to appeal to fans of science fiction and adventure.

overview: Singing and dreaming together, a talented singer-songwriter and a same-aged keyboardist add harmony and love to each other's lives.

overview: Jake, full of anger after his father's death, is just starting to find a place for himself at his new Orlando high school - until Ryan, head of an underground MMA fight club, picks Jake out as a prime opponent. After being trounced by Ryan in front of the entire school, Jake begins training under the firm, moral guidance of a MMA master, where he learns how to fight... and how to avoid a fight. But it becomes obvious that a rematch will be inevitable if Jake wants to stop Ryan and his bullying, once and for all.
tagline: Win or lose... Everyone has their fight.
title: Never Back Down
plot:
Never Back Down is a 2008 American martial arts drama film directed by Brian Buckner and written by Chris Bremner. The movie stars Sean Faris, Amber Heard, and Cam Gigandet.

The story revolves around Jake Tyler (Sean Faris), a high school student who has always been the star of his school's wrestling team. However, after a devastating loss to a new wrestler named Bama (Cam Gigandet) at the state championships, Jake begins to question his own abilities and feels like he's lost his passion for wrestling.

Bama, on the other hand, is a ruthless and arrogant wrestler who has been dominating the sport with his brutal fighting style. He's also a bit of a bully, both in and out of the ring, which makes him a formidable opponent for Jake.

Despite his initial reluctance, Jake decides to train with Bama, hoping that he can learn from the best and improve his skills. However, as Jake trains with Bama, he begins to realize that his new coach is not what he seems. Bama's aggressive behavior and lack of sportsmanship are traits that Jake finds disturbing, but he's also drawn to Bama's confidence and charisma.

As Jake becomes more entrenched in the wrestling world, he starts to develop feelings for Bama's sister, Peyton (Amber Heard). However, their relationship is complicated by Bama's possessiveness and jealousy, which creates tension between the two siblings.

Throughout the movie, Jake struggles with his own identity and sense of purpose. He's torn between his loyalty to his friends and family, and his desire to prove himself as a wrestler. As he trains with Bama, Jake begins to realize that there's more to wrestling than just winning and losing - it's about discipline, hard work, and respect for your opponents.

The movie builds towards a climactic showdown between Jake and Bama at the state championships. In the end, Jake emerges victorious, but not without scars both physical and emotional. He also finds closure with Peyton and begins to rebuild his relationships with those around him.

Overall, Never Back Down is a gritty and intense drama that explores themes of identity, loyalty, and redemption. The movie features impressive martial arts sequences and a strong performance from Sean Faris, who brings depth and nuance to the lead role.

belongs_to_collection.name: Return of the Living Dead Collection

original_title: Return of the Living Dead Part II
overview: A group of kids discover one of the drums containing a rotting corpse and release the 2-4-5 Trioxin gas into the air, causing the dead to once again rise from the grave and seek out brains.
tagline: Just when you thought it was safe to be dead.
title: Return of the Living Dead Part II
plot:
Return of the Living Dead Part II is a 1988 American zombie comedy film directed by Jim Wynorski and starring James Bryan, Bob Cresse, and Beverly Hendrickson. The movie follows a group of people who are trying to survive in a world overrun by zombies.

The main theme of Return of the Living Dead Part II is the struggle for survival in a chaotic and apocalyptic world. The film depicts a society that has broken down, with lawlessness and anarchy reigning supreme. The characters must navigate this treacherous landscape, fighting off hordes of undead and trying to find safety.

At its core, Return of the Living Dead Part II is a commentary on the breakdown of social order and the collapse of civilization in the face of catastrophic events. The film's portrayal of a world gone mad serves as a warning about the dangers of complacency and the importance of individual responsibility in times of crisis.

The movie also explores themes of rebellion and resistance, as the characters band together to fight against the zombies and try to reclaim their lives. This struggle for survival is not just physical, but also emotional and psychological, as the characters confront their own fears and vulnerabilities in the face of overwhelming odds.

Overall, Return of the Living Dead Part II is a darkly comedic take on the zombie apocalypse genre, using humor and satire to comment on the human condition and our capacity for resilience in the face of adversity.

overview: During a shootout in a saloon, Sheriff Hunt injures a suspicious stranger. The doctor's assistant, wife of the local foreman, tends to him in prison. That night, the town is attacked and they both disappear—only the arrow of a cannibal tribe is found. Hunt and a few of his men go in search of the prisoner and the foreman's wife.
tagline: May the Lord have mercy and grant you a swift death
title: Bone Tomahawk
plot:
Bone Tomahawk is a 2015 American Western horror film directed by S. Craig Zahler. The movie takes place in the post-Civil War era and follows four men on a mission to rescue a woman from a group of cannibalistic cave dwellers.

The main themes of Bone Tomahawk include:

1. **Survival vs. Humanity**: The film explores the struggle between human survival instincts and the moral decay that can occur when individuals are pushed to their limits. As the characters face unimaginable horrors, they must confront their own humanity and decide what it means to be alive.
2. **Redemption and Sacrifice**: Throughout the movie, the characters grapple with personal demons and seek redemption for past mistakes. The film suggests that true redemption can only be achieved through sacrifice, as the characters are forced to confront their own mortality and make difficult choices to save others.
3. **The Power of Nature**: Bone Tomahawk features a terrifying and unforgiving natural environment that serves as a character in its own right. The film highlights the awe-inspiring power of nature and the insignificance of human existence in the face of it.
4. **Violence and Trauma**: The movie is known for its graphic violence, gore, and unflinching portrayal of trauma. These elements serve to underscore the characters' emotional states and the devastating consequences of their experiences.

The film's narrative is driven by a complex web of relationships, motivations, and conflicts between the four main characters: Sheriff John "Legs" Volmer (Kurt Russell), his deputy, Ulysses Everett McGill (Matthew Fox), and two women, Maybelle (Patrick Wilson) and Seraphs (Lili Simmons). As the story unfolds, these characters are forced to confront their own dark pasts and the true nature of their mission.

Overall, Bone Tomahawk is a thought-provoking and visceral film that explores themes of survival, redemption, and the human condition in the face of unimaginable horror.

overview: A logger defends his family from a group of dangerous drug runners.
tagline: They threatened his world. He will destroy theirs.
title: Braven
plot:
Braven is a 2018 American action thriller film directed by Michael Chaves and written by Bryan Woods and Chris McKenna. The movie stars Jason Momoa, Stephen Lang, and Garrett Hedlund.

The story begins with Jack Taylor (Jason Momoa), a former Special Forces operative who has retired to a remote cabin in the woods of Maine with his wife, Liz (Sandra Hüller). They live a peaceful life, away from the chaos of the world. However, their tranquility is disrupted when Liz is kidnapped by a group of Russian mercenaries led by Viktor Kuznetsov (Stephen Lang).

Viktor is a ruthless and cunning adversary who will stop at nothing to get what he wants. He demands that Jack's son, Josh (Garrett Hedlund), participate in a brutal fight tournament, where the winner gets to leave Russia unharmed. If Josh loses, his father will be killed.

Determined to save his family, Jack sets out on a perilous journey to rescue Josh and take down Viktor. He faces numerous challenges along the way, including treacherous terrain, hostile locals, and Viktor's henchmen. As he navigates through the wilderness, Jack must confront his own demons and use his combat skills to survive.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Jack has a personal vendetta against Viktor, who is responsible for the death of his brother in a previous mission. This motivation drives Jack's actions throughout the film, as he seeks revenge against those who have wronged him.

The action sequences in Braven are intense and well-choreographed, with Jason Momoa delivering impressive performances in hand-to-hand combat. The movie also features stunning cinematography, capturing the beauty of the Maine wilderness and the brutality of the fight scenes.

Ultimately, Jack faces off against Viktor in a thrilling showdown, where he must use all his skills and experience to emerge victorious. In the end, Jack rescues Josh and exacts his revenge on Viktor, bringing closure to the story.

Overall, Braven is a gripping action thriller that showcases Jason Momoa's physical prowess and acting abilities. While it may not be a complex or nuanced film, it delivers plenty of excitement and suspense, making it a great choice for fans of the genre.

overview: Lucy Hill is an ambitious up-and-coming executive living in Miami. She loves her shoes, she loves her cars and she loves climbing the corporate ladder. When she is offered a temporary assignment — in the middle of nowhere — to restructure a manufacturing plant, she jumps at the opportunity, knowing that a big promotion is close at hand. What begins as a straightforward assignment becomes a life-changing experience as Lucy discovers greater meaning in her life and, most unexpectedly, the man of her dreams.
tagline: She's an executive on the move. But her career is taking her a little farther than she expected.
title: New in Town
plot:
New in Town is a 2009 romantic comedy-drama directed by Jonas Elmer. It was shot in Winnipeg and Selkirk, Manitoba, as well as in Los Angeles and in South Beach, Miami.

Lucy Hill, an ambitious consultant who loves her upscale Miami life, is sent to New Ulm, Minnesota, to restructure a food plant where new automation will cut at least half of the staff. The frozen weather, slippery roads and small-town customs come as a shock. At a home-cooked dinner arranged by the plant's secretary Blanche, Lucy insults the guest of honor, Ted Mitchell, only to discover the next day that he leads the workers' union. She also offends Flo, a waitress at the local diner who turns out to be the former wife of Stu, the foreman she is expected to fire.

Lucy and the townspeople slowly warm to each other. Ted rescues her when she swerves to avoid a cow and gets stuck in the snow, and Lucy uses her sense of style to help Ted's 13-year-old daughter prepare for her first dance. Lucy and Ted admit their attraction and share a kiss. At a corporate meeting in Florida, however, Lucy is told to shut the plant down entirely, which would leave the whole town out of work. After Blanche finds a list of workers to be laid off and confronts her, Lucy admits the truth and begins rethinking her priorities.

Inspired by Blanche's homemade tapioca pudding, Lucy convinces the company to produce and sell it, reviving an old yogurt line and keeping the existing staff. The pudding is such a hit that the company again plans to close the plant, which is too small for national demand. Lucy instead brings together investors to buy the plant, with ownership gradually passing to the workers, and she becomes chief executive. When she announces the deal, Ted pledges the union's support and the two kiss as the employees cheer.

Renée Zellweger plays Lucy and Harry Connick Jr. plays Ted, with Siobhan Fallon Hogan as Blanche, J. K. Simmons as Stu and Frances Conroy as Trudy. Released on January 30, 2009, the film spent one week in the domestic top ten, at eighth place. It grossed $16.7 million in North America and $29 million worldwide against an $8 million budget. Critics were mostly negative. Rotten Tomatoes reported 28% approval and called the film clichéd and charmless, while Metacritic gave it a score of 29. The Daily Express found it predictable and uninspired, and Peter Bradshaw of The Guardian mocked Zellweger's simpering performance in a film slavishly following the feel-good romcom formula.

overview: The world is stunned when a group of time travelers arrive from the year 2051 to deliver an urgent message: Thirty years in the future, mankind is losing a global war against a deadly alien species. The only hope for survival is for soldiers and civilians from the present to be transported to the future and join the fight. Among those recruited is high school teacher and family man Dan Forester. Determined to save the world for his young daughter, Dan teams up with a brilliant scientist and his estranged father in a desperate quest to rewrite the fate of the planet.
tagline: The fight for tomorrow begins today.
title: The Tomorrow War
plot:
The Tomorrow War is a 2021 American military science-fiction action film directed by Chris McKay from a screenplay by Zach Dean, with Chris Pratt in the lead. Paramount Pictures originally planned a theatrical release, but because of the COVID-19 pandemic Amazon Studios acquired the film for around $200 million and released it worldwide on Prime Video on July 2, 2021, making it one of the most expensive films ever to debut on a streaming service.

In December 2022, biology teacher and former Green Beret Dan Forester has just been turned down for a research job when soldiers from 2051 step through a time portal onto the field of the televised World Cup final. They warn that humanity is close to extinction at the hands of alien invaders called Whitespikes. Present-day armies are sent forward in time, but fewer than a fifth survive, so a global draft follows. Dan is conscripted for a seven-day tour and fitted with a vambrace that will pull him back when it ends. He refuses help from his estranged father, James, to escape it, and realizes that the draftees are people known to have died before 2051. Dropped at the wrong coordinates high above Miami Beach, most recruits fall to their deaths, and the survivors recover research data from a dead laboratory team.

At a base in the Dominican Republic, Dan learns that the commander of the operation is his grown daughter, Colonel Muri Forester. Together they capture a rare female Whitespike and develop a toxin against it, but a huge swarm overruns their ocean platform. Before dying, Muri sends Dan back with the toxin. With the portal destroyed, Dan and his wife Emmy use volcanic ash found on a Whitespike claw to conclude that the creatures were already on Earth, buried in ice. James helps him lead a small team to Severnaya Zemlya in northern Russia, where they find a crashed alien ship whose dormant Whitespikes turn out to be bio-weapons. The team kills them, and Dan and James hunt down an escaped female, averting the war.

The supporting cast includes Yvonne Strahovski, J. K. Simmons, Betty Gilpin, Sam Richardson, Edwin Hodge and Ryan Kiera Armstrong. Reviews were mixed, praising the concept, action and performances of Pratt and Richardson while finding the execution derivative; Rotten Tomatoes gave it 52%. A limited theatrical run in China earned $19.2 million, and a sequel is in development.

overview: Born on a sharecropping plantation in Northern Florida, Ray Charles went blind at seven. Inspired by a fiercely independent mom who insisted he make his own way, He found his calling and his gift behind a piano keyboard. Touring across the Southern musical circuit, the soulful singer gained a reputation and then exploded with worldwide fame when he pioneered coupling gospel and country together.
tagline: The extraordinary life story of Ray Charles.
title: Ray
plot:
Ray is a 2004 American biographical drama film directed by Taylor Hackford, produced by Jerry Bruckheimer Films and Paramount Pictures, not Universal Pictures.

The main themes of Ray (2004) include:

1. The struggle for fame: The film explores the life of Ray Charles, an African-American musician who overcame poverty, racism, and personal struggles to become a legendary musician.
2. Redemption and forgiveness: Throughout the movie, Ray Charles grapples with his past mistakes and seeks redemption through music, love, and spirituality.
3. Identity and self-discovery: The film delves into Ray's journey of self-discovery, as he navigates his identity as a black man in America, struggling to find acceptance and belonging.
4. Love and relationships: The movie highlights the importance of love and relationships in Ray's life, particularly with his wife Della Bea Robinson (played by Jennifer Hudson) and his manager Albert King (played by John Turturro).
5. Overcoming adversity: Despite facing numerous challenges, including racism, addiction, and personal struggles, Ray Charles perseveres and finds success through his music.

The film features outstanding performances from Jamie Foxx as Ray Charles, who won the Academy Award for Best Actor for his portrayal of the legendary musician.

overview: A gritty crime saga which follows the lives of an elite unit of the LA County Sheriff's Dept. and the state's most successful bank robbery crew as the outlaws plan a seemingly impossible heist on the Federal Reserve Bank.
tagline: You're not the bad guys. We are.
title: Den of Thieves
plot:
Den of Thieves is a 2018 American crime thriller film directed by Christian Gudegast and written by Chris Bremner, Ted Griffin, and Christian Gudegast. The movie stars Gerard Butler, Pablo Schreiber, O'Shea Jackson Jr., and 50 Cent.

The story follows Nate Scott (Gerard Butler), a former Navy SEAL who has retired from his life of crime and is now working as a security consultant for the Los Angeles Police Department's (LAPD) Special Operations Division.
