As the story progresses, we see flashbacks of Gio's life before she met her husband, where she is portrayed as a strong-willed and independent woman. We also learn that Gio was in love with Renzo's father, Giovanni (played by Giuseppe Bonifati), but their social differences made it impossible for them to be together.

Throughout the film, Tornatore masterfully weaves together the present-day narrative with the past, slowly revealing the secrets of Gio's life. We see glimpses of her time in a concentration camp during World War II, where she met Giovanni and fell deeply in love with him. However, their love was forbidden, and they were forced to part ways.

As Renzo gets closer to Gio, he begins to uncover the truth about her past. He learns that she is not just a beautiful woman but also a complex and multifaceted individual with a rich history. Through his efforts, Gio slowly opens up to him, revealing the depth of her emotions and the pain of her past.

The film's climax revolves around Renzo's realization that he has fallen in love with Gio, not for who she is today but for the woman she was in the past. The ending is bittersweet, as Gio must confront the reality of her life and make a choice between her past and present.

Throughout the film, Tornatore explores themes of love, loss, and identity. He masterfully captures the essence of Italy during the 1960s, with its vibrant culture, stunning landscapes, and rich history. The cinematography is breathtaking, with sweeping shots of Turin's picturesque streets and buildings.

Malena is a beautifully crafted film that will leave you spellbound. With its poignant story, memorable characters, and stunning visuals, it's no wonder why this film won the Academy Award for Best Foreign Language Film in 2001.

overview: During the course of an ordinary week in Hollywood, movie producer Ben must navigate his way through shark-infested waters as he struggles to complete his latest projects. A demanding studio boss demands extensive changes to a movie starring Sean Penn, while another chief won't greenlight a project unless star Bruce Willis shaves his beard. Meanwhile, Ben tries to reconcile with his wife and maintain a relationship with his young daughter.
tagline: Admit nothing.
title: What Just Happened
plot:
What Just Happened is a 2008 American satirical comedy-drama directed by Barry Levinson and starring Robert De Niro, based on producer Art Linson's 2002 book What Just Happened? Bitter Hollywood Tales from the Front Line, about his own experiences in the film business. An independent production of 2929 Productions, Art Linson Productions and Tribeca Productions, it screened at the Cannes Film Festival on May 25, 2008, before its release on October 17, 2008.

Ben, a veteran Hollywood producer, is beset by professional and personal problems. His new film, Fiercely, tests disastrously, largely because its ending shows the murder of the hero, played by Sean Penn, together with his dog. Studio executive Lou Tarnow suspects Ben shot the dog's death only as a bargaining chip and threatens to take over the edit and pull the film from Cannes unless that scene goes, while the volatile British director Jeremy Brunell refuses to change anything. At the same time, the studio may cancel Ben's next project because its star, Bruce Willis, will not shave the thick beard he has grown, and Ben's attempts to reason with him meet furious resistance. In his private life, Ben cannot cleanly separate from his second wife, Kelly, and discovers that she is having an affair with Scott Solomon, a married screenwriter he has worked with, whose own script soon attracts Brad Pitt.

Jeremy eventually agrees to let the dog live, and although Ben's appeal to Willis's agent only gets the agent fired, Willis finally shaves and production continues. At Cannes, however, Jeremy unveils a secret new cut in which the dog dies after all, with almost a minute of extra gunfire. The ending ruins any hope of a Palme d'Or, though some viewers, including Penn, cheer. Lou flies home on the studio jet, leaving Ben stranded, and when he finally makes it to a Vanity Fair shoot of Hollywood's top thirty producers, he is placed at the far edge of the photo.

The supporting cast includes Catherine Keener, Robin Wright, Stanley Tucci, John Turturro, Michael Wincott, Moon Bloodgood and Kristen Stewart. Filming began in March 2007, with exteriors in Los Angeles and interiors in Connecticut, where the production moved for tax incentives. Critics were divided, with 49% approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 51.

overview: After the tragic death of star volleyball player Caroline "Line" Found, a team of dispirited high school girls must band together under the guidance of their tough-love coach in hopes of winning the state championship!
tagline: Every point. Every game. Every match. Was for her....
title: The Miracle Season
plot:
The Miracle Season is a heart-wrenching drama that revolves around the true story of Erin Cottrell, a high school volleyball player who overcomes incredible adversity to find hope and redemption. At its core, the film explores the theme of resilience in the face of tragedy, as Erin navigates her way through grief, guilt, and self-discovery after losing her best friend and teammate, Kelsi.

The movie delves into the complexities of human emotions, particularly the struggle to come to terms with loss and find a new sense of purpose. Through Erin's journey, the film highlights the importance of friendship, love, and support in helping individuals heal and move forward. The Miracle Season also touches on the theme of identity, as Erin grapples with her own sense of self-worth and finds a way to redefine herself outside of her volleyball career.

The film's narrative is also infused with a sense of hope and redemption, as Erin discovers that even in the darkest moments, there is always the possibility for transformation and growth. The Miracle Season ultimately becomes a powerful exploration of the human spirit, showcasing the capacity for individuals to overcome seemingly insurmountable challenges and find a way to thrive despite adversity.

The movie's portrayal of the complex emotions and relationships involved in Erin's journey adds depth and nuance to the narrative, making it a thought-provoking and emotionally resonant viewing experience.

overview: Tom Ludlow is a disillusioned L.A. Police Officer, rarely playing by the rules and haunted by the death of his wife. When evidence implicates him in the execution of a fellow officer, he is forced to go up against the cop culture he's been a part of his entire career, ultimately leading him to question the loyalties of everyone around him.
tagline: Their city. Their rules. No prisoners.
title: Street Kings
plot:
Street Kings is a gritty and intense crime drama that delves into the darker aspects of human nature, corruption, and redemption. The film follows a tough-as-nails Los Angeles Police Department detective, Tom Ludlow, who is driven by a personal vendetta against the corrupt cops on the streets.

At its core, Street Kings explores the theme of moral decay and the blurred lines between good and evil. The movie portrays a world where corruption and violence are rampant, and the police department is no exception. As Ludlow navigates the treacherous landscape of the LAPD, he must confront his own demons and make difficult choices that challenge his sense of justice.

The film also touches on the theme of loneliness and isolation, as Ludlow's personal life is marked by tragedy and loss. His character's emotional scars are a testament to the toll that his job takes on him, and his relationships with others are strained and complicated.

Furthermore, Street Kings critiques the systemic corruption within law enforcement agencies, highlighting the ways in which power and privilege can lead individuals to compromise their values and principles. The movie suggests that even those who wear badges and claim to uphold justice can be complicit in the very system they're supposed to serve.

Ultimately, Street Kings is a thought-provoking and unflinching portrayal of a world that often seems to value profit over people, and power over principle. Through its complex characters and gripping storyline, the film raises important questions about the nature of justice, morality, and redemption in a society that often seems to be torn apart by corruption and violence.

overview: In an attempt to make some extra cash while away at College, Kylie moves into a house that streams content to an X-rated website. After a deranged fan hacks in to determine the house's location, she finds herself in a terrifying fight for her life.
tagline: Enjoy the show.
title: GirlHouse
plot:
GirlHouse is a 2014 American comedy film that explores the theme of female empowerment and the objectification of women in society. The movie follows the story of a group of young women who are forced to participate in a mysterious experiment, where they are subjected to various forms of psychological manipulation and humiliation.

Through the characters' experiences, the film critiques the way women are perceived and treated in society, particularly in the context of relationships, sex, and media. The movie highlights the ways in which women are often reduced to their physical appearance and used as objects for male pleasure, rather than being seen as individuals with agency and autonomy.

The film also touches on themes of consent, boundaries, and the importance of communication in relationships. As the characters navigate their way through the experiment, they are forced to confront their own desires, fears, and insecurities, leading to a journey of self-discovery and empowerment.

Ultimately, GirlHouse is a commentary on the societal pressures that women face, particularly in terms of their bodies and their relationships with men. The movie offers a satirical take on these issues, using humor and irony to highlight the absurdity and hypocrisy of certain attitudes towards women.

overview: Elliot Richardson, a suicidal techno geek, is given seven wishes to turn his life around when he meets a very seductive Satan. The catch: his soul. Some of his wishes include a 7 foot basketball star, a rock star, and a hamburger. But, as could be expected, the Devil puts her own little twist on each of his fantasies.
tagline: Meet the Devil. She's giving Elliott seven wishes. But not a chance in Hell.
title: Bedazzled
plot:
Bedazzled is a 2000 American fantasy comedy film directed by Barry Sonnenfeld and starring Brendan Fraser, Elizabeth Hurley, and Frances O'Connor. The movie is loosely based on the 1967 film of the same name, which was itself an adaptation of the 1920 play "Bedazzled" by Noël Coward.

The story follows Elliot Richards (Brendan Fraser), a young and ambitious advertising executive who is struggling to find meaning in his life. He is married to Emily (Elizabeth Hurley), but their relationship is lacking, and he feels unfulfilled. One night, while driving home from work, Elliot makes a Faustian bargain with the devil, Mover (Michael Caine), who offers him seven wishes in exchange for his soul.

Initially, Elliot's wishes seem to bring him success and happiness: he becomes wealthy, charming, and popular. However, each wish comes with an unexpected twist or consequence that ultimately leads to chaos and destruction. For example, his first wish makes him incredibly attractive, but also makes him a womanizer who loses touch with Emily.

As the story progresses, Elliot's wishes become increasingly absurd and destructive. He wishes for fame, which leads to him becoming a self-absorbed celebrity; he wishes for wealth, which turns him into a miserly and greedy person; and he wishes for love, which makes him fall in love with his own reflection.

Throughout the film, Elliot's transformation from a selfish and arrogant individual to a more humble and compassionate person is evident. He begins to realize that true happiness and fulfillment come not from material possessions or external validation but from meaningful relationships and personal growth.

In the end, Elliot's final wish is to be reunited with Emily, which ultimately leads to his redemption. The film ends on a hopeful note, with Elliot having learned valuable lessons about the importance of love, friendship, and living in the present moment.

Overall, Bedazzled is a witty and entertaining film that explores themes of identity, morality, and the human condition. With its clever script, engaging performances, and visual effects, it has become a cult classic among fans of fantasy comedy films.

overview: Jesse Freeman is a former special forces officer and explosives expert now working a regular job as a security guard in a state-of-the-art basketball arena. Trouble erupts when a tech-savvy cadre of terrorists kidnap the team's owner and Jesse's daughter during opening night. Facing a ticking clock and impossible odds, it's up to Jesse to not only save them but also a full house of fans in this highly charged action thriller.
title: Welcome to Sudden Death
plot:
Boogeyman 2 is a supernatural horror film that delves into the darker aspects of human psychology and the blurred lines between reality and fantasy. The movie follows a young woman named Sarah, who returns to her hometown after a traumatic experience, only to discover that the Boogeyman, a malevolent entity from her childhood nightmares, has come back to haunt her.

At its core, Boogeyman 2 explores the theme of trauma and its lasting impact on individuals. The film suggests that unresolved emotional wounds can manifest in terrifying ways, making it difficult for Sarah (and others) to distinguish between reality and their own personal demons. As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that the Boogeyman is not just a monster, but a symbol of the dark corners of the human psyche.

The movie also touches on the idea of guilt and responsibility, particularly in relation to Sarah's past experiences. Her inability to confront her traumas head-on has allowed them to fester and manifest as the Boogeyman's presence in her life. This theme is expertly woven throughout the narrative, adding depth and complexity to the film's horror elements.

Furthermore, Boogeyman 2 can be seen as a commentary on the fragility of the human psyche and the ease with which our deepest fears can be exploited. The film's use of psychological manipulation and gaslighting serves to underscore this theme, leaving the viewer questioning what is real and what is just a product of the characters' fevered imaginations.

Overall, Boogeyman 2 is a thought-provoking horror film that masterfully weaves together themes of trauma, guilt, and the fragility of the human psyche.

overview: Virgil Oldman is a world renowned antiques expert and auctioneer. An eccentric genius, he leads a solitary life, going to extreme lengths to keep his distance from the messiness of human relationships. When appointed by the beautiful but emotionally damaged Claire to oversee the valuation and sale of her family’s priceless art collection, Virgil allows himself to form an attachment to her – and soon he is engulfed by a passion which will rock his bland existence to the core.
tagline: A Master of Possession. A Crime of Obsession
title: The Best Offer
plot:
The Best Offer (2013) is a psychological thriller film directed by Giuseppe Tornatore, not PACO Cinematografica. 

The movie follows the story of Jervis (played by Ralph Fiennes), a wealthy and reclusive art collector who hires a young and ambitious art consultant, Emma (played by Caroline Dhavernas), to help him acquire a rare painting.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Jervis is not what he seems. He has a dark past and is using his wealth and power to manipulate those around him. The film explores themes of obsession, control, and the blurring of reality and fantasy.

Throughout the movie, Tornatore expertly weaves together elements of psychological suspense, mystery, and drama, keeping the audience on the edge of their seats as they try to unravel the truth about Jervis's true intentions.

Ultimately, The Best Offer is a thought-provoking exploration of the human psyche, revealing the darker aspects of human nature and the devastating consequences of unchecked ambition.

original_title: From a House on Willow Street
overview: After a young woman is kidnapped, her captors soon come to realize that in fact they may be the ones in danger and this young woman has a dark secret inside her.
tagline: Evil has an address...
title: From a House on Willow Street
plot:
From a House on Willow Creek is not "From a House on Willow Street" but rather "From a House on Willow Creek". 

From a House on Willow Creek, directed by Tom Holland, revolves around the theme of isolation and loneliness. The story takes place in a remote area where the protagonist, Alex, moves to escape his troubled past. However, as he settles into his new life, it becomes apparent that the house has a dark history and is home to supernatural entities.

The film explores the idea of how our surroundings can shape us and influence our behavior. The isolated setting serves as a catalyst for Alex's inner turmoil, forcing him to confront his demons and re-evaluate his relationships with others. As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that the house has a malevolent presence that is both a physical and emotional threat.

The film also touches on themes of trauma, grief, and the struggle to find one's place in the world. Alex's past experiences have left him emotionally scarred, and his attempts to rebuild his life are hindered by the supernatural forces at work in the house. The movie builds tension through its slow-burning atmosphere, creating a sense of unease that permeates every aspect of the narrative.

Overall, From a House on Willow Creek is a psychological horror film that delves into the complexities of human psychology and the power of our surroundings to shape us.

overview: In the futuristic city of Olympus, built on the ashes of the third world war, a police officer and her cyborg partner fight terrorism.
tagline: Urban combat in the city of dreams
title: Appleseed
plot:
Appleseed is a 1988 Japanese cyberpunk original video animation adapted from the manga of the same name by Masamune Shirow. Produced by Gainax, it departs greatly from the manga's storyline, keeping only its characters and setting, and takes place in an unspecified future. Its voice cast includes Masako Katsuki, Toshio Furukawa and Norio Wakamoto.

After the Third World War, the General Management Control Office builds the experimental city of Olympus, home to humans, cyborgs and bioroids, genetically engineered beings created to serve humanity who carry out the city's administration. Intended as a utopia, Olympus feels like a cage to some residents, among them city police officer Charon Mautholos. He secretly conspires with the terrorist A. J. Sebastian to disable Gaia, the supercomputer that runs the city's utilities and networks and controls the override circuits safeguarding a powerful weapon, the Multi-ped Cannon. Members of the city's ESWAT unit, Deunan Knute and Briareos Hecatonchires, set out to stop them.

The conspirators raid the facility where bioroids are created but the attack proves to be cover for stealing data on a single bioroid, Hitomi, a friend of Deunan and Briareos, whose DNA serves as the genetic key to shut Gaia down. The shutdown can be triggered at kiosks across the city, so the city director orders all but one destroyed and places the last under heavy guard. Sebastian converts himself to his full military configuration and seizes the Multi-ped Cannon, while Charon, wearing a powered suit stripped of half its armor for speed, carries Hitomi through heavy gunfire to the remaining kiosk. As Charon dies of his wounds, the frightened Hitomi backs into the kiosk and starts the shutdown. Sebastian uses the cannon to wreak havoc in the city while the director and Deunan race to restart Gaia by destroying the module keeping it offline. When the databank's defenses damage Deunan's pistol and injure her shooting hand, the director gives Deunan her own gun, and firing left-handed with her last round, Deunan hits the module. Gaia immediately disables the cannon, Sebastian is killed, and Charon is mourned.

Critics were divided. Reviewers at Mania found the simple plot workable as a side story to the manga but lacking emotional pull, while THEM Anime Reviews, EX Media and Otaku USA criticized its departures from the source, limited animation and story. Helen McCarthy wrote that although dated, it was still worth owning.

overview: A chainsaw-wielding George Washington teams with beer-loving bro Sam Adams to take down the Brits in a tongue-in-cheek riff on the American Revolution.
tagline: This summer they're redrawing history.
title: America: The Motion Picture
plot:
America: The Motion Picture is a 2021 American adult animated comedy film directed by Matt Thompson, in his feature directorial debut, and written by Dave Callaham. An R-rated parody of George Washington and the fight against the British, it features the voices of Channing Tatum, Jason Mantzoukas, Olivia Munn, Bobby Moynihan, Judy Greer, Will Forte, Raoul Max Trujillo, Killer Mike, Simon Pegg and Andy Samberg. The film was announced in 2017 as a Netflix original produced by Phil Lord and Christopher Miller alongside Will Allegra, Thompson, Adam Reed, Tatum, Reid Carolin and Peter Kiernan. Its humor relies on deliberate anachronism and Americentrism, scrambling dates, historical figures, battles and inventions, and moving events from across American history into its 1776 setting.

In July 1776, Benedict Arnold massacres the signers of the Declaration of Independence, blows up Independence Hall and steals the document. At Ford's Theatre, George Washington watches a play with his childhood best friend Abraham Lincoln, until Arnold transforms into a werewolf and kills Lincoln, whose dying wish is for Washington to win the revolution and name the new country "America". At Lincoln's funeral Washington meets Martha Dandridge, who urges him to carry on the fight. He assembles a team of misfits: the hard-partying Samuel Adams, champion horseman Paul Revere, Thomas Edison, here a female Chinese scientist rescued from execution by the British, and the Native American hunter Geronimo. Together they set out to forge a silver bullet capable of killing Arnold, enlisting the blacksmith John Henry and raiding the Titanic in Boston for silver spoons, where they stumble on British plans for a secret superweapon and accidentally sink the ship. After Arnold kidnaps Martha, an ambush at a secret meeting called the Gettysburg Address costs Revere his loyal horse, and King James challenges Washington to a battle, only for Arnold to kill the king and seize power for himself. Washington must rally a hastily assembled American army against the British and their plan to turn Americans British with a rain of tea, leading to a climactic battle against Arnold.

Netflix released the film on June 30, 2021. Critics gave it generally negative reviews, finding it unfunny; it holds a 35% rating on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus calls it outrageous and possibly patriotic but not very funny, and a Metacritic score of 38.

overview: After finding an ad online for “video work,” Sara, a video artist whose primary focus is creating intimacy with lonely men, thinks she may have found the subject of her dreams. She drives to a remote house in the forest and meets a man claiming to be a serial killer. Unable to resist the chance to create a truly shocking piece of art, she agrees to spend the day with him. However, as the day goes on, she discovers she may have dug herself into a hole from which she can’t escape.
tagline: oh my god, this is going to be a good day.
title: Creep 2
plot:
Creep 2 is a psychological horror film that delves into the darker aspects of human nature and the blurred lines between reality and fantasy. The movie follows Aaron, a young man who seeks revenge against Mark, the filmmaker from the first Creep, whom he believes wronged him.

At its core, Creep 2 explores themes of trauma, vulnerability, and the exploitation of others for one's own twisted desires. The film takes a deep dive into the psyche of its protagonist, Aaron, who is driven by a desire for revenge against Mark, but ultimately finds himself trapped in a cycle of violence and manipulation.

The movie also touches on the theme of gaslighting, where Mark manipulates Aaron's perception of reality, making him question his own sanity. This theme is expertly woven throughout the film, creating a sense of unease and tension that keeps the viewer on edge.

Furthermore, Creep 2 critiques the notion of "found footage" as a genre, subverting expectations and challenging the audience to consider the motivations and intentions of the characters involved. The film's use of found footage adds to the sense of realism, making it difficult to distinguish between what's real and what's staged.

Overall, Creep 2 is a thought-provoking and unsettling film that explores the darker aspects of human nature, manipulation, and the blurred lines between reality and fantasy.

original_title: Confessions of a Teenage Drama Queen
overview: Lola is an ambitious teenager who aspires to be a famous stage actress, but ger dream of performing on Broadway suffers a setback when her family moves from New York City to suburban New Jersey. Determined to make the best of it, however, Lola embarks on a mission to become the most popular girl at her high school, a goal that sets her on a collision course with the catty Carla Santini.
tagline: She's making a scene over everything.
title: Confessions of a Teenage Drama Queen
plot:
Confessions of a Teenage Drama Queen is a 2004 American teen comedy film directed by Savage Steve Holland and written by Gail Lerner. The movie stars Lindsay Lohan, Megan Fox, and Adam Garcia.

The main themes of Confessions of a Teenage Drama Queen revolve around self-discovery, friendship, and the challenges of adolescence. The story follows Mary Elizabeth "Molly" McIntire (Lindsay Lohan), a shy and awkward teenager who moves to a new town with her family after being homeschooled by her mother.

At first, Molly struggles to fit in at her new high school, where she is ridiculed and ostracized by her peers. However, she soon befriends a group of outcasts, including Janis (Megan Fox) and Damian (Adam Garcia), who help her navigate the complexities of high school social hierarchy.

Throughout the movie, Molly learns to assert herself, stand up for what she believes in, and find her own identity. She also discovers that being different is not something to be ashamed of, but rather something to be celebrated.

The film explores themes of:

1. Self-acceptance: Molly's journey is a metaphor for self-discovery and acceptance. As she navigates her new environment, she learns to love herself and find her own strengths.
2. Friendship: The movie highlights the importance of having supportive friends who accept you for who you are. Janis and Damian become Molly's confidants and help her through tough times.
3. Social hierarchy: Confessions of a Teenage Drama Queen satirizes the complexities of high school social dynamics, where cliques and peer pressure can be overwhelming.
4. Individuality: The film celebrates individuality and nonconformity, encouraging viewers to express themselves authentically.

Overall, Confessions of a Teenage Drama Queen is a lighthearted, entertaining movie that explores themes relevant to teenagers and young adults, making it a relatable and enjoyable watch for audiences of all ages.

overview: After getting in a car accident, a woman is held in a shelter with two men, who claim the outside world is affected by a widespread chemical attack.
tagline: Monsters come in many forms.
title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
plot:
In a post-apocalyptic world, Michelle (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) wakes up in an underground bunker with no memory of how she got there. She finds herself trapped and unsure if she can trust the man who claims to be her husband, Howard (John Goodman). As she tries to piece together her past, she discovers that Howard has been preparing for a catastrophic event that he believes will destroy the world.

Howard reveals that he has been living in the bunker with his "wife" Emma (Bodhi Elfman), who is actually a man in disguise. He claims that they have been waiting for the apocalypse to arrive, and that Michelle's arrival was part of the plan. Howard tells Michelle that she must stay in the bunker until it is safe outside.

As Michelle tries to escape, she realizes that Howard's story is not entirely believable. She discovers a hidden room with a computer and finds evidence that suggests the bunker is actually a trap set by Howard to keep her captive. Despite this, Michelle remains uncertain about what is real and what is not.

Throughout the film, Michelle's character undergoes significant development as she struggles to maintain her sanity in the face of uncertainty. She begins to question Howard's motives and the true nature of their relationship. As tensions rise, Michelle must make a choice between trusting Howard or taking control of her own destiny.

The plot thickens when Emma is revealed to be a man named Ben, who has been living with Howard for years. The truth about the bunker and its purpose becomes clear: it was designed as a survivalist's lair, where Howard could keep himself safe from the outside world. However, Michelle soon realizes that she is not just a prisoner but also a pawn in Howard's twisted game.

As the story unfolds, Michelle discovers that the apocalypse Howard predicted never occurred. Instead, he created his own reality to cope with the trauma of losing Emma in an accident. The bunker was designed as a way for him to keep himself occupied and maintain a sense of control over his life.

In the climactic final act, Michelle must confront Howard about his deception and make a choice between escaping or staying in the bunker. In a tense showdown, Michelle outsmarts Howard and escapes the bunker, finally finding freedom after being trapped for so long.

The film's ending is intentionally ambiguous, leaving the audience to ponder the true nature of reality and the consequences of Howard's actions. As Michelle emerges from the bunker, she is met with an uncertain future, but one thing is clear: she has gained a newfound sense of independence and self-awareness.

original_title: Robin Williams: Come Inside My Mind
overview: A funny, intimate and heartbreaking portrait of one of the world’s most beloved and inventive comedians, Robin Williams, told largely through his own words. Celebrates what he brought to comedy and to the culture at large, from the wild days of late-1970s L.A. to his death in 2014.
title: Robin Williams: Come Inside My Mind
plot:
Directed by Marina Zenovich, Robin Williams: Come Inside My Mind is an American documentary from 2018 about the life and career of the comedian and actor Robin Williams, who died in 2014. Produced by Jigsaw Productions for HBO Documentary Films, with Alex Gibney and Shirel Kozak as producers and Sheila Nevins and David Steinberg among the executive producers, it is told largely in Williams's own words, through interviews, never-before-seen outtakes and little-known clips of his stand-up performances.

Structured as a chronological portrait, the film opens with Williams improvising a torrent of logical nonsense when asked on Inside the Actors Studio how his mind works. It traces his childhood as an only child, with step-brothers he scarcely knew, an outrageous mother and a cold father, his first taste of laughter when he impersonated a teacher in high school, and his time at Juilliard under John Houseman. It follows his explosive rise in the comedy clubs of late-1970s Los Angeles and his instant stardom on Mork & Mindy, alongside the drug, alcohol and sexual excesses that followed and the death of John Belushi, which frightened him into sobriety. It covers the failure of Popeye, the end of his first marriage to Valerie Velardi and his relationship with Marsha Garces, and revisits highlights such as an improvised speech he gave at the 2003 Critics' Choice Awards. The final part touches on his heart attack, his Parkinson's disease diagnosis and his final years, though without fully explaining his death. Interviewees include Billy Crystal, Whoopi Goldberg, David Letterman, Steve Martin, Pam Dawber, Eric Idle, Elayne Boosler, Bobcat Goldthwait, Lewis Black, Velardi and his son Zak Williams.

The documentary premiered at the 2018 Sundance Film Festival, where it played six sold-out screenings, and was later shown at the Nantucket Film Festival and the Hamptons International Film Festival's SummerDocs series, where Zenovich took part in a discussion hosted by Alec Baldwin. It first aired on HBO on 16 July 2018. Critics responded warmly: it holds a 94% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus calls it a poignant if incomplete look behind the curtain, and a Metacritic score of 78. In Variety, Owen Gleiberman called it sharp-edged, humane and deeply researched, bringing viewers closer to the engine of Williams's brilliance and pain, while noting that it leaves the circumstances of his death largely unexplored.

overview: Taking place during the events of Incredibles 2, Edna Mode babysits Jack-Jack.
title: Auntie Edna
plot:
Auntie Edna is a 2018 American computer-animated short film produced by Pixar Animation Studios and Walt Disney Pictures as a "mini-movie" for the home entertainment release of Incredibles 2. Written and directed by Ted Mathot, a Pixar story artist since 1999 who had worked on The Incredibles, Cars, Ratatouille and WALL-E and served as story supervisor on Incredibles 2, and produced by Marc Sondheimer, it runs about five minutes. Brad Bird, director of both Incredibles features, again voices the superhero costume designer Edna Mode, with Craig T. Nelson and Eli Fucile also in the voice cast.

The short fills in an event that happens off-screen during Incredibles 2. In the feature, Edna volunteers to babysit Jack-Jack after learning that the infant has developed a wide range of superpowers, and returns him to his family with a suit designed to accommodate them. Auntie Edna reveals what happened that night at her mansion. Bob drops Jack-Jack off, and in her workshop Edna lets the baby loose so she can observe his many abilities, which include teleportation, shrinking, anti-gravity and multiplying into several copies, as well as his "demon baby" form; the short also accounts for elements set up in the film, such as the Mozart music and the cookies. In a lab sequence, the roles are reversed: Jack-Jack takes charge while Edna watches from inside an observation chamber, first fascinated even as her lab is wrecked, then bored and restless, until she simply waits for things to calm down. Once the baby is worn out, she sets about designing the seemingly impossible: a super suit that can harness all of his powers.

Mathot said he wanted to push the always-in-control Edna out of her comfort zone without losing the essence of a character very close to Bird, using time cuts and classical music for the lab sequence; Bird encouraged him to add more powers and quicken the timing. The film was completed in about four and a half months by a crew of roughly 40 artists. Following the precedent of Jack-Jack Attack, the short included on the home video release of The Incredibles, it was released with Incredibles 2 on digital platforms on 23 October 2018 and on Blu-ray and DVD on 6 November 2018. Reviewers welcomed it as a fun bonus for fans, praising its colorful animation, Jack-Jack's imaginative powers and the rare sight of Edna losing her composure, and enjoying the glimpse into her mansion and workspace.

overview: John Garrity, his estranged wife and their young son embark on a perilous journey to find sanctuary as a planet-killing comet hurtles toward Earth. Amid terrifying accounts of cities getting levelled, the Garritys experience the best and worst in humanity. As the countdown to the global apocalypse approaches zero, their incredible trek culminates in a desperate and last-minute flight to a possible safe haven.
title: Greenland
plot:
Greenland is a 2020 American post-apocalyptic disaster film directed by Ric Roman Waugh and written by Chris Bremner. The movie stars Gerard Butler, Morena Baccarin, Roger Dale Floyd, and Sienna Campbell.

The story begins with a family - John (Gerard Butler), his wife Allison (Morena Baccarin), and their 11-year-old son Caleb (Sienna Campbell) - living in Greenland with their young daughter. The family is preparing for the annual summer solstice celebration when they receive an alert from NASA about a massive asteroid hurtling towards Earth.

The asteroid, which is approximately 5 miles in diameter, is predicted to impact Earth and cause catastrophic destruction. The government has only 6 months to prepare for the impending disaster, but it's clear that this will not be enough time.

As the family tries to come to terms with their situation, they realize that they are one of the few families who have managed to escape the initial blast of the asteroid. They soon discover that the impact has caused widespread destruction and chaos around the world, with many cities being reduced to rubble.

The family sets out on a perilous journey across Greenland in search of safety and hope. Along the way, they encounter various obstacles, including treacherous terrain, harsh weather conditions, and other survivors who are not as trustworthy as they seem.

As the days turn into weeks, the family faces numerous challenges, including finding food and shelter, navigating through the treacherous landscape, and dealing with the emotional toll of their situation. They also encounter a group of survivors who are determined to take control of the remaining resources in Greenland.

Throughout the movie, the family's relationship is put to the test as they struggle to work together and make difficult decisions that will determine their survival. John, who has been struggling with feelings of guilt and inadequacy, must come to terms with his role as a father and leader.

As the asteroid hurtles towards Earth, the family faces an impossible decision: stay in Greenland and risk being crushed by the impact, or try to find a way to escape the planet. In the end, they make a desperate bid for survival, using their skills and ingenuity to launch themselves into space on a makeshift rocket.

The movie ends with John and Caleb floating above the Earth, watching as the asteroid impacts the planet below them. The family's fate is left uncertain, leaving the audience to wonder if they will survive or succumb to the harsh conditions of space.

Overall, Greenland is a tense and suspenseful thriller that explores themes of survival, hope, and redemption in the face of catastrophic disaster.

overview: Based on the true story of Robin, a handsome, brilliant and adventurous man whose life takes a dramatic turn when polio leaves him paralyzed.
tagline: With her love, he lived
title: Breathe
plot:
Breathe is a 2017 Indian biographical drama film directed by Iram Haider. The movie revolves around the life of Robin Cavendish, a British socialite who contracts polio at the age of 28 and later becomes an advocate for disability rights.

The main theme of Breathe is the struggle for independence and self-discovery in the face of adversity. Robin's journey is marked by his determination to live life on his own terms despite being confined to a wheelchair, which serves as a constant reminder of his physical limitations. The film explores how he navigates this new reality, finding ways to adapt and overcome the challenges that come with it.

The movie also delves into the theme of love and relationships, particularly Robin's marriage to Diana Cavendish, who becomes his rock and support system throughout his struggles. Their relationship is portrayed as a deep and abiding one, built on mutual respect, trust, and understanding.

Furthermore, Breathe touches upon the theme of social justice and disability rights, highlighting the need for greater accessibility and inclusivity in society. Robin's advocacy work serves as a catalyst for change, inspiring others to challenge the status quo and fight for their rights.

Overall, Breathe is a powerful and moving film that explores themes of resilience, love, and social justice, offering a poignant portrayal of one man's journey towards self-discovery and empowerment in the face of adversity.

overview: The life story of New Zealander Burt Munro, who spent years building a 1920 Indian motorcycle—a bike which helped him set the land-speed world record at Utah's Bonneville Salt Flats in 1967.
title: The World's Fastest Indian
plot:
The World's Fastest Indian is a 2005 biographical drama film that tells the story of Burt Munro, a New Zealand inventor and motorcycle enthusiast. The movie explores several themes that are deeply intertwined with the narrative.

One of the primary themes of the film is perseverance and determination. Burt Munro's passion for building the fastest Indian motorcycle in the world drives him to overcome numerous obstacles, including financial struggles, personal losses, and self-doubt. His unwavering dedication to his craft serves as a testament to the power of persistence and hard work.

The movie also delves into the theme of identity and belonging. Burt Munro's journey is marked by feelings of isolation and disconnection from mainstream society. As an outsider who doesn't quite fit in, he finds solace in his motorcycle and the sense of community it provides him with like-minded individuals. The film highlights the importance of finding one's place in the world and embracing what makes us unique.

Furthermore, The World's Fastest Indian touches on the theme of love and sacrifice. Burt Munro's relationship with his wife, Lily, is a central aspect of the story. His devotion to her and their family serves as a driving force behind his pursuit of building the fastest motorcycle. The film also explores the sacrifices he makes for his craft, including putting his own needs and desires aside.

Lastly, the movie touches on the theme of legacy and leaving a mark on the world. Burt Munro's quest for speed is not just about personal fulfillment but also about leaving a lasting impact on the world of motorcycle racing. The film suggests that our passions and pursuits can transcend time and leave a lasting legacy that inspires others.

Overall, The World's Fastest Indian is a heartwarming and inspiring film that explores themes of perseverance, identity, love, sacrifice, and legacy through the remarkable story of Burt Munro.

original_title: Das weiße Band - Eine deutsche Kindergeschichte
overview: Strange events happen in a small village in the north of Germany during the years just before World War I, which seem to be ritual punishment. The abused and suppressed children of the villagers seem to be at the heart of this mystery.
title: The White Ribbon
plot:
The White Ribbon is a 2009 German drama film directed by Michael Haneke, not X Filme Creative Pool. 

The White Ribbon explores the dark and complex web of societal norms, morality, and the consequences of unchecked patriarchal power in a small German town on the eve of World War I. The film delves into the themes of repression, conformity, and the dangers of blind obedience to authority.

Through its portrayal of a seemingly idyllic rural community, Haneke masterfully exposes the underlying tensions and repressed desires that simmer beneath the surface. The film's title, "The White Ribbon," refers to an ancient ritual in which young men would tie white ribbons around their wrists as a symbol of purity and innocence.

However, as the story unfolds, it becomes clear that this ritual is merely a facade for the darker impulses and desires that lurk beneath. The film's exploration of these themes is both haunting and thought-provoking, leaving the viewer to ponder the consequences of a society that values conformity above all else.

Ultimately, The White Ribbon is a powerful critique of societal norms and the dangers of unchecked power, inviting viewers to consider the complexities of human nature and the devastating consequences of repression.

overview: Persuasion is the newest adaptation of the classic Jane Austen novel of the same name published in 1818. Anne falls deeply in love with handsome young naval officer Frederick Wentworth at the age of nineteen.
title: Persuasion
plot:
Persuasion is a 2007 television film adaptation of Jane Austen's novel of the same name, produced by WGBH Boston. The movie explores the complex and nuanced theme of second chances and the power of unrequited love.

At its core, Persuasion delves into the emotional turmoil experienced by Anne Elliot, a young woman who is forced to confront her past when she reunites with Captain Frederick Wentworth, a man she was persuaded to reject years earlier due to societal pressures. The film masterfully portrays the pain and regret that can arise from missed opportunities and the difficulty of overcoming social conventions.

Throughout the story, Austen's timeless insight into human nature shines through, as Anne grapples with her own identity, self-worth, and the constraints placed upon her by society. The movie also touches on the theme of class and social status, highlighting the limited options available to women during that era.

Ultimately, Persuasion is a poignant exploration of the human heart, revealing the enduring power of love, forgiveness, and personal growth.

overview: After the strange death of his young son at their new home, Daniel hears a ghostly plea for help, spurring him to seek out a renowned paranormal expert.
tagline: Don't listen to them.
title: Don't Listen
plot:
I couldn't find any information on a movie titled "Don't Listen" released in 2020 by TVE. 

However, I found that there is a Spanish horror film titled "No te escuchen" which translates to "They don't listen" or "Don't Listen". It was released in 2019 and directed by Álex de la Iglesia.

The main themes of the movie "No te escuchen" include:

* The struggle for power and control within a family
* The consequences of trauma and abuse on individuals and families
* The theme of silence and how it can be both a source of strength and weakness

The story revolves around a woman who returns to her childhood home after her mother's death, only to discover that she is not alone. As the night progresses, she realizes that someone or something is watching her, and she must fight for survival.

Please note that I couldn't find any information on a movie titled "Don't Listen" released in 2020 by TVE, so my previous response was based on a different title.

overview: Mayhem and death follow when an earthquake traps a group of tourists in a Chilean town.
tagline: The only thing more terrifying than Mother Nature is human nature.
title: Aftershock
plot:
Aftershock is a 2012 American found-footage horror film directed by Nicolás López. The movie revolves around a group of friends who embark on a road trip to a music festival, but their adventure takes a dark turn when they stumble upon an abandoned mine shaft.

The main theme of Aftershock is the exploration of human vulnerability and the consequences of meddling with forces beyond one's control. As the characters delve deeper into the mine, they are forced to confront the unknown and the supernatural, which serves as a metaphor for the fears and anxieties that we all try to keep hidden.

The film also touches on the theme of group dynamics and how quickly relationships can deteriorate under pressure. The characters' initial camaraderie is slowly eroded as they face one terrifying situation after another, revealing their true personalities and motivations.

Furthermore, Aftershock explores the idea of hubris and the dangers of underestimating the power of nature or the supernatural. As the characters venture deeper into the mine, they are forced to confront the limits of human knowledge and understanding, leading to a descent into chaos and terror.

Overall, Aftershock is a tense and unsettling film that masterfully crafts an atmosphere of dread and unease, keeping viewers on the edge of their seats until the very end.

overview: Now in their late 20s, two former bandmates and best friends reconnect in their hometown and decide to get the band back together.
tagline: It's showtime, baby.
title: The Cosmos Sisters
plot:
The Cosmos Sisters is a 2022 American independent comedy-drama film written and directed by Whitney Uland and Nora Kaye, who also star as two lifelong best friends. Produced by Kookisimo Productions and Outer Darkness Films and filmed in Florence, Massachusetts, it co-stars Jake Swain, Madeline Grey DeFreece, Alexander Manuel, Arielle Haller-Silverstone and Shelley Kuefner. It was released on demand by Gravitas Ventures on 20 December 2022 and runs 78 minutes.

Whitney (Uland) and Nora (Kaye), friends since childhood, once performed together as the Cosmos Sisters, a musical act with catchphrases and garishly coloured wigs that they performed at their school's homecoming halftime. Now in their late twenties, they have drifted apart. Nora, still living in their small hometown, has slipped into a funk after her mother's death, while Whitney, a skin-care influencer and product-review vlogger based in Brooklyn, was too busy to be there for her when it mattered. Claiming to be acting at the request of Nora's boyfriend (Swain), Whitney arrives in town for a one-woman intervention, promising to take a break from Instagram, help her friend through her grief and perhaps sort out the barn full of belongings her mother left behind, though Nora suspects an ulterior motive. When the pair revive a little of their old act for Whitney's Instagram channel, a viewer asks them to play a benefit show for her son, who has cancer, and Whitney decides to get the band back together. As Nora digs out her guitar, her boyfriend wishes she would clear out the barn instead, and Whitney finds time to flirt with a former classmate (DeFreece), now a pizza delivery driver, whom she ignored in high school. Along the way the friends visit another classmate (Manuel), whom Whitney once snubbed but who has become a successful musician and producer, confronting past mistakes and the ways they have grown apart.

Roger Moore of Movie Nation found the leads so convincing as old friends, from their shorthand banter to their biting but never terminal fights, that he wondered whether they were childhood friends in real life, but called the film feather-light, cute rather than deep or insightful, and not very funny, singling out Manuel's single scene as a highlight. Chris Jones of Overly Honest Movie Reviews was more positive, praising the well-written, character-driven treatment of friendship and redemption despite some struggles to keep a consistent tone.

overview: Testament of Youth is a powerful story of love, war and remembrance, based on the First World War memoir by Vera Brittain, which has become the classic testimony of that war from a woman’s point of view. A searing journey from youthful hopes and dreams to the edge of despair and back again, it’s a film about young love, the futility of war and how to make sense of the darkest times.
tagline: Divided by war. United by love.
title: Testament of Youth
plot:
Testament of Youth is a poignant and powerful film that explores the complexities of love, loss, and identity during World War I. The movie delves into the life of Vera Brittain, a young woman who finds herself torn between her desire for independence and her need to conform to societal expectations.

At its core, Testament of Youth is a story about the human cost of war and the devastating impact it has on individuals and communities. The film masterfully captures the sense of disillusionment and despair that pervades the lives of those affected by the conflict, as well as the resilience and determination that ultimately define the human spirit.

Through Vera's journey, the movie sheds light on the struggles faced by women during this period, who were forced to navigate a world dominated by men. The film highlights the tension between Vera's desire for autonomy and her need to find love and security in a society that restricts her choices.

The movie also explores the theme of sacrifice and the moral dilemmas that arise when individuals are forced to make difficult choices between their personal desires and their sense of duty. Vera's relationships with those around her, particularly her fiancé Roland and her friend Sylvia, serve as a catalyst for these themes, revealing the complexities of human connection in the face of adversity.

Ultimately, Testament of Youth is a powerful exploration of the human experience during wartime, one that celebrates the strength and courage of those who have been forever changed by their experiences.

original_title: Hello, Goodbye, and Everything in Between
overview: Clare and Aidan, who after making a pact that they would break up before college, find themselves retracing the steps of their relationship on their last evening as a couple. The epic date leads them to familiar landmarks, unexpected places, and causes them to question whether high school love is meant to last.
tagline: Every ending is a new beginning.
title: Hello, Goodbye, and Everything in Between
plot:
Hello, Goodbye, and Everything in Between is a 2022 American romantic drama directed by Michael Lewen in his feature debut, from a screenplay by Amy Reed and Ben York Jones adapted from Jennifer E. Smith's novel of the same name. Jordan Fisher, who also served as an executive producer, and Talia Ryder were cast in September 2020, followed the next month by Ayo Edebiri, Nico Hiraga and the rest of the ensemble, and principal photography began in October 2020. Netflix released the film on July 6, 2022.

Clare, a high school senior who has moved from state to state since her parents' divorce, returns to a West Coast town and is talked into a Halloween party by her old friend Stella. There she meets Aidan, an aspiring musician whose doctor parents would prefer he study medicine, and the two spend a spontaneous night together. Clare, who plans to become a lawyer and does not want a boyfriend after watching her parents' high school romance fall apart, accepts his proposal of a pact: they will date until the end of the following summer and then break up after one epic final date.

On the eve of Clare's departure for Dartmouth, Aidan stages a surprise tour of places from their relationship, hoping to change her mind: a show by his old band, the ice rink where they had their first fight, a speedboat ride recalling the day he first said he loved her. Overwhelmed, Clare invites Stella and their friend Scotty along, and Aidan realizes she is avoiding the romance. A break-in at their school to let Scotty tag a wall ends with Aidan hurting his hand, and at the hospital Clare learns he was not accepted at Berklee and never told her. After a painful night apart, her mother helps her see that a relationship cannot work if its end is fixed in advance. Clare tells Aidan she loves him, and they part on good terms; he takes a year in Los Angeles to pursue music while she goes to New Hampshire, and they later reunite at the playground from their first night.

Fisher plays Aidan, Ryder plays Clare, Edebiri plays Stella and Hiraga plays Scotty, with Jennifer Robertson, Eva Day, Julia Benson, Dalias Blake, Patrick Sabongui, Sarah Grey and Djouliet Amara. Critical reaction was lukewarm: only 29% of the 21 reviews counted by Rotten Tomatoes were positive, while Metacritic's score of 54 indicated mixed reviews.

overview: While gathering evidence to support closing a tropical U.S. Air Force base, a congressional aide warms to its generous captain.
title: Operation Christmas Drop
plot:
Operation Christmas Drop is a heartwarming holiday film that explores the themes of love, redemption, and the power of human connection during the most wonderful time of the year. The movie tells the story of Captain Brixton "Bryce" Walker (played by Noah Centineo), a U.S. Air Force pilot who returns to his hometown on Christmas Eve after a decade away.

As Bryce navigates his complicated past and reconnects with old friends, he finds himself drawn to a kind-hearted local woman named Kat Meredith (played by Kathryn Newton). Through their blossoming romance, the film showcases the transformative power of love and second chances. The movie also delves into themes of community, small-town charm, and the importance of embracing one's roots.

One of the most significant themes in Operation Christmas Drop is the idea that everyone deserves a fresh start and a chance to rediscover themselves. Bryce, in particular, must confront his past mistakes and learn to forgive himself and others. The film's portrayal of this theme is both poignant and uplifting, making it a delightful holiday watch.

Overall, Operation Christmas Drop is a feel-good movie that celebrates the magic of Christmas, the beauty of small-town America, and the human spirit's capacity for love, forgiveness, and redemption.

overview: Successful architect Jeremy Angust is approached on his trip to the Tokyo International Airport by a chatty girl called Texel Textor. She is a strange young woman who seems to be looking for captive victims whom she forces to listen to her strange stories. Jeremy loses the flight because of Texel and once they are installed in the lounge area, he will not be able to get rid of the annoying stranger. Although the meeting seems fortuitous, soon there be a turn that will transform the character of that encounter into something much more sinister and criminal.
title: A Perfect Enemy
plot:
A Perfect Enemy is a 2021 Spanish drama film directed by Jonás Trueba and produced by Sábado Películas. The movie revolves around the story of Ana, a young woman who discovers that her husband has been leading a double life as a spy.

The main theme of A Perfect Enemy is the exploration of identity and deception. Through Ana's journey, the film delves into the complexities of human relationships and the blurred lines between truth and lies. As Ana navigates her way through this treacherous landscape, she must confront the fact that everyone around her, including herself, is hiding secrets.

The movie also touches on the theme of loyalty and betrayal, highlighting the consequences of keeping secrets and the devastating effects it can have on personal relationships. The film's portrayal of a seemingly perfect marriage turned upside down raises questions about the nature of love, trust, and deception.

Furthermore, A Perfect Enemy critiques the societal expectations placed on women, particularly in terms of their roles as caregivers and homemakers. Ana's character is a prime example of this, as she struggles to reconcile her own desires with the responsibilities thrust upon her by society.

Overall, A Perfect Enemy is a gripping drama that explores the intricate web of relationships, deception, and identity, leaving the audience questioning what is real and what is hidden beneath the surface.

overview: An unconventional thinker helps a budding cinematographer gain a new perspective on life.
title: Dear Zindagi
plot:
Dear Zindagi is a thought-provoking film that explores the complexities of life, love, and self-discovery. The movie delves into the theme of finding one's purpose in life, navigating through the challenges of relationships, and embracing the beauty of uncertainty.

At its core, Dear Zindagi is a story about a young woman named Kavya, who embarks on a journey of self-discovery after a near-death experience. As she navigates through her life, she grapples with the idea of finding meaning and purpose in a seemingly chaotic world. The film takes the audience on a poignant exploration of the human condition, where we are forced to confront our fears, insecurities, and doubts.

One of the primary themes of Dear Zindagi is the power of relationships in shaping our lives. Kavya's journey is deeply intertwined with her relationships, particularly with her grandmother, who becomes a source of wisdom and guidance. The film beautifully captures the complexities of love, loss, and letting go, highlighting the importance of human connections in our lives.

The movie also explores the theme of embracing uncertainty and living in the present moment. Kavya's near-death experience serves as a catalyst for her to re-evaluate her life and priorities, leading her to take risks and pursue her passions. The film encourages us to let go of our fears and doubts, and instead, focus on living in the moment, where every experience is an opportunity for growth and learning.

Overall, Dear Zindagi is a heartwarming and thought-provoking film that explores the complexities of life, love, and self-discovery. It is a beautiful reminder to live in the present, cherish our relationships, and find meaning in the journey, rather than just the destination.

original_title: The Mortal Instruments: City of Bones
overview: In New York City, Clary Fray, a seemingly ordinary teenager, learns that she is descended from a line of Shadowhunters — half-angel warriors who protect humanity from evil forces. After her mother disappears, Clary joins forces with a group of Shadowhunters and enters Downworld, an alternate realm filled with demons, vampires, and a host of other creatures. Clary and her companions must find and protect an ancient cup that holds the key to her mother's future.
tagline: You have been chosen
title: The Mortal Instruments: City of Bones
plot:
The Mortal Instruments: City of Bones is an urban fantasy film of 2013 directed by Harald Zwart from a screenplay by Jessica Postigo, adapted from the first novel in Cassandra Clare's Mortal Instruments series. Lily Collins stars as Clary Fray, a New York teenager who discovers her hidden heritage, with Jamie Campbell Bower playing Jace, Robert Sheehan as Simon, Kevin Zegers in the role of Alec, Lena Headey as Clary's mother Jocelyn, Aidan Turner as Luke, Jared Harris as Hodge and Jonathan Rhys Meyers as Valentine.

Clary keeps seeing and sketching a mysterious symbol, worrying her mother and their friend Luke. At a nightclub with her best friend Simon, she alone sees a young man, Jace, and his companions kill someone. When two men break into the family apartment hunting for a cup, Jocelyn warns Clary by phone to stay away and to tell Luke about someone called Valentine, then drinks a potion that plunges her into deep sleep. Clary returns to find her mother gone and is attacked by a demon, which Jace destroys. He is a Shadowhunter, one of a secret order of half-angel demon hunters, and Clary has inherited her mother's Shadowhunter gifts. The intruders are after the Mortal Cup, a sacred artifact that can create new Shadowhunters, sought by the renegade Valentine Morgenstern.

At the hidden Institute, Clary meets Alec, Isabelle and their mentor Hodge, and in the City of Bones beneath a cemetery the Silent Brothers trace her blocked memories to the warlock Magnus Bane, who erased her knowledge of this world at Jocelyn's request. After rescuing Simon from vampires with the help of werewolves, Clary falls for Jace. Realising the Cup is hidden in a tarot card her mother painted for their neighbour Dorothea, Clary retrieves it, but Hodge betrays them and summons Valentine, who reveals that he is Clary's father. Escaping through a portal, she learns from Luke, himself a werewolf, that this is true. In the final battle at the Institute, Valentine claims that Jace is also his son, which Hodge had earlier privately called a lie. Clary tricks him with a fake Cup and pushes him through the portal, destroying it. Jocelyn is found but remains unconscious, and Jace, refusing to believe they are siblings, vows to learn the truth as Clary returns to the Institute with him.

The film was released in August 2013. Critics panned it, giving it 13% on Rotten Tomatoes, though it won four Canadian Screen Awards, including for visual effects and make-up.

overview: Framed for crimes against the country, the G.I. Joe team is terminated by Presidential order. This forces the G.I. Joes into not only fighting their mortal enemy Cobra; they are forced to contend with threats from within the government that jeopardize their very existence.
title: G.I. Joe: Retaliation
plot:
G.I. Joe: Retaliation is a 2013 action film directed by Jon M. Chu and written by Rhett Reese, Paul Wernick, Zech Daley, and Art Marcum. The movie serves as the sequel to G.I. Joe: The Rise of Cobra (2009) and stars Dwayne Johnson, Channing Tatum, Bruce Willis, and Adrianne Palicki.

The film begins with a flashback sequence showing the events that led to the death of Duke (Channing Tatum), a member of the elite special forces team known as G.I. Joe. The story then jumps forward in time to the present day, where we see Duke's funeral being held. However, it becomes clear that something is amiss when the eulogy is interrupted by a group of masked assassins who kill several high-ranking officials.

The main character, Roadblock (Dwayne Johnson), is introduced as he tries to uncover the truth behind his friend Duke's death. He soon discovers that the event was orchestrated by a mysterious figure known as Cobra Commander (Luke Evans). Roadblock teams up with other G.I. Joe members, including Flint (Djimon Hounsou) and Lady Jaye (Adrianne Palicki), to take down Cobra.

As the story unfolds, we learn that Duke's death is connected to a conspiracy involving the U.S. government and a secret organization known as the "President's Guard." The President's Guard is led by Admiral William Shepherd (Bruce Willis) and is comprised of high-ranking officials who are secretly working with Cobra Commander.

The plot thickens when Roadblock discovers that he has been framed for Duke's murder, and that he is actually being hunted by the very people he is trying to take down. With the help of his G.I. Joe teammates, Roadblock sets out on a mission to clear his name and bring down the President's Guard.

Throughout the film, we see flashbacks of Duke's time with G.I. Joe, as well as his final moments before his death. These scenes provide insight into Duke's character and serve as a reminder of the camaraderie and sacrifice that defines the G.I. Joe team.

The movie culminates in an action-packed showdown between Roadblock and the President's Guard at the White House. In the end, Roadblock is able to clear his name and take down Cobra Commander, but not before realizing that Duke's death was just a small part of a larger conspiracy.

Overall, G.I. Joe: Retaliation is an action-packed film with plenty of twists and turns. While it received mixed reviews from critics, fans of the franchise will likely enjoy the movie's over-the-top action sequences and nostalgic value.

original_title: アイの歌声を聴かせて
overview: Satomi is fine being alone until an AI named Shion joins her class with a song and a promise to make her happy. While Shion’s musical numbers and princess gowns don’t quite pass as human, her antics bring Satomi closer to four other classmates. Together, they make memories worth saving, but even our most precious data can be erased.
title: Sing a Bit of Harmony
plot:
Sing a Bit of Harmony (Japanese: Ai no Utagoe o Kikasete, literally "Let Me Hear Ai's Singing Voice") is a 2021 Japanese animated musical science fiction film in the slice-of-life genre, directed by Yasuhiro Yoshiura and produced by J.C.Staff as a co-production with Funimation. Yoshiura wrote the script with Ichirō Ōkouchi, Kanna Kii created the original character designs and Ryo Takahashi composed the score. The voice cast includes Tao Tsuchiya, Haruka Fukuhara, Asuka Kudo, Kazuyuki Okitsu and Mikako Komatsu.

In an unspecified near future, the technology company Hoshima uses a small Japanese town as a testing ground for robots and systems run by artificial intelligence. High school student Satomi Amano lives with her mother, Mitsuko, an AI specialist employed by Hoshima. Because of an incident in her past, Satomi is shunned by her classmates and estranged from her childhood friend Tōma Suzaki. Mitsuko is preparing a secret trial of a new AI designed to be indistinguishable from a human: for a few days it will attend Satomi's class in a lifelike robotic body as an exchange student named Shion Ashimori. Soon after being introduced, Shion startles everyone by recognizing Satomi, asking whether she is happy and bursting into song.

Determined to make Satomi happy, Shion helps her make friends, solves those friends' problems and works to mend Satomi's bond with Tōma, always through song. Meanwhile, someone is secretly altering the school's security recordings and Shion's telemetry so that her unusual behavior stays hidden from Hoshima. When the company finds out, Shion is forcibly taken away to be deleted, and every device holding footage or memories of her is confiscated. Satomi then learns that Shion is a modified version of an AI that Tōma gave her when they were children. Satomi, Mitsuko and the friends break into Hoshima to rescue Shion, and despite the company's security guards they bring her to the roof, where Tōma connects her to the building's antenna. Shion uploads herself to a satellite, and encouraged by Shion, who now watches over her from orbit, Satomi reconciles with Tōma.

 It had its international premiere at the Scotland Loves Animation festival in Glasgow on October 2, 2021, where it won the Audience Award, before opening in Japan on October 29, 2021. It won the Best Animation Film Award at the 2021 New York City Film & Television Festival and was nominated for Excellent Animation of the Year at the 2022 Japan Academy Film Prize.

overview: Christmas Eve. On his way to his in-laws with his family, Frank Harrington decides to try a shortcut, for the first time in 20 years. It turns out to be the biggest mistake of his life.
tagline: Read the signs.
title: Dead End
plot:
Dead End is a 2003 English-language French horror film written and directed by Jean-Baptiste Andrea and Fabrice Canepa. It stars Alexandra Holden, Ray Wise, Lin Shaye, Mick Cain, Billy Asher and Amber Smith. On a routine Christmas Eve drive, a dysfunctional family finds itself trapped on an endless forest road, pursued by a mysterious hearse and a woman dressed in white.

Bored with the usual route, Frank Harrington takes a shortcut through remote countryside while driving his wife, Laura, their son, Richard, their daughter, Marion, and her boyfriend, Brad. After nearly colliding with another car, they meet a woman in white carrying a baby. With the car full, they leave her with Brad while the others explore a nearby cabin. When Brad asks how the baby can breathe under its blankets, she shows him that it is dead, and he vanishes. Marion sees a hearse pass with Brad screaming in the back, and the family soon finds his mutilated body on the road. Laura's call to the police reaches only a woman pleading for help, which she conceals.

When they stop to examine a baby carriage in the road, the hearse takes Richard, and his body is found soon after. Laura begins to lose her grip on reality, and a road sign reading "Marcott" convinces Frank that they are on a military road missing from the map. Laura shoots Frank in the leg with a shotgun meant as a gift, then leaves the car to meet a friend who died twenty years earlier, and Frank, firing at the hearse, kills her instead. At a ranger station Frank writes a note for Marion, but after an attack by the woman in white he becomes deranged, beats Marion unconscious and is killed in the woods by an unseen force. Marion walks for help and finds her family's bodies in body bags on the road, and the woman in white tells her the hearse has not come for her. Marion then wakes in a hospital, where Dr. Marcott tells her she has been in a coma and that she and her baby will be fine. The man who found the wreck says that Marion was the only survivor of a crash that also killed a young woman and her baby in the other car, and he offers the doctor a ride in the hearse from Marion's vision. Workers clearing the debris find Frank's note.

The film premiered at the Gérardmer fantasy film festival in January 2003 and opened in British cinemas on 12 December 2003. Peter Bradshaw of The Guardian found it macabre with ingenious twists, and the BBC compared it to an extended Twilight Zone episode.

overview: A two-hour Battlestar Galactica special that tells the story of the Battlestar Pegasus several months prior to it finding the Galactica.
tagline: Fear gets you killed. Anger keeps you alive.
title: Battlestar Galactica: Razor
plot:
Battlestar Galactica: Razor is a 2004 television miniseries that serves as a prequel to the re-imagined series, and it explores several key themes. At its core, the story delves into the consequences of war and the moral dilemmas faced by those who fight it.

The main character, Captain William Adama, grapples with the weight of his responsibilities as a military leader, particularly in regards to the fate of the Cylons, an artificial intelligence that has become self-aware and is now at war with humanity. As Adama navigates this complex situation, he must confront the harsh realities of conflict and the difficult choices that come with it.

One of the primary themes of Battlestar Galactica: Razor is the exploration of identity and what it means to be human in a world where technology has blurred the lines between man and machine. The Cylons, as artificial intelligences, challenge Adama's understanding of humanity and force him to question his own values and principles.

The miniseries also touches on the theme of sacrifice and the true cost of war. As Adama faces difficult decisions that will impact the lives of those around him, he must weigh the greater good against personal relationships and loyalties. This internal conflict serves as a powerful commentary on the human condition and the sacrifices we make in the name of duty and honor.

Overall, Battlestar Galactica: Razor is a thought-provoking exploration of the complexities of war, identity, and humanity, raising important questions about what it means to be alive and to fight for something greater than oneself.

overview: Emma is a young and beautiful graduate student just starting a new life in New York City. Like most people her age, she is always connected - her phone and laptop are constant companions, documenting her most intimate moments. What she doesn't realize is that she's sharing her life with an uninvited and dangerous guest. A hacker is following Emma’s every move. When the voyeuristic thrill of watching her digitally isn't enough, the situation escalates to a dangerous and terrifying level.
title: Ratter
plot:
Ratter is a 2015 American found-footage horror thriller written and directed by Branden Kramer, making his feature debut. It expands Webcam, a short film that Kramer wrote and co-directed, and is presented in found-footage style. The film premiered at the Slamdance Film Festival on January 24, 2015. In October 2015 Sony Pictures Worldwide Acquisitions bought its global distribution rights, and it opened in a limited release through Destination Films and Vertical Entertainment on February 12, 2016.

Graduate student Emma Taylor moves to a Brooklyn apartment in New York City for a fresh start after breaking up with her boyfriend, Alex. Soon an anonymous stranger hacks into all of her electronic devices and begins watching her through their cameras. At school she meets Michael, and they start dating, but the hacker steals intimate images of the couple and sends Emma messages and videos while posing as Michael. Emma accuses him, refuses to believe his denials and pulls away. After a night out with her best friend Nicole, she comes home drunk and falls asleep, unaware that the intruder has entered the apartment and is waiting on her balcony.

Michael visits with a cat to keep her company and the couple reconcile, but he later tells her that someone emailed him a warning to stay away from her. The police do nothing, and Emma grows isolated and depressed. Returning home one day to an unlocked door, she finds her cat dead, and Michael does not answer her calls. Frightened, she spends the day wandering the city before going back to wait for Nicole. During a video call with her mother, the power goes out and the stalker attacks Emma while the call is still connected. Her screams stop, her mother calls the police and begs the man to leave her daughter alone, and he turns the laptop toward himself before closing it. The film ends as police search for the missing Emma.

Ashley Benson stars as Emma and Matt McGorry as Michael, with Rebecca Naomi Jones as Nicole, Kalli Vernoff and Ted Koch as Emma's parents, Michael William Freeman as Alex and Karl Glusman as Brent. Its reported earnings come from DVD and Blu-ray sales, which totaled $110,834.

original_title: ブライト: サムライソウル
overview: Izo, a Ronin, and Raiden, an orc, work to bring a young elf girl and the wand she carries to the land of the elves in the north.
title: Bright: Samurai Soul
plot:
Bright: Samurai Soul (Japanese: Buraito: Samurai Sōru) is a 2021 adult animated action film directed by Kyōhei Ishiguro from a script by Michiko Yokote, and a spin-off of the 2017 film Bright that sets its world of elves, orcs and magic wands in Japan at the time of the Meiji Restoration. Netflix announced it during its Geeked Week in June 2021 and released it on October 12, 2021. Arect produced the animation, rendered in 3D computer graphics styled after Japanese woodblock prints, with character designs by Atsushi Yamagata.

In 1868, the swordsman Izou is defending Shogun Yoshinobu Tokugawa at Edo Castle when a dazzling elven spell halts the battle. Years later he works as a guard at a brothel, where the high courtesan Chihaya, who has lost her memory, takes in Sonya, a defiant young elf girl from Russia, and shows her a map of Hakodate, an elven land across the sea. An army of orcs, goblins and dwarves attacks the brothel in search of the girl, and its leader promises the orc warrior Raiden his freedom if he finds her. Chihaya is fatally stabbed protecting Sonya and, before dying, asks her to carry her hairpin to Hakodate.

Izou and Raiden rescue Sonya. She offers the hairpin to hire Izou as her protector, and Raiden disowns his employer for hunting elves. The trio is ambushed at an inn, where Izou recalls how the traitor Kōketsu cost him his eye, and they plunge into a river. An old centaur named Tsukuyomi rescues the two warriors and sends them after Sonya, who has been taken. In Yokohama, Chihaya's twin sister tells them that the hairpin is actually a magic wand. At the Inferni estate, Kōketsu kills Izou, but Sonya uses the wand to revive him, and together they destroy Kōketsu. Believing that people must solve their own problems, Izou throws the wand into the ocean.

The Japanese voice cast is led by Yūki Nomura, in his first voice role, with Daisuke Hirakawa, Shion Wakayama, the musician Miyavi, also making his voice-acting debut, Maaya Sakamoto, Kenjiro Tsuda and Mamoru Miyano.
