Simu Liu, Fred Mancuso and Yuzu Harada lead the English dub, which also features Keone Young and Paul Nakauchi. On Rotten Tomatoes, two of the five critics' reviews counted were positive, an approval rating of 40%.

overview: Maleficent and her goddaughter Aurora begin to question the complex family ties that bind them as they are pulled in different directions by impending nuptials, unexpected allies, and dark new forces at play.
tagline: Go beyond the fairy tale
title: Maleficent: Mistress of Evil
plot:
Maleficent: Mistress of Evil is a 2019 American dark fantasy film directed by Michelle MacLaren, written by Michelle MacLaren and Christina Hodson, and produced by Walt Disney Pictures. The film serves as a sequel to the 2014 film Maleficent.

The story begins with Princess Aurora (Ella Balinska) now a young woman, preparing for her wedding to Prince Philip (Benedict Walker). However, Maleficent (Angelina Jolie), who has been watching over Aurora from afar, senses that something is amiss. She discovers that the royal family's advisor, King Stefan (Harris Dickinson), plans to use dark magic to ensure his daughter's happiness and secure the throne.

Maleficent sets out to stop the wedding, knowing that it will lead to a catastrophic outcome for all of them. Along the way, she meets Morgan (Jemaine Clement), a powerful sorcerer who claims to be her long-lost brother. As they journey together, Maleficent learns more about her past and the reason behind her curse.

Meanwhile, Prince Philip's mother, Queen Grimhilde (Lesley Manville), is revealed to be the one responsible for casting the original curse on Aurora as a child. The queen's true intentions are to use Aurora's blood to gain ultimate power and control over the kingdom.

As Maleficent navigates her complicated past and confronts her enemies, she must also face her own morality and the consequences of her actions. Alongside Morgan, she forms an unlikely alliance with the fairy godmother, who helps them in their quest to stop the wedding and save Aurora from a terrible fate.

The film's climax features an epic battle between Maleficent and Queen Grimhilde, with the two powerful women engaging in a magical duel that will determine the future of the kingdom. In the end, Maleficent emerges victorious, but not without scars and a newfound understanding of her own strength and vulnerability.

Throughout the film, Angelina Jolie's performance as Maleficent is both captivating and nuanced, bringing depth to the character's complexities. The supporting cast delivers solid performances, particularly Ella Balinska as Aurora, who shines in her breakout role.

Overall, Maleficent: Mistress of Evil offers a thrilling and emotionally resonant sequel that expands on the original story while introducing new characters and themes. With its stunning visuals, engaging storyline, and strong performances, this film is sure to delight fans of fantasy and adventure movies alike.

overview: Laura Price is a successful San Francisco lawyer on the cusp of promotion – a far cry from her childhood growing up on a tropical island with best friends Chip and Gem. When the firm’s biggest client – Chip’s grandfather – asks Laura to travel to the island and deliver a contract to make Chip his heir, she leaves behind her practice and fiancé Owen to convince her childhood friend to sign a contract that will make him a billionaire.
tagline: Follow your heart... to find your calling.
title: This Little Love of Mine
plot:
This Little Love of Mine is a 2021 Australian romantic comedy film directed by Christine Luby from a screenplay by Georgia Harrison and produced by The Steve Jaggi Company. It stars Saskia Hampele and Liam McIntyre, with Lynn Gilmartin, Craig Horner, Lawrence Ola, Rajan Velu and Tiriel Mora in supporting roles. Although made in Australia with a largely Australian cast speaking in American accents, the film is set on a South Seas island and was shot in North Queensland. It was first released in April 2021 and arrived on Netflix in July 2021. The film runs 91 minutes.

Laura Price (Hampele) is a high-powered San Francisco corporate lawyer on the verge of being made partner and engaged to the equally ambitious Owen (Horner). She grew up on the tropical island of Sapphire Cove with her best friends Chip and Gem, but has not seen them in years. When her firm's biggest client, Chip's grandfather, a business mogul who must cede control of his company before his 85th birthday, asks her to travel back to the island and get Chip to sign a contract making him his heir and a billionaire, she leaves her practice and her fiancé behind. Chip (McIntyre), however, is happily living on island time as the barefoot captain of a charter boat and ferry and wants nothing to do with the responsibility. The workaholic lawyer and the laid-back islander clash, haggle and strike bargains, such as his offer to read one page of the contract for every fun activity she tries on the island, and between emails, video meetings, pressure from her boss and distracted calls from Owen, Laura finds herself horse riding and snorkelling, rediscovering the place where she grew up and her feelings for Chip.

Critics found the film pleasant to look at but generic. Roger Moore of Movie Nation complained that the decision to scrub every trace of Australia from the film had bleached out its local colour and any chance of drama or romantic friction, calling it so dull that it barely passed Hallmark Channel muster, with a generic plot, bland characters and sleep-inducing dialogue, though he credited the leads for mastering American accents. Jane Freebury of The Canberra Times gave it two stars out of five, writing that it lacked wit and a sense of place. Other reviewers enjoyed its tropical scenery, breezy pace and the chemistry between Hampele and McIntyre.

overview: Maggie is an uptight, single mother and college writing teacher from New York City. In an effort to reconnect with her troubled teen daughter Summer, she decides to embark on a journey to a Tuscan village where she frequented in her younger days. Upon arrival, Maggie runs into Luca a handsome former lover who is still a bachelor and lives with his eighty-year-old mother Carmen. Summer (missing her “bad boy” boyfriend in NYC) and Carmen (secretly planning a wedding against Luca’s wishes to MARCELINO, her one true love in Rome) impulsively steal Luca’s car and race off to Rome. Maggie and Luca quickly pursue allowing the two mismatched couples to spend some time together and develop a new understanding of each other.
tagline: Sometimes first love deserves a second chance...
title: All Roads Lead to Rome
plot:
All Roads Lead to Rome is a 2015 romantic comedy directed by Ella Lemhagen and written by Josh Appignanesi and Cindy Myers. Sarah Jessica Parker stars as Maggie Falk, an American journalist revisiting Italy with her rebellious teenage daughter, Summer (Rosie Day), alongside Raoul Bova as her former love, Luca, Claudia Cardinale as Luca's mother, Carmen, Paz Vega as Giulia, a television reporter and Luca's one-time love interest, Nadir Caselli as Luca's daughter, Valentina, and Marco Bonini as Inspector Moravia.

Maggie takes Summer to the Tuscan town where she spent part of her youth. There she runs into Luca, with whom she had a passionate romance decades earlier before she suddenly left for America and cut off all contact. Luca, who still has feelings for her, sets out to win her back. Summer, meanwhile, is desperate to return to the United States and to her selfish boyfriend, Tyler, who wants her to take the blame for a recent drug charge on the grounds that, as a minor, she would receive a lighter sentence. Luca's mother, Carmen, has her own plans: she has been exchanging love letters with Marcellino, her sweetheart from a 1960s pop band, and wants to marry him.

When Carmen and Summer steal Luca's car and race toward Rome, where Carmen and Marcellino have arranged a secret wedding in a church, chaos follows. Summer initially intends to catch a flight home from the Rome airport, but seeing Carmen's devotion makes her realize that Tyler is using her, and she unexpectedly falls for a farm girl, Ermenegilda. Maggie and Luca chase after them, bickering about their shared past along the way, and gradually rekindle their romance as they head for Rome.

Filming began in Rome on October 20, 2014. Marcellino is played by Shel Shapiro, who in real life was a member of the 1960s Italian pop group The Rokes, and Ermenegilda by Rocío Muñoz, the real-life partner of Bova. The film received a limited release in international markets, earning about $524,000, and Momentum Pictures released it on video on demand in North America in March 2016.

overview: Determined to keep Annabelle from wreaking more havoc, demonologists Ed and Lorraine Warren bring the possessed doll to the locked artifacts room in their home, placing her “safely” behind sacred glass and enlisting a priest’s holy blessing. But an unholy night of horror awaits as Annabelle awakens the evil spirits in the room, who all set their sights on a new target—the Warrens' ten-year-old daughter, Judy, and her friends.
tagline: Possess them all
title: Annabelle Comes Home
plot:
Annabelle Comes Home is a 2019 supernatural horror film directed by Gary Dauberman and written by Dauberman and Chris McGinnis. The movie serves as a sequel to the 2014 film Annabelle, which was part of The Conjuring Universe.

The story begins with the introduction of a young girl named Judy Warren (played by Ella Taylor), who is the daughter of paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren (played by Tony Curran and Vera Farmiga). The movie then flashes back to the 1970s, where we see a young Annabelle Higgins (played by MacKenzie Foy) living with her foster parents, John and Missy Higgins.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Annabelle is not just any ordinary doll. She was once a real person named Annabelle Higgins who died under mysterious circumstances. The doll was then taken in by the Warrens, who believed that she was possessed by the spirit of Annabelle.

The movie takes a dark turn when John and Missy are brutally murdered by a group of Satanic cultists. Ed and Lorraine find the doll in their home and take it with them on the road, where they use it to help them with their paranormal investigations.

As the story progresses, we see the Warrens' investigation into a series of mysterious events that seem to be connected to Annabelle. They soon discover that the cultists who killed John and Missy are still active and are seeking revenge against the Warrens.

The movie's climax features a terrifying confrontation between Ed, Lorraine, and their daughter Judy, as well as a group of Satanic cultists led by a mysterious figure known as "The Collector." The final showdown is intense and suspenseful, with many lives hanging in the balance.

Throughout the movie, there are several nods to the original Annabelle film, including a memorable scene where Ed and Lorraine first discover the doll's dark history. The movie also expands on the mythology of the Conjuring Universe, introducing new characters and plot twists that add depth to the franchise.

Overall, Annabelle Comes Home is a chilling horror film that delivers on its promise of scares and suspense. With its talented cast, clever plot twists, and terrifying villain, it's sure to leave fans of the genre sleeping with the lights on.

overview: A mysterious virus hits an isolated elementary school, transforming the kids into a feral swarm of mass savages. An unlikely hero must lead a motley band of teachers in the fight of their lives.
tagline: Please don't feed the children.
title: Cooties
plot:
Cooties is a dark comedy horror film that explores several themes that are both thought-provoking and unsettling. At its core, the movie delves into the idea of societal collapse and the breakdown of social norms in the face of chaos.

The film takes place in an elementary school where a mysterious virus causes children to become violent and aggressive, turning them into "cooties" that spread rapidly among the student body. As the situation spirals out of control, the adults are forced to confront their own vulnerabilities and weaknesses, revealing a deeper unease about their roles as caregivers and authority figures.

One of the primary themes of Cooties is the fear of losing control and the breakdown of social order. The film's portrayal of a school descending into chaos serves as a metaphor for the fragility of modern society, where even the most seemingly stable institutions can be brought to its knees by external forces.

The movie also explores the theme of toxic masculinity, particularly in the character of Duncan, who embodies a brand of aggressive, entitled masculinity that ultimately proves to be his downfall. As the situation escalates, Duncan's behavior becomes increasingly erratic and violent, highlighting the dangers of unchecked male aggression.

Furthermore, Cooties touches on the idea of the "other," particularly in the context of the virus, which serves as a symbol for the unknown and the uncontrollable. The film's portrayal of children as monstrous, zombie-like creatures taps into deep-seated fears about the vulnerability of our most innocent and defenseless members.

Overall, Cooties is a thought-provoking and unsettling film that explores themes of societal collapse, toxic masculinity, and the fear of the unknown, all set against a backdrop of chaos and horror.

overview: Emma left Russia to live with her husband in Italy. Now a member of a powerful industrial family, she is the respected mother of three, but feels unfulfilled. One day, Antonio, a talented chef and her son's friend, makes her senses kindle.
title: I Am Love
plot:
I Am Love is a 2009 Italian drama film directed by Luca Guadagnino. The movie revolves around the life of Edoardo Beretta, a wealthy and successful businessman who lives in Milan with his wife, Laura, and their two children.

The main theme of I Am Love is the exploration of identity, class, and social status through the lens of family dynamics and relationships. As Edoardo navigates his complicated marriage and struggles to connect with his children, he begins to question the superficiality of his wealthy lifestyle and the emptiness of his relationships.

One of the central themes of the film is the tension between tradition and modernity, as embodied by the Beretta family's old-money aristocracy and Edoardo's desire for something more authentic. This conflict is reflected in the character of Edoardo himself, who is torn between his loyalty to his family's values and his own sense of disconnection and disillusionment.

The film also explores the theme of love as a complex and multifaceted emotion that can be both redemptive and destructive. Through Edoardo's relationships with his wife, Laura, and his children, as well as his encounters with a young woman named Clara, Guadagnino reveals the ways in which love can both heal and harm us.

Ultimately, I Am Love is a nuanced and introspective exploration of the human condition, one that probes the complexities of family life, social status, and personal identity. Through its thoughtful pacing and richly drawn characters, the film offers a profound meditation on what it means to be alive and to love in a world marked by both beauty and ugliness.

overview: A fast food restaurant mini variant of Buzz forcibly switches places with the real Buzz and his friends have to deal with the obnoxious impostor.
title: Small Fry
plot:
Small Fry, released as Toy Story Toons: Small Fry, is a 2011 American animated short film written and directed by Angus MacLane. The second short in the Toy Story Toons series built around characters from the Toy Story features, it premiered in theaters alongside the feature film The Muppets on November 23, 2011.

At the Poultry Palace, a fast-food chicken restaurant, Bonnie is disappointed with the Zurg belt buckle that comes with her kids' meal and asks for a Mini Buzz Lightyear instead, but the remaining ones are only for display. Inside the display case, one Mini Buzz complains that they will never be played with, while a Mini Zurg is happy to stay put. When Bonnie plays in the ball pit with Rex and the real Buzz, whom she has brought along, Mini Buzz slips out of the case, drags Buzz under the balls and takes his place. Bonnie's mother packs up the toys without noticing the switch. Mini Buzz convinces Rex that the ball pit plastic shrank him, but the other toys at Bonnie's house see through the impostor at once.

Buzz climbs out of the pit to find the restaurant closed for the night. Looking for a way out, he stumbles into a storeroom where discarded fast-food toys hold a support group for abandoned toys led by a mermaid named Neptuna. Taking Buzz for another castaway, the group makes him join the meeting, but during a role-playing therapy exercise he befriends Gary Grappling Hook and uses him to escape. At home, the other toys interrogate Mini Buzz and plot a rescue mission, only for Buzz to walk in on his own and confront the little impostor. Mini Buzz later opens up at the support group with Buzz beside him as his sponsor, and in a post-credits scene Mini Zurg is delighted with the electronic belt buckle as his new companion.

Tim Allen voices Buzz and Teddy Newton voices Mini Buzz, with Tom Hanks, Joan Cusack, Don Rickles, Estelle Harris, Wallace Shawn, John Ratzenberger and Timothy Dalton voicing Bonnie's other toys and Emily Hahn as Bonnie. Jane Lynch voices Neptuna and MacLane voices several characters, including Gary Grappling Hook. The toys in the short include a Condorman figure, a nod to the 1981 Disney adventure comedy Condorman, which MacLane joked might stir up interest in a gritty reboot.

overview: For Nick, Kurt and Dale, the only thing that would make the daily grind more tolerable would be to grind their intolerable bosses into dust. Quitting is not an option, so, with the benefit of a few-too-many drinks and some dubious advice from a hustling ex-con, the three friends devise a convoluted and seemingly foolproof plan to rid themselves of their respective employers... permanently.
tagline: Ever wish your boss was dead?
title: Horrible Bosses
plot:
Horrible Bosses is a 2011 American black comedy film directed by Seth Gordon and written by Michael Markowitz, John Francis Daley, and Jonathan Goldstein. The movie stars Jason Bateman, Charlie Day, Jason Sudeikis, Jennifer Aniston, Colin Farrell, Jamie Foxx, and Kevin Spacey.

The story revolves around three friends, Nick Hendricks (Jason Bateman), Dale Arbus (Charlie Day), and Kurt Buckman (Jason Sudeikis), who are all fed up with their terrible bosses. Nick is a dentist whose boss, Dr. Julia Harris (Jennifer Aniston), constantly harasses him and makes unwanted advances. Dale is an assistant at a children's museum where his boss, Dave Harken (Kevin Spacey), is a sadistic and demanding man. Kurt is a marketing executive who has just been passed over for a promotion by his boss, Bobby Pellit (Colin Farrell).

One night, the three friends get drunk and fantasize about killing their bosses. The next morning, they wake up to find that their wives have discovered their plan and are now pressuring them to go through with it. Desperate and feeling trapped, Nick, Dale, and Kurt decide to take matters into their own hands.

The trio concocts a plan to murder their bosses, but things don't go as smoothly as they had hoped. They hire a hitman, Dean "MF" Jones (Jamie Foxx), who turns out to be a bit of an oddball. As the three friends try to navigate the complexities of murder and mayhem, they also have to deal with their own personal issues and relationships.

Throughout the movie, the characters' backstories are revealed through flashbacks, which add depth to their personalities and motivations. Nick is shown to be a responsible and caring husband who feels trapped in his mundane life. Dale is depicted as a childlike and insecure man who struggles to find his place in the world. Kurt is portrayed as a confident and successful executive who has lost touch with his own desires.

As the story unfolds, the three friends face various obstacles and setbacks, including a series of hilarious mishaps and unexpected twists. In the end, they must confront their own demons and make amends with each other and themselves.

The movie features a talented ensemble cast, witty dialogue, and plenty of humor, making it an entertaining and engaging watch. The film's climax is both shocking and satisfying, leaving the audience feeling relieved that the characters have finally found some closure.

Overall, Horrible Bosses is a dark comedy that explores themes of friendship, loyalty, and redemption. With its talented cast, clever writing, and hilarious performances, this movie is sure to leave viewers laughing and entertained.

overview: A girl wakes up in a huge secret laboratory, then accidentally meets another girl who is trying to protect her house from a gang. The mystery girl overthrows the gang with her unexpected powers, and laboratory staff set out to find her.
tagline: The beginning of everything.
title: The Witch: Part 2. The Other One
plot:
The Witch: Part 2. The Other One is a South Korean science fiction action horror film of 2022 written and directed by Park Hoon-jung, a sequel to his The Witch: Part 1. The Subversion (2018) with a largely new cast. Shin Si-ah stars as Ark 1, a girl who escapes from a secret laboratory, with Park Eun-bin as Kyung-hee, Sung Yoo-bin as her younger brother Dae-gil, Seo Eun-soo as the agent Jo-hyeon, Jin Goo as the gangster Yong-du, Jo Min-su as Dr Baek, Lee Jong-suk as the institute chief Jang and Kim Da-mi as Goo Ja-yoon, the witch of the first film.

Years earlier, a teenage girl riding a bus with a friend is gassed and abducted in a staged accident; Dr Baek and her twin tell her that the fraternal twins she is carrying will be of great importance. In the present, a girl known as Ark 1 slaughters every soldier and scientist at a hidden facility and flees into the forest, where she is snatched by henchmen of Yong-du, who are also holding Kyung-hee for refusing to sign over her house. Kyung-hee takes her in, has her uncle remove the experimental devices from her skin, and brings her home to live with Dae-gil. Jang, head of the institute, discusses the escape from its coastal base on Jeju Island with Dr Baek and sends a tactical team.

When Yong-du's gang threatens Kyung-hee for the deed to her late father's land, revealing that Yong-du murdered him, the girl overpowers them with brute strength and he flees. Baek gives the agent Jo-hyeon and her partner Tom a device to track Ark 1, and Jo-hyeon shows Kyung-hee footage of the massacre, asking for her help. Yong-du trades the girl's location to Jang's squad in return for a dose of their power. As the gang and the squad descend on the house, Kyung-hee is shot dead while buying time for the others, and Dae-gil is killed by Yong-du. The girl survives a rocket strike, breaks Yong-du's feet, and destroys one of the squad with telekinesis before Ja-yoon arrives, kills the last survivor and reveals that they are sisters. Needing the girl's stronger psychic bond to find their mother, she sedates her and drives away. Baek senses the danger the two now pose, and their mother is shown suspended in a vast tank, opening her eyes. A post-credits scene shows that Jo-hyeon and Tom survived and are joined by more witches to hunt the sisters.

Delayed by the COVID-19 pandemic, the film was released in June 2022 and drew over 2.8 million admissions, grossing about $23.4 million to rank seventh among Korean films that year.

overview: The government gets wind of a plot to destroy America involving a trio of nuclear weapons for which the whereabouts are unknown. It's up to a seasoned interrogator and an FBI agent to find out exactly where the nukes are.
tagline: Right and Wrong no longer exist
title: Unthinkable
plot:
Unthinkable is a 2010 American thriller film directed by Jesse Moss and written by Jesse Moss and John Cusack. The movie stars Samuel L. Jackson, Michael Emery, and Clancy Brown.

The main theme of Unthinkable revolves around the moral dilemmas faced by its protagonist, Will Lewis (played by Samuel L. Jackson), a former CIA operative who is forced to confront his own dark past when he is kidnapped and subjected to psychological manipulation by his captors.

As the story unfolds, Will is presented with an impossible choice: kill a group of innocent people or watch them die. The film expertly explores the complexities of human morality, highlighting the blurred lines between right and wrong, and the devastating consequences of making choices that go against one's values.

Throughout the movie, Will's character grapples with the weight of his past actions and the moral implications of his current situation. He is forced to confront the possibility that he may be capable of committing atrocities, which challenges his sense of identity and purpose.

The film also touches on themes of redemption, forgiveness, and the human capacity for empathy and compassion. Will's journey is a thought-provoking exploration of what it means to be human, and how our choices can shape us into the people we become.

Overall, Unthinkable is a gripping thriller that raises important questions about morality, free will, and the complexities of the human condition.

overview: A controlling father’s attempts to ensure that his two children succeed in high school backfire after his son experiences a career-ending sports injury. Their familial bonds are eventually placed under severe strain by an unexpected tragedy.
tagline: Love is patient.
title: Waves
plot:
Waves is actually produced by A24, not Bron Studios.

The film explores the complexities of family dynamics and the consequences of trauma on multiple generations. It delves into the theme of toxic masculinity, as embodied by the character of Tyler, who struggles with his own identity and sense of purpose. The movie also examines the destructive nature of privilege and entitlement, particularly through the lens of the character of Jack, whose life is marked by a series of poor choices and self-destructive tendencies.

Furthermore, Waves touches on the theme of generational trauma, highlighting how unresolved issues from one generation can have a profound impact on those that follow. The film's non-linear narrative structure adds to its emotional complexity, as it weaves together multiple storylines and timelines to create a rich tapestry of character development and exploration.

Ultimately, Waves is a powerful and thought-provoking film that challenges viewers to confront the darker aspects of human nature and the cyclical nature of trauma.

overview: As Constance (Natasha Richardson) and Nina (Toni Collette) gather at the deathbed of their mother, Ann (Vanessa Redgrave), they learn for the first time that their mother lived an entire other lifetime during one evening 50 years ago. In vivid flashbacks, the young Ann (Claire Daines) spends one night with a man named Harris (Patrick Wilson), who was the love of her life.
tagline: Her greatest secret was her greatest gift.
title: Evening
plot:
Evening is a 2007 American drama film directed by Lajos Koltai, with a screenplay by Susan Minot and Michael Cunningham based on Minot's 1998 novel of the same name. The ensemble cast includes Claire Danes as the young Ann, Toni Collette, Vanessa Redgrave, Patrick Wilson, Hugh Dancy and Mamie Gummer. The novel and original screenplay were set in Maine, but Koltai was so taken with a Newport house found by his location scouts that he moved the story to Rhode Island; filming began in September 2006, with locations in Tiverton, Bristol, Providence and Manhattan.

The film moves between the 1950s and the present, as Ann Grant Lord lies dying and reflects on her past, mentioning people her daughters Constance and Nina have never heard of and leaving them wondering whether she is delusional. In the 1950s, Ann, a young cabaret singer, arrives at the grand Newport home of her best friend Lila Wittenborn for Lila's wedding to Karl Ross. Lila's brother Buddy, Ann's college friend and a heavy drinker, introduces her to Harris Arden, a young doctor and the son of a former family servant, and confides that Lila has always adored Harris and may be marrying out of duty rather than love. Ann and Harris feel an instant connection. On the wedding day Lila admits that Harris rebuffed her, and she goes through with the marriage. At the reception Ann sings, joined by Harris, while the drunken Buddy confronts them and then unexpectedly kisses Harris. Later Buddy confesses that he has loved Ann for years. When he plays a frightening prank after diving from a clifftop into the sea, Ann angrily rejects him and slips away with Harris to his hideaway, where they make love. That night, searching for Ann, Buddy is struck by a car and killed, a tragedy that Ann and Harris learn of only the next morning. In the present, Lila visits Ann's bedside to reminisce, and the memories of that weekend help Ann offer her daughters, especially the uncertain Nina, guidance about love and the choices they face.

Evening grossed about $20 million worldwide. It received largely negative reviews, holding a 28% rating on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus calls it beautifully filmed but dull and a waste of a talented cast, though some critics praised the performances, particularly those of Danes and Gummer.

overview: An impromptu goodbye party for Professor John Oldman becomes a mysterious interrogation after the retiring scholar reveals to his colleagues he never ages and has walked the earth for 14,000 years.
tagline: From one of the acclaimed writers of Star Trek and The Twilight Zone comes a story that transcends both time and space...
title: The Man from Earth
plot:
The Man from Earth is a thought-provoking film that explores various philosophical and existential themes through its narrative. At its core, the movie delves into the human condition, questioning the nature of time, identity, and the consequences of one's actions.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that the protagonist, John Oldman, has lived an extraordinary life, accumulating vast knowledge and experiencing numerous historical events firsthand. This unique perspective allows him to offer insightful commentary on the human experience, highlighting both the beauty and the darkness of existence.

One of the primary themes of The Man from Earth is the concept of time and its relationship to human perception. Oldman's experiences span centuries, allowing him to witness the rise and fall of civilizations, the evolution of ideas, and the passage of time itself. Through his observations, he comes to understand that time is a fluid, subjective experience, shaped by individual perspectives and cultural contexts.

The film also explores the theme of identity and its fragility. As Oldman navigates different eras and personas, he grapples with the notion of selfhood, questioning whether it's possible for an individual to maintain a consistent sense of identity across multiple lives. This existential conundrum raises questions about the nature of personal continuity and the human desire for stability in an ever-changing world.

Furthermore, The Man from Earth touches on the consequences of one's actions, highlighting the importance of empathy, compassion, and responsibility. Oldman's experiences have taught him that even small actions can have far-reaching effects, leading to a deeper understanding of the interconnectedness of human experience.

Ultimately, the movie presents a nuanced exploration of the human condition, inviting viewers to reflect on their own place within the grand tapestry of time and existence. Through its thought-provoking narrative and Oldman's introspective commentary, The Man from Earth encourages us to consider the complexities of human nature and our shared experiences as individuals.

overview: The radical true story behind three teenage surfers from Venice Beach, California, who took skateboarding to the extreme and changed the world of sports forever. Stacy Peralta, Tony Alva and Jay Adams are the Z-Boys, a bunch of nobodies until they create a new style of skateboarding that becomes a worldwide phenomenon. But when their hobby becomes a business, the success shreds their friendship.
tagline: They came from nothing to change everything.
title: Lords of Dogtown
plot:
Lords of Dogtown is a 2005 biographical drama film that explores the lives of three young skateboarders who became legends in the sport: Jay Adams, Stacy Peralta, and Tony Alva. The movie delves into their struggles with fame, identity, and the darker side of their success.

At its core, Lords of Dogtown is a story about the fragility of youth and the consequences of chasing one's dreams. The film portrays the characters' tumultuous relationships, substance abuse, and the blurred lines between friendship and rivalry. As they navigate the cutthroat world of professional skateboarding, they must confront their own demons and learn to balance their passion for the sport with the harsh realities of adulthood.

The movie also touches on themes of rebellion and nonconformity, as the characters reject mainstream values and forge their own path in life. Through their experiences, the film highlights the tension between individuality and conformity, as they struggle to maintain their unique identities amidst the pressures of fame and success.

Ultimately, Lords of Dogtown is a poignant exploration of the human condition, capturing the essence of youthful rebellion, self-discovery, and the enduring power of friendship in the face of adversity.

overview: The story of Jody, a misguided, 20-year-old African-American who is really just a baby boy finally forced-kicking and screaming to face the commitments of real life. Streetwise and jobless, he has not only fathered two children by two different women-Yvette and Peanut but still lives with his own mother. He can't seem to strike a balance or find direction in his chaotic life.
tagline: Just a Baby Boy.
title: Baby Boy
plot:
Baby Boy is a 2001 American drama film directed by John Singleton, produced by Columbia Pictures, and written by John Singleton.

The movie follows the life of Tre Styles (played by Taraji P. Henson), a young African American woman who struggles with her identity, family dynamics, and relationships in Los Angeles during the 1970s. overview: Two years after the events of the Fourth Great Ninja War, the moon that Hagoromo Otsutsuki created long ago to seal away the Gedo Statue begins to descend towards the world, threatening to become a meteor that would destroy everything on impact. Amidst this crisis, a direct descendant of Kaguya Otsutsuki named Toneri Otsutsuki attempts to kidnap Hinata Hyuga but ends up abducting her younger sister Hanabi. Naruto and his allies now mount a rescue mission before finding themselves embroiled in a final battle to decide the fate of everything.
title: The Last: Naruto the Movie
plot:
The Last: Naruto the Movie is a 2014 Japanese animated film directed by Tensai Okamura, produced by Studio Pierrot and Aniplex. The movie takes place after the events of the Naruto Shippuden series.

The story revolves around Naruto Uzumaki, now in his mid-20s, who has become the Seventh Hokage of Konoha. However, a mysterious threat emerges in the form of Kaguya Otsutsuki, the true enemy that Naruto and Sasuke had been searching for throughout their lives.

Kaguya is revealed to be the origin of chakra, the source of all ninja power, and she seeks to reclaim her lost powers by gathering the nine tailed beasts. She plans to use these beasts' combined strength to destroy the world and rule over it.

Naruto, along with his friends Sakura Haruno and Sasuke Uchiha, must now face their greatest challenge yet as they try to stop Kaguya's plan. Along the way, Naruto is forced to confront his own doubts and fears about being a leader and his ability to protect his village.

The movie features epic battles, emotional character development, and explores themes of friendship, sacrifice, and the true meaning of leadership. The animation is stunning, with vibrant colors and detailed action sequences that bring the world of Naruto to life.

Throughout the film, Naruto's growth as a character is on full display as he grapples with his responsibilities as Hokage and his own sense of identity. His relationships with Sakura and Sasuke are also put to the test as they face their own personal struggles and doubts.

Overall, The Last: Naruto the Movie is an epic conclusion to the Naruto series that will leave fans emotionally invested in the characters and their journey. It's a must-watch for anyone who loves the Naruto franchise or is looking for an exciting adventure with memorable characters and stunning animation.

overview: In his second year of fighting crime, Batman uncovers corruption in Gotham City that connects to his own family while facing a serial killer known as the Riddler.
tagline: Unmask the truth.
title: The Batman
plot:
The Batman is a 2022 superhero thriller film directed by Matt Reeves, starring Robert Pattinson as the titular character. The movie takes place in Gotham City, where a series of brutal murders has taken place, targeting young women.

The story begins with Bruce Wayne (Pattinson), now an older and more brooding individual, still grieving the loss of his parents. He is haunted by the trauma of his childhood and struggles to connect with others. However, when he witnesses one of the victims being attacked, he becomes determined to track down the killer.

As Bruce delves deeper into the case, he discovers that the murders are all connected to a larger conspiracy involving the Riddler (Paul Dano), a serial killer who is using his intelligence and cunning to taunt the police. The Riddler's true identity is revealed to be Edward Nashton, a former student of Bruce's at the Gotham City Academy.

As the investigation unfolds, Bruce becomes increasingly obsessed with catching the Riddler, often putting himself in harm's way. He also begins to question his own morality and whether he is truly making a difference as a vigilante. Meanwhile, Selina Kyle (Zoë Kravitz), a cat burglar, becomes entangled in Bruce's investigation, and they develop a complicated relationship.

Throughout the film, Matt Reeves explores themes of trauma, grief, and redemption, delving into Bruce's psyche to understand what drives him as a hero. The movie also features a standout performance from Jeffrey Wright as James Gordon, the Commissioner of Gotham City Police Department, who is struggling to maintain order in the city.

The Batman received widespread critical acclaim for its dark and atmospheric tone, as well as Pattinson's performance as the iconic character. The film's success has paved the way for future DC Comics adaptations, with Reeves set to direct a sequel.

Overall, The Batman is a gripping and thought-provoking thriller that explores the complexities of Bruce Wayne's psyche and his role as a hero in Gotham City.

overview: A recently widowed man and his two teenage daughters travel to a game reserve in South Africa. However, their journey of healing soon turns into a fight for survival when a bloodthirsty lion starts to stalk them.
tagline: Fight for family.
title: Beast
plot:
Beast is a survival action horror film of 2022 directed by Baltasar Kormákur; Ryan Engle wrote the script from a story by Jaime Primak Sullivan. Idris Elba stars as Dr Nate Samuels, a recently widowed father, with Iyana Halley and Leah Sava Jeffries as his teenage daughters Meredith and Norah, Sharlto Copley as his old friend Martin Battles, a wildlife biologist, and Tafara Nyatsansa as the reserve worker Banji.

Hoping to reconnect with his daughters, Nate brings them to the Mopani Reserve in South Africa, managed by Martin, who introduced him to his late wife. Martin shows them the village where she grew up, and Nate admits his guilt at having drifted apart from her after their separation, before she was diagnosed with terminal cancer. Touring restricted areas, Martin points out a lion pride he helped raise, then discovers that most of a nearby Tsonga community has been killed. Suspecting a rogue lion, he goes to investigate and is mauled, and the lion then attacks Nate, who escapes into the car; Meredith speeds off but crashes into a tree, stranding them. With the radio out of range, Nate assembles a tranquilliser rifle. In the next attack Meredith rescues the injured Martin and Norah drives the lion off with a dart. Martin guesses that poachers slaughtered the animal's pride, turning it against humans.

That night the poachers themselves arrive, offering a ride for money until they see Martin, a committed anti-poaching campaigner. The lion falls on them, killing most, and Nate recovers their truck keys. Martin holds the beast off so the girls can escape, Meredith suffering a deep wound, and when the car tumbles into a ravine he sacrifices himself by igniting leaking fuel, badly burning the lion. Low on fuel, the family shelters in an abandoned school used by the poachers. Locking his daughters inside, Nate lures the lion toward Martin's pride; it overpowers him, but the pride's males kill it, and Banji arrives to save the unconscious Nate. Recovered, he tells his daughters he loves them, and later the reunited family return to the reserve to recreate a photograph his wife took beside her favourite tree.

Shot in South Africa in 2021, the film was released by Universal Pictures in August 2022 and grossed $59.1 million worldwide on a $36 million budget. Critics were mostly positive, giving it 68% on Rotten Tomatoes, and its lion earned a Visual Effects Society Award nomination.

overview: 16-year-old Cassie Sullivan tries to survive in a world devastated by the waves of an alien invasion that has already decimated the population and knocked mankind back to the Stone Age.
tagline: Protect Your Own
title: The 5th Wave
plot:
The 5th Wave is a science fiction film directed by Neill Blomkamp, released in 2016. The movie is based on the novel of the same name by Rick Yancey.

In the near future, an alien invasion has devastated Earth, and the extraterrestrial beings, known as "The Others," have begun to abduct humans, leaving behind a trail of destruction and chaos. The story follows Cassie Sullivan (Chloe Moretz), a 16-year-old girl who is trying to survive in this new world.

Cassie's life takes a dramatic turn when she witnesses the abduction of her brother, Sam (Harris Dickinson). She soon discovers that the Others are not just random abductors but are actually targeting specific individuals with unique skills and abilities. Cassie learns that she has been chosen as one of the "Five," a group of children who possess special talents that will help humanity fight back against The Others.

The movie begins with Cassie's life in a post-apocalyptic world, where she is forced to live on her own after her mother's death. She meets Evan Walker (Alex Roe), a mysterious and handsome young man who claims to be one of the "Five." As they spend more time together, Cassie starts to develop feelings for Evan, but their relationship is complicated by the danger that surrounds them.

The plot thickens as Cassie discovers that The Others are not just mindless abductors but are actually using the children to harvest a powerful energy source. The aliens have created a device that can harness the energy of human brains, and they need the "Five" to activate it.

As Cassie and Evan try to evade The Others, they embark on a perilous journey across the country. Along the way, they encounter other survivors who possess unique skills, including Marcus (Patton Oswalt), a genius hacker, and Bishop (Ludacris), a former soldier with exceptional combat skills.

The movie's climax features an intense battle between Cassie and The Others as she tries to activate the device that will help humanity fight back. In the process, Evan sacrifices himself to save Cassie, leaving her heartbroken but determined to continue the fight.

In the end, Cassie manages to activate the device, which sends a signal to the remaining survivors, allowing them to launch a counterattack against The Others. The movie concludes with Cassie standing alone, ready to face whatever challenges lie ahead in the fight for humanity's survival.

Overall, The 5th Wave is an action-packed sci-fi thriller that explores themes of survival, sacrifice, and the power of human connection in the face of overwhelming odds.

overview: Dr. Alan Stone breaks new ground for treatment of the mentally ill through an experiment on three paranoid schizophrenic patients who believe they are Jesus Christ.
title: Three Christs
plot:
Three Christs is a psychological drama film that delves into the complexities of human nature, free will, and the blurred lines between reality and fantasy. The movie follows Chris, a man who claims to be Jesus Christ, and his interactions with two psychiatrists, Dr. Sheehan and Dr. Sheehan's colleague, as they attempt to understand his delusions.

At its core, Three Christs explores the theme of identity and how it is shaped by our experiences, perceptions, and societal expectations. Chris's character raises questions about the nature of reality and whether it is possible for an individual to truly know themselves. His claims of being Jesus Christ serve as a catalyst for exploring these themes, highlighting the tension between faith and doubt.

The film also touches on the idea of control and power dynamics, particularly in the relationships between Chris and the psychiatrists. As Chris's story unfolds, it becomes clear that his character is not just a product of his own imagination but also a reflection of the societal expectations placed upon him as a figure of authority and faith.

Furthermore, Three Christs examines the theme of empathy and understanding, highlighting the difficulties in truly comprehending someone who operates on a different level of reality. The psychiatrists' attempts to connect with Chris serve as a metaphor for the human desire to understand others, even when they may not be able to grasp the full extent of their experiences.

Overall, Three Christs is a thought-provoking film that challenges viewers to consider the complexities of human nature and the blurred lines between reality and fantasy.

overview: Sudan, East Africa, 1980. A team of Israeli Mossad agents plans to rescue and transfer thousands of Ethiopian Jews to Israel. To do so, and to avoid raising suspicions from the inquisitive and ruthless authorities, they establish as a cover a fake diving resort by the Red Sea.
tagline: In the 1980s one partnership saved thousands of lives
title: The Red Sea Diving Resort
plot:
The Red Sea Diving Resort is a 2019 film that tells the story of a group of divers who come together to rescue a young girl from a terrorist group in Sudan. 

At its core, the movie explores themes of friendship, camaraderie, and the power of human connection in the face of adversity. The characters, all strangers at first, form an unbreakable bond as they work together to save the girl, and their relationships with each other become a source of strength and inspiration.

The film also delves into the complexities of terrorism and the impact it has on innocent lives. Through the story of the young girl and her family, the movie sheds light on the human cost of violence and the importance of empathy and understanding in breaking down barriers between cultures and communities.

Furthermore, The Red Sea Diving Resort is a film about resilience and determination. The characters face numerous challenges and obstacles as they navigate their mission, but they refuse to give up, driven by their commitment to helping others and standing up against injustice.

Overall, the movie is a heartwarming and thought-provoking tale of human connection, courage, and the power of friendship in overcoming even the most daunting challenges.

overview: In Ancient Polynesia, when a terrible curse incurred by Maui reaches an impetuous Chieftain's daughter's island, she answers the Ocean's call to seek out the demigod to set things right.
tagline: The ocean is calling.
title: Moana
plot:
Moana (2016) is an animated adventure film that explores several themes that are both universally relatable and culturally specific to Polynesian communities.

One of the primary themes of Moana is the concept of identity and self-discovery. The protagonist, Moana, is a young girl who feels an insatiable call to explore the ocean and discover her true purpose in life. As she sets sail on her journey, she must navigate her own identity and confront the expectations placed upon her by her community.

Another significant theme in Moana is the importance of family and tradition. Moana's island, Motunui, is a tight-knit community that values its ancestral heritage and cultural traditions. However, as Moana embarks on her journey, she must also learn to balance her own desires with the needs of her family and community.

The film also explores the theme of perseverance and determination in the face of adversity. Moana faces numerous challenges, including treacherous seas, fierce monsters, and her own self-doubt. However, through her bravery and resilience, she is able to overcome these obstacles and achieve her goals.

Furthermore, Moana touches on the theme of colonialism and cultural appropriation. The film's depiction of European explorers and their impact on Polynesian cultures is a commentary on the historical exploitation and erasure of indigenous cultures. However, it also highlights the importance of preserving and celebrating one's own cultural heritage.

Finally, Moana features a strong female protagonist who embodies qualities such as courage, compassion, and wisdom. The film celebrates women's empowerment and encourages young girls to be confident in their abilities and pursue their passions.

Overall, Moana is a beautifully crafted film that explores complex themes and emotions through its engaging storyline and memorable characters.

overview: A former agent of the CIA and his estranged daughter go on the run after his employers target them for assassination.
production_companies: National Bank of Canada TV and Motion Picture Group
tagline: Far from home. Far from safe. Far from over.
title: Erased
plot:
Erased, released outside the United States as The Expatriate, is an action thriller of 2012 directed by Philipp Stölzl and written by Arash Amel. Aaron Eckhart stars as Ben Logan, a former CIA operative living quietly in Belgium, with Liana Liberato as his teenage daughter Amy, Olga Kurylenko as the CIA officer Anna Brandt, and Garrick Hagon as the executive James Halgate III.

He works for the Kohler Company, part of the multinational technology firm the Halgate Group, testing ways to defeat security systems such as locks and iris scanners. After a colleague notices that the company holds no patent for one of its products, Ben reports it to his boss, Kohler. Soon afterwards he arrives to find the office deserted, with no trace of the company or of his employment. While he tries to prove his job through bank records, his co-worker Floyd seizes him and Amy at gunpoint and forces them into Ben's car. Ben deliberately crashes it and kills Floyd before his shocked daughter, and the two flee the police. Hiding in an empty house, Amy demands the truth, and he hints only that he used to get people out of difficult situations.

Learning that all his colleagues have been murdered, Ben goes underground with help from Algerian illegal immigrants Amy has befriended. He uncovers evidence of a vast conspiracy in which Halgate is smuggling arms to African insurgents in order to win lithium mining rights once they seize power; the shell company had been using Ben's skills to steal the incriminating documents from a CIA cache. He finally admits to Amy that he was once a CIA operative. Hunted by the Belgian police, a Halgate assassin and a CIA team led by Anna, Ben's former lover, who is secretly on Halgate's payroll and had recommended him for the job. When the two finally meet, Ben persuades her that she has lost her moral bearings, and she switches sides, but she is killed trying to save Amy after the assassin captures the girl. Ben offers himself and the documents in exchange for his daughter, hiding a homemade bomb in the briefcase. After saying goodbye to Amy, who leaves with her Algerian friend Nabil, he hands over the case; when Halgate orders Amy and her grandfather killed within a week, the bomb kills him, his assistant and the assassin. Ben and Amy are reunited at an airport.

Acquired by RADiUS-TWC, the film was released in American cinemas in May 2013. Critics found it derivative, giving it 28% on Rotten Tomatoes and 34 on Metacritic.

overview: A woman brings her family back to her childhood home, which used to be an orphanage, intent on reopening it. Before long, her son starts to communicate with a new invisible friend.
tagline: A tale of love.  A story of horror.
title: The Orphanage
plot:
The Orphanage is a Spanish horror film directed by Juan Antonio Bayona, released in 2007. The movie tells the story of a woman named Laura, played by Belén Rueda, who returns to the orphanage where she grew up as an adult.

Laura's childhood was marked by tragedy when her younger brother died under mysterious circumstances at the orphanage. She has always felt a deep sense of guilt and responsibility for his death. As an adult, Laura is haunted by nightmares and a feeling of being watched. She decides to return to the orphanage, now abandoned and rumored to be haunted, in an attempt to lay her brother's spirit to rest.

Upon arrival, Laura discovers that the orphanage has been renovated into a nursing home for elderly people. However, she soon realizes that the residents are not what they seem. They appear to be in a state of catatonia, and their eyes seem to follow her everywhere she goes. As Laura delves deeper into the mystery, she begins to uncover dark secrets about the orphanage's past.

Laura's investigation leads her to a room where her brother's grave is supposed to be located. However, when she searches for it, she finds that it has been moved and is now in a different location. This discovery sets off a chain of events that reveals the truth about the orphanage's dark history.

As Laura digs deeper, she discovers that the orphanage was once home to a group of children who died under mysterious circumstances. The children's spirits are trapped between the world of the living and the afterlife, and they are unable to move on. Laura realizes that her brother's death is connected to these children's deaths and that she has been carrying the guilt of their deaths with her all along.

In a shocking twist, it is revealed that Laura herself was one of the children who died at the orphanage. Her memories of the event were false, implanted by her adoptive parents to protect her from the truth. The entire story is a product of Laura's imagination, and she has been trying to uncover the truth about her own past.

The movie ends with Laura finally finding peace and closure. She realizes that she was not responsible for her brother's death and that she has been carrying the guilt of others' deaths all along. The film's ending is open to interpretation, leaving the audience to wonder whether Laura's memories were real or just a product of her imagination.

Overall, The Orphanage is a haunting and atmospheric horror film that explores themes of grief, guilt, and the power of the human mind. The movie features stunning visuals and a standout performance from Belén Rueda, who brings depth and nuance to the complex character of Laura.

overview: A dysfunctional family awake on Christmas morning to discover they’re sealed inside their house by a mysterious black substance. On television, a single line of text reads: “Stay Indoors and Await Further Instructions.”
tagline: Contain. Corrupt. Control.
title: Await Further Instructions
plot:
Await Further Instructions is a 2018 British science fiction thriller film directed by Stuart Orme. The movie follows a family who are trapped in their home during a mysterious event that causes time to slow down, and they must navigate the challenges of this altered reality.

The main theme of Await Further Instructions revolves around the concept of time and its relationship with human experience. As the characters struggle to cope with the slowed-down world, they begin to question the nature of time and their place within it. The film explores how our perception of time is influenced by our emotions, relationships, and experiences.

The movie also delves into the theme of family dynamics and the ways in which relationships can be both a source of comfort and a source of conflict. As the characters try to navigate this altered reality, they are forced to confront their own personal demons and re-evaluate their priorities.

Furthermore, Await Further Instructions touches on the idea of isolation and confinement, highlighting how these conditions can affect individuals in different ways. The film's use of time dilation as a plot device serves to underscore the psychological effects of being trapped in a confined space with limited communication with the outside world.

Overall, Await Further Instructions is a thought-provoking exploration of the human experience, delving into themes that are both timely and timeless.

overview: After spending 12 years in prison for keeping his mouth shut, notorious safe-cracker Dom Hemingway is back on the streets of London looking to collect what he's owed.
tagline: I want my money plus interest… and a present
title: Dom Hemingway
plot:
Dom Hemingway is a 2013 British action comedy film directed by Richard Shepard. The movie follows the story of Dom Hemingway, a safecracker who is released from prison after serving time for a crime he didn't commit. As he tries to rebuild his life and clear his name, he becomes embroiled in a complex web of deceit and betrayal.

The main theme of Dom Hemingway revolves around the idea of identity and redemption. The film explores how Dom's past mistakes have shaped him into the person he is today, and whether he can truly change and start anew. Throughout the movie, Dom struggles with his own morality and sense of self-worth, as he navigates a world that seems determined to hold him back.

The film also delves into themes of loyalty and friendship, particularly in the complex relationship between Dom and his partner, Jackson. As their bond is tested by external forces, they are forced to confront the true meaning of loyalty and what it means to have someone's back.

Furthermore, Dom Hemingway touches on the idea of class and social status, highlighting the stark contrast between Dom's working-class background and the wealthy elite he encounters throughout his journey. This dichotomy serves as a commentary on the societal pressures that can shape our lives and choices.

Overall, Dom Hemingway is a thought-provoking film that explores complex themes with humor, wit, and a healthy dose of action.

original_title: The Smurfs: The Legend of Smurfy Hollow
overview: When Brainy Smurf is favored to win the annual Smurfberry Hunt for the ninth year in a row, Gutsy Smurf sets out to discover how Brainy wins every year. Gutsy’s investigation takes him into spooky Smurfy Hollow–and right into Gargamel’s trap! Can Brainy and Gutsy, with the help of Smurfette, put aside their rivalry before Gargamel captures them–or worse, they come face-to-face with the legendary ghost, the Headless Horseman?
tagline: Smurf or Treat
title: The Smurfs: The Legend of Smurfy Hollow
plot:
The Smurfs: The Legend of Smurfy Hollow is a 2013 animated comedy film produced by Sony Pictures Animation. The movie takes place in the fictional village of Smurfville, where the lovable blue creatures live.

The story begins with Papa Smurf (voiced by Jonathan Winters) announcing that he has chosen a new Smurfberry harvest site for the year, which is located in a hollow tree called Smurfy Hollow. The Smurfs are excited to start their annual tradition of harvesting Smurfberries, but things take a turn when they discover that the hollow tree is inhabited by a ghostly spirit.

The ghost, known as the "Ghost of Smurfy Hollow," is said to be the spirit of a young Smurf who died in the hollow many years ago. The Ghost is determined to scare away the living Smurfs and keep them from harvesting their Smurfberries. The Smurfs are initially frightened by the Ghost's presence, but they soon realize that it's just trying to protect its home.

As the story progresses, Brainy Smurf (voiced by Danny Pudi) discovers that the Ghost is actually a manifestation of his own guilt and regret over not being able to save the young Smurf who died in the hollow. The Ghost is trying to find peace and move on from its past, but it's stuck in the hollow due to its unfinished business.

The Smurfs decide to help the Ghost by completing its unfinished task: finding a way to forgive itself and let go of its guilt. Along the way, they learn valuable lessons about friendship, forgiveness, and the importance of moving forward.

As the story unfolds, the Smurfs face various obstacles and challenges as they try to help the Ghost find peace. They also have to deal with Gargamel (voiced by Hank Azaria), who's trying to capture the Ghost and use its energy for his own evil purposes.

In the end, the Smurfs successfully help the Ghost find closure and move on from its past. The Ghost is finally able to rest in peace, and the Smurfs are able to harvest their Smurfberries without any further issues. The movie ends with a heartwarming moment of the Smurfs celebrating their success and looking forward to a bright future.

Overall, The Smurfs: The Legend of Smurfy Hollow is a charming and entertaining film that explores themes of forgiveness, friendship, and moving on from past mistakes. With its lovable characters, engaging storyline, and beautiful animation, it's a must-see for fans of the Smurfs franchise.

overview: Tired of being locked in a reptile house where humans gawk at them like they are monsters, a ragtag group of Australia’s deadliest creatures plot an escape from their zoo to the Outback, a place where they’ll fit in without being judged.
tagline: Dangerously cute and on the loose
title: Back to the Outback
plot:
Back to the Outback is a 2021 Australian animated adventure comedy film directed by Alex Spiller and produced by Weed Road Pictures, in association with Screen Australia and the Australian Film Institute. The movie follows the story of a group of orphaned koalas who embark on an epic journey through the Australian outback.

The film begins with a dramatic scene where a group of orphaned koalas are being transported to a wildlife sanctuary when their plane crashes, killing everyone on board except for four young koalas: Bubba, Boomer, Bluey, and Brenda. The four koalas find themselves stranded in the Australian outback, surrounded by venomous snakes, spiders, and other deadly creatures.

As they try to survive and find a way back home, the koalas meet a friendly and eccentric kangaroo named Kip, who becomes their guide and mentor. Kip teaches the koalas how to navigate the harsh desert environment, hunt for food, and avoid predators.

However, their journey is not without its challenges. The group soon discovers that they are being pursued by a ruthless and cunning dingo named Scorch, who seeks to capture them and sell them to a sinister wildlife collector. Along the way, the koalas also encounter other dangers, including treacherous terrain, raging rivers, and even a massive saltwater crocodile.

Despite these obstacles, the four koalas work together, using their unique skills and personalities to overcome each challenge. Bubba, the brave and fearless leader, takes charge of the group and keeps them safe. Boomer, the tech-savvy koala, uses his knowledge of technology to help the group navigate and find food. Bluey, the curious and adventurous koala, loves to explore and discover new things. And Brenda, the gentle and caring koala, looks out for her friends and keeps everyone's spirits high.

As they journey deeper into the outback, the koalas learn valuable lessons about teamwork, perseverance, and believing in themselves. They also develop a strong bond with Kip, who becomes like a surrogate father to them.

In the end, the group faces off against Scorch in an epic battle, using all their skills and cunning to outwit him and escape his clutches. With Kip's help, they finally reach the safety of a wildlife sanctuary, where they are reunited with other orphaned animals and begin a new life together.

Throughout the film, the animation is vibrant and colorful, bringing the Australian outback to life in stunning detail. The characters are well-developed and relatable, making it easy for audiences to become invested in their journey. The story is full of action, adventure, and heart, making Back to the Outback a fun and entertaining film for both children and adults.

Overall, Back to the Outback is a thrilling and inspiring animated adventure that celebrates the beauty and diversity of the Australian outback. With its lovable characters, exciting plot twists, and stunning animation, it's a must-see film for anyone who loves animals, adventure, or just a good story well-told.

overview: Ex-con Zequi and company come back for a new adventure.
title: No Manches Frida 2
plot:
No Manches Frida 2 is a Spanish comedy film directed by David Pablos and starring Karra Elejalde, Clara Lago, and Antonio de la Torre. The movie is the sequel to the 2016 film No Manches Frida.

The story begins with Álvaro Molina (Karra Elejalde), a former professional soccer player who has retired from the sport due to an injury. Álvaro is now working as a coach for a local youth soccer team, but he's struggling to connect with his players and find his place in life.

One day, Álvaro receives an offer to become the new coach of the national under-20 soccer team, which is led by the charismatic and confident captain, Iván (Antonio de la Torre). However, there's a catch: the team has been struggling on the field, and the players are not motivated. Álvaro sees this as an opportunity to redeem himself and prove his coaching skills.

As Álvaro takes over the team, he faces resistance from the players, who are skeptical of his abilities. However, with the help of Iván's sister, Frida (Clara Lago), a talented young player who becomes Álvaro's protégée, he starts to win them over.

Meanwhile, Álvaro also has to deal with the pressure from the team's sponsors and the media, who are expecting him to deliver results quickly. As the team prepares for an important tournament, Álvaro must navigate the challenges of coaching a young team while dealing with his own personal demons.

Throughout the movie, there are plenty of comedic moments as Álvaro tries to connect with his players and find his place in the world. The film also explores themes of identity, redemption, and the importance of finding one's passion in life.

In the end, Álvaro and his team face off against their toughest opponents yet, but with Frida's help, they're able to overcome their challenges and achieve success on the field. The movie ends on a high note, with Álvaro finally finding his place as a coach and a person.

Overall, No Manches Frida 2 is a heartwarming and hilarious comedy that explores themes of identity, redemption, and the power of sports to bring people together. With its talented cast and engaging storyline, it's a must-see for fans of Spanish cinema.

overview: Faced with an unplanned pregnancy, an offbeat young woman makes an unusual decision regarding her unborn child.
tagline: A comedy about growing up… and the bumps along the way.
title: Juno
plot:
Juno (2007) is a critically acclaimed comedy-drama film directed by Jason Reitman, written by Diablo Cody, and produced by Lianne Halfon, Mason Neustein, and Jennifer Westfeldt.

The main themes of Juno revolve around several key elements:

1. **Teenage Pregnancy and Independence**: The film explores the complexities of teenage pregnancy, particularly for a young woman like Juno MacGuff (Ellen Page), who is determined to maintain her independence and individuality despite being pregnant.
2. **Motherhood and Responsibility**: As Juno navigates her pregnancy, she must confront the responsibilities that come with motherhood, including finding a suitable adoptive family for her child. This theme highlights the challenges of balancing personal desires with societal expectations.
3. **Identity and Self-Discovery**: Throughout the film, Juno grapples with her own identity, questioning her values, relationships, and future plans. Her journey serves as a metaphor for self-discovery and growth.
4. **Adoption and Family**: The adoption plotline in the movie raises questions about family, love, and acceptance. It highlights the complexities of creating a family through adoption and the emotional connections that form between adoptive parents and their child.
5. **Social Commentary on Abortion and Reproductive Rights**: Although not explicitly stated, Juno touches upon the sensitive topic of abortion and reproductive rights in the United States during the early 2000s. The film's portrayal of a young woman's decision to give her baby up for adoption serves as a commentary on the complexities surrounding these issues.

The movie features a talented ensemble cast, including Michael Cera, Jennifer Garner, Jason Bateman, and Allison Janney, who deliver nuanced performances that add depth to the story.

Overall, Juno is a thought-provoking film that explores themes of identity, responsibility, and self-discovery, set against the backdrop of teenage pregnancy and adoption.

overview: A prequel to the first two Underworld films, this fantasy explains the origins of the feud between the Vampires and the Lycans. Aided by his secret love, Sonja, courageous Lucian leads the Lycans in battle against brutal Vampire king Viktor. Determined to break the king's enslavement of his people, Lucian faces off against the Death Dealer army in a bid for Lycan independence.
tagline: Every war has a beginning.
title: Underworld: Rise of the Lycans
plot:
Underworld: Rise of the Lycans is an American action horror film of 2009 directed by Patrick Tatopoulos, a prequel to Underworld (2003) and the third film in the series, tracing the origins of the war between vampires and Lycans. The screenplay is by Danny McBride, Dirk Blackman and Howard McCain from a story by Len Wiseman, Robert Orr and McBride. Michael Sheen stars as Lucian, with Bill Nighy as the vampire elder Viktor, Rhona Mitra as his daughter Sonja, Steven Mackintosh as Andreas Tanis and Kevin Grevioux as Raze, while Kate Beckinsale appears briefly at the end.

For twenty years vampires have battled the first werewolves, savage beasts unable to regain human shape. Lucian is the first born able to take human form, the first Lycan, and Viktor raises him, dreaming of a race of Lycan slaves to guard his fortress by day and toil for the vampires by night. Lucian and Sonja grow up to become secret lovers. When the headstrong Sonja is ambushed by werewolves, Lucian breaks free of the collar that stops him transforming and saves her, but Viktor punishes the escape with a whipping and imprisonment. Sonja trades her council seat to Tanis for help freeing Lucian, who flees with the other Lycans, planning to meet her in three days. Viktor bites his daughter and reads the truth of the affair in her blood, then locks her away.

Lucian builds an army of freed human slaves and werewolves that raids noble estates, and the vampire council demands he be caught. Confident that Lucian will return for Sonja, Viktor waits. Lucian frees her but they are caught as they flee, and Sonja reveals she is carrying Lucian's child. Disgusted, Viktor has the council sentence her to death and she is burned by sunlight before Lucian's eyes. Transforming in fury, Lucian summons the wild werewolves to storm the fortress, killing council members and nobles. He catches Viktor in shafts of sunlight, stabs him through the mouth and casts him into the water. Raze declares it finished, but Lucian knows the war has only begun. On a ship fleeing the fortress, the surviving Viktor is sealed into hibernation by Tanis, and a coda from the first film has Kraven telling Selene that Viktor killed her family.

Released in January 2009, the film opened at number one on its first day and grossed about $92 million worldwide. Reviews were mixed, with 29% on Rotten Tomatoes, though critics singled out Sheen's performance.

overview: A talented photographer stuck in a dead-end job inherits an antique Advent calendar that may be predicting the future -- and pointing her toward love.
title: The Holiday Calendar
plot:
The Holiday Calendar is a heartwarming romantic comedy that explores the themes of love, self-discovery, and the power of believing in oneself. At its core, the movie tells the story of Amanda, a young photographer who inherits an antique advent calendar from her great-aunt, which holds magical powers to reveal her true feelings.

As Amanda navigates her way through the holiday season, she finds herself on a journey of self-discovery, learning to let go of her past and open herself up to new experiences. The movie delves into the idea that sometimes, we need to take risks and step out of our comfort zones to find what truly makes us happy.

The film also explores the theme of love in all its forms, from romantic relationships to familial bonds. Amanda's journey is not just about finding love, but also about learning to accept herself and her place in the world. The movie's portrayal of a strong, independent woman who finds her true self through the magic of the advent calendar is truly inspiring.

Throughout the film, there are moments of humor, wit, and charm that make it an enjoyable watch. However, beneath its lighthearted surface, The Holiday Calendar touches on some deeper themes about the importance of believing in oneself, taking chances, and embracing love in all its forms.

overview: Denmark, 2016. A blurred note is found in a bottle that has traveled across the ocean for a long time. After deciphering the cryptic note, Department Q members follow a sinister trail that leads them to investigate a case occurred in 2008. At the same time, new tragic events take place that test their faith and deepest beliefs.
title: A Conspiracy of Faith
plot:
A Conspiracy of Faith is a 2016 Danish thriller film directed by Nikolaj Arcel. The movie revolves around a young woman, Sarah, who seeks revenge against her father's killer after his brutal murder. As she delves deeper into the mystery, she uncovers dark secrets and conspiracies that lead her to question everything.

The main theme of A Conspiracy of Faith is the destructive power of trauma and the cyclical nature of violence. The film explores how past traumas can shape individuals and lead them down a path of revenge, causing further harm to themselves and others. Through Sarah's journey, the movie highlights the devastating consequences of unresolved grief and the importance of confronting the truth in order to break free from the cycle of violence.

The film also touches on themes of identity, family dynamics, and the blurred lines between good and evil. As Sarah navigates her quest for revenge, she is forced to confront her own demons and the complexities of human nature, leading to a nuanced exploration of what it means to be a victim, a perpetrator, or something in between.

Ultimately, A Conspiracy of Faith is a thought-provoking thriller that raises questions about the nature of justice, morality, and the human condition.

overview: The Queen of Selvascura risks everything to be a mother; the King of Roccaforte falls in love with the voice of a mysterious girl; the King of Altomonte becomes obsessed with a flea and neglects his daughter.
production_companies: Fonds Eurimages du Conseil de l'Europe
tagline: Desire. Envy. Obsession.
title: Tale of Tales
plot:
Tale of Tales (2015) is a fantasy drama film directed by Matteo Garrone, not RAI. The movie is an adaptation of Giambattista Basile's 17th-century Italian fairy tale collection, Il Pentamerone.

The main themes of Tale of Tales include:

1. **Feminism and Female Empowerment**: The film explores the lives of three sisters who are forced to navigate a patriarchal society where they are treated as objects rather than individuals. Through their stories, the movie highlights the struggles faced by women in medieval Italy.
2. **Motherhood and Maternal Love**: The film delves into the complexities of motherhood, exploring themes of sacrifice, love, and the consequences of one's actions. The characters' relationships with their children are a central focus of the story.
3. **Power Dynamics and Corruption**: Tale of Tales critiques the abuse of power and corruption in medieval society. The movie shows how those in positions of authority exploit and manipulate others for their own gain.
4. **Identity and Self-Discovery**: As the characters navigate their lives, they grapple with questions of identity, self-discovery, and finding one's place in the world.

The film features a unique blend of dark fantasy, drama, and social commentary, making it a thought-provoking and visually stunning experience.

overview: When an oil rig in the Gobi Desert of Mongolia proves unproductive, an aircraft crew are sent to shut the operation down and fly them out. On the flight out over the desert on the way to Beijing, Capt. Frank Towns and co-pilot A.J. are unable to keep their cargo plane, a C-119 Flying Boxcar, in the air when a violent sandstorm strikes. Crash-landing in a remote uncharted part of the desert, the two pilots and their passengers -- a crew of oil workers and a drifter -- must work together to survive by rebuilding the aircraft. Soon, low supplies and a band of merciless smugglers add even greater urgency to their task.
tagline: Out of the ashes, hope will rise.
title: Flight of the Phoenix
plot:
Flight of the Phoenix is a 2004 American survival drama film directed by John Moore and written by Scott Frank and Edward Burns, a remake of the 1965 film The Flight of the Phoenix, both based on Elleston Trevor's 1964 novel. Dennis Quaid, Giovanni Ribisi, Tyrese Gibson, Miranda Otto and Hugh Laurie star in the story of a group who survive a plane crash in the desert and must build a new aircraft from the wreckage to escape. It was filmed on location in the Namib Desert, using a mix of models and computer graphics for its aerial scenes.

When an oil-drilling operation in the Gobi Desert of Mongolia proves unproductive, pilot Frank Towns and his co-pilot A.J. are sent in their C-119 Flying Boxcar to shut it down and fly the crew out, along with a mysterious hitchhiker named Elliott. En route to Beijing, a violent dust storm disables an engine and forces a crash landing in an uncharted stretch of desert, killing several passengers. Stranded some 200 miles off course with about a month's supply of water, the survivors face a fierce debate about whether to wait for a rescue that may never come or attempt to walk out.
