Hunt topped the South Korean box office on release and drew more than 4.3 million admissions. Critics were mixed, with 69% approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 52, though some found the plot needlessly convoluted.

overview: Ella returns to her hometown to mend fences with her fractured family. With the help of Griffin, her ex-boyfriend, she encourages her family to celebrate Christmas and Kwanzaa and to heal their past wounds before it’s too late.
title: Holiday Heritage
plot:
Holiday Heritage is a 2022 Canadian Christmas and Kwanzaa family drama television film directed by Alfons Adetuyi from a screenplay by Rhonda Baraka. Produced by Muse Entertainment, it was the Hallmark Channel's first film built around Kwanzaa. It stars Lyndie Greenwood, Brooks Darnell, Holly Robinson Peete and Darlene Cooke, with Jennifer de Lucia, Jason Verma and Rothaford Gray in supporting roles, and features a score by Michael Richard Plowman. The film premiered on the Hallmark Channel on 16 December 2022 and runs 84 minutes.

Ella Chapel (Greenwood), a graphic designer who moved from Pennsylvania to Boston two years earlier, returns home to Mary's Town for the holidays to a family still struggling after the death of her grandfather Riley (Gray), who served as the town's mayor, championed its annual Kwanzaa celebrations and long acted as the family peacemaker. Her visit begins with a shock when her mother Micah (Robinson Peete) announces that she is moving to Chicago after the holidays to open her own bistro. Micah and her mother Tess (Cooke) run the Chapel Family Bakery together but are barely speaking: Tess, uninterested in celebrating this year, throws herself into work around the clock and clings to her traditional recipes, refusing to give Micah any say in the business, even though Micah has worked there since high school. Determined to heal the rift and keep her mother in town, Ella digs out her grandfather's Kwanzaa chest and sets out to get the whole family to observe all seven nights of the holiday alongside their Christmas traditions. She is helped by her ex-boyfriend Griffin (Darnell), now the mayor, who is carrying on the town's Kwanzaa events, and as the pair scheme to get Micah and Tess talking, they also confront why Ella left and what their relationship might become.

Reviews were mixed. Decider recommended it as a heartwarming film, praising the extraordinary chemistry of Greenwood, Robinson Peete and Cooke as three generations of Chapel women, the focus on family rather than romance, Plowman's propulsive score and the respectful depiction of Kwanzaa. TheWrap ranked it 23rd of Hallmark's 43 new holiday films of 2022, calling it a step in the right direction that explained the holiday gracefully, though neither the family drama nor the love story leapt off the page. Kristen of TV Tweetie liked its celebration of Kwanzaa but found the scenes between Tess and Micah hard to watch and the film boring.

original_title: オルタード・カーボン：リスリーブド
overview: On the planet Latimer, Takeshi Kovacs must protect a tattooist while investigating the death of a yakuza boss alongside a no-nonsense CTAC.
title: Altered Carbon: Resleeved
plot:
Altered Carbon: Resleeved is a 2020 Japanese anime film spun off from Netflix's Altered Carbon television series, directed by Jō Nakajima and written by Dai Satō and Tsukasa Kondo. Set 253 years before the first season, it follows Takeshi Kovacs on the planet Latimer as he protects a tattooist while investigating the death of a yakuza boss alongside an agent of the UN's CTAC. The voice cast includes Tatsuhisa Suzuki, Rina Sato and Ayaka Asai.

On Latimer, a girl named Holly flees from yakuza and is nearly killed by a ninja before Takeshi, newly needlecast into a fresh sleeve, fights the attacker off. Yakuza clan head Hideki Tanaseda hires Takeshi to protect Holly and discover how and why his younger brother died. After Holly runs into Gena of CTAC, the group survives a ninja ambush, and Holly reveals that the ninjas were sent by Shinji, who is plotting a coup within the Mizumoto syndicate. At the syndicate's headquarters, the old luxury hotel Wild Geese, run by an AI butler named Ogai, Shinji welcomes them, and Holly continues inking his tattoos. Genzo explains that Tanaseda is the son of the syndicate's founder and that, by tradition, each outgoing boss is killed by a death program embedded in his tattoos. Gena secretly reports to CTAC and is revealed to be Reileen Kawahara, Takeshi's sister, who later recognizes him but stays silent. Holly says she needs the Mizumoto clan to find the stacks of her murdered parents and that a former tattooist, Margot, created the death tattoos.

On the day of succession Holly drugs Shinji, and Genzo is killed by his tattoo on stage. Tanaseda then reveals that Shinji and Genzo are the same person, his father, the syndicate's founder, who has overwritten the stacks of new bosses for generations. The founder destroys the stacks of Holly's parents and dons a power suit, and after Tanaseda proves to Ogai that he is not the rightful leader, Ogai turns the hotel's fireworks on him. Takeshi and Gena destroy his armor, Holly activates his tattoo and Tanaseda shoots his stack. Gena, secretly ordered to eliminate Holly, falsely reports her mission complete. Ogai addresses Holly as Margot, and she declines a younger sleeve so that her friends will know her if they meet again.

Netflix released the film on March 19, 2020. Reviews were mixed, with critics praising the animation and action but finding the characters and plot weak; IGN rated it 6 out of 10, and the film holds 60% on Rotten Tomatoes.

overview: The giant, man-eating Graboids are back and even deadlier than before, terrorizing the inhabitants of a South African wildlife reserve as they attack from below-and above.
title: Tremors 5: Bloodlines
plot:
Tremors 5: Bloodlines is a 2015 direct-to-video monster horror film directed by Don Michael Paul and produced by Ogden Gavanski. The fifth film in the Tremors franchise and the first in eleven years, it served as Universal Pictures' relaunch of the series and was the first entry made without Stampede Entertainment, the company of series creators S. S. Wilson and Brent Maddock. Michael Gross returns as the survivalist Burt Gummer, joined by Jamie Kennedy as his cameraman Travis Welker, Pearl Thusi as Dr. Nandi Montabu, Rea Rangaka as Baruti, Brandon Auret as Johan Dreyer, Daniel Janks as Erich Van Wyk, Nolitha Zulu as Amahle and Ian Roberts as the pilot Den Bravers.

Burt, now the star of his own survivalist web series, and Travis are hired by South African wildlife agents Van Wyk and Dreyer to deal with Ass-Blasters. Burt's heavy weapons are impounded under South African gun laws, leaving him with guns he considers too small. The team bases itself at an animal refuge, where Travis befriends the young Amahle and falls for her mother Nandi, sparking a rivalry with the local man Baruti. After two paleontologists are devoured at a dig, Burt realizes the creatures are a new breed of Graboid. When a refuge worker is carried off, Burt kills an Ass-Blaster in a cave, though its falling body kills Dreyer. Discovering that the creatures have been laying Graboid eggs, Van Wyk reveals himself as a poacher, locks Burt in a cage and steals the eggs, only to be eaten by a huge Graboid with detachable tentacles that Burt dubs the "Queen Bitch". With help from Den's helicopter rockets, Burt destroys the nest, and on the way back Travis reveals that he is Burt's son, the result of a one-night stand in Florida forty years earlier. At the refuge, Nandi, Amahle and Baruti fend off further attacks and learn that Amahle has been hiding a Graboid egg, which is why the creatures keep coming. As the creature besieges the village, Nandi proposes using the daily thunderstorm: the villagers build a metal trap, and lightning destroys both the egg and the Queen Bitch. Burt accepts Travis as his son, and the two go on to co-host his show, hunting monsters around the world.

Released on October 6, 2015, the film divided critics, with some welcoming the series' revival and others calling it generic without its creators' humour. It earned about $2.7 million from domestic home video sales, and a sequel, Tremors: A Cold Day in Hell, followed in 2018.

overview: Zamperini returns to California where he wound up marrying Cynthia Applewhite while wrestling with untreated PTSD, suffering constant nightmares, angry, bitter and deeply depressed, his wife convinces Zamperini to attend the 1949 Billy Graham Crusade.
tagline: When the war ended, the battle began.
title: Unbroken: Path to Redemption
plot:
Unbroken: Path to Redemption is a 2018 American Christian drama directed by Harold Cronk and a sequel to the 2014 film Unbroken. Drawing on Laura Hillenbrand's bestselling book, it continues the true story of Olympic runner and World War II prisoner of war Louis Zamperini after his return home. Made on a far smaller budget than the first film, it brought back none of the original cast or crew except producer Matthew Baer and actors Vincenzo Amato and Maddalena Ischiale.

Back in America in the mid-1940s, Louie is celebrated as a hero but sees himself as anything but. Haunted by post-traumatic stress, he relives the beatings and humiliation inflicted by the prison camp guard known as "the Bird", whose voice in his head keeps telling him he is worthless, and his nightmares are easily triggered by sounds, smells or even a plate of rice. Sent on a cross-country fundraising tour for the military, he begins drinking. He falls for and marries Cynthia Applewhite, but a broken ankle ends his hopes of returning to the Olympics, he refuses menial work and squanders money, and he grows obsessed with going back to Japan to kill the Bird. As his alcoholism deepens he becomes angry and withdrawn, frightening Cynthia, who hides her pregnancy from him for two months. The birth of their daughter brings a brief respite, but his drinking and rages push the marriage to the brink, and Cynthia threatens divorce. Instead she attends Billy Graham's 1949 Los Angeles crusade and urges Louie to come. Reluctant because of hypocritical Christians he has known, he finally goes, remembers the promise he made to God while adrift at sea to serve Him if he survived, and gives his life to Christ. He stops drinking, recommits to his marriage, and years later returns to Tokyo to forgive his former captors in person; the Bird cannot be found, so Louie leaves him a Bible. Closing footage shows the real Zamperini giving his testimony and founding a camp for troubled boys.

Samuel Hunt plays Louie and Merritt Patterson plays Cynthia, with Bobby Campo as his brother Pete, David Sakurai as the Bird, Gary Cole, Bob Gunton, Vanessa Bell Calloway, and evangelist Will Graham portraying his own grandfather, Billy Graham. Pure Flix released it on September 14, 2018. Critics found it a dull, preachy drama, giving it 40% on Rotten Tomatoes, but audiences gave it an "A" CinemaScore, and it earned roughly its $6 million budget back.

overview: Three lighthouse keepers on an uninhabited island off the coast of Scotland discover something that isn't theirs to keep.
tagline: What's left when the light goes out?
title: The Vanishing
plot:
The Vanishing, previously titled Keepers, is a 2018 British psychological thriller directed by Kristoffer Nyholm in his feature debut and written by Celyn Jones and Joe Bone. Inspired by the unsolved disappearance of the Flannan Isles Lighthouse keepers in 1900, it stars Gerard Butler as James Ducat, Peter Mullan as Thomas Marshall and Connor Swindells as Donald McArthur, with Søren Malling and Gary Lewis in supporting roles.

The three keepers begin a six-week shift at the remote lighthouse. Donald, the youngest, is learning the job from the veterans: James, who has a family waiting on the mainland, and Thomas, still grieving the deaths of his wife and children. After a storm they find a wrecked boat, a body and a wooden chest washed ashore. Donald climbs down the cliff to check the man, who appears dead, but as the chest is hauled up the man revives and attacks him, and Donald kills him with a rock in self-defense. Thomas opens the chest alone and keeps quiet, but the others finally discover that it holds gold bars. Thomas proposes that they dispose of the body, smuggle the gold home and wait a year before dividing it.

Two strangers, Locke and Boor, crewmates of the dead man, arrive and question Thomas, who claims that the cargo was reported and collected. When the keepers fail to answer a radio call because their set is broken, the lie is exposed, and the men return at nightfall. In a violent struggle James strangles Boor and Donald kills Locke. Chasing another figure through the dark, James strikes him with a hook and is horrified to find he has killed a young boy, who reminds him of his own son. As suspicion grows, James retreats to the island's tiny chapel while Donald urges Thomas to leave with the gold. James returns apologizing, but then locks Thomas in the pantry and strangles Donald. Thomas breaks free and overpowers him, and the two set off in the strangers' boat. Unable to live with his guilt, James lowers himself into the sea and asks Thomas to help him die, and Thomas holds his head under the water before sailing on alone.

The film was announced in 2016, with Butler among its producers. It premiered at the Sitges Film Festival in October 2018 and was released in the United Kingdom in March 2019. Critics praised its suspenseful atmosphere, setting and cast, giving it 85% on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 64.

overview: Stuart, an adorable white mouse, still lives happily with his adoptive family, the Littles, on the east side of Manhattan's Central Park. More crazy mouse adventures are in store as Stuart, his human brother, George, and their mischievous cat, Snowbell, set out to rescue a friend.
tagline: A Little goes a long way.
title: Stuart Little 2
plot:
Stuart Little 2 is a 2002 American live-action/CGI comedy film directed by Rob Minkoff and written by John Hughes, based on the children's book series by E.B. White.

The movie begins with Stuart Little (voiced by George C. Scott), a talking mouse who lives with his family in New York City. The story takes place one year after the events of the first film. Stuart is now 7 years old and has grown into a more confident and adventurous mouse. He is excited to celebrate his birthday, but things take an unexpected turn when he discovers that his parents are planning a surprise party for him.

However, Stuart's excitement is short-lived as he soon learns that his evil uncle, Uncle Montgomery (voiced by Hugh Laurie), has arrived in New York City with the intention of kidnapping him. The reason behind this sinister plot is revealed to be a desire for revenge against Stuart's family, who had thwarted his plans in the first film.

As Stuart navigates through the city, he meets a new friend, Margalo (voiced by Christine Lakin), a beautiful and charming bird who becomes his love interest. Together, they embark on a thrilling adventure to outsmart Uncle Montgomery and save Stuart from danger.

Meanwhile, Stuart's parents are dealing with their own issues as they try to balance their careers and family life. His father, Mr. Little (voiced by George C. Scott), is struggling to find a new job after being laid off from his position at the toy company, while his mother, Mrs. Little (voiced by Christine Ebersole), is trying to manage the household and care for Stuart.

As the story unfolds, Stuart and Margalo face numerous challenges as they try to evade Uncle Montgomery's clutches. Along the way, they encounter a cast of colorful characters, including a wise-cracking pigeon named Snowbell (voiced by Jim Carrey) who becomes an ally in their quest.

In the end, Stuart and his friends successfully outwit Uncle Montgomery and save him from harm. The movie concludes with Stuart's birthday party being a huge success, and he finally finds happiness and fulfillment as he begins to explore the world beyond his family's home.

Overall, Stuart Little 2 is a heartwarming and entertaining film that explores themes of family, friendship, and growing up. With its lovable characters, witty humor, and exciting adventure sequences, it is sure to delight audiences of all ages.

original_title: ariana grande: excuse me, i love you
overview: Ariana Grande takes the stage in London for her Sweetener World Tour and shares a behind-the-scenes look at her life in rehearsal and on the road.
title: ariana grande: excuse me, i love you
plot:
Ariana Grande: Excuse Me, I Love You (styled in lowercase) is a 2020 American concert documentary directed by Paul Dugdale that follows the pop singer Ariana Grande on stage and behind the scenes during her 2019 Sweetener World Tour. It was executive produced by Grande together with Scooter Braun, Allison Kaye and Scott Manson of SB Projects and Jesse Ignjatovic and Evan Prager of Den of Thieves, with Samon Fisher, Liz Garbus and Dan Cogan among the producers. The audio of the tour had already been released a year earlier on the live album K Bye for Now (SWT Live).

Most of the performance footage was filmed at Grande's show at the O2 Arena in London. The concert portion runs through a 25-song set list, opening with "Raindrops (An Angel Cried)" and "God Is a Woman" and including "Bad Idea", "Break Up with Your Girlfriend, I'm Bored", "R.E.M.", "7 Rings", "Breathin", "Needy", "NASA", "Into You", "Dangerous Woman", "Break Free" and "No Tears Left to Cry", before closing with "Thank U, Next". Between songs the film cuts to candid moments away from the stage, showing Grande with her dancers, band and crew such as Scott and Brian Nicholson, as well as rehearsals, preparations and casual conversations on the road, presenting a playful and affectionate side of the singer and her team.

Grande announced the film on social media in early December 2020, and Netflix released the trailer a few days later, along with themed profile icons for subscribers. It premiered on Netflix on 21 December 2020, marking the first anniversary of the tour's final show. Critical response was mixed to positive: Metacritic gave it a weighted score of 70 based on four reviews, while Rotten Tomatoes reported a 50% approval rating. The New York Times praised Grande's charming and relatable presence and the film's unguarded moments, and NME awarded four stars, describing it as euphoric pure pop even if it is not especially revealing. Mashable called it a gift to fans that recalled the days before the COVID-19 pandemic but regretted the lack of deeper rehearsal or songwriting footage. IndieWire gave it a C, likening it to a commercial for a polished product, and Common Sense Media felt the meticulously staged show and superficial chats offered little real insight into Grande's personality.

overview: A couple's camping trip turns into a frightening ordeal when they stumble across the scene of a horrific crime.
tagline: A remote campsite. An abandoned tent. A romantic getaway to die for.
title: Killing Ground
plot:
Killing Ground is a 2017 Australian survival horror film directed by Tim Wise. The movie follows two young women, Aimee and Sarah, who embark on a solo canoeing trip through the Northern Territory's rugged wilderness. As they navigate the unforgiving terrain, they become stranded in the middle of nowhere with limited supplies.

The main theme of Killing Ground is the struggle for survival against the harsh environment and the psychological effects it has on the characters. The film masterfully builds tension as Aimee and Sarah face numerous challenges, including treacherous terrain, scorching heat, and a lack of resources. As they fight to stay alive, their mental state begins to deteriorate, and they are forced to confront their deepest fears.

The movie also explores the theme of vulnerability and the fragility of human life in the face of nature's fury. The characters' isolation and disconnection from civilization make them more susceptible to the dangers that surround them, highlighting the delicate balance between humanity and the natural world.

Furthermore, Killing Ground touches on the idea of female empowerment and the challenges women face when venturing into male-dominated territories. Aimee and Sarah are both strong-willed individuals who must rely on each other to survive, but their experiences also reveal the societal expectations and biases that can hinder women's ability to navigate and thrive in these environments.

Overall, Killing Ground is a gripping survival horror film that expertly weaves together themes of survival, vulnerability, and female empowerment, creating a tense and unsettling viewing experience.

overview: Samantha MacKenzie, the daughter of the president of the United States, arrives at college with a group of Secret Service agents. Samantha, however, resents their presence and decides she wants to attend school just like a normal student. Her father agrees to recall the agents but secretly assigns James, an undercover agent, to pose as a student. They fall in love, but their romance is jeopardized when Samantha learns James' true identity.
tagline: The girl who always stood out is finally getting the chance to fit in.
title: First Daughter
plot:
First Daughter is a 2004 American romantic comedy film directed by Bryan Singer and produced by Davis Entertainment.

The movie follows the story of Mackenzie Allen (played by Katie Holmes), the daughter of the President of the United States, who is struggling to balance her life as a high school student with her responsibilities as the First Daughter. When Mackenzie's boyfriend, Will Cooper (played by Alec Baldwin), becomes the new White House Chief of Staff, she must navigate the complexities of her father's presidency while also dealing with her own feelings and relationships.

The main themes of First Daughter include:

1. Identity Crisis: Mackenzie's struggle to balance her life as a high school student with her responsibilities as the First Daughter serves as a metaphor for the challenges of growing up and finding one's identity.
2. Family Dynamics: The movie explores the complexities of family relationships, particularly between Mackenzie and her father, who is portrayed as a loving but overprotective parent.
3. Love and Relationships: The film focuses on Mackenzie's romance with Will Cooper, which serves as a catalyst for her growth and self-discovery.
4. Politics and Power: As the First Daughter, Mackenzie is exposed to the inner workings of the White House and the pressures of being in the public eye.

Overall, First Daughter is a lighthearted and entertaining film that explores themes of identity, family, love, and power in a humorous and relatable way.

overview: While doing a series of reports on alternative energy sources, opportunistic reporter Kimberly Wells witnesses an accident at a nuclear power plant. Wells is determined to publicize the incident, but soon finds herself entangled in a sinister conspiracy to keep the full impact of the incident a secret.
tagline: Sometimes it’s too late to tell the truth.
title: The China Syndrome
plot:
The China Syndrome is a thought-provoking drama that explores the darker aspects of human nature and the consequences of unchecked ambition. At its core, the film delves into the theme of corporate greed and the exploitation of power. The story revolves around a nuclear power plant accident, which serves as a catalyst for the characters' descent into chaos.

As the narrative unfolds, it becomes clear that the true enemy is not the nuclear reactor itself, but rather the system that enables its operation. The film critiques the prioritization of profits over safety and the willingness to sacrifice human lives for the sake of economic gain. This theme is expertly woven throughout the story, often through the character's interactions with the plant's management.

The China Syndrome also touches on the idea of media manipulation and the role of journalists in holding those in power accountable. The film's portrayal of a sensationalized news cycle that prioritizes ratings over truth serves as a commentary on the state of modern journalism.

Furthermore, the movie explores the theme of female empowerment and the struggles faced by women in male-dominated industries. The character of Kelly Curtis, played by Jane Fonda, is a strong and determined individual who refuses to be silenced or marginalized. Her story serves as a powerful allegory for the challenges faced by women in the workplace.

Ultimately, The China Syndrome is a cautionary tale that warns of the dangers of unchecked ambition and the importance of accountability in power structures. Through its thought-provoking narrative and well-developed characters, the film continues to resonate with audiences today, offering a commentary on the human condition that remains relevant and timely.

overview: A slick New York publicist who picks up a ringing receiver in a phone booth is told that if he hangs up, he'll be killed... and the little red light from a laser rifle sight is proof that the caller isn't kidding.
tagline: No options. No lies. No fear. No deals. Just keep talking.
title: Phone Booth
plot:
Phone Booth is a psychological thriller film directed by Joel Schumacher, released in 2002 (not 2003) by Fox 2000 Pictures. The movie stars Colin Farrell as Stu Shepard, a radio talk show host who finds himself trapped in his phone booth during a hijacking.

The story begins with Stu Shepard, a successful and arrogant radio talk show host, who is on the air at 4:00 AM, discussing current events and taking calls from listeners. As he's about to wrap up his show, a man, played by Kiefer Sutherland, enters the booth and takes Stu hostage, claiming that he has a bomb strapped to his body.

The hijacker, who is revealed to be a former Marine named Phil (Sutherland), demands that Stu call 911 and report his location. However, when Stu tries to call for help, he realizes that his phone is dead, and the only way to get out of the booth is to answer Phil's demands.

As the situation escalates, Stu begins to realize that Phil is not just a random hijacker but someone who has a personal vendetta against him. Through a series of flashbacks, it becomes clear that Stu was responsible for Phil's wife's death in a car accident several years ago.

Throughout the film, Stu tries to negotiate with Phil, while also trying to find ways to escape. He uses his radio show as an opportunity to manipulate Phil and try to get him to reveal more about himself. Meanwhile, Detective Bannion (Kiefer Sutherland) is investigating a series of hijackings across the city, unaware that he's dealing with the same person.

As the standoff continues, Stu begins to question his own morality and the consequences of his actions. He starts to feel guilty for not taking responsibility for Phil's wife's death and begins to see himself as a victim of circumstance.

In the end, Stu manages to outsmart Phil by using his radio show to lure him into a trap. However, just as it seems like Stu has escaped, he realizes that he may have made things worse for himself. The film ends with Stu being taken away by police, but not before he reflects on the events of the night and the consequences of his actions.

Overall, Phone Booth is a tense and suspenseful thriller that explores themes of guilt, responsibility, and redemption. Colin Farrell delivers a strong performance as Stu Shepard, bringing depth and nuance to a complex character. The film's twist ending adds an extra layer of complexity to the story, leaving audiences questioning what really happened in the phone booth that night.

overview: On the 100th anniversary of the original voyage, a modern luxury liner christened "Titanic 2," follows the path of its namesake. But when a tsunami hurls an ice berg into the new ship's path, the passengers and crew must fight to avoid a similar fate.
tagline: 100 years later, lightning strikes twice.
title: Titanic II
plot:
Titanic II is a 2010 American disaster drama film written and directed by Shane Van Dyke, who also stars, and distributed by The Asylum. Not a sequel to the 1997 film, it is set aboard a fictional replica of the famous liner that sails exactly a century after the original's maiden voyage, only for global warming and the forces of nature to make history repeat itself on the same night on an even deadlier scale. Van Dyke plays the ship's owner and designer Hayden Walsh, with Marie Westbrook as the nurse Amy Maine, Bruce Davison as her father, Coast Guard Captain James Maine, Michelle Glavan as her fellow nurse Kelly Wade, D. C. Douglas as the ship's captain Will Howard and Brooke Burns as the glaciologist Dr. Kim Patterson.

Off the Helheim Glacier in Greenland, a surfer riding waves created by falling ice is overwhelmed and drowns. Captain Maine is sent to investigate with Dr. Patterson, and while they are there another enormous mass of ice collapses into the ocean. On April 10, 2012, a hundred years after the RMS Titanic set sail, the new Titanic II begins its maiden voyage along the same route in reverse, from New York to Southampton. Mid-Atlantic, Maine warns the crew of an approaching tsunami that will drive ice before it. As the ship races for shore one engine is damaged, and the wave and a giant iceberg slam into the vessel, crushing its starboard side and lifeboat ramps and injuring many passengers. Hayden and Amy find Kelly badly hurt below decks, while another glacier unleashes a still larger tsunami. Strain on the turbines causes an explosion that kills many aboard, including Captain Howard, and sets the sinking ship ablaze. Maine calls his daughter to warn her of the second wave and tells her to avoid the lifeboats and head for the onboard diving facility. Kelly is crushed by a heavy door before they get there. The second wave capsizes the ship and destroys the lifeboats, and with only one oxygen tank and diving suit available, Hayden gives them to Amy, kisses her and asks her to try to revive him if he drowns. Maine swims into the sinking ship to rescue them, but Amy's attempt to resuscitate Hayden comes too late; she and the injured passengers Hayden had sent away by helicopter are the only known survivors.

First shown on television in Australia on August 7, 2010, and released in the United States that month, the film was poorly received, though the cast, especially Davison, drew praise. A sequel, Titanic 666, followed in 2022.

overview: Four boyhood friends return to New Orleans’ Lower Ninth Ward after Hurricane Katrina, to find their home decimated and prospects for work swept away. Turning to a local gangster for employment, the crew is hired to pull off a daring casino heist, right in the heart of the city.
tagline: Desperate times. Dangerous measures.
title: Cut Throat City
plot:
Cut Throat City is a 2020 American crime drama film directed by Ramin Bahrani. The movie takes place in New York City during the 1970s and follows the story of four friends who are struggling to make ends meet.

The main theme of Cut Throat City revolves around the struggle for survival and the consequences of desperation. The characters, all from different walks of life, find themselves entangled in a web of crime and violence as they try to escape their bleak circumstances. As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that the characters' actions are driven by a desire to break free from the constraints of their lives.

The film also explores the theme of loyalty and friendship, highlighting the strong bonds between the four main characters. Despite their differences, they find solace in each other's company, which ultimately becomes a source of strength and motivation for them.

Furthermore, Cut Throat City touches on the idea of social inequality and the struggles faced by those living on the margins of society. The film portrays a gritty and unromanticized portrayal of life in New York City during the 1970s, where opportunities are scarce and violence is ever-present.

Overall, Cut Throat City is a gripping and intense drama that delves into the darker aspects of human nature, exploring themes of survival, loyalty, and social inequality.

overview: Blindsided by a new generation of blazing-fast racers, the legendary Lightning McQueen is suddenly pushed out of the sport he loves. To get back in the game, he will need the help of an eager young race technician with her own plan to win, inspiration from the late Fabulous Hudson Hornet, and a few unexpected turns. Proving that #95 isn't through yet will test the heart of a champion on Piston Cup Racing’s biggest stage!
tagline: It's not over until lightning strikes.
title: Cars 3
plot:
In Cars 3, Lightning McQueen (voiced by Owen Wilson) is nearing the end of his racing career. He's struggling to find his place on the track and feeling like he's lost his edge. The film takes a different approach from its predecessors, focusing more on the emotional journey of the main character.

As Lightning McQueen faces retirement, he meets Jackson Storm (voiced by Armie Hammer), a young and cocky racing prodigy who becomes the new face of speed. This sparks a rivalry between the two, with Lightning McQueen feeling threatened by Jackson's talent and charisma.

Meanwhile, Lightning McQueen reconnects with his old friend Doc Hudson (voiced by Paul Newman) and learns valuable lessons about life beyond racing. He also meets Cruz Ramirez (voiced by Cristela Alonzo), a talented but struggling racing instructor who becomes his new mentor.

As the story unfolds, Lightning McQueen faces personal struggles and self-doubt, forcing him to reevaluate his priorities and find a new sense of purpose. The film explores themes of identity, friendship, and finding one's true passion in life.

One of the standout aspects of Cars 3 is its portrayal of aging and retirement. The film tackles these complex emotions with sensitivity and nuance, avoiding simplistic or sentimental portrayals. Instead, it presents a realistic and relatable exploration of what it means to grow older and find new meaning in life.

The animation is also noteworthy, with stunning visuals that bring the world of Radiator Springs to life. The action sequences are thrilling, but it's the quieter moments between characters that truly shine.

Overall, Cars 3 is a heartwarming and thought-provoking film that explores themes of identity, friendship, and finding one's true purpose. While it may not be as flashy or action-packed as its predecessors, it's a satisfying conclusion to Lightning McQueen's story arc.

overview: In present-day Nicaragua, a headstrong American journalist and a mysterious English businessman strike up a romance as they become embroiled in a dangerous labyrinth of lies and conspiracies and are forced to try and escape the country.
tagline: A sumptuous tale of romance and espionage.
title: Stars at Noon
plot:
Stars at Noon is a 2022 film that explores the complexities of human relationships and the blurred lines between love, desire, and exploitation in a patriarchal society. The movie delves into the intricate dynamics of power and control, particularly in the context of colonialism and imperialism.

The story revolves around two characters, Hana and Jake, who form an intense connection in a small town in Africa. As their relationship deepens, it becomes increasingly complicated by the power imbalance between them, with Jake holding significant economic and social influence over Hana. The film raises questions about consent, agency, and the ways in which societal structures can both enable and constrain individual freedom.

Through its portrayal of this complex relationship, Stars at Noon critiques the ways in which colonialism and imperialism have shaped the lives of women in Africa, often leaving them vulnerable to exploitation and oppression. The movie also touches on themes of identity, culture, and belonging, highlighting the tensions that arise when individuals from different backgrounds and social classes interact.

Ultimately, Stars at Noon presents a nuanced and thought-provoking exploration of the human condition, one that challenges viewers to confront their own assumptions about power, desire, and relationships.

overview: When aspiring model Jesse moves to Los Angeles, her youth and vitality are devoured by a group of beauty-obsessed women who will take any means necessary to get what she has.
tagline: Beauty is vicious.
title: The Neon Demon
plot:
The Neon Demon is an arthouse horror film of 2016 directed by Nicolas Winding Refn, who wrote it with Mary Laws and Polly Stenham, following a teenage model whose beauty provokes obsession and envy in the Los Angeles fashion world. Elle Fanning stars as Jesse, with Karl Glusman as the photographer Dean, Jena Malone as the make-up artist Ruby, Bella Heathcote and Abbey Lee as the models Gigi and Sarah, Christina Hendricks as agency owner Roberta Hoffman, Alessandro Nivola as designer Robert Sarno and Keanu Reeves as the motel manager Hank.

Jesse, a sixteen-year-old orphan, has just arrived in Los Angeles from a small town in Georgia to become a model. Through a first shoot with Dean she meets Ruby, who introduces her to the older models Gigi and Sarah. Roberta signs her, tells her to say she is nineteen, and sends her to the celebrated photographer Jack McCarther. That night Jesse returns from a date with Dean, who is interested in her as a person, to find that a cougar has wrecked her motel room; the leering owner, Hank, demands payment, which Dean covers. Jack photographs her naked and painted in gold, and the shoot's success deepens the older models' envy. At a casting for Sarno, the designer ignores Sarah and is captivated by Jesse. When Sarah asks how it feels to be the one everyone wants and Jesse replies that it is everything, Sarah lunges at her; Jesse cuts her hand on broken glass, and Sarah sucks the blood.

Jesse closes Sarno's show amid hallucinations of triangles and mirrored reflections of herself, and afterwards, as Sarno tells Dean that beauty is the only thing that matters, she rejects Dean, having embraced a new narcissism. After a nightmare about Hank and the sound of someone trying her door, she hears an intruder attack the young girl in the next room and flees to Ruby's house. There she rejects Ruby's advances and reveals that she is a virgin. Later, at the house, Ruby, Gigi and Sarah pursue Jesse, push her into an empty swimming pool, kill her and devour parts of her body, bathing in her blood. At a shoot the next day, Jack is suddenly fascinated by Sarah, but Gigi, overcome with sickness, vomits up one of Jesse's eyes and, crying that she must get Jesse out of her, stabs herself fatally with scissors. Sarah swallows the eye and returns to work.

A French, Danish and American co-production, the film was in competition for the Palme d'Or at Cannes in 2016. Critics were divided, giving it 59% on Rotten Tomatoes.

overview: Lured by the promise of an Australian holiday, backpackers Rutger, Katarina and Paul visit the notorious Wolf Creek Crater.  Their dream Outback adventure soon becomes a horrific reality when they encounter the site's most infamous local, the last man any traveller to the region ever wants to meet—Mick Taylor.  As the backpackers flee, Mick pursues them on an epic white knuckled rampage across hostile wasteland.
tagline: The outback can be crazy this time of year.
title: Wolf Creek 2
plot:
Wolf Creek 2 is a 2013 Australian horror film directed by Greg McLean, not South Australian Film Corporation.

The movie follows the story of Sarah Levene, a young American woman who becomes the latest victim of Mick Taylor, the same serial killer from the first film. The main themes of Wolf Creek 2 include:

1. Revenge and Retribution: Mick Taylor's actions are driven by a desire for revenge against those he perceives as having wronged him in the past.
2. Survival and Resilience: Sarah Levene must use her wits and resourcefulness to survive the brutal attacks of Mick Taylor, who is determined to kill her.
3. Trauma and PTSD: The film explores the psychological effects of trauma on its characters, particularly Sarah Levene, who has experienced a traumatic event in her past.
4. The Nature of Evil: The movie raises questions about the nature of evil and whether people are born with it or if it is something that can be learned.

The plot development of Wolf Creek 2 follows Sarah Levene as she tries to escape from Mick Taylor, who is determined to kill her. Along the way, she encounters other characters who become embroiled in her ordeal, including a group of travelers who take her in and try to help her evade Mick.

The ending of Wolf Creek 2 is intense and suspenseful, with Sarah Levene facing off against Mick Taylor in a final confrontation. The film's conclusion is both shocking and thought-provoking, leaving the audience to ponder the nature of evil and the consequences of Mick's actions.

Overall, Wolf Creek 2 is a tense and unsettling horror film that explores themes of revenge, survival, trauma, and the nature of evil.

overview: Los Angeles, June 21st, 2028. While the streets are being torn apart by riots, the Nurse, who runs a clandestine hospital for criminals in the penthouse of the Artemis, a closed old hotel, has a rough night dealing with troublemaker clients: thieves, assassins, someone from the past and the one who owns the place and the whole city.
tagline: No guns. No cops. No killing the other patients.
title: Hotel Artemis
plot:
Hotel Artemis is a thought-provoking sci-fi thriller that delves into the darker aspects of human nature and the consequences of playing with fire when it comes to advanced technology. The film takes place in a dystopian future where a group of high-stakes thieves, con artists, and assassins are forced to live in a secret underground hospital called Hotel Artemis.

At its core, Hotel Artemis is a cautionary tale about the dangers of unchecked ambition and the blurred lines between right and wrong. The film's protagonist, Jake Penton (played by Jodie Foster), is a complex and multifaceted character who embodies both the vulnerability and resilience of humanity in the face of adversity.

As the story unfolds, Hotel Artemis explores themes of identity, community, and the struggle for power and control. The hospital becomes a microcosm of society, where characters are forced to navigate their own moral compasses and confront the consequences of their actions. Through its intricate plot and complex characters, the film raises questions about what it means to be human in a world where technology is rapidly changing the rules.

Ultimately, Hotel Artemis is a gripping and thought-provoking thriller that challenges viewers to consider the implications of our choices and the importance of empathy and compassion in a world that often seems determined to tear us apart.

overview: Peter is thrilled that his Grandpa is coming to live with his family. That is, until Grandpa moves into Peter's room, forcing him upstairs into the creepy attic. And though he loves his Grandpa, he wants his room back - so he has no choice but to declare war.
tagline: Old school vs new cool
title: The War with Grandpa
plot:
The War with Grandpa is a 2020 American comedy film directed by Matt Lillard and written by Oren Uziel. The movie stars Robert De Niro, Oakes Fegley, and Julia De Fiore.

The main themes of The War with Grandpa revolve around the complexities of family relationships, generational differences, and the challenges of growing up. Here's a brief overview:

Beginning: The story begins with 12-year-old Peter (Oakes Fegley) who is struggling to cope with his grandfather's recent move in with him and his mother. His grandfather, Grandpa Paul (Robert De Niro), is a feisty and eccentric man who refuses to adapt to modern technology or societal norms.

Plot Development: As the story unfolds, Peter and Grandpa Paul engage in an escalating series of pranks and battles, which become increasingly intense and childish. However, beneath their bickering and rivalry lies a deeper emotional connection between the two characters. Through their interactions, we see glimpses of their shared past and the bond that exists between them.

Ending: Ultimately, The War with Grandpa is a heartwarming tale about the power of love, acceptance, and understanding. As Peter and Grandpa Paul navigate their differences, they learn to appreciate each other's unique perspectives and find common ground. The film concludes on a hopeful note, suggesting that even in the most unlikely of relationships, there can be a deep and abiding connection.

Throughout the movie, Robert De Niro brings his signature wit and charm to the role of Grandpa Paul, while Oakes Fegley delivers a relatable and endearing performance as Peter. The film's themes of family, love, and acceptance make it a delightful and entertaining watch for audiences of all ages.

original_title: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
overview: Frodo and Sam are trekking to Mordor to destroy the One Ring of Power while Gimli, Legolas and Aragorn search for the orc-captured Merry and Pippin. All along, nefarious wizard Saruman awaits the Fellowship members at the Orthanc Tower in Isengard.
tagline: A New Power Is Rising.
title: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
plot:
The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers is an epic fantasy film of 2002 directed by Peter Jackson, the second part of his trilogy adapted from J. R. R. Tolkien's The Lord of the Rings, written by Fran Walsh, Philippa Boyens, Stephen Sinclair and Jackson. Elijah Wood returns as Frodo, with Sean Astin as Sam, Andy Serkis as Gollum, Viggo Mortensen as Aragorn, Ian McKellen as Gandalf, Orlando Bloom as Legolas, John Rhys-Davies as Gimli, Bernard Hill as King Théoden, Christopher Lee as Saruman and David Wenham as Faramir.

Frodo and Sam are lost in the rocky Emyn Muil. They capture Gollum, a former bearer of the One Ring, and Frodo, moved to pity, lets him guide them toward Mordor despite Sam's distrust. Aragorn, Legolas and Gimli chase the Uruk-hai who seized Merry and Pippin into Rohan, where riders under Éomer, exiled by a king under the sway of Saruman and Wormtongue, destroy the orcs; the hobbits escape into Fangorn Forest. There the three hunters meet Gandalf, returned from death after slaying the Balrog. At Edoras he frees Théoden from Saruman's control, and the king leads his people to Helm's Deep. On the way, Éowyn falls for Aragorn, who falls in a wolf-rider attack and is presumed dead, but survives. In Rivendell, Elrond persuades Arwen to leave Middle-earth, while Galadriel convinces him to send elves to aid Rohan.

In Fangorn, Merry and Pippin befriend Treebeard, an Ent. When the Ent council declines to join the war, Pippin leads Treebeard past the forests Saruman has felled, and the furious Ents storm Isengard, flooding it and trapping Saruman in his tower. At Helm's Deep, the outnumbered defenders are joined by elves under Haldir, but the Uruk-hai blast through the wall and Haldir falls. Aragorn persuades Théoden to ride out in a last charge at dawn, when Gandalf and Éomer arrive with the Rohirrim and rout the enemy. Meanwhile Gollum steers Frodo and Sam away from the Black Gate, and the hobbits are captured by Faramir, Boromir's younger brother, who learns of the Ring and resolves to take it to his father in Gondor. In the ruins of Osgiliath a Nazgûl nearly seizes Frodo, until Sam saves him and reminds him there is still good worth fighting for. Faramir lets them go, but Gollum, feeling betrayed, plots to lead them to "her" at Cirith Ungol and reclaim the Ring.

Released in December 2002, the film grossed $923 million worldwide, the highest of the year. It won Academy Awards for visual effects and sound editing and was nominated for Best Picture.

overview: Strangers June and Charlie have to learn to coexist when they accidentally book the same Airbnb to get away from the pandemic. Alone Together is the ultimate New York lockdown love story.
tagline: A New York lockdown lovestory.
title: Alone Together
plot:
Alone Together is a 2022 American romantic drama written and directed by Katie Holmes, her second feature as a director, who also stars in it alongside Jim Sturgess and Derek Luke. Melissa Leo, Zosia Mamet and Becky Ann Baker play supporting roles. Holmes wrote the script at the very start of the COVID-19 lockdown in 2020 and produced it through her company Lafayette Pictures with Jordan Yale Levine, Jordan Beckerman and Jesse Korman of Yale Productions and Shaun Sanghani of SSS Entertainment.

The story opens with a montage of June, a Manhattan restaurant critic, enjoying a glamorous life of parties and lavish meals with her boyfriend John. In mid-March 2020, as the city shuts down and panic spreads, she sets out for a rental house in upstate New York that John has booked for the two of them. Train service has been cut, so she takes a Lyft, and on the way John texts that he will not join her after all because he wants to stay in the city with his worried parents. When June reaches the house she finds the lights on and a stranger, Charlie, already living there: the property has been double-booked, apparently because its owners are in the middle of a messy divorce.

With nowhere else to go, the two agree to share the house. June is a polished, type-A transplant who has made New York her identity; Charlie, a native New Yorker who restores old motorcycles and, as he puts it, just about anything, is at first wary of her haughty manner. Their prickly coexistence gradually warms as they cook, drink, sing karaoke, play games, sewing masks out of cloth and shoelaces as news reports mark the passing weeks of the pandemic. They confide in one another about their families, comfort each other through personal losses and encourage each other's ambitions. As the bond deepens into romance, June must eventually confront her unresolved relationship with John.

Alone Together had its world premiere in the Tribeca Film Festival's Spotlight Narrative section on July 14, 2022, and Vertical Entertainment released it theatrically in the United States on July 22, followed by video on demand a week later. Reviews were mostly negative, with about 28 percent of critics on Rotten Tomatoes rating it positively. The Hollywood Reporter found it a predictable but sweet and disarming time capsule of the early pandemic, praising the leads' easy chemistry, while RogerEbert.com faulted its heavy-handed, overly predictable script and thin characters.

overview: A man looking for the release of a long-time prisoner takes a police officer, his daughter, and a group of strangers hostage.
title: Police Story: Lockdown
plot:
Police Story: Lockdown, released in China as Police Story 2013, is a 2013 Chinese-Hong Kong neo-noir action thriller written and directed by Ding Sheng, who had previously made Jackie Chan's Little Big Soldier. The sixth installment and another reboot of the Police Story series, it casts Chan not as a Hong Kong cop, as in the earlier films, but as a police officer from mainland China, and like New Police Story it stands alone with a much darker tone than the comedic originals.

Detective Zhong Wen goes to Wu Bar, a nightclub, to see his estranged daughter Miao Miao, who is dating its owner, Wu Jiang, and the two argue over the relationship. Before he can make peace with her, Zhong is knocked out and wakes up tied to a chair with wire, as Wu reveals himself as the mastermind of a hostage-taking that traps the bar's customers, Miao among them. Wu demands a ransom from the police and a meeting with the prisoner Wei Xiaofu. Breaking free, Zhong finds Wu's secret room, filled with pictures of a teenage girl and of Wu as a young kickboxer nicknamed "Spider", along with plans showing that he has wired the bar with explosives. Recaptured when Wu threatens to plunge Miao's hand into a tank of piranhas, Zhong wins the release of three hostages by beating one of Wu's fighters despite a broken finger, and then brings Wei to the bar.

Wu explains that Zhong, Wei and several hostages all witnessed the death of his younger sister years earlier, when Wei, trying to steal medicine for his mother, held her at knifepoint in a pharmacy and the pregnant girl killed herself with his blade. Zhong had arrived but could not save her, and the bartender reveals that he was her boyfriend. When the police storm the club, the bombs go off and Wu escapes with Miao into a subway tunnel. There he offers Zhong a choice between shooting himself to save his daughter or shooting Wu. Zhong pulls the trigger on himself, but the gun is empty, and Wu, satisfied, releases Miao and stands before an oncoming train, which is switched onto another track at the last moment. Wu is arrested, and Zhong reconciles with his daughter.

Jackie Chan plays Zhong Wen, with Liu Ye as Wu Jiang and Jing Tian as Miao Miao. Filmed in Beijing from November 2012 to February 2013, it was shown at the Beijing International Film Festival and released in China on 24 December 2013. Well Go USA distributed it in the United States as Police Story: Lockdown in June 2015. Reviews were mixed, with a 44 on Metacritic.

overview: Queen Poppy and Branch make a surprising discovery — there are other Troll worlds beyond their own, and their distinct differences create big clashes between these various tribes. When a mysterious threat puts all of the Trolls across the land in danger, Poppy, Branch, and their band of friends must embark on an epic quest to create harmony among the feuding Trolls to unite them against certain doom.
title: Trolls World Tour
plot:
Trolls World Tour is a 2020 musical comedy film directed by Mike Mitchell and written by Aaron Seltzer, Scott Mosier, and Jennifer Peña. The movie serves as a sequel to the 2016 animated film Trolls.

The story begins with Poppy (voiced by Anna Kendrick), the optimistic leader of the Trolls, who is preparing for the annual "Trollstice" celebration. However, their festivities are disrupted when Queen Barb (voiced by Rachel Bloom), the ruler of the hard rock trolls, threatens to destroy all other music genres and rule over a world where only hard rock music exists.

Barb's plan is to steal the magical song that gives each genre its unique sound, which she believes will make her the most powerful troll in the land. Poppy teams up with Branch (voiced by Justin Timberlake), her grumpy but lovable companion, to stop Barb and save all the other music genres.

Their journey takes them to different parts of the world, where they meet various musical groups from different genres, including country, jazz, classical, and hip-hop. Along the way, Poppy and Branch encounter new friends, such as Prince D (voiced by Anderson .Paak), a smooth-talking prince who joins their quest.

As they travel through these different worlds, the Trolls learn about the unique characteristics of each genre and how music brings people together. However, Barb's plan is to use the magical song to dominate all other genres and rule over the world.

The movie features an impressive array of musical numbers, showcasing a wide range of genres and styles. The film's soundtrack includes original songs by various artists, such as Anderson .Paak, Sia, and Charli XCX.

In the end, Poppy and Branch successfully stop Barb from stealing the magical song, and all the music genres come together to celebrate their differences and unity. The movie concludes with a grand musical number featuring all the Trolls and their new friends, celebrating the power of music to bring people together.

Overall, Trolls World Tour is a fun and colorful film that celebrates the diversity of music and the importance of embracing our individuality. While it may not be as strong as its predecessor, the movie still delivers plenty of laughs, catchy musical numbers, and heartwarming moments.

overview: Axel heads for the land of sunshine and palm trees to find out who shot police Captain Andrew Bogomil. Thanks to a couple of old friends, Axel's investigation uncovers a series of robberies masterminded by a heartless weapons kingpin—and the chase is on.
tagline: The Heat's Back On!
title: Beverly Hills Cop II
plot:
Beverly Hills Cop II is a 1987 American action comedy film directed by Tony Scott and starring Eddie Murphy as Axel Foley, a Detroit cop who goes undercover to solve a murder case in Beverly Hills.

The movie begins with Axel Foley (Eddie Murphy) returning to Beverly Hills after the events of the first film. He's greeted as a hero by his friend Billy Rosewood (Judge Reinhold), but Axel soon discovers that the city is being terrorized by a group of Russian mobsters, led by Viktor Kuznetsov (Brion James). The Russians are using their wealth and influence to buy up properties in Beverly Hills, and Axel suspects that they're behind a series of murders.

Axel teams up with Billy Rosewood again, as well as a new partner, Rosewood's girlfriend, Julie (Glynn Turman), who is also an undercover cop. Together, they try to gather evidence against the Russians, but their efforts are hindered by Kuznetsov's henchmen and the corrupt Beverly Hills police department.

As Axel delves deeper into the case, he discovers that Kuznetsov is using his wealth and influence to buy up properties in Beverly Hills, including a valuable piece of land that would give him control over the city. Axel also learns that Kuznetsov has a personal vendetta against him, which makes their confrontation even more intense.

The plot thickens as Axel and his team discover that the murders are all connected to a larger scheme by Kuznetsov to take over Beverly Hills. They also uncover a mole within the police department who is working with Kuznetsov, adding an extra layer of complexity to the case.

In the climax of the film, Axel confronts Kuznetsov in a thrilling showdown at a nightclub. The two engage in a fierce battle, but Axel ultimately emerges victorious, having solved the case and brought the Russian mobsters to justice.

Throughout the film, Eddie Murphy's signature blend of humor and action is on full display. His chemistry with Judge Reinhold is still evident, and their banter provides some of the film's funniest moments. The movie also features a memorable performance by Brion James as the villainous Kuznetsov.

Overall, Beverly Hills Cop II is an entertaining sequel that builds on the success of the first film. It offers plenty of action, humor, and excitement, making it a classic 80s comedy.

overview: Snoopy embarks upon his greatest mission as he and his team take to the skies to pursue their arch-nemesis, while his best pal Charlie Brown begins his own epic quest.
tagline: The story of an underdog. And his dog.
title: The Peanuts Movie
plot:
The Peanuts Movie is a computer-animated comedy-drama film released in 2015 by 20th Century Fox. The movie is based on the popular comic strip Peanuts created by Charles M. Schulz.

The story begins with Charlie Brown, a lovable but hapless boy who struggles to find his place in the world. He is constantly plagued by self-doubt and insecurity, which makes him feel like an outcast among his peers. Despite this, Charlie Brown has a loyal group of friends, including Snoopy, Lucy, Linus, Sally, and Peppermint Patty.

The movie opens with Charlie Brown trying to kick the football that Lucy is holding, only for her to pull it away at the last second, leaving him feeling defeated once again. This scene sets the tone for the rest of the film, which explores themes of friendship, perseverance, and the struggles of growing up.

As the story progresses, Charlie Brown becomes determined to win the heart of the Little Red-Haired Girl, a girl who he has had a crush on since childhood. He enlists the help of his friends, but their efforts are met with failure after failure. Meanwhile, Snoopy's wild imagination runs amok, and he becomes convinced that he is a World War I flying ace.

Throughout the movie, Charlie Brown faces various challenges, including a disastrous baseball game, a failed attempt to impress the Little Red-Haired Girl, and a confrontation with the infamous "blockhead" bully. Despite these setbacks, Charlie Brown perseveres, and his friends rally around him in support.

One of the standout aspects of The Peanuts Movie is its faithfulness to the original comic strip. The film's animation style is reminiscent of Schulz's classic artwork, and many of the characters' personalities and quirks are preserved from the comics.

The movie's climax features Charlie Brown's iconic kite-flying scene, which has become an iconic moment in the Peanuts franchise. In this scene, Charlie Brown finally finds success with his kite, and it soars high into the air, symbolizing his triumph over adversity.

In the end, Charlie Brown comes to realize that true happiness and fulfillment come from within, rather than from external validation or material possessions. The movie concludes on a heartwarming note, with Charlie Brown surrounded by his friends and family, who have accepted him for who he is.

Overall, The Peanuts Movie is a charming and entertaining film that captures the spirit of childhood innocence and friendship. With its lovable characters, witty humor, and poignant themes, it's a must-see for fans of all ages.

original_title: 七つの大罪: 怨嗟のエジンバラ
overview: Tristan, the son of Meliodas and Elizabeth, inherits the power of the Goddess Clan and can heal people’s wounds and injuries, but he often ends up hurting others due to his inability to control his Demon Clan power. To protect his family, Tristan heads to Edinburgh Castle and meets a host of new friends along the way.
title: The Seven Deadly Sins: Grudge of Edinburgh Part 1
plot:
The Seven Deadly Sins: Grudge of Edinburgh Part 1 is a 2022 Japanese computer-animated fantasy action film directed by Bob Shirahata from a screenplay by Rintarō Ikeda. Based on Nakaba Suzuki's manga The Seven Deadly Sins, it is the first half of a two-part story co-produced by Alfred Imageworks and Marvy Jack for Netflix. Unlike earlier entries, it uses CG animation. Key members of the original voice cast return, with Ayumu Murase voicing the teenage Tristan and Mikako Komatsu the younger Tristan.

After their coronation as king and queen of Liones, Meliodas, of the Demon Clan, and Elizabeth, of the Goddess Clan, have a son, Tristan, who inherits the powers of both parents. At ten, while training with Lancelot, the son of Ban and a fairy, Tristan loses control to the demon side of his nature and gravely injures his friend, who vanishes shortly after. Ashamed and frightened of losing control again, Tristan turns to the gentler, healing side of his abilities, straining his bond with his parents.

Four years later Elizabeth falls gravely ill from a curse cast by Priest, a servant of Deathpierce, a former Holy Knight who seeks revenge for the injustices he suffered at the hands of the Demon and Goddess Clans fourteen years earlier. Tristan's goddess powers cannot cure his mother, so when he senses Priest he rushes out of the kingdom alone to save her. Gowther tracks him and alerts their old companions from the disbanded Seven Deadly Sins. Meanwhile Deathpierce is capturing demons, giants and fairies and fusing them into monstrous chimeras with his mystical Chaos Staff, planning to use them to conquer Liones.

On the road Tristan meets a hostile fairy who has rescued three non-human children from the Empties, the magical automatons serving Deathpierce. Uneasy allies, the pair trail the captive parents of those children to Edinburgh, the stronghold Deathpierce rules, and free them. When Tristan is nearly killed while struggling to master his demonic instincts, the fairy saves him and takes on a human form, revealing himself to be Lancelot.

Netflix released the film on December 20, 2022, with Part 2 following in August 2023. Anime News Network gave it a B-minus, enjoying the chance to reconnect with the characters and their children and calling it the start of a pretty good adventure, while IGN found it entertaining but incomplete.

overview: In the near future, 10 death row convicts are forced to compete in a virtual reality game that pits them against dinosaurs and each other.
tagline: Win the games. Win your freedom.
title: The Jurassic Games
plot:
The Jurassic Games is a 2018 American low-budget science fiction action film written and directed by Ryan Bellgardt, produced by High Octane Pictures and distributed by Uncork'd Entertainment. It stars Adam Hampton as Tucker, a death-row inmate, with Ryan Merriman as the Host, Perrey Reeves as the producer Savannah and Katie Burgess as Joy, alongside Daniel Barton, Ron Clemons, Dylan Cox and Erika Daly. It runs 86 minutes and was promoted with the tagline "Win the games. Win your freedom."

In the near future, ten convicts on death row are chosen to take part in the Jurassic Games, a televised virtual reality competition broadcast to a huge international audience. Plugged into a simulated world of deserts and jungles, the contestants must survive attacks by digital dinosaurs as well as each other. Only one of them can emerge as the winner and earn freedom; the catch is that anyone who dies inside the game dies in the real world as well. Tucker insists that he is an innocent man and is determined to survive so he can return to his children, who watch him on television as he fights for his life. His fellow contestants include Joy, a teenage psychopath, and a cartel boss, and their backstories are filled in as the competition goes on. Presiding over the spectacle is the flamboyant Host, who wears a sharp suit and a black dinosaur helmet, while the ruthless Savannah runs the show behind the scenes. The film repeatedly cuts away to viewers laughing at the carnage, and its story includes twists involving the characters' motives.

The film was released on DVD in the United States and United Kingdom in May 2018. Critics treated it as a mockbuster drawing on Jurassic Park, The Hunger Games, Death Race, The Matrix and Battle Royale. Luiz H. C. of Bloody Disgusting called it shallow but a legitimately entertaining ride, finding its self-aware satire of reality television better than expected and some of its dinosaur sequences surprisingly impressive, though the characters were one-dimensional; he singled out Hampton as a solid lead and Merriman as the most entertaining character. Zoe Crombie of Film Inquiry also praised Merriman's scene-stealing performance and Burgess's over-the-top turn, but criticized the weightless computer-generated creatures, uncreative cinematography, contradictory satire of violent media and reliance on racial stereotypes, concluding that it was less than the sum of its borrowed parts.

original_title: 名探偵コナン から紅の恋歌
overview: Bombing case at Nichiuri TV in autumn. The Satsuki Cup, which crowns the winner of Japan's Hyakunin Isshu, is currently being filmed inside the facility. The incident results in a big commotion and, while the building is burning to ashes, the only people left inside are Hattori and Toyama Kazuha. They get rescued just in time by Conan , who rushes to the scene. Both the identity and purposes of the bomber are unknown.
title: Detective Conan: The Crimson Love Letter
plot:
Detective Conan: The Crimson Love Letter is a 2017 Japanese mystery film that revolves around the story of Shinichi Kudo, a high school detective who is framed for murder and must use his wits to clear his name. 

The main theme of this movie is the power of love and relationships in overcoming adversity. Throughout the story, Shinichi's bond with his friends and family plays a crucial role in helping him stay strong and focused on solving the case. The film also explores the idea that true friendship can be a powerful force for good, as seen in the unwavering loyalty and support shown by those around Shinichi.

Another significant theme present in this movie is the struggle between justice and morality. As Shinichi navigates the complex web of clues and suspects, he must confront his own moral compass and make difficult choices that challenge his sense of right and wrong. This internal conflict adds depth to the story and highlights the complexities of real-life detective work.

The film also touches on the theme of identity and self-discovery, as Shinichi grapples with his dual identities as Kudo Shinichi and Conan Edogawa. The movie explores how these different personas intersect and impact each other, leading to a deeper understanding of oneself and one's place in the world.

Overall, Detective Conan: The Crimson Love Letter is a gripping mystery that weaves together themes of love, justice, identity, and self-discovery to create a compelling narrative that keeps viewers on the edge of their seats.

overview: A women-in-prison action comedy featuring girls running amok! Multiple Shower Scenes! Kung Fu Food Fights! Mutant Zombies! Evil Scientists, Prominent Product Placement, and Mud Wrastlin!
title: Prison-A-Go-Go!
plot:
Prison-A-Go-Go! is a 2003 American low-budget action comedy directed by Barak Epstein, who wrote it with Mike Wiebe, and produced by WorldWide International Picture Studios, known for campy B-movies. A deliberate parody of and homage to the women-in-prison exploitation genre, it also borrows from zombie horror, mad-scientist pictures and ninja films. Laurie Walton plays the heroine Janie, with Lauren Graham as her sister Callista, Travis Willingham as the villainous Dr. Hurtrider, Rhonda Shear as the inmate Jackpot and Ilram Choi as a ninja, while Mary Woronov and the Troma Entertainment chief Lloyd Kaufman make cameo appearances and Wiebe plays the prison's new warden.

Janie, a small-town veterinarian, sees her sister kidnapped by the henchmen of Dr. Hurtrider, a self-described scientist and torturer who intends to experiment on Callista in his absurd quest to cure the common cold, using torture, lobotomies and genetic mutation even on people who are not sick. The abductors conveniently leave behind a business card giving the doctor's address as the biggest prison in the Philippines, and the dim-witted Janie concludes that the only way to reach her sister is to get herself locked up there. She kills a local vagrant, receives her sentence and is shipped off to the institution.

Inside, she finds a surreal place where the guards are gay, the women are more victims of fashion than of violence and the newly hired warden, appointed by an executive played by Woronov, is spectacularly lazy. An on-screen shower clock counts down to the next of the film's many shower scenes. Teaming up with the queen bee Jackpot, a gang of fellow inmates and a reluctant, acrobatic ninja, Janie must find Callista before Hurtrider turns her into a human-porcupine hybrid, while his laboratory experiments also produce flesh-eating zombies. The film also promised kung fu food fights and mud wrestling.

Shot on 35 mm film with rented equipment, Prison-A-Go-Go! premiered at the 2003 Deep Ellum Film Festival, where it was named best feature, and it won four prizes at that year's B-Movie Film Festival, including best B-movie, best director and best actress for Shear, followed by festival awards in 2004. It was released on DVD in 2005. Critics were largely unimpressed. DVD Talk found it a tiresome spoof with occasional laughs, praising Woronov, Wiebe and Choi, and Film Blitz felt it pointed out the genre's clichés without exaggerating them enough to be truly funny.

overview: Bourne is brought out of hiding once again by reporter Simon Ross who is trying to unveil Operation Blackbriar, an upgrade to Project Treadstone, in a series of newspaper columns. Information from the reporter stirs a new set of memories, and Bourne must finally uncover his dark past while dodging The Company's best efforts to eradicate him.
tagline: Remember everything. Forgive nothing.
title: The Bourne Ultimatum
plot:
The Bourne Ultimatum is a 2007 action-thriller film directed by Paul Greengrass, starring Matt Damon as Jason Bourne. The movie is the third installment in the Bourne series and concludes the story of the amnesiac assassin.

Beginning:
The film opens with Jason Bourne (Matt Damon) on the run from the CIA, who are trying to capture him for his alleged crimes. Bourne is haunted by fragmented memories of his past, which he struggles to piece together. He encounters Nicky Parsons (Julia Stiles), a former CIA operative who helps him uncover more about his identity.

Plot Development:
As Bourne delves deeper into his past, he discovers that the CIA has been experimenting on him using advanced techniques such as memory erasure and implantation. He also learns that he was created by the Treadstone program, a secret black ops organization within the CIA. The program's goal was to create super-soldiers through mind control and conditioning.

Bourne's investigation leads him to uncover a conspiracy involving the CIA's attempts to cover up their involvement in the assassination of several world leaders, including the President of Russia. He also discovers that his memories are false and that he is not who he thinks he is.

As Bourne gets closer to the truth, he is pursued by the CIA and other agents, including Noah Vosen (David Strathairn), a ruthless agent tasked with capturing him. Bourne's only ally is Pamela Landy (Joan Allen), a senior CIA officer who begins to question her agency's motives.

Ending:
The film culminates in an intense action sequence where Bourne confronts Vosen and the CIA's attempts to silence him. In a thrilling finale, Bourne outsmarts his pursuers and escapes, but not before discovering that he is still being hunted by the CIA.

In a surprising twist, it is revealed that Bourne has been playing into the hands of the CIA all along, using his skills to gather intelligence on their operations. The film ends with Bourne walking away from the chaos, leaving the audience wondering what will happen next in his journey.

Overall, The Bourne Ultimatum is a gripping and intense thriller that explores themes of identity, loyalty, and the blurred lines between good and evil. Matt Damon's performance as Jason Bourne cements his status as one of Hollywood's most iconic action heroes.

overview: While attending college in Cape Town, Melea Martin feels constrained by the school's strict policies, and decides to set out on her own. Searching for a way to use her talents as a dancer and inspire the community around her, Melea rents a failing theater in order to put on a Hip-Hop Romeo and Juliet performance. But much like the Capulets and Montagues, conflicts between cast members threaten to bring the whole performance to a halt...
title: Honey 3: Dare to Dance
plot:
Honey 3: Dare to Dance is a 2016 American dance film directed by Bille Woodruff, who also directed the first two Honey films, from a script by Catherine Cyran. The third installment of the series, it stars Cassie Ventura as Melea Martin and Kenny Wormald as Erik Wildwood, with Dena Kaplan as Nadine, Sibongile Mlambo as Ishani Mfeke, Bobby Lockwood as Laser and Clayton Evertson as Taj Mfeka, and it moves the franchise to Cape Town, South Africa.

Melea, an American dance student at a prestigious South African school, plans her thesis presentation as a contemporary hip-hop adaptation of Romeo and Juliet, to be performed with her love interest, Erik, in honor of her late mother. Her dream collapses when she cannot pay her tuition and is forced to leave the school. Determined not to give up, she rents a failing theater and sets out to win over the local community to support her unconventional production, recruiting her childhood friend Nadine and her classmate Laser. At a club dance battle she clashes with Ishani, a street-tough Cape Town local who never backs down from a fight or a dance-off and who has hardened herself after the loss of her brother. When Melea asks her to choreograph the show together, the two rivals form an unlikely partnership. As rehearsals intensify, rival dance crews and clashing egos threaten to tear the company apart, echoing the feud between Shakespeare's Capulets and Montagues, while a romantic love triangle and personal conflicts complicate matters further. Daring to follow her vision, Melea risks everything to stage a performance the Cape Town community will not forget.

Woodruff said that shooting in South Africa was a way to take the franchise somewhere new and explore different styles of dance, calling dance a universal language and pointing to the city's large dance community. Mlambo's casting was announced in November 2015, followed later that month by Ventura's, and filming in Cape Town ran through December 20, 2015, for Universal 1440 Entertainment, the original production arm of Universal Pictures Home Entertainment. The film was released on Netflix and on DVD and Blu-ray in the United States on September 6, 2016, earning about $271,000 from domestic home video sales. Its soundtrack included songs by Major Lazer, Jason Derulo and Cassie, alongside six tracks from South African composer Mark Kilian.

overview: After Will Spann's wife suddenly vanishes at a gas station, his desperate search to find her leads him down a dark path that forces him to run from authorities and take the law into his own hands.
tagline: He'll stop at nothing to get her back.
title: Last Seen Alive
plot:
Last Seen Alive is a 2022 American action thriller directed by Brian Goodman from a screenplay by Marc Frydman, starring Gerard Butler, who also produced it, with Jaimie Alexander and Russell Hornsby. Shot under the title Chase, it follows a man who takes the law into his own hands to find his missing wife. It was released in the United States on June 3, 2022.

Will Spann, a wealthy real-estate agent, is driving his wife, Lisa, to her parents' house at a moment when their marriage is in trouble. While he fills the tank at a gas station, Lisa goes into the store for water and never comes back. Finding only her belongings, Will calls 911 and is told by Detective Paterson to wait, but instead he goes to Lisa's parents, Barry and Anna Adams, who have never fully trusted him and can tell him nothing. Back at the station, the clerk, Oscar, claims the security cameras are broken, but Will spots one that is working, fights Oscar for the recorder and hands it to the police. The footage shows Lisa leaving with a man before a passing truck blocks the view. Angered when Paterson asks about Lisa's life insurance, Will shows the video to her parents, who recognize their handyman, Knuckles.

Will tracks down and overpowers Knuckles, who admits that he delivered Lisa to a man named Frank and agrees to lead Will to his hideout. Forced to abandon his SUV, with the bound Knuckles in the back, when police pull him over, Will makes his way through the forest to Frank's camp, a run-down drug lab where he also finds Oscar. A gunfight leaves Frank and one of his men dead, apparently taking Lisa's location with them, while Paterson learns from Knuckles, who had been coerced by Frank, that Lisa is supposedly dead. When Oscar demands money for information, the drug lab explodes and kills him. As Paterson finds the grave Knuckles described empty, Will hears banging from a shed and discovers Lisa tied up but alive. Paterson later notes that some of the burned bodies had gunshot wounds, but chooses not to pursue it.

Butler plays Will, Alexander plays Lisa and Hornsby plays Paterson, with Ethan Embry as Knuckles, Michael Irby as Oscar and David Kallaway as Frank.
